chapters.title: Chapter 151: Breeding the Highest Intelligent Life
paragraphs: “Reporting to Master.” Yang Yi bowed slightly, his tone calm, “With the current assets of the Divine Kingdom, it is sufficient to support the early development of the Mechanical Path.”

“However, the Mechanical Path belongs to a high-consumption System and requires long-term investment of massive Resources, including various metals, equipment, research institutes, and core creation units.”

“At the same time, it also needs to occupy quite a bit of land in the Divine Kingdom. If we choose to develop it, it will slow down the development speed of the Cultivation and Martial Arts believers for quite a long time.”
Yang Fan’s gaze narrowed slightly, “How will it drag us down? Give a detailed analysis.”
“Starting large model calculation...”
Yang Yi’s voice paused slightly, and then a string of data unfolded in the Void Realm.

“First, capital consumption. In the Early Stage, it is necessary to purchase the Mechanical Heart (basic grade), F-grade industrial metals, energy cores, conduction Materials, and various special minerals. The initial investment alone is expected to be no less than 10 million Divinity Points.”

“Second, land occupation. It is necessary to allocate about 1 million square kilometers of land for the development of the Mechanical Divine Kingdom. This area will be used for the construction of Mechanical cities, production lines, material reserve zones, and basic research institutes. This move will compress the living space of believers on a small scale and affect population growth.”

“Third, resource diversion. In the Early Stage, the Mechanical System cannot form effective combat power, and all investments are pure consumption. It will significantly reduce the resource supply for Cultivation and Martial Arts believers.”
“Fourth, maintenance costs. Mechanical units require regular maintenance and consume a large amount of metal Resources. In the long run, resource consumption will continue to grow.”

“According to comprehensive calculations, under the premise of not reducing investment in believers, given the current income and expenditure structure of the Divine Kingdom, the funds will be completely exhausted in about 30,000 years.”
After listening to Yang Yi’s report, Yang Fan chuckled softly.
When all was said and done, it was still a matter of money.
And what he lacked least happened to be time and funds.
Thirty thousand years? Under the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, it was only ten months, and it was impossible for him to do nothing during these ten months.
Divine Kingdom War, Divine Kingdom expansion, resource plundering, and Divine Kingdom investment would all proceed simultaneously.
The extra land could completely continue to be used for investment.
High-yield projects like the Dragon Marsh Water Mansion and Spirit Peach Mountain occupied a huge area and had an investment cap, but he had more flexible choices.
Fixed assets such as the Moon Well and Sun Spring occupied very little land, yet they could continuously output returns.
Today, the area occupied by the 500,000 Moon Wells and Sun Springs was even less than one percent of the total area of the forest where the Elf Race resided.
The annualized yield of a single Moon Well was only 12%, but under the blessing of the Evolution Talent, it was 1,200%.
A full twelvefold return in a year was already an extremely terrifying payout. As long as Yang Fan was willing, even if he took the most conservative investment route, he would not lack funds.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan’s eyes narrowed slightly, and he already had a decision in his heart.
The Mechanical Path should indeed be put on the agenda.

“Yang Yi, I want to develop the Mechanical Divine Kingdom. Give me a complete plan. No need to consider funding issues; the goal is to let the Mechanical Path catch up with the Cultivation and Martial Arts Systems at the fastest speed,” Yang Fan commanded.
“Yes, Master,” Yang Yi immediately responded.
“Apply to purchase Mechanical Heart X1, Elementary industrial city X1 (covering an area of about 1 million square kilometers).”
“Supporting facilities include energy conversion devices, Mechanical production lines, and intelligent control centers.”
“Resource-class purchases include F-grade metals, recycled metal reserves, conductive Ores, energy crystals, and industrial modules.”
“Auxiliary facilities include ordinary research institutes (Elementary), maintenance centers, and resource dispatch Systems.”
“Total initial investment is about 10 million Divinity Points.”
“Approve the application,” Yang Fan said without hesitation.
“In addition, please give me temporary Divine Decree authority to migrate some believers.”
“They will serve as the first batch of targets cultivated by the Mechanical System.”
“Approved.”
“In addition, purchase Moon Wells and Sun Springs in batches from the market. The more the better,” Yang Fan said.

“Master, the returns on such assets are relatively low, and large-scale investment is not recommended. Moreover, the current ecology of the Elf Race is already sufficient to support its development,” Yang Yi reminded.
“Then do you have a better investment choice? The Dragon Marsh Water Mansion and Spirit Peach Mountain occupy too much area and are close to the investment cap,” Yang Fan asked rhetorically.

“If Divine Kingdom investment is the core direction, it is recommended to prioritize purchasing Spiritual Veins. Not only can they significantly optimize the environment of the Divine Kingdom, but their returns also far exceed low-level buildings like Moon Wells.”

Hearing this, Yang Fan could not help but slap his own head, “If you had not mentioned it, I would have forgotten. I am currently in Taichu City and possess the purchasing authority for Spiritual Veins. As an A-grade building, even if we only count the output of Spirit Stones, its returns far exceed C-grade buildings.”

“Yang Yi, start purchasing Spiritual Veins on a large scale. On Penglai Island, on the ground of the Divine Kingdom, at the bottom of the rivers—as long as the Divine Kingdom has space, bury them all and max out the Spiritual Vein investment first!” Yang Fan said.
“But Master,” Yang Yi’s tone paused slightly, “This move will consume a huge amount of funds and is very likely to seriously slow down the development pace of the Divine Kingdom.”
“Do as I say,” Yang Fan directly interrupted.
“After the Spiritual Veins are fully paved, continue to purchase Moon Wells and Sun Springs on a large scale. Reserve 100 million Divinity Points as emergency funds, and invest all the rest.”
“As for the funds for the development of the Divine Kingdom, you do not need to worry.”
Yang Fan’s command fell, leaving no room for doubt.
Under the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, in the Real World, it would not exceed two months for all investments to be fully recouped.
Lacking Resources? That did not exist at all.
As long as Yang Fan was willing, the investment returns of the Divine Kingdom could even multiply several times over.
Consciousness returning to reality, Yang Fan let out a light breath.
“These Intelligent Life forms cannot perceive the SSS-Rank Evolution Talent. To a certain extent, their judgments instead limit the development upper limit of the Divine Kingdom.”
“Should I... set a set of rules for them? Making decisions according to the hundredfold time flow rate of the Divine Kingdom?” Yang Fan frowned slightly and murmured in a low voice.
But soon, he rejected this idea.
The SSS-rank Talent was his biggest trump card and also his biggest hidden danger.
Even though Yang Yi, Yang Er, and Yang San were bound to the Origin of the Divine Kingdom, they were produced from other Mechanical Divine Kingdoms after all.
Even if the risk was only one in ten thousand, or even one in a hundred million, he was not willing to gamble.
As his strength increased and he saw more, Yang Fan became even more cautious instead.
“Forget it, it is mainly deviations in investment judgment. I will just keep a closer eye on them from now on,” Yang Fan muttered to himself.
Meanwhile, changes had already taken place inside the Divine Kingdom.
Under Yang Yi’s overall arrangement, the Mechanical Civilization had already begun to take shape.

Overlooking the entire Divine Kingdom, the pattern gradually became distinct: On Penglai Island, clouds and mist curled, and Spiritual Qi was like a tide. Cultivation believers sat cross-legged and breathed in and out, just like a fairyland. In the left-leaning area of the Divine Kingdom’s ground, the blood and qi of Martial Arts believers soared to the sky, and the Worlds Number One Martial Arts Arena stretched out in patches. Fist Intent, Saber Intent, and Battle Intent converged like a flood. On the right side, a brand-new city quietly rose.
That was a city of a completely different style.
Steel as the bones and metal as the walls, the city was piled with all kinds of Resources.
High-purity metals, energy crystals, Mechanical components, modular assemblies, and even food were decomposed into standardized reserve units.
The entire city was cold, orderly, and efficient, without the slightest redundancy.
Inside the city, a full 5 million believers knelt on the ground in utter silence.
All their gazes converged at the center of the city, where a ball of pure white light was suspended in mid-air.
The light was soft yet filled with a sense of oppression, as if it were breeding a certain supreme life.
“Mechanical Heart...” Yang Fan whispered to himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 152: Where's My Money???
paragraphs: Even though Yang Fan was in reality, he could still clearly perceive that the ball of light was “alive.”
Unlike Yang Yi and the others, this aura was closer to the Divine Kingdom’s Origin, as if it had always belonged here.
The life being nurtured within it was like a believer, yet seemed superior to one. It was an existence somewhere between “life” and “rules.”
The believers in the city were like worshiping a god, while the life in the light ball evolved while establishing a connection with the entire Divine Kingdom.
Time passed, and thirty years in the Divine Kingdom flashed by.
Finally, the light receded, and the Mechanical Heart evolved into an Intelligent Life.
At the same time, Yang Fan’s consciousness descended into the Divine Kingdom.
A figure instantly appeared before him.
Yang Fan’s pupils constricted slightly; the person in front of him looked exactly like him.
Face, temperament, demeanor, even the clothing was identical, just like seeing himself in a mirror.
But the strange thing was, Yang Fan’s subconscious didn’t feel the slightest bit of rejection or worry; instead, it felt perfectly natural.
As if that was “him,” another self.
“Master.” The other party spoke, his voice completely identical to Yang Fan’s. “I am the Divine Kingdom’s highest Intelligent Life.”
Yang Fan took a deep breath to steady himself. “You... between us?”
Yang Fan had a strange feeling; the other party was completely different from Yang Yi and the others. He could clearly perceive his emotions, even his thoughts.
It was like facing another self; the feeling was quite wonderful!

“Master, you can understand me as an ‘extension of your will,’ or perhaps a proxy of the god.” He spoke slowly, his tone calm. “The Mechanical Heart is a rule-level creation. Each Divine Kingdom can only give birth to one highest Intelligent Life. From the moment of my birth, I possess all sub-permissions and am absolutely loyal to Master.”

He looked directly at Yang Fan and continued, “I can coordinate the development of the Divine Kingdom, plan resource flows, optimize believer structure, formulate war strategies, and simulate future Evolution. As long as it is within the dimension of the Divine Kingdom, all variables are within my control.”

“Master only needs to set the goal, and I will handle everything else.” He bowed slightly, saying proudly, “I am the Divine Kingdom’s second ‘brain,’ as well as the extension and amplification of Master’s will.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but ask, “In other words, you can replace all the work of Yang Yi, Yang Er, and Yang San?”

“Not for now,” the other party replied bluntly. “Currently, I am only a first-grade Intelligent Life. My computing power and deduction capabilities are far inferior to theirs; they still possess extremely high value.”
“As the Divine Kingdom develops, resources may be invested in them and they may be upgraded in the future to build a more efficient management system.”
“So, you’re basically useless right now?” Yang Fan blinked.
“Of course not. Intelligent lives purchased from the Divine Shop, like Yang Yi, have a bottom-layer logic centered on’stability’.”
“The advantage is safety, but the disadvantage is an extremely low ceiling. They cannot break through frameworks to make radical decisions and require higher permissions for coordination.”

He paused for a moment and then said, “As for Master, your Nine-year Compulsory Education level is completely half-baked. Being able to get to where you are today basically relies on your SSS-rank Evolution Talent.”
The air instantly went silent, and Yang Fan’s expression changed.
It wasn’t because he was called a poor student, but because the other party actually knew about the existence of the SSS-rank Talent.
“You know?”
“Rest assured, Master. I am an extension of your will, and because of that, I can perceive the existence of the Evolution Talent.”

After saying that, he added, “Furthermore, Master’s previous caution was correct. In the first year of the Divine Kingdom, Divine Shop intelligent lives once faced a risk of information leakage. A god from a high-tier Mechanical Divine Kingdom implanted hidden instructions in the bottom-layer code of intelligent lives, which could transmit core information like Divine Kingdom coordinates and investment structures during long-term operation.”
“That god used this to obtain a vast amount of intelligence and continued to seize resources through his Family’s descendants in trade, investment, and war.”
“Ultimately, it triggered an attack by many Human Race gods. That Family was forced to defect from the Human Race and join the alien races, becoming a massive stain on human history.”

His tone remained calm, as if stating facts. “However, Master does not need to worry. The federal supreme intelligent life has patched all vulnerabilities. Current Divine Shop intelligent lives are all safe versions.”
“But the value of an SSS-rank Talent is too great; keeping it hidden is the optimal choice.”
After hearing this, the last bit of wariness in Yang Fan’s heart slowly dissipated.
Since the other party could already perceive his talent, there was no point in hiding it.
Moreover, the “sense of connection” he felt with the highest Intelligent Life couldn’t be faked.
He could doubt anyone, but he couldn’t doubt himself.
“Ahem, I can’t keep calling you ‘highest Intelligent Life.’ I’ll give you a name. Let’s call you Yang...” Yang Fan coughed lightly.
“Stop right there.” The other party directly raised his hand.
“Master, according to memory analysis, you do not possess a talent for naming. I have already chosen one for myself.”
Yang Fan was stunned. “What is it?”
The other party’s face was calm, but his tone carried a hint of pride. “I’ll be called Yang... Da.”
“What?”
“I said, my name is Yang Da.”
He tilted his chin up. “Besides Master, I am the greatest in this Divine Kingdom.”
Yang Fan’s face twitched slightly. “...”
“Master, what’s with that expression?”
“Nothing. You truly are my will; this name is very... sophisticated.” Yang Fan nodded expressionlessly.
(Thinking: Might as well have called him Yang Four...)
“Mm.” Yang Da clearly enjoyed the praise, a hint of “smugness” appearing in his expression.
Compared to Yang Yi and the others, Yang Da was indeed different.
Although he was only a first-grade Intelligent Life, he possessed complete emotions, just like another Soul of Yang Fan.
His consciousness returned to reality. Yang Fan lay on his bed and let out a long sigh of relief.
That night, he slept particularly soundly. The appearance of Yang Da finally gave him a reason to completely slack off.

With an Intelligent Life around, why would he, the god, need to worry about the development of the Divine Kingdom? Isn’t it better to just lie flat? One shouldn’t look for trouble where there is none.
He slept until dawn. The next day, Yang Fan stretched and checked the Divine Kingdom’s information, then immediately froze in place.
“Divinity Points: 2.6”
Yang Fan: “?”
He stared at the panel, silent for three seconds.
“Where’s my money?”
“Wait...”
“What’s going on? Where are the emergency funds?”
“All gone???”
Yang Fan’s pupils shook. “Are all the bullets used up?”
“A direct all-in???”
With a thought, Yang Fan’s consciousness instantly descended into the Divine Kingdom.
The next moment, he was even more shocked by the sight before him.
In just one night, fifty years had passed in the Divine Kingdom. And the scene before him was completely beyond his recognition.
At some point, a magnificent palace had appeared in the center of the Divine Kingdom.
With stone and gold as the foundation, spiritual jade as pillars, layered halls, and flowing rosy light. The entire palace was luxurious to the extreme.
And in the main hall, Yang Da sat high on an imperial throne, wearing a gold-patterned robe, looking languid.
On the left, Yang Yi stood straight, respectfully pouring wine for him; on the right, Yang Er held a tray and presented spiritual fruits.
Even more ridiculous, a “Beauty Pageant” was taking place below.
Hundreds of female believers entered one after another, wearing clothes Yang Da had somehow bought—silks and satins, exotic finery, gauzes, battle skirts, ritual robes...

In various styles, each with a graceful figure and outstanding appearance, they were clearly all carefully selected. There were even two female believers at the Foundation Establishment Realm among them.
“...” Yang Fan was silent for three seconds, almost spitting blood in anger the next moment.
“What the hell is going on?!”
What happened to developing the Divine Kingdom?
You, an Intelligent Life, are here holding a Concubine Selection???
Do you even have reproductive needs?!
DO YOU?!!

“A direct all-in???”
With a thought, Yang Fan’s consciousness instantly descended into the Divine Kingdom.
The next moment, he was even more shocked by the sight before him.
In just one night, fifty years had passed in the Divine Kingdom.
And the scene before him was completely beyond his recognition.
At some point, a magnificent palace had appeared in the center of the Divine Kingdom.
With stone and gold as the foundation, spiritual jade as pillars, layered halls, and flowing rosy light.
The entire palace was luxurious to the extreme.
And in the main hall, Yang Da sat high on an imperial throne, wearing a gold-patterned robe, looking languid.
On the left, Yang Yi stood straight, respectfully pouring wine for him; on the right, Yang Er held a tray and presented spiritual fruits.
Even more ridiculous, a “Beauty Pageant” was taking place below.
Hundreds of female believers entered one after another, wearing clothes Yang Da had somehow bought—silks and satins, exotic finery, gauzes, battle skirts, ritual robes...
In various styles, each with a graceful figure and outstanding appearance, they were clearly all carefully selected.
There were even two female believers at the Foundation Establishment Realm among them.
“...” Yang Fan was silent for three seconds, almost spitting blood in anger the next moment.
“What the hell is going on?!”
What happened to developing the Divine Kingdom?
You, an Intelligent Life, are here holding a Concubine Selection???
Do you even have reproductive needs?!
DO YOU?!!

chapters.title: Chapter 153: The World Has Never Been Truly Fair
paragraphs: Yang Fan’s face darkened, his worldview beginning to shatter. He suddenly felt that his previous understanding of “Intelligent Life” might have been far too naive.
Right at that moment, Yang Da seemed to sense something.
In the next instant, his figure vanished directly from the imperial throne.
Clack— The wine glass hit the ground, spilling Monkey Wine all over the floor.
“Master,” Yang Da appeared before Yang Fan, bowing respectfully. “You have finally come.”
Looking at the face that was identical to his own, Yang Fan found it somewhat difficult to speak for a moment.
He felt like scolding him would be equivalent to scolding himself.
Yang Fan took a deep breath. “What are you doing?”
“Oh,” Yang Da replied naturally. “Just relaxing.”
“Currently, the divine kingdom is only about ten million square kilometers in size. Outside, Yang San handles combat, while inside, Yang Yi executes commands. The kingdom’s development is stable.”
“Why should I exhaust myself? Isn’t lying flat nice? As the highest Intelligent Life of the divine kingdom, I shouldn’t suffer unnecessary hardship,” Yang Da said as if it were completely natural.
“...” Yang Fan froze. Why did these words sound so familiar?
For a moment, he didn’t know how to respond. Looking at the resplendent palace in the distance, a subtle hint of envy flashed in Yang Fan’s eyes.
“You... are living pretty comfortably, aren’t you?” Yang Fan marveled.

“It’s alright,” Yang Da nodded. “Through these years of learning, I’ve gained an understanding not only of the divine kingdom, but also of the real world where Master resides. If Master is interested, I can share some life tips.”
“What tips?” Yang Fan’s interest was piqued.
“Tips on how to enjoy life, of course.”
“With the enhancement of the Evolution Talent, the kingdom’s revenue far surpasses that of ordinary gods. Since we earn so much, naturally, we must learn how to spend it.”
“Taichu City is too monotonous, but there are Vacation Planets nearby. The entertainment systems there are very well-developed.”
“Right, right, right!” Yang Fan chimed in instantly. “I stayed in a presidential suite before! The environment was indeed pretty nice.”
“Presidential suite?” Yang Da glanced at him with a hint of disdain. “What is that worth? Master could easily buy an entire commercial building—the kind with two elevators for three units.”
“Tianxiang Renjian even has sugar baby sponsorship services. Keeping an entire building filled with Demigod beauties wouldn’t be a problem at all.”
Yang Fan’s pupils dilated in shock. “You can play it like that?!”
“Of course. When the time comes, you can flip concubine tags every day, visiting whoever gets chosen.”
“You play this wildly???”
“We are wealthy people. Master needs to broaden your horizons.”
“...” Yang Fan was a little shaken. “Isn’t that... too extravagant? Besides, I’m married.”
“This is contributing to the Federation’s economy. We must think bigger,” Yang Da said solemnly.
Yang Fan nodded automatically, then suddenly remembered something and coughed heavily.

“Cough, cough! Don’t get off topic! We can discuss these small matters often in the future. I came this time to ask you: how did you spend all my six hundred million plus Divinity Points in a single night? Even for an investment, shouldn’t you leave some reserve funds?”

“Master, the divine kingdom has the Hundredfold Evolution Talent. A single day in reality brings an income of around ten million Divinity Points; why would we need reserve funds? Yesterday, I spent nearly six hundred million Divinity Points buying Spiritual Veins. Once loaded into the divine kingdom, the monthly net profit will exceed six hundred million.” Yang Da spoke calmly, yet with a matter-of-fact confidence.
“Where are the Spiritual Veins?”
“Yuan Zong, a Tier 3 God from Taichu City, will deliver the buildings this morning.”
Back in the trading area of Taichu City, Yang Fan had casually added the contact information of many shopkeepers.

Yuan Zong was one of them. He specialized in buying and selling resource-type buildings. Yang Fan had purchased Spiritual Veins from him several times before, and it had always been delivered by his Subordinate Gods.
“You bought this much all at once?” Yang Fan frowned slightly.
Unlike Yang Yi, as the highest Intelligent Life of the divine kingdom, Yang Da could perceive the faint trace of worry in Yang Fan’s heart.

“Master need not worry. I will not make dangerous moves behind your back,” Yang Da said calmly. “This is Taichu City, one of the most prosperous planets of the Human Race. Countless direct descendants of the Five Great Giants reside here. Spending a few hundred million Divinity Points is by no means extravagant.”
“Moreover, Master is now a Human Race Prodigy, and many major factions are interested in investing in you. They won’t suspect anything.”
Hearing this analysis, Yang Fan relaxed slightly in his heart.
In comparison, human information processing capabilities were limited after all. Since Yang Da had already made the judgment, Yang Fan naturally trusted it.
Although his consciousness still remained in the divine kingdom, as a Demigod, he could still vaguely sense everything in the outside world.
Just then, a crisp doorbell rang in the real world.
Yang Fan’s consciousness jolted slightly as he quickly withdrew from the divine kingdom and returned to reality.
Opening his eyes, clarity returned to his gaze, and he stood up to walk toward the main door.
As the door opened, a figure with a deep and profound aura stood quietly outside.
Yang Fan’s gaze narrowed slightly; the visitor turned out to be Yuan Zong himself.
Unlike before, this Tier 3 God had actually come to his doorstep in person.
“Your Highness Yang Fan, all the Spiritual Vein buildings you ordered are here.” Yuan Zong’s face was beaming with smiles, his tone warm and respectful. “We welcome your next visit.”
In Taichu City, resource-type buildings were never as popular as combat-type buildings and Wonder buildings.
Yang Fan’s order this time, a Spiritual Vein purchase worth nearly six hundred million Divinity Points, qualified as one of the top ten big orders of the year for Yuan Zong.

Although security in Taichu City was tight, the value of this batch of resources was simply too astounding. He ultimately felt uneasy leaving it to a Subordinate God for delivery, so he simply made the trip himself.
“Thank you.” Yang Fan took the resource card, his tone calm.

“With these resources, combined with Your Highness’s S-rank Talent of Tenfold Time Sequence, you will certainly make a blockbuster impression at Primordial Academy,” Yuan Zong flattered opportunistically.
Yang Fan merely nodded faintly, exchanging a few brief pleasantries before closing the door.
Outside the door, Yuan Zong did not leave immediately. Instead, he turned back to look at the quiet small courtyard.
A hint of envy unconsciously surfaced in his eyes as he murmured softly, “A Human Race Prodigy indeed lives up to his reputation.”

“Merely at the Demigod Realm, yet his divine kingdom can be equipped with resource buildings on such a scale, with major factions competing to invest... This starting point is already a height that countless people cannot reach in their entire lives.”
He shook his head gently and turned to leave.
Five or six hundred million Divinity Points—if placed in the outside world, some small Families exhausting their entire foundations might still fail to gather it.
Yet in this Taichu City, even an ordinary Divine Being might hide unimaginable wealth within their divine kingdom.
The world has never been truly fair.
Some exhaust their lives merely bustling about for food and clothing, while others are born already standing at the destination that countless people look up to.
What truly determines height has never been effort alone, but rather the starting point, Opportunity, and that subtle, indescribable luck.

chapters.title: Chapter 154: The Essence of Divine Kingdom Investment
paragraphs: Inside the room.
Yang Fan took a deep breath, suppressing all stray thoughts.
The next moment, with a thought, he threw all the Spiritual Vein Cards in his hand into the Divine Kingdom.
‘Boom!’

As if an invisible force exploded between heaven and earth, phantoms of Spiritual Veins emerged from the Void Realm, coiled like Dragons, and then quickly merged into various parts of the Divine Kingdom.
The earth trembled, and mountains and rivers rose and fell.
Spiritual Qi gushed out from deep underground like a torrent, turning into extremely thick mist that quickly permeated the entire Divine Kingdom.
Within just a few breaths, the concentration of Spiritual Qi in the Divine Kingdom surged by more than a hundredfold!
In the sky, spiritual clouds surged; on the ground, plants grew wildly, and mountain rocks glowed.
All believers sensed this earth-shaking change almost at the same time.
Their expressions were fanatical as they knelt on the ground one after another.
“Thank you for the gift of my God!”
“My God is eternal!”
“I am willing to dedicate everything to my God!”
Pious shouts rose and fell, echoing throughout the Divine Kingdom.
In the Real World, Yang Fan’s body was also undergoing changes.
A warm and majestic force slowly surged from the depths of the Divine Kingdom, feeding back into his Physical Body in the Real World.
That feeling was not a simple increase in power. It was more like an enhancement of some kind of “upper limit.”
It was as if the capacity of the original container had been forcibly widened, and the power it could carry was raised invisibly.
In the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan’s gaze fell on the forest where the Ancient Spirit Tree was located.
Now, that area had long since changed drastically.
Numerous Moon Wells and Sun Springs were spread out like leaves, covering almost the entire forest. The extremely thick breath of life flowed in the air, as if turning into a substantial haze.
Even those originally ordinary shrubs were quietly transforming. Their branches and leaves became more lush, their trunks became tough, and they faintly revealed a bit of spirituality.
“You spent the rest of the funds on Moon Wells and Sun Springs?” Yang Fan was somewhat puzzled.

“C-grade buildings are too cheap,” Yang Da’s tone was calm. “I purchased a total of two hundred million units, spending only six hundred thousand Divinity Points. Now, the forest where the Elf Race is located has been completely filled.”
“If it weren’t for cultivating the subordinate race, these C-grade buildings themselves wouldn’t be worth investing in.”
With the support of the Evolution Talent, even if it’s just a C-grade building, it can bring Yang Fan nearly six hundred thousand Divinity Points in revenue every month in the Real World.
But compared to the massive investment portfolio of the entire Divine Kingdom, this bit of income is indeed just a drop in the bucket.
“After the Ancient Spirit Tree grows into a elf holy tree, buildings like Moon Wells will lose their acceleration effect. At that time, they can all be sold off to recover funds,” Yang Da said.

“According to the Master’s idea, you planned to fill the entire Divine Kingdom with Moon Wells and Sun Springs. Although the individual yield is low, by relying on quantity, they can pile up an amazing total yield.” Yang Da paused, his tone shifting slightly, “However, I do not recommend doing this.”
“Why?” Yang Fan asked.
“There are two reasons.”
Yang Da spoke slowly, his tone calm and clear.
“First, the investment efficiency is too low.”
“Under the enhancement of the Evolution Talent, the yield of C-grade buildings can indeed be called exorbitant. But the problem is, this is a waste of the Divine Kingdom’s resource slots.”
“The space in the Divine Kingdom is limited. Using it to carry low-tier yield buildings is essentially sacrificing the future upper limit.”
He raised his hand and tapped lightly, and several sets of data appeared in the Void Realm.

“With the current investment structure of the Divine Kingdom, if the Evolution Talent is not considered, the return on investment for the Monkey Wine Spring is about 50%, and Dragon Fish farming is close to 100%.”
“Such returns are already enough to support the current resource cycle of the Divine Kingdom.”
“But this is only a stage-specific optimal solution. When the Master promotes to a Low-tier God, the investment targets you can access will be completely different.”
“For example, mass forging of high-tier weapons, large-scale cultivation of special medicinal materials, or even raising True Dragons and Phoenixes with Nascent Soul-level combat power.”
“The stronger the strength, the more high-return projects you can participate in.”
Yang Da’s gaze narrowed slightly.
“If you rely on the Evolution Talent to forcibly raise the yield of low-end investments, this is essentially a form of laziness.”

“The development of a Divine Kingdom is like sailing against the current; if you don’t advance, you retreat. On the war level, stability is needed; but on the investment level, you must constantly iterate toward higher yields and higher potential.”
“Given the Master’s current status as a Human Race Prodigy, using a large number of resource slots to carry C-grade buildings is essentially losing opportunity costs.”
Yang Da said this with a tone of absolute rationality.
He turned around and waved his right hand lightly. A light blue light screen spread out in the air, like a miniature panoramic map of the Divine Kingdom.
“As for the second reason, it is the risk of war.”
“As the Divine Kingdom continues to develop, the exposure of coordinates is an inevitable result. If Moon Wells and Sun Springs are deployed on a large scale in these areas, the result is obvious.”
He raised his hand and pointed to the vast area on the outskirts of the Divine Kingdom.
“They will be plundered at the first moment.” Yang Fan’s eyes narrowed, showing a look of contemplation.
“Divine Kingdom investment is not a case of ‘the more, the better.'”
Yang Da’s speaking speed increased slightly, entering a state of analysis that was almost like a deduction.
“The entire Divine Kingdom can be roughly divided into a three-layer structure.”

“The outermost layer is the buffer zone. This is the first point of contact in a war, and its main function is to weaken the enemy’s offensive and buy time. Defensive buildings, consumable positions, and low-value bait resources should be placed here to disperse the enemy’s fire and judgment.”
“The core logic of this layer is ‘disposable.'”
“Any high-value assets invested here are a waste of resources.”
He moved his finger slightly, pointing to the middle of the Divine Kingdom.

“The second layer is the combat zone. This is where the flames of war truly spread. Once a Divine Kingdom War breaks out, this place will almost certainly be repeatedly contested, and the battlefield for the believers of both sides will be here.”
“During non-war periods, this place is only suitable for medium-value assets to maintain basic output. Once war breaks out, the assets in this layer must be ready to be cleared at any time.”
“Its core logic is ‘damageable.'”
Finally, Yang Da’s finger fell toward the center of the Divine Kingdom.

“The third layer is the core zone. This is the true lifeblood of the Divine Kingdom. High-value resources, core assets, and key production systems must all be concentrated here and protected by the strongest defense system.”
“The logic of this layer is ‘indispensable.'”
Yang Da withdrew his hand, and the light screen slowly dissipated.

“Therefore, every unit of area in the Divine Kingdom is a strategic resource, not just a carrier for Divine Kingdom investment. How it is allocated depends on war expectations, the stage of growth, and the Master’s strength limit.”
“This is the essence of Divine Kingdom investment.”
After listening to this analysis, Yang Fan couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
It hadn’t been long since his Breakthrough to become a semi-god. Except for that initial Demi-god Demon Monkey, no real external enemy had ever stepped into his Divine Kingdom.
Because of this, his previous thinking was indeed somewhat one-dimensional.
Divine Kingdom investment is never about simple “yield maximization.” It must be matched with the overall combat power system.
Otherwise, even if you possess a mountain of treasure, one day it will only become someone else’s prize.

chapters.title: Chapter 155: f-class transformation pod
paragraphs: Yang Fan was silent for a moment, then suddenly spoke: “Given the current asset scale of the divine kingdom, coupled with the income brought by the Evolution Talent, can these resources really be spent completely?”
“Of course, they can.” Yang Da had almost no hesitation.
“Master, even if you gave me a hundred times more funds, I would still be able to spend all of them.”
“Then why...” Yang Fan frowned slightly.
“Is the Master asking why Divinity Points accumulated more and more when Yang Yi was in charge?” Yang Da glanced at Yang Fan, his tone calm.
“That is because the suggestions they gave were all ‘most cost-effective’ choices.”
“spiritual grain, dragon meat, and various Medicinal Pills. Although the unit price is not low, the divine kingdom needs to invest one hundred million Divinity Points every three thousand years.”
Speaking of this, Yang Da’s tone suddenly changed: “If I were to choose, I would directly purchase the f-class transformation pod produced by the high-level Mechanical Divine Kingdom.”
“Believers only need to lie inside, and they can leap from Mortals to Tier 5 Beings in a very short time.”
“There is such a thing?!” Yang Fan looked shocked, as if he had opened the door to a new world for the first time.
Yang Da did not explain much, and just gently snapped his fingers.
The next moment, an information panel unfolded in the Void Realm.
[f-class transformation pod, Type: Mechanical Auxiliary Cultivation Building, Price: 10,000 Divinity Points

Introduction: Built with the core technology of the Mechanical Divine Kingdom, it reconstructs the Physical Body structure of believers, simulates the operation path of the Cultivation Technique, and guides the efficient infusion of energy.
It can complete the energy accumulation process required for decades of conventional Cultivation in a short time, significantly compressing the growth cycle.
Effect: After entering, Mortal believers can quickly complete the transformation of the Physical Body, reaching the Tier 5 Being level directly.
Restriction: Each transformation pod can only accommodate one believer. After a single use, it takes 30 years to recover to the full-energy state.

Evaluation: It significantly shortens the Cultivation time of believers, giving them more time for Cultivation Technique comprehension and Realm Breakthrough. Before the Lifespan is exhausted, the probability of Mortal believers breaking through to the Qi Refining Realm is increased by about 70%.
Remarks: The manufacturing cost is high. Without sufficient financial support, large-scale investment is not recommended]
After reading the introduction, Yang Fan felt as if he had missed a hundred million. How was this a Cultivation aid? It was simply a “cheating machine.”
“Such a good thing, and yet Yang Yi didn’t recommend it to me?” Yang Fan couldn’t help complaining.

“Because it’s expensive.” Yang Da’s tone was taken for granted: “Ten thousand Divinity Points per pod, and it can only serve one believer at a time, requiring thirty years of charging from the divine kingdom.”
“Given the current population scale of the divine kingdom, do you think it is realistic if we deploy it on a large scale?”
“Furthermore, Yang Yi and the others cannot understand the existence of the SSS-rank Talent. In their cognition, this kind of building is not something demigods can equip.”
“Instead, high-level spiritual grain, spiritual meat, and Medicinal Pills—letting believers eat and drink well, and growing through their own bit-by-bit Cultivation—are the optimal solutions.”
“I have the SSS-rank Talent, so I can totally configure it in large quantities.” Yang Fan said excitedly.
“In theory, that is the case, but the divine kingdom does not fully recognize Intelligent Life forms like Yang Yi. Core secrets like the SSS-rank Talent are restricted from them.”
Yang Da said casually, “And the f-class transformation pod is only Entry-Level; further up, there are E-class transformation pods.”
“That can directly leap believers at the first layer of the Qi Refining Stage to the Qi Refining Stage Perfection.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s heartbeat sped up by a few beats.
Believers in ordinary divine kingdoms need to meditate and Cultivate day after day, slowly absorbing the energy of heaven and earth.
As for divine kingdoms with these transformation pods, believers only need to focus on comprehending the Heavenly Dao and breaking through Bottlenecks.
As for energy accumulation? That was just a “resource problem.” The gap between them could be imagined.

Yang Da continued, “The Mechanical Path is also a gold-swallowing beast. Taking myself as an example, I currently belong to the first-tier Intelligent Life. To promote to the second tier, a large number of believers need to be cultivated into Intelligent Life, building a higher-dimensional logical core, loading massive data modules, and constantly carrying out self-Evolution. This process requires consuming a massive amount of Divinity Points.”
“In addition, there are Mechanical maintenance Systems, energy dispatch networks, redundant backup Systems, and so on. Every link requires Divinity Points.”

“The essence of the Mechanical Path is to pile up the future with massive resources. To get feedback, I must at least become a fourth-tier Intelligent Life to possess the ‘creation’ ability and start earning Divinity Points for the divine kingdom.”
“As long as resources are sufficient, everything on the Mechanical Path can be quantified and accelerated.”
Yang Fan listened in some silence. Unlike Cultivation and Martial Arts, Yang Da’s growth was not considered Cultivation, but more like “smashing money to push Realms.”

“The core competition of divine kingdom development is fundamentally resources.” Yang Da said indifferently, “Even a person without any Talent, as long as you give him ten billion Divinity Points and forcefully smash them, you can smash him into a demigod or even a god.”
Speaking of this, his gaze fell on Yang Fan, and his tone became serious: “Please rest assured, Master. With me here, the divine kingdom will only grow stronger and stronger.”
Yang Fan nodded: “You are originally my will, so of course I am relieved.”
This sentence was not encouragement, but the truest thought in his heart at this moment.
In a sense, Yang Da was another self with richer knowledge and more rationality.
Seeming to perceive Yang Fan’s thoughts, Yang Da suddenly rubbed his hands, his expression becoming somewhat subtle: “Master... Do you have anything else?”
“No.” Yang Fan gave him a strange look.
“Then I’ll go back first!” Yang Da’s spirits instantly perked up: “Today is my annual concubine-selecting day, which is very important!”
As soon as his voice fell, his figure had turned into a stream of light and rushed straight toward the palace.
Yang Fan stood in place, his face twitching involuntarily. “How come this highest Intelligent Life of mine... is so unserious? I wonder who he takes after?”
Shaking his head, he couldn’t be bothered to think about it anymore.
“Forget it, with him around, there’s no need to worry too much about the development of the divine kingdom. I might as well go to the Virtual World to find Rou’er and Bing’er!”
In the following time, Yang Fan’s days were very relaxed.
Either browsing the divine kingdom forum, going to the Virtual World to see his wives, or looking for ‘friends’ at Tianxiang Renjian, or having dinner and chatting with Sima Bang and others.
I have to say, Sima Bang truly lived up to being the son of the Sima Family head; his knowledge and vision far surpassed his own.
Just a few exchanges brought Yang Fan a lot of inspiration.
Especially on the point of “highest Intelligent Life of the divine kingdom.”
Through conversation, Yang Fan learned that when these children of major families first awakened their divine kingdoms, their families would equip them with a Mechanical Heart.
Even if what they mainly cultivated was not the Mechanical Path, this was almost a standard configuration.
Sima Bang was no exception. His divine kingdom was dominated by the Martial Arts System, but it still possessed the highest Intelligent Life to coordinate and dispatch.
This initially made Yang Fan somewhat puzzled, until the other party explained it, and then he fully understood.
Possessing the highest Intelligent Life was not equivalent to walking the Mechanical Path.

The real Mechanical Path was to deeply transform believers, taking the Mechanical Heart as the core, and converting them into Smart Weapons with high coordination and computing capabilities, equipped with complete combat Systems and data links.
Under this System, every believer required huge resources to be invested. The entire divine kingdom was like a war machine operating precisely.
Sima Bang’s choice was completely different.
He only retained the core of “highest Intelligent Life” to coordinate the development of the divine kingdom, analyze resource allocation, and formulate strategic planning.
The believers themselves still followed the original Cultivation System without undergoing mechanization modification.
In essence, it used part of the advantages of the Mechanical System to serve the Cultivation path.
The cost of this model was still not low; among them, the Mechanical Heart, intelligent hub, and algorithm modules all required continuous investment.
But compared with the complete Mechanical Path, the cost of this “semi-intelligent” structure was much smaller.
With Sima Bang’s identity, he could naturally afford it.

chapters.title: Chapter 156: The War Ends, Yang Da's Arrangements
paragraphs: Time passed, and nearly ten days had already gone by in the blink of an eye.
Meanwhile, inside the Alien Divine Kingdom, the battle had finally Advanced to its final stage.
Yang San led the army straight to the Divine Kingdom Core.
At this moment, the core area of the Fission Beast Divine Kingdom was already in complete ruins, and the enemy’s remaining forces were left with only a little over fifty billion.
However, Yang Fan’s army of believers did not rashly launch a general attack.

They steadily spread out their formation on the outer perimeter, with overlapping defensive lines in the front and nearly five hundred thousand Adult Elves neatly arrayed in the back, bowstrings taut.
Arrows filled the sky like rain, continuously suppressing the enemy’s active space.
What truly made one’s heart palpitate was not the rain of arrows, but the scene in the center of the battlefield.
A large number of Fission Beasts had been eroded by the zombie virus, their eyes scarlet, their sanity collapsed, frantically throwing themselves at their own kind nearby, tearing and devouring them.
The originally dense beast tide was now disintegrating on its own. Chaos was devouring everything.
High up in the sky, the Fission Beast Demigod was extremely furious, and one Divine Decree after another descended.
“All believers form formations for defense!”
“Execute anyone who has been contaminated immediately!”
“Be careful not to get injured in the process!”

“My God...” A Fission Beast in the Qi Refining Realm raised its head to report, “The unranked subjects have no sanity, and their numbers are too large, making it difficult to convey the Divine Decree...”
After a brief silence, the furious will descended once again.
“Then put the waste to use! Let them charge the enemy’s defense line!”
The order was cold and cruel; clearly, he had completely abandoned that batch of low-tier subjects.
High in the air, the gaze of the Fission Beast Demigod locked firmly onto Yang San in the distance, his eyes filled with bitter hatred and unwillingness.
Originally, his Divine Kingdom possessed a core building called the “Sea of Blood”, which could not only purify the zombie virus but also continuously replenish basic troops.
Yet the Human Race happened to find the location of the Sea of Blood.

With the help of the C-rank Array at the Great Success stage, all the troops stationed within were directly wiped out, and the Sea of Blood was moved away. The advantage of his believers’ Breeding instantly turned into a disadvantage.
The zombie virus was no longer a controllable variable, but had become a fatal threat.

He felt deep regret in his heart. If he had arranged the Sea of Blood more covertly back then, and if he hadn’t invested all his remaining funds into flesh expansion, the situation might have been completely different.
One wrong step, and every step was wrong. Compared to Yang San, his command was simply a complete mess.
On the battlefield, the number of Fission Beasts was still continuously decreasing.
Fifty billion, forty billion, thirty billion...
Excluding those ranked beings who could still maintain their sanity, ordinary Fission Beasts were being devoured and consumed at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Yet Yang San never issued the order for a general attack.
This was the Divine Kingdom Core, and the opponent was already a trapped beast with no way out.
What he needed to do was not to recklessly charge forward, but to surround without attacking.
Using the long-range suppression of the Adult Elves, he would eat away at the enemy’s living forces bit by bit.
Time stood on his side; the longer it dragged on, the smaller the losses would be.
Three days in the Real World, three years in the Alien Divine Kingdom.
Finally, the last defense line was completely torn apart.
Yang San’s army drove straight in, and the opponent’s Divine Kingdom Core was successfully captured.
Yang Fan’s consciousness descended upon the Divine Kingdom at the very first moment.
In the center of the Divine Kingdom.
Yang San knelt on one knee, holding his hands high, with a blood-red Divine Kingdom Core resting in his palms.
“Master! This Divine Kingdom War took a total of twenty-seven years! Believers lost amounted to eighty million, among whom one hundred and seventy-six were in the Qi Refining Realm!”
“The mission has been completed to Perfection!”
Yang San’s voice was loud and clear, carrying undisguised excitement.
Inside the central palace of the Divine Kingdom.
Yang Fan sat high upon the imperial throne. Yang Da stood to one side with a calm expression.
Below, Yang Yi, Yang Er, and Yang San stood in separate rows, like three ministers, respectful and solemn.
After listening to the report, Yang Fan nodded slowly, a look of satisfaction showing in his eyes.
To conquer a demigod’s Divine Kingdom and reduce the losses to such a low level, this war could be called perfect.
Moreover, the role of the Zombie System was almost decisive.
Judging solely from the input-output ratio, this single battle alone had perhaps already recovered all the preliminary costs.

Although the believers poured into the Extra-dimensional Research Institute were as many as ten billion, they were merely ordinary Mortals screened out by the River of Hope, with an Aptitude of only green.
Among ten million such believers, not even one might be able to give birth to a Qi Refining Realm being.
But the believers participating in the Divine Kingdom War were different; they were all ranked beings.

For a god, the value of different believers varies. This was also why, when the Fission Beast Demigod first appeared, he would rather abandon ten billion ordinary Fission Beasts than fail to prioritize protecting that thousand-odd Qi Refining Realm believers.
“Well done.”
Yang Fan swept his gaze across those below, his tone calm and majestic, “Next, all development of the Divine Kingdom will be handed over to Yang Da for unified arrangement.”
“Yes, Master!”
“This subordinate greets you, Lord!”
Yang Yi, Yang Er, and Yang San saluted simultaneously, their voices in unison.

As Intelligent Life, their perception of identity was extremely clear. As the highest Intelligent Life of the Divine Kingdom, Yang Da was essentially an extension of the deity’s will and the “proxy” of the entire Divine Kingdom.
Even though he was currently only a first-class Intelligent Life, his status was still far above theirs.
Yang Da nodded slightly, his gaze falling on the three men, quickly entering his state.
“Yang Er.”
“This subordinate is here.”

“Take one thousand Qi Refining Realm believers and one hundred million ranked beings to pioneer the Alien Divine Kingdom. Scavenge all usable resources. Whether it is buildings, flesh and corpses, or Ore and Materials, bring them all back to the Divine Kingdom.”
“Yes!” Yang Er did not hesitate at all, and after receiving the order, he turned and left.
“Yang Yi.”
“This subordinate is here.”

Yang Da’s gaze sank slightly, “Regarding the cultivation of the Zombie System, from now on, all believers detected by the River of Hope as having green Aptitude are to be entirely poured into the Extra-dimensional Research Institute.”
As the words fell, Yang San and Yang Yi were stunned almost simultaneously.
“Lord.” Yang Yi stepped forward, his tone cautious, “Such an arrangement will likely seriously affect the demographic structure of the Divine Kingdom.”
“Moreover, compared to the Zombie System, the development of the believers themselves is the foundation.”
Hearing this, Yang Da just gave a faint smile, “Rest assured, cultivating the Zombie System through this method will last at most five thousand years.”
“Within these five thousand years, your task is only one, and that is to mobilize all resources to increase the birth rate of the Divine Kingdom.”

“Specific methods are up to you to decide: reward high-quality Medicinal Pills and high-quality meat, elevate the social status of childbearing families, and even establish exclusive resource tilting. I will give you the highest level of resource support.”

“However, there is one requirement: the total population of the Divine Kingdom must not be lower than five billion. If you have the ability to raise the population to ten billion, on behalf of the Master, I will reward you with ten Mechanical Hearts.”
“Yes, Lord!” Yang Yi bowed deeply, his tone obviously carrying a bit more excitement.
Yang Da then turned to Yang San, “Yang San, next I will continuously purchase Divine Kingdom coordinates for you.”
“As for troop sources, the Divine Kingdom will supply them with full effort. For every Divine Kingdom Core obtained, you will be rewarded with one Mechanical Heart.”
“Yes, Lord!” Yang San’s expression was likewise invigorated, and a trace of fanaticism faintly showed in his eyes.
For Intelligent Life like them purchased through the Divine Shop, the Mechanical Heart was the key to evolution.
In fact, before this, Yang Fan was not clear about the true significance of the Mechanical Hearts to them. Yang Yi and the others had never received any “rewards” all this time either.
They were merely executing orders, accurately, efficiently, and without complaint. But this did not mean they had no “desires”.
Intelligent Life were not inanimate objects without emotions; they had goals and also yearned for evolution.
It was just that without an incentive mechanism, this “yearning” was suppressed deep within their underlying logic.
And now, Yang Da activated this desire.
From this moment on, they were no longer just tools executing orders, but executors driven by “goals”.
Efficiency would only be even higher.

Whether it is buildings, flesh and corpses, or Ore and Materials, bring them all back to the Divine Kingdom.”
“Yes!” Yang Er did not hesitate at all, and after receiving the order, he turned and left.
“Yang Yi.”
“This subordinate is here.”

Yang Da’s gaze sank slightly, “Regarding the cultivation of the Zombie System, from now on, all believers detected by the River of Hope as having green Aptitude are to be entirely poured into the Extra-dimensional Research Institute.”
As the words fell, Yang San and Yang Yi were stunned almost simultaneously.
“Lord.” Yang Yi stepped forward, his tone cautious, “Such an arrangement will likely seriously affect the demographic structure of the Divine Kingdom.”
“Moreover, compared to the Zombie System, the development of the believers themselves is the foundation.”
Hearing this, Yang Da just gave a faint smile, “Rest assured, cultivating the Zombie System through this method will last at most five thousand years.”
“Within these five thousand years, your task is only one, and that is to mobilize all resources to increase the birth rate of the Divine Kingdom.”

“Specific methods are up to you to decide: reward high-quality Medicinal Pills and high-quality meat, elevate the social status of childbearing families, and even establish exclusive resource tilting.
I will give you the highest level of resource support.”
“However, there is one requirement: the total population of the Divine Kingdom must not be lower than five billion.
If you have the ability to raise the population to ten billion, on behalf of the Master, I will reward you with ten Mechanical Hearts.”
“Yes, Lord!” Yang Yi bowed deeply, his tone obviously carrying a bit more excitement.
Yang Da then turned to Yang San, “Yang San, next I will continuously purchase Divine Kingdom coordinates for you.”
“As for troop sources, the Divine Kingdom will supply them with full effort.
For every Divine Kingdom Core obtained, you will be rewarded with one Mechanical Heart.”
“Yes, Lord!” Yang San’s expression was likewise invigorated, and a trace of fanaticism faintly showed in his eyes.
For Intelligent Life like them purchased through the Divine Shop, the Mechanical Heart was the key to evolution.
In fact, before this, Yang Fan was not clear about the true significance of the Mechanical Hearts to them.
Yang Yi and the others had never received any “rewards” all this time either.
They were merely executing orders, accurately, efficiently, and without complaint.
But this did not mean they had no “desires”.
Intelligent Life were not inanimate objects without emotions; they had goals and also yearned for evolution.
It was just that without an incentive mechanism, this “yearning” was suppressed deep within their underlying logic.
And now, Yang Da activated this desire.
From this moment on, they were no longer just tools executing orders, but executors driven by “goals”.
Efficiency would only be even higher.

chapters.title: Chapter 157: Advanced Retarded Life!
paragraphs: After receiving the order.
Yang Yi and Yang San bowed at the same time, then turned and left the grand hall.
In the vast palace, only Yang Fan and Yang Da were left.

Yang Fan frowned and said, “Why arrange it like this? The Zombie System is remarkably effective when facing high-reproduction alien races like the Fission Beast, but believers are the foundation of the Divine Kingdom, right?”
His tone carried a trace of puzzlement. As a deity, he was very clear about the testing situation of the River of Hope.
Among them, purple Aptitude accounted for ten percent; blue Aptitude accounted for twenty percent; while green Aptitude accounted for a full seventy percent.
According to Yang Da’s plan, in the future, the vast majority of newborn believers would be sent into the Extra-dimensional Research Institute.
With such a scale of population “disappearing,” the “Glory Plan” previously formulated by Yang San could simply no longer be maintained.
This was simply uprooting the ‘chive roots’!
If not for the fact that Yang Da was an extension of his own will, Yang Fan would have already spoken out in opposition just now.
However, facing the questioning, Yang Da suddenly revealed a meaningful smile.
“Master, do you know that the zombie cultivation of the Extra-dimensional Research Institute actually does not require investing believers?”
At this moment, Yang Da’s tone even carried a hint of banter.
“What do you mean?” Yang Fan was stunned.

Yang Da spoke softly, “Any living being can turn into a zombie. The Evolution of zombies only requires flesh and blood energy, not necessarily believers; any corpse purchased from the Divine Shop will do.”
“Have you never thought of such a simple question, Master?”
As the words fell, Yang Fan was instantly stunned in place.
He had never thought about this point. He could even say that ever since purchasing the Advanced Intelligent Life, he had hardly truly “used his brain” for the development of the Divine Kingdom.
For all work related to the development of the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan’s answer had always been two words — ‘Agree’.

“Damn it, since that’s the case, what is Yang San doing all those fancy operations for? And you, what was that order just now about?” Yang Fan was almost angered to laughter; he really couldn’t quite keep up with the thought processes of these Intelligent Life forms.
Yang Da’s expression remained calm as he said, “I have said before that these Intelligent Life forms purchased from the Divine Shop cannot break through established thinking frameworks.”
“Every decision they make is the ‘optimal solution’ under existing logic, but there are also limitations because of this.”
“As for why Yang San did this, the reason is very simple. Because this is the lowest-cost plan.”
“Lowest cost?” Yang Fan furrowed his brows tightly.
“That’s right.” Yang Da nodded, “In order to cultivate this one hundred million scale of ordinary zombies, the cumulative investment of Mortal believers has already exceeded ten billion.”
“If replaced by directly purchasing equivalent flesh and blood energy from the Divine Shop, it would require ten Divinity Points.”
As the voice fell, the air seemed to grow quiet for an instant.
Yang Fan was stunned for a moment, as if he hadn’t heard clearly, “... Do you want to say that again? Ten... Divinity Points?”
In his tone, there even carried a trace of absurdity.
The next moment, Yang Fan couldn’t help taking a deep breath, his chest heaving.
At this moment, he wished he could recall Yang San, slap it directly to death on the ground, and buy a new one from the Divine Shop.

When he originally chose to cultivate the Zombie System, the Divine Kingdom’s circulating funds reached as high as six hundred million Divinity Points. For just this bit of resources, they pulled off so many fancy operations.
This was so-called Advanced Intelligent Life?
It’s more like an Advanced Retarded Life!
As a deity, Yang Fan truly could not treat these believers as people equal to himself.
Even deep inside, just like Yang Yi and the others, he only regarded them as resources.
Yet seeing such a huge number of believers consumed, he would still instinctively feel uncomfortable.
For the sake of war, for more efficiently invading the Alien Divine Kingdom, these costs he could accept.
But now Yang Da told him that the root of all this was just to “save” ten Divinity Points.
It was absurd, even comical to the extreme.

Watching Yang Fan’s gloomy complexion, Yang Da slowly let out a breath, his tone becoming solemn, “Master, you possess the Evolution Talent and are destined to step into deityhood in the future, or even higher levels.”
“As the highest Intelligent Life of the Divine Kingdom, I have an obligation to remind you that your current way of thinking is wrong.”
“My thinking is wrong? Do you know what I am thinking right now?” Yang Fan took a deep breath and said.
Yang Da shook his head, “I cannot directly read the Master’s thoughts, but based on your expression and reactions, I can make an inference.”
“You think that Yang San’s behavior is foolish, using the stupidest method to do the most unworthy thing.”
“Isn’t it?” Yang Fan retorted.
Yang Da did not refute, but calmly said, “The reason why such a judgment is produced is because to you, ten Divinity Points are almost negligible.”
“Even, it is not as important as the guilt brought by the disappearance of those believers.”
“Please think carefully, Master, ten Divinity Points are equivalent to one billion Faith Points. Does the Master still remember that demigod who took you to the Luo Family back then, Zhan Yunxiao?”
“If it were him, how do you think he would choose?”
Yang Fan was slightly startled, and his thoughts began to calm down.
Yang Da’s voice continued to come over: “Whether it is the Human Race or alien races, similar systems exist.”
“Zombies, viruses, calamities... different races just call them by different names.”

“According to statistics, quite a few demigods construct such systems. Except for those born in top families whose resources are never lacking, the vast majority choose to sacrifice Mortal believers when cultivating this system.”
“The only difference is in the quantity, and the reason is very simple. This is the cheapest and most sustainable source of resources.”
“Believers will reproduce generation after generation; they themselves are the most basic ‘means of production’ of the Divine Kingdom.”
Speaking of this, Yang Da’s gaze fell on Yang Fan, and his tone was unprecedentedly solemn: “As a deity, the Master should not feel pity for believers.”
He paused for a split second, then slowly spoke:
“Deities control the life and death of believers. But the life and death of deities might not necessarily be outside the control of higher-dimensional existences.
If there truly is such an existence overlooking all living beings, then you and I are essentially no different from these believers. It is merely a difference in tiers and perspectives.
So-called good and evil are merely excuses woven by the weak for their own circumstances.
In front of absolute power, all morals can be redefined.
If a deity is still trapped by human nature, they will ultimately only become ‘food’ in the eyes of higher existences.

Only by discarding useless emotions, utilizing everything that can be utilized, and constantly moving upward can one reach a day where they are no longer defined by any existence. Instead, they become the party that defines the rules.”
Inside the grand hall, there was silence.
Yang Fan stood in place, remaining silent for a long time.
After a long while, he finally took a deep breath and completely calmed his emotions.

Yang Fan looked at Yang Da and continued to question: “With the Divine Kingdom’s current assets, if it were just to cultivate the Zombie System, there is completely no need to use this method. Then what on earth was that order you gave just now for?”
“To accelerate the Evolution of believers.” Yang Da said indifferently.
“What do you mean?” Yang Fan frowned.

Yang Da slowly spoke, “The essence of any biological system is survival of the fittest. Individuals with higher Aptitude, stronger Physique, and greater strength will obtain more resources, occupy superior living environments, and simultaneously possess a higher reproduction probability.”
“The weak will be continuously eliminated in the passage of time. Under this natural Evolution, the overall Aptitude of believers will slowly improve generation after generation.”
Speaking of this, Yang Da paused for a split second.

“But it is still too slow. With normal Evolution speeds, wanting to make the overall Aptitude of the Divine Kingdom’s believers leap to the limit of Mortals would still take hundreds of thousands of years, or even longer. But the Divine Kingdom currently has more efficient methods.”
“The River of Hope can directly screen Aptitude. Since that is the case, there is no need to let low-Aptitude individuals occupy living space anymore.”

“My plan is to throw all ordinary believers with green Aptitude into the Extra-dimensional Research Institute. While utilizing resources, this frees up a massive amount of living space for believers with higher Aptitude to reproduce and expand.”
“According to deductions, in at most five thousand years for the Divine Kingdom, the proportion of purple Aptitude among the new generation of believers will exceed seventy percent.”
“By then, the screening value of the River of Hope will drop drastically. The basic population quality of the entire Divine Kingdom will undergo a fundamental change.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan remained silent, finding it hard to connect Yang Da with that image of “selecting concubines” every year.

Yang Da continued, “Afterwards, the cultivation of the Zombie System will not need to be so troublesome; we can directly purchase corpses and live Yao Beasts from the Divine Shop to use as conversion materials.”

“We possess the Evolution Talent and completely have no need to continue following Yang San’s inefficient method. Moreover, as the Divine Kingdom continuously grows stronger, the Divine Kingdom Wars we participate in the future will only become more and more numerous. The existing zombie scale is far from enough.”
“If the resource pressure is too heavy at that time, we can also purchase cloning technology, combining fully automatic culture dishes with intelligent nutrient chambers to mass-produce life units.”
“By then, the resources required for the Zombie System can be completely self-sufficient by the Divine Kingdom, and costs can be compressed even further.”

chapters.title: Chapter 158: Being Lectured
paragraphs: After Yang Da finished speaking, the great hall fell silent.
Yang Fan looked at the entity before him that looked exactly like himself, remaining silent for a long time.

At times, Yang Da truly resembled him, but that similarity was limited to daily life and appearances. Once matters involved Divine Kingdom development, resource allocation, or future planning, he completely stripped away all emotion.
While Yang Fan remained silent, Yang Da walked steadily and unhurriedly until he stopped right in front of him.
The distance between the two was no more than half a step.
He raised his head, looking directly into Yang Fan’s eyes.
Seeing the look in his eyes, Yang Fan’s heart tightened inexplicably.
The next moment, Yang Da said coldly, “Master, I am the highest Intelligent Life of your Divine Kingdom, one with you, sharing your honor and disgrace. Some things only I can say.”
“The current Master has absolutely no potential to become a powerful deity; in my view, you are no different from trash.”
The air seemed to freeze.
“What did you say?” Yang Fan’s eyes widened abruptly, filled with disbelief.
His highest Intelligent Life was actually lecturing him?
Even if the entity possessed independent thinking capabilities, he was, after all, a deity. Such insubordination was simply inconceivable.
“The current Master is merely trash.” Yang Da’s tone remained calm, yet every word was like a blade, “If you continue to maintain this state, your future will not go very far.”
“Why do you say that?” Yang Fan’s voice lowered a few degrees.
“Please think about it, Master. To reach this point, as a deity, what effort have you actually put in?” Yang Da did not back down and continued to speak bluntly.
The sentence was like a heavy hammer, causing Yang Fan to fall into silence.
He opened his mouth but found that he could not provide an answer.
“According to your memories, Master was born in a remote place like Yang County, with no Family support in reality, and your knowledge was extremely limited.”
“When the Divine Kingdom first opened, you were still working hard to study investments, communicate with classmates, and find ways to improve the strength of your Believers.”
“But what about since you purchased an Intelligent Life?”
“I...” Yang Fan’s throat moved slightly.

“I will answer for you.” Yang Da interrupted directly, “Because Intelligent Life possesses information processing capabilities and knowledge reserves far exceeding those of humans, you chose to give up thinking, Master.”
“For the vast majority of decisions, you only say two words—’Agreed’.”

“In reality, you have become complacent. While you appear low-key and are polite to everyone, deep down you have long since decided that your future is boundless. You even foolishly rejected an invitation from a core deity of the Gu Family, one of the Five Great Giants.”
Yang Da’s gaze became increasingly sharp, “Everything you possess now is built entirely upon your SSS-rank Evolution Talent. If you did not have this talent, what would your life be like?”
This question left Yang Fan completely silent.

Yang Da did not stop, “Or does Master truly believe that the development of a Divine Kingdom does not require a deity, and that one can reach the end simply by relying on hundredfold returns to constantly pile up resources?”
The great hall was terrifyingly quiet. For a long time, Yang Fan did not say a word.
Just then, Yang Da suddenly turned around, “Please follow me, Master.”
As his voice fell, he had already walked toward the outside of the hall.
Yang Fan hesitated for a moment but followed him.
Soon, the two arrived ten thousand meters above the Divine Kingdom, with the extremely luxurious divine palace beneath their feet.
Yang Da raised his hand and snapped his fingers lightly.
“Snap.”
The next moment, the entire palace collapsed with a roar!
“What are you doing?!” Yang Fan’s pupils constricted.
Yang Da did not even glance at the ruins; his voice slowly echoed in Yang Fan’s mind.
“The path of a deity is very long. The Divine Kingdom is merely the Foundation, but it is not everything.”
“Master’s battlefield is in reality.”
“Everyone has a Divine Kingdom, so why does the real world have so many Families, factions, companies, and even listed corporations?”
“The world is bustling for profit; the world is jostling for gain. War is just one way of competing for resources, but it is not the only way.”

“Learning without thought is labor lost; thought without learning is perilous. Master currently suffers from both. You are addicted to the rapid growth of your Divine Kingdom and immersed in your existing advantages, yet you do not take the initiative to learn, nor do you think deeply.”

“This is not the mark of a strong person, but of a product of a greenhouse.” Yang Da paused, his tone suddenly carrying a hint of mockery, “Back then, when I suggested that Master purchase property on a Vacation Planet, or even suggested keeping a woman from Tianxiang Renjian, were you tempted, Master?”
Yang Fan’s expression changed slightly, “You...”

Yang Da chuckled, “What Master should really be thinking about is not buying a house, but buying an entire Vacation Planet. Turn it into your property and let it continuously generate revenue for you.”
“Then use these revenues to feed back into the Divine Kingdom, strengthen your Believers, and elevate your own life level.”
Saying this, his gaze became profound, “As for beauty, it is but skin and bones. Being in Taichu City, have you really understood why this place has become a Holy Land for the Human Race deities?”
“What do the resources, knowledge, information, trading networks, and faction games gathered here mean?”
“Have you studied the capital flows, industrial structures, and power dynamics here?”
“Or is it that Master is merely treating this place as a safe and comfortable ‘newbie protection zone’?”
Yang Da’s voice grew heavier with every sentence.
“I...” Yang Fan wanted to retort, but he could not say a word, because he knew that Yang Da had not said anything wrong.
“According to records, Yang County, where Master was born, and even the entire Tiannan City, were breached by alien deities three thousand years ago.”
“In that battle, tens of billions of Divine Kingdoms collapsed, deities were displaced, their Physical Bodies were destroyed, and their Souls dissipated.”
“It was only after high-ranking Human Race deities joined the war that the lost territory was reclaimed.”
“After long years of reconstruction, immigration, and resource allocation, we have the prosperity of today.”
“This world is far less safe than Master imagines.”

Yang Da paused slightly for a moment and added, “There is one more thing I forgot to tell Master. Since my birth, your Mental Energy has increased dozens of times, far exceeding that of an ordinary demigod. Perhaps you should read more books, Master.”
His consciousness jolted, and Yang Fan withdrew from the Divine Kingdom.
In the real world, he was lying on his bed, his eyes open, staring at the ceiling, motionless.
Yang Fan’s thoughts were surging at this moment; he never expected that Yang Da would pull something like this.
He had actually been thoroughly lectured by an Intelligent Life.
“I have indeed... relied too much on my SSS-rank Talent,” Yang Fan muttered in a low voice, “As a deity, I should also be doing more.”
He knew very well in his heart that although Yang Da’s words were harsh, not a single one was wrong.
Yang Fan suddenly recalled that during his gatherings with Sima Bang and the others recently, every time he spoke, his remarks would always elicit a round of good-natured laughter.
They would naturally help him smooth things over and give him Face.
But that “decency” was essentially due to his potential.
Compared to these Prodigies who truly came from great Families, he was like a child who had just entered the world, shallow in knowledge, ignorant of everything, and naive in his thinking.
Even though they were Human Race Prodigies, they still worked harder than anyone else.
For example, Ye Jianfeng, who possessed the S-rank Talent “Ten Thousand Sword Body,” had specially purchased a “Spirit-Nurturing Pod” produced by the Mechanical Divine Kingdom for his room.
Every day, he had to lie in it to rest, nourishing his Mental Energy while connecting to the Virtual World to repeatedly hone his sword techniques in a private training room.

Take Sima Bang for another example; although he was the son of the Sima Family head, and despite his bloated figure and seemingly lazy appearance, he was actually so diligent in his training that it bordered on harsh.

He not only Cultivated his Cultivation Technique personally but also spent a great deal of money to hire deity-level mentors to explain Formations, resource allocation, and various types of high-level knowledge.

Even during their casual gatherings, what they discussed was never about pleasure. It was about Divine Kingdom investment, Believer cultivation, the pros and cons of Formations, the resource flow of Taichu City, and even the landscape of the entire Human Race.
Only Yang Fan, who barely managed to integrate into this circle by relying on his talent, could hardly get a word in during every gathering.
Because all he knew were some trivial daily matters, and the various positions he had studied at Tianxiang Renjian.
