The sentence was like a heavy hammer, causing Yang Fan to fall into silence.
He opened his mouth but found that he could not provide an answer.
“According to your memories, Master was born in a remote place like Yang County, with no Family support in reality, and your knowledge was extremely limited.”
“When the Divine Kingdom first opened, you were still working hard to study investments, communicate with classmates, and find ways to improve the strength of your Believers.”
“But what about since you purchased an Intelligent Life?”
“I...” Yang Fan’s throat moved slightly.

“I will answer for you.” Yang Da interrupted directly, “Because Intelligent Life possesses information processing capabilities and knowledge reserves far exceeding those of humans, you chose to give up thinking, Master.”
“For the vast majority of decisions, you only say two words—’Agreed’.”
“In reality, you have become complacent.
While you appear low-key and are polite to everyone, deep down you have long since decided that your future is boundless.
You even foolishly rejected an invitation from a core deity of the Gu Family, one of the Five Great Giants.”
Yang Da’s gaze became increasingly sharp, “Everything you possess now is built entirely upon your SSS-rank Evolution Talent.
If you did not have this talent, what would your life be like?”
This question left Yang Fan completely silent.

Yang Da did not stop, “Or does Master truly believe that the development of a Divine Kingdom does not require a deity, and that one can reach the end simply by relying on hundredfold returns to constantly pile up resources?”
The great hall was terrifyingly quiet.
For a long time, Yang Fan did not say a word.
Just then, Yang Da suddenly turned around, “Please follow me, Master.”
As his voice fell, he had already walked toward the outside of the hall.
Yang Fan hesitated for a moment but followed him.
Soon, the two arrived ten thousand meters above the Divine Kingdom, with the extremely luxurious divine palace beneath their feet.
Yang Da raised his hand and snapped his fingers lightly.
“Snap.”
The next moment, the entire palace collapsed with a roar!
“What are you doing?!” Yang Fan’s pupils constricted.
Yang Da did not even glance at the ruins; his voice slowly echoed in Yang Fan’s mind.
“The path of a deity is very long.
The Divine Kingdom is merely the Foundation, but it is not everything.”
“Master’s battlefield is in reality.”
“Everyone has a Divine Kingdom, so why does the real world have so many Families, factions, companies, and even listed corporations?”
“The world is bustling for profit; the world is jostling for gain.
War is just one way of competing for resources, but it is not the only way.”
“Learning without thought is labor lost; thought without learning is perilous.
Master currently suffers from both.
You are addicted to the rapid growth of your Divine Kingdom and immersed in your existing advantages, yet you do not take the initiative to learn, nor do you think deeply.”

“This is not the mark of a strong person, but of a product of a greenhouse.” Yang Da paused, his tone suddenly carrying a hint of mockery, “Back then, when I suggested that Master purchase property on a Vacation Planet, or even suggested keeping a woman from Tianxiang Renjian, were you tempted, Master?”
Yang Fan’s expression changed slightly, “You...”
Yang Da chuckled, “What Master should really be thinking about is not buying a house, but buying an entire Vacation Planet.
Turn it into your property and let it continuously generate revenue for you.”
“Then use these revenues to feed back into the Divine Kingdom, strengthen your Believers, and elevate your own life level.”
Saying this, his gaze became profound, “As for beauty, it is but skin and bones.
Being in Taichu City, have you really understood why this place has become a Holy Land for the Human Race deities?”
“What do the resources, knowledge, information, trading networks, and faction games gathered here mean?”
“Have you studied the capital flows, industrial structures, and power dynamics here?”
“Or is it that Master is merely treating this place as a safe and comfortable ‘newbie protection zone’?”
Yang Da’s voice grew heavier with every sentence.
“I...” Yang Fan wanted to retort, but he could not say a word, because he knew that Yang Da had not said anything wrong.
“According to records, Yang County, where Master was born, and even the entire Tiannan City, were breached by alien deities three thousand years ago.”
“In that battle, tens of billions of Divine Kingdoms collapsed, deities were displaced, their Physical Bodies were destroyed, and their Souls dissipated.”
“It was only after high-ranking Human Race deities joined the war that the lost territory was reclaimed.”
“After long years of reconstruction, immigration, and resource allocation, we have the prosperity of today.”
“This world is far less safe than Master imagines.”
Yang Da paused slightly for a moment and added, “There is one more thing I forgot to tell Master.
Since my birth, your Mental Energy has increased dozens of times, far exceeding that of an ordinary demigod.
Perhaps you should read more books, Master.”
His consciousness jolted, and Yang Fan withdrew from the Divine Kingdom.
In the real world, he was lying on his bed, his eyes open, staring at the ceiling, motionless.
Yang Fan’s thoughts were surging at this moment; he never expected that Yang Da would pull something like this.
He had actually been thoroughly lectured by an Intelligent Life.
“I have indeed... relied too much on my SSS-rank Talent,” Yang Fan muttered in a low voice, “As a deity, I should also be doing more.”
He knew very well in his heart that although Yang Da’s words were harsh, not a single one was wrong.
Yang Fan suddenly recalled that during his gatherings with Sima Bang and the others recently, every time he spoke, his remarks would always elicit a round of good-natured laughter.
They would naturally help him smooth things over and give him Face.
But that “decency” was essentially due to his potential.
Compared to these Prodigies who truly came from great Families, he was like a child who had just entered the world, shallow in knowledge, ignorant of everything, and naive in his thinking.
Even though they were Human Race Prodigies, they still worked harder than anyone else.
For example, Ye Jianfeng, who possessed the S-rank Talent “Ten Thousand Sword Body,” had specially purchased a “Spirit-Nurturing Pod” produced by the Mechanical Divine Kingdom for his room.
Every day, he had to lie in it to rest, nourishing his Mental Energy while connecting to the Virtual World to repeatedly hone his sword techniques in a private training room.

Take Sima Bang for another example; although he was the son of the Sima Family head, and despite his bloated figure and seemingly lazy appearance, he was actually so diligent in his training that it bordered on harsh.

He not only Cultivated his Cultivation Technique personally but also spent a great deal of money to hire deity-level mentors to explain Formations, resource allocation, and various types of high-level knowledge.
Even during their casual gatherings, what they discussed was never about pleasure.
It was about Divine Kingdom investment, Believer cultivation, the pros and cons of Formations, the resource flow of Taichu City, and even the landscape of the entire Human Race.
Only Yang Fan, who barely managed to integrate into this circle by relying on his talent, could hardly get a word in during every gathering.
Because all he knew were some trivial daily matters, and the various positions he had studied at Tianxiang Renjian.

chapters.title: Chapter 159: Growth, Alien Gatherer
paragraphs: Yang Fan took a deep breath and sat up abruptly from the bed.
Without hesitation, he put on the helmet and his consciousness entered the Virtual World.
“Welcome, Human Race Prodigy Yang Fan. Please select a coordinate.” A cold mechanical voice rang out.
Yang Fan raised his hand and tapped on Taichu City.
The next instant, his consciousness was instantly pulled in.
Wen Yushui once said that Taichu City possessed the most complete and massive library system of the Human Race. Every student of Primordial Academy could access it for free.
Yang Fan slowly exhaled; with the SSS-Rank Evolution Talent, he was confident he would become stronger in the future.
But he did not want to become a “Puppet” that only relied on Intelligent Life, a fool who possessed power but was ignorant and foolish.
Yang Da’s words today had undoubtedly served as a wake-up call for him.
In this world, just because you possess something does not mean you will definitely be able to keep it.
A person’s cognition and vision determine the upper limit of the resources they can command.
Whether it is wealth or power, it is essentially a reflection of one’s “height of thought.”
When one’s ability is insufficient to support everything one possesses, those things that seem to belong to you will eventually slip away in another way.

It is just like a poor person who gets rich overnight; even if they win the lottery and become a billionaire, if their cognition does not change, they may not necessarily be able to keep that wealth in the end.
Yang Fan’s gaze gradually became firm; he understood that he could no longer indulge in pleasure and could no longer waste time.
He needed to make up for his own shortcomings and become a god in the true sense.
In the Taichu City library, rows upon rows of classics stretched out of sight.

“”Basic and Advanced Strategies for Divine Kingdom Investment”, “Comprehensive Explanation of Believer Cultivation Systems”, “Divine Kingdom Resource Allocation and Revenue Models”, “Detailed Explanation of Formation Construction and Battlefield Application”, “Overview of the Human Race and Alien Divine Kingdom Power Landscape”, “Real-world Capital Operation and Equity Structure”...”
Time slipped away unknowingly.
A night passed, but Yang Fan did not feel the slightest bit of fatigue; on the contrary, his eyes were becoming increasingly clear.
Only now did Yang Fan realize that what Yang Da said was true.
His Mental Energy was far superior to before, and he could even remember everything he saw.
In just one night, he had finished reading two classics and had formed his own understanding.

The process of learning was indeed boring and painful at first, but once immersed in it, that feeling of constantly understanding and breaking through the boundaries of cognition would bring a continuous sense of achievement.
In the time that followed, Yang Fan almost permanently resided in the Virtual World, and the Taichu City library became the place he frequented most.
Except for occasionally meeting his family, he never stepped into Tianxiang Renjian again, nor did he go to see that “old friend” Liu Ruyan.
Time flew by, and by the time he came back to his senses, two whole months had passed in the real world.
During these two months, in addition to learning knowledge and broadening his horizons, Yang Fan could feel the changes in his own strength every day.
Six thousand years had passed in the Divine Kingdom; during this time, with Yang Da’s full support, Yang San had conquered three demigod Divine Kingdoms.
Their Divine Kingdom Core had also long been absorbed by Yang Fan.
His consciousness entered the Divine Kingdom, and the specific information appeared before his eyes.
“Divine Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: 13.5 million square kilometers
Talents: F-rank Resource Talent, SSS-Rank Talent: Evolution
Believers: Foundation Establishment Realm (45,266), Qi Refining Stage (120 million), Martial Apprentice Realm (31.22 million), Tier 5 Being (2.2 billion)... Mortal (12.2 billion)
Professions: Alchemist (1.01 million), Blacksmith (1.85 million), Rune Master (100,000), Formation Master (200,000)
Dependents: Adult Elf (8.66 million)
Techniques: Ten Kings of Hell Formation (C-rank, Major Achievement)...
Divinity Points: 10.24 million (Reality provides 7.66 Divinity Points daily)

Buildings: Moon Well X100 million, Sun Spring X100 million, Fountain of Life X1422, divine weapon world-forging platform (S-rank), Extra-dimensional Research Institute (A-rank), Spiritual Vein X50,000 (A-rank), Alchemy Tower X1000 (B-rank), hundred herb spirit pivot academy X200 (B-rank), prison-suppressing body-refining tower X500 (B-rank), immortal nurturing tower X10,000 (B-rank), Monkey Wine Spring X600,000 (B-rank), special building Enlightenment Stone X10,000, B-rank defense building City-Annihilating Cannon X4, B-rank defense building f3500 fighter jet X10,000, nine profound ice tower X10,000, C-rank City of Technology X2, C-rank Thousand Poison Swamp X1 million...
Wonders: Penglai Island X1200, Spirit Peach Mountain X6000, Dragon Marsh Water Mansion X12000, Worlds Number One Martial Arts Arena X1000, myriad manifestation battle stele X10

Assets: Dragon Fish seedlings (X120 million), f-class transformation pod X100,000, Alien Gatherer X2 billion, cloning nutrition pod X1 million, large mineral vein X10, normal zombie (X3 billion), Robot Soldiers (X1 million), Super Alloy Robot Warrior (X5000), zombie-suppressing coffin (), Spirit Stone (), Dragon meat (), spiritual grain (), various Medicinal Pill (), various spirit fruits (), various medicinal herbs and Spirit Plant (), B-grade weapon ()...”
With Yang Da presiding over the development of the Divine Kingdom, throughout these six thousand years, the entire Divine Kingdom had already undergone earth-shaking changes.
As it continuously devoured Divine Kingdom Core, the territory continued to expand, and various investment projects were also being loaded and perfected in an orderly manner.
Today, the Divine Kingdom’s main operating revenue still revolved around three core sectors: Dragon Fish farming, Monkey Wine brewing, and Spirit Stone production.

Under the blessing of the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, the monthly revenue from Dragon Fish farming in the real world was about 180 million Divinity Points, Monkey Wine was about 60 million, and Spirit Stone production was as high as 500 million.
Coupled with some scattered income, Yang Fan’s monthly net income had stabilized at 800 million Divinity Points.
Unlike Yang Yi, Yang Da would never let Divinity Points “sit and gather dust.”
Excluding the necessary defense system construction, the Divine Kingdom’s current largest investment was the f-class transformation pod.
The total investment reached as high as one billion Divinity Points!
A full 100,000 Evolution Pods were distributed throughout the Divine Kingdom, and each could be recycled once every thirty years.
In one day of reality, three rounds of use could be completed.
In other words, every day in reality, 300,000 Mortal Believers could leap to become Tier 5 Being.
Even so, the number of Evolution Pods was still far from enough.
The population scale of the Divine Kingdom had already expanded to a terrifying degree.
Under various fertility incentive policies, as early as two thousand years ago, the total population of the Divine Kingdom had already exceeded 10 billion.
And with the continuous investment in Evolution Pods, the future “starting point” for Believers in the Divine Kingdom would no longer be Mortal. It would be Tier 5 Being.
The improvement in overall combat power also directly drove the rhythm of war. Now, the frequency of Divine Kingdom War was becoming higher and higher.
To this end, Yang Da specially configured a batch of mechanical units for Yang Er—Alien Gatherer.

These units also came from the Mechanical Divine Kingdom; their individual combat power was only equivalent to ranked beings, but they were extremely efficient in repetitive tasks such as resource collection, transportation, and dismantling.
Since then, after every Divine Kingdom War ended, the task of resource recovery was entirely undertaken by these mechanical life forms.
Yang Fan’s Believers no longer needed to waste time doing this “inefficient labor,” and all their energy was focused on Cultivate and combat.
In fact, given the current scale of the Divine Kingdom’s output, those resources collected from Alien Divine Kingdom were already insignificant.

chapters.title: Chapter 160: The Sixth Proposal
paragraphs: Out of the principle of “not wasting”, Yang Fan was even unwilling to participate in pioneering.
But regarding this, Yang Da had a much more long-term judgment.
“Current investments are preparations for the future.” He had explained it this way.

The ones purchased nowadays are all “Safe-grade Coordinates” in the Divine Shop, and these Divine Kingdoms themselves are limited in scale and barren in assets, so naturally their value cannot be seen.
But as the Divine Kingdom continues to grow, the enemies faced in the future will no longer be these “small places of a bullet’s range”, but truly powerful demigods, and even gods.
In Divine Kingdoms of that level, high-tier buildings are everywhere, and the value of any random A-grade building might reach tens of thousands of Divinity Points.
That is wealth accumulated by the other party for thousands, or even tens of thousands of years.
The stronger the combat power of the Divine Kingdom, the more its internal assets grow exponentially.
Simply put, what they are fighting right now are “scraps”, and what they will fight in the future are truly “treasuries”.
Regarding this, Yang Da proposed a suggestion more than once — giving up Safe-grade coordinates and instead purchasing normal or even dangerous-grade coordinates.
In his view, with the current comprehensive combat power of the Divine Kingdom, it is definitely not considered weak among demigods.
Continuing to attack low-tier Divine Kingdoms has too low efficiency.
“In current Divine Kingdom Wars, aside from the Divine Kingdom Core having value, the rest of the resources can be almost ignored.”
“If we want to accelerate development, we must participate in higher-level wars.”
These were Yang Da’s exact words; he had even explicitly proposed the strategy of supporting war through war.

After all, the current “money-burning speed” of the Divine Kingdom is equally astonishing, and if they could capture the Divine Kingdom of a powerful demigod, doubling their assets would by no means be empty talk.
But this proposal was forcibly vetoed by Yang Fan.
Back then, the two had a dispute inside the main hall.
“With the current Divine Kingdom combat power, it can completely withstand higher-intensity warfare.” Yang Da’s tone was calm. “Continuing to choose safe coordinates is simply wasting time.”
“You are too anxious.” Yang Fan shook his head.
“I recently read a book on financial investment.” Yang Fan slowly said, “There is a sentence in it that left a deep impression on me.”
“In the field of wealth, what determines the ultimate height is never who runs faster, but who lives longer, and who can stay at the poker table the entire time.”

“In my view, the development of the Divine Kingdom is the same. With our SSS-rank Talent, we are already leading the vast majority of people. In that case, there is even less need to gamble on those uncertain risks.”
“Advancing steadily is the optimal solution.” Yang Fan’s tone was firm.
Facing Yang Fan’s decision, although Yang Da had objections in his heart, he didn’t say anything more.
After all, gods are the ultimate arbiters.
Thus, the development of the Divine Kingdom still advanced steadily according to the current rhythm.
Yang Da’s calculation was not wrong. One thousand years of Divine Kingdom time ago, the proportion of purple Aptitude among newborn believers had already exceeded seventy percent.
From that moment on, the River of Hope completed its mission and was directly sold.
And the plan of casting low-Aptitude believers into the Extra-dimensional Research Institute was terminated accordingly.
Nowadays, the periphery of that research institute has long been replaced by another scene.
Billions of nutrient pods spread out densely, resembling a cold and massive “life factory”.
Within the pods, simian creatures similar in size to the Human Race are cultivated.
Consciousness has not yet been born, but they already possess a complete flesh-and-blood structure.
Countless work-type robots shuttle back and forth among them.
Testing, recording, calibrating, batches of light green nutrient solution were orderly injected into the pods.
The entire area was quiet, cold, and efficient, resembling an emotionless production line.
Back then, Yang Da had once proposed extracting believer genes directly to carry out large-scale cloning.
But this proposal was still vetoed by Yang Fan.
From the perspective of the result, whether it was humans or Yao Beasts of similar size, they would eventually transform into zombies. In essence, there was no difference.
What Yang Fan truly needed were just these “vectors”, as long as they could allow the virus to spread within the Alien Divine Kingdom.
From the perspective of results, cloned believers and these “blanks” indeed had no difference.
But emotionally, Yang Fan still felt a trace of instinctive rejection.
Perhaps in the eyes of Intelligent Life, everything is a resource without distinction of high or low.
But he was human after all; since the result was the same, and the cost of purchasing these biological blanks from the Divine Shop was so low as to be negligible,
Then Yang Fan naturally chose the path that made him more “comfortable”.
Developing up to now, the only Bottleneck of the Divine Kingdom was no longer resources, but area.
With the laying of a large number of Spiritual Veins, the Cultivate environment of the entire Divine Kingdom had been pushed to an extremely high level.
The concentration of Spiritual Qi was close to saturation; under such an environment, the believers’ cultivation speed far exceeded the past.
The quantity of the Foundation Establishment Realm continued to increase.
You must know that the Lifespan of Foundation Establishment Realm living beings can reach up to ten thousand years.

Although during these long years they needed to continuously participate in Divine Kingdom Wars, suffering a certain amount of combat losses, and would also naturally perish when their Lifespan came to an end,
But at the same time, Qi Refining Stage believers were also breaking through in an endless stream.
Amidst the replacement of the old and the new, the overall quantity of the Foundation Establishment Realm still presented a slow and steady growth trend.
Nowadays, for Yang Fan, he only needs to continuously devour the Divine Kingdom Core and expand his territory.
As long as the living space is sufficient, believers will naturally multiply rapidly.
Within the Divine Kingdom.
The four of Yang Da stood shoulder to shoulder, uniformly bowing in salute, “Greetings, Master.”
Upon the high platform, Yang Fan sat upright.
His expression was calm, and his gaze was profound. He was no longer as lazy as before, replaced instead by a sharp aura.
A faint sense of oppression permeated from him.
In two months’ time, he had learned a lot in the Primordial City Library, gaining a completely new understanding of the relationship between “gods” and “Divine Kingdoms”.
The Divine Kingdom is the Foundation; gods are the helmsmen. The two complement each other.
The current him would no longer hand everything over to Intelligent Life for a decision like in the past.
“Master,” Yang Da spoke, “I once again propose purchasing dangerous-grade Divine Kingdom coordinates.”
Yang Fan had already heard this sentence six times; almost every time his consciousness entered the Divine Kingdom, Yang Da would bring it up once.
In the past, Yang Fan’s response was only two simple words — refusal.
But this time, he didn’t immediately deny it, instead slightly raising his gaze, “Reasons.”
Hearing these words, a flash of joy crossed Yang Da’s eyes.
Seeing him raise his hand, a light blue light screen unfolded in front of Yang Fan.
Dense data rapidly emerged.

“First is the combat power evaluation. According to the Human Race Federation demigod big data model calculations, the current Divine Kingdom’s comprehensive combat power is at an upper-middle level. Whether it is believer quality, quantity, or war resource allocation, the Foundation to challenge dangerous-grade Divine Kingdoms is already possessed.”

“Second is the defense system. As of now, the total investment in defense-type buildings in the Divine Kingdom has reached thirty million Divinity Points. Calculated by the current Divine Kingdom area, the defense density and strength belong to the top tier among the demigod level. Even if the battle situation is unfavorable, believers can retreat and defend the Divine Kingdom homeland. At most, the Divine Kingdom coordinates will be exposed, but under the existing defense system, security can still be guaranteed.”

“Third is the profit. The current target of invasion is safe-grade Divine Kingdoms, and the area increase from a single devouring of the Divine Kingdom Core is only between 500,000 to 1.5 million square kilometers. However, if the target is the Divine Kingdom of a powerful demigod, the area growth from a single absorption of the Divine Kingdom Core can reach 5 million, or even 10 million square kilometers. If lucky, the resources from pioneering can also make a huge profit.”

“Fourth is for the believers to fight. The current overall combat power of believers far exceeds the safe-grade Divine Kingdom standard; battles are basically a rolling crush. Although losses are low, combat power is completely wasted.”
“Powerful pressure can bring more growth to believers.”

Yang Da retracted his hand, and the light screen slowly dissipated. He looked at Yang Fan, saying in an excited tone, “In summary, the current Divine Kingdom combat power and Divine Kingdom area seriously mismatched. Risks are controllable, and profits are extremely high. Continuing to walk the conservative route is instead slowing down the Divine Kingdom’s development rhythm.”

The stronger the combat power of the Divine Kingdom, the more its internal assets grow exponentially.
Simply put, what they are fighting right now are “scraps”, and what they will fight in the future are truly “treasuries”.
Regarding this, Yang Da proposed a suggestion more than once — giving up Safe-grade coordinates and instead purchasing normal or even dangerous-grade coordinates.
In his view, with the current comprehensive combat power of the Divine Kingdom, it is definitely not considered weak among demigods.
Continuing to attack low-tier Divine Kingdoms has too low efficiency.
“In current Divine Kingdom Wars, aside from the Divine Kingdom Core having value, the rest of the resources can be almost ignored.”
“If we want to accelerate development, we must participate in higher-level wars.”
These were Yang Da’s exact words; he had even explicitly proposed the strategy of supporting war through war.

After all, the current “money-burning speed” of the Divine Kingdom is equally astonishing, and if they could capture the Divine Kingdom of a powerful demigod, doubling their assets would by no means be empty talk.
But this proposal was forcibly vetoed by Yang Fan.
Back then, the two had a dispute inside the main hall.
“With the current Divine Kingdom combat power, it can completely withstand higher-intensity warfare.” Yang Da’s tone was calm.
“Continuing to choose safe coordinates is simply wasting time.”
“You are too anxious.” Yang Fan shook his head.
“I recently read a book on financial investment.” Yang Fan slowly said, “There is a sentence in it that left a deep impression on me.”
“In the field of wealth, what determines the ultimate height is never who runs faster, but who lives longer, and who can stay at the poker table the entire time.”
“In my view, the development of the Divine Kingdom is the same.
With our SSS-rank Talent, we are already leading the vast majority of people.
In that case, there is even less need to gamble on those uncertain risks.”
“Advancing steadily is the optimal solution.” Yang Fan’s tone was firm.
Facing Yang Fan’s decision, although Yang Da had objections in his heart, he didn’t say anything more.
After all, gods are the ultimate arbiters.
Thus, the development of the Divine Kingdom still advanced steadily according to the current rhythm.
Yang Da’s calculation was not wrong.
One thousand years of Divine Kingdom time ago, the proportion of purple Aptitude among newborn believers had already exceeded seventy percent.
From that moment on, the River of Hope completed its mission and was directly sold.
And the plan of casting low-Aptitude believers into the Extra-dimensional Research Institute was terminated accordingly.
Nowadays, the periphery of that research institute has long been replaced by another scene.
Billions of nutrient pods spread out densely, resembling a cold and massive “life factory”.
Within the pods, simian creatures similar in size to the Human Race are cultivated.
Consciousness has not yet been born, but they already possess a complete flesh-and-blood structure.
Countless work-type robots shuttle back and forth among them.
Testing, recording, calibrating, batches of light green nutrient solution were orderly injected into the pods.
The entire area was quiet, cold, and efficient, resembling an emotionless production line.
Back then, Yang Da had once proposed extracting believer genes directly to carry out large-scale cloning.
But this proposal was still vetoed by Yang Fan.
From the perspective of the result, whether it was humans or Yao Beasts of similar size, they would eventually transform into zombies.
In essence, there was no difference.
What Yang Fan truly needed were just these “vectors”, as long as they could allow the virus to spread within the Alien Divine Kingdom.
From the perspective of results, cloned believers and these “blanks” indeed had no difference.
But emotionally, Yang Fan still felt a trace of instinctive rejection.
Perhaps in the eyes of Intelligent Life, everything is a resource without distinction of high or low.
But he was human after all; since the result was the same, and the cost of purchasing these biological blanks from the Divine Shop was so low as to be negligible,
Then Yang Fan naturally chose the path that made him more “comfortable”.
Developing up to now, the only Bottleneck of the Divine Kingdom was no longer resources, but area.
With the laying of a large number of Spiritual Veins, the Cultivate environment of the entire Divine Kingdom had been pushed to an extremely high level.
The concentration of Spiritual Qi was close to saturation; under such an environment, the believers’ cultivation speed far exceeded the past.
The quantity of the Foundation Establishment Realm continued to increase.
You must know that the Lifespan of Foundation Establishment Realm living beings can reach up to ten thousand years.

Although during these long years they needed to continuously participate in Divine Kingdom Wars, suffering a certain amount of combat losses, and would also naturally perish when their Lifespan came to an end,
But at the same time, Qi Refining Stage believers were also breaking through in an endless stream.
Amidst the replacement of the old and the new, the overall quantity of the Foundation Establishment Realm still presented a slow and steady growth trend.
Nowadays, for Yang Fan, he only needs to continuously devour the Divine Kingdom Core and expand his territory.
As long as the living space is sufficient, believers will naturally multiply rapidly.
Within the Divine Kingdom.
The four of Yang Da stood shoulder to shoulder, uniformly bowing in salute, “Greetings, Master.”
Upon the high platform, Yang Fan sat upright.
His expression was calm, and his gaze was profound.
He was no longer as lazy as before, replaced instead by a sharp aura.
A faint sense of oppression permeated from him.
In two months’ time, he had learned a lot in the Primordial City Library, gaining a completely new understanding of the relationship between “gods” and “Divine Kingdoms”.
The Divine Kingdom is the Foundation; gods are the helmsmen.
The two complement each other.
The current him would no longer hand everything over to Intelligent Life for a decision like in the past.
“Master,” Yang Da spoke, “I once again propose purchasing dangerous-grade Divine Kingdom coordinates.”
Yang Fan had already heard this sentence six times; almost every time his consciousness entered the Divine Kingdom, Yang Da would bring it up once.
In the past, Yang Fan’s response was only two simple words — refusal.
But this time, he didn’t immediately deny it, instead slightly raising his gaze, “Reasons.”
Hearing these words, a flash of joy crossed Yang Da’s eyes.
Seeing him raise his hand, a light blue light screen unfolded in front of Yang Fan.
Dense data rapidly emerged.
“First is the combat power evaluation.
According to the Human Race Federation demigod big data model calculations, the current Divine Kingdom’s comprehensive combat power is at an upper-middle level.
Whether it is believer quality, quantity, or war resource allocation, the Foundation to challenge dangerous-grade Divine Kingdoms is already possessed.”
“Second is the defense system.
As of now, the total investment in defense-type buildings in the Divine Kingdom has reached thirty million Divinity Points.
Calculated by the current Divine Kingdom area, the defense density and strength belong to the top tier among the demigod level.
Even if the battle situation is unfavorable, believers can retreat and defend the Divine Kingdom homeland.
At most, the Divine Kingdom coordinates will be exposed, but under the existing defense system, security can still be guaranteed.”
“Third is the profit.
The current target of invasion is safe-grade Divine Kingdoms, and the area increase from a single devouring of the Divine Kingdom Core is only between 500,000 to 1.5 million square kilometers.
However, if the target is the Divine Kingdom of a powerful demigod, the area growth from a single absorption of the Divine Kingdom Core can reach 5 million, or even 10 million square kilometers.
If lucky, the resources from pioneering can also make a huge profit.”
“Fourth is for the believers to fight.
The current overall combat power of believers far exceeds the safe-grade Divine Kingdom standard; battles are basically a rolling crush.
Although losses are low, combat power is completely wasted.”
“Powerful pressure can bring more growth to believers.”
Yang Da retracted his hand, and the light screen slowly dissipated.
He looked at Yang Fan, saying in an excited tone, “In summary, the current Divine Kingdom combat power and Divine Kingdom area seriously mismatched.
Risks are controllable, and profits are extremely high.
Continuing to walk the conservative route is instead slowing down the Divine Kingdom’s development rhythm.”

chapters.title: Chapter 161: Black Armored Beetle Race, where did this lunatic come from?
paragraphs: Listening to Yang Da’s explanation, Yang Fan’s gaze swept over the four, finally landing on Yang Da.
“Follow your plan. However, since we have chosen to attack, I will not allow failure. The Divine Kingdom coordinates must not be exposed.”
The four bowed in unison. “We, will strictly follow the Master’s orders!”
Yang Fan’s consciousness had already returned to reality.
He sat by the window, flipping through a book titled “Comprehensive Guide to Divine Kingdom War.
The pages turned lightly, carrying a real tactile sensation different from the Virtual World.
However, at this moment, his attention was on Yang San’s perspective.
Yang Da had already completed the purchase of the coordinates, which was the Dangerous-level Divine Kingdom priced at three million Divinity Points — the Black Armored Beetle Race.
Inside the Divine Kingdom, space tore apart, and the coordinate channel slowly opened.
At this moment, Yang San stood before the great army, his expression cold and stern, with ten massive phalanxes arranged neatly behind him.
Each phalanx had one thousand Foundation Establishment Realm Believers, one hundred thousand Qi Refining Stage, one hundred thousand Martial Apprentice, and the rest were all Tier 5 Beings.
A total of one hundred million troops.
Ten phalanxes meant one billion troops.
An aura of slaughter surged into the sky.
Under Yang Da’s coordination, the forces deployed this time far exceeded the past.
“Open —!” Yang San gave the order, the spatial channel stabilized completely, and the army poured into it like a flood.
Shifting his gaze, the Black Armored Beetle Race’s Alien Divine Kingdom came into view.
Everywhere he looked, it was full of vitality, with towering ancient trees stretching in continuous stretches, the ground covered in lush vegetation, and Spiritual Qi swirling.
Even in the outer areas of the Alien Divine Kingdom, there were large tracts of reclaimed farmland, where black rice grew, permeating with a rich aura of life.
In the distance, one could see a large number of creatures active; herds of cattle, horses, and sheep were wandering about.
Yang Fan’s gaze shifted; he actually saw a familiar creature in this Alien Divine Kingdom — the Bodhi Precious Snake.
That was a species he had cultivated when he was still a Divine Being, he didn’t expect this Alien Divine Kingdom to have it too.
Unlike that Fission Beast Demigod from before, this insectoid demigod’s Divine Kingdom was developing very well, following a path of sustainable development.
No overdrawing of the Divine Kingdom’s foundation, and the Believers were not strengthened through predatory methods.
It was more like a steady and solid management style.
Just then, the sky on the periphery of the Alien Divine Kingdom suddenly darkened.
Hum —
A low buzzing of wings filled the air, and countless figures rose from the distant sky, dense and numerous, obscuring the firmament.

These alien Believers were pitch black all over, about the size of a Half-man, their entire bodies covered in hard scales with black light flowing across them; just looking from afar, one could feel their astonishing defensive power.
Someone had invaded the Alien Divine Kingdom, and as a god, the opponent sensed the disturbance immediately.
On the periphery of the Alien Divine Kingdom, the patrolling Black Armored Beetle Race did not immediately launch an attack.
They flapped their wings and ascended, quickly forming ranks in the high altitude, their Formation disciplined, like a black iron curtain spanning the sky, waiting in battle array.
The next moment, a phantom slowly condensed above the insect swarm.
Demigod will, descended.
“Human Race demigod —” The phantom looked down, its voice low. “Which faction do you come from? With such a large-scale invasion, are you not afraid of mutual destruction?”
His gaze fell upon Yang Fan’s army, his expression becoming increasingly solemn.
Ten thousand Foundation Establishment, two million Qi Refining and Martial Apprentice, the rest all Tier 5 Beings.
Although the Human Race army only numbered one billion, the quality was ridiculously strong.
He had experienced many Divine Kingdom invasions, but this was the first time he had seen an opponent with such “luxurious” initial forces.
Even though this was his home turf, unless necessary, he did not want to easily fight to the death with such an enemy.
There were no words in response to him, only actions.
Yang San stood at the front of the Formation, his gaze cold and sharp.
“Form up.”
With these two faint words falling, the ten-direction Formation unfolded instantly.
Ten Yama Halls Formation — Complete!
Yin Qi surged, the Formation was like a prison.
The next instant, all-out attack!
The strongest of the Black Armored Beetle Race on the periphery of the Alien Divine Kingdom were only at the entry level; under the suppression of the Formation, they had almost no power to resist.
Large swaths of the insect swarm were torn, crushed, and annihilated.
The battle ended cleanly and decisively.
Watching his Believers being slaughtered, the insectoid demigod only let out a cold huff, and the phantom dissipated immediately.
Since the Divine Kingdom coordinates had already been exposed, there was no way back; only by making the opponent “hurt” could a ceasefire be exchanged.
He never expected a few words to persuade the enemy to retreat; Divine Kingdom War had always been like this—without a painful price, no one would retreat.
As Yang San’s army continued to advance, they encountered more and more of the Black Armored Beetle Race.
From the initial millions to tens of millions, then to hundreds of millions!
Dense and numerous, blocking the sky and sun, like a sea of insects.

And what was even trickier was their attack method; the forelimbs of these Black Armored Beetle Race were coated with highly toxic poison, and once scratched, the toxin would rapidly erode flesh and Qi.
For this reason, Yang Yi urgently purchased a large amount of antidote from the Divine Shop, continuously dropping it to the front line.
But the problem did not end there; a month later, the war situation changed abruptly.
Yang San encountered real resistance.
The insectoid race began to counterattack in an organized manner, utilizing terrain, numbers, toxins, and endless sneak attacks and harassment, giving the army no time to rest.
In just one month, nearly one hundred million Believers were lost!
The front line was suppressed at one point.
Faced with this situation, Yang Yi and Yang Da made quick decisions, once again investing resources from the Divine Shop.
They spent nearly ten thousand Divinity Points, directly purchasing over a thousand tons of Class C insecticide!
As the agent was deployed, a large number of the Black Armored Beetle Race were cleansed, and the insect sea was forcefully torn open.
Yang Fan didn’t care about the purchase of these war supplies.
However, he couldn’t help but sigh in his heart: “As expected of a Dangerous-level Divine Kingdom, the difficulty of Divine Kingdom War increases geometrically.”
In the past, those “Safe-level” targets almost only required the Believer army to crush them, with minimal resource investment.
But now, before the army had even touched the Divine Kingdom Core, the investment had already reached tens of thousands of Divinity Points.
Such consumption, if it were an ordinary demigod, would have already stopped losses and retreated.
But Yang Fan was different; he wasn’t short on money, and he was even less short on troops.
His goal had been very clear from the beginning: the opponent’s Divine Kingdom Core.
As for this little loss during the war, it was still within his acceptable range.
But the insectoid demigod on the other side could no longer bear it.
In the core area of the Divine Kingdom.
He stood in the high sky, his expression twisted.
“Lunatic... where did this lunatic come from?!”
“Pouring so much poison into my Divine Kingdom?!”
“Does he not calculate the cost?!”
“If we keep fighting like this, all my accumulation from over a hundred years will be consumed!!!”
His eyes were bloodshot; in order to deal with those toxins, he also had to purchase a large amount of antidote from the insectoid Divine Shop.
These were real, tangible costs, and these investments would have no return in the future.
What also made him unable to understand was that these poisons were not just poisoning his Believers; they were now even destroying the environment of his Divine Kingdom.
Large tracts of Spirit Plant withered, and some buildings were corroded and damaged.
If this continued, even if the opponent finally conquered his Divine Kingdom, how much value could be recovered?
Why on earth go to such lengths without regard for the cost?!
He had appeared above the battlefield more than once.
Attempting to negotiate, attempting to stop the losses.
But neither Yang San nor the Yang Fan behind him gave any response, as if they didn’t care about these losses at all.
This disregard was even more infuriating than direct suppression.
If one didn’t know better, they would think there was some deep, bloody feud between the two sides.

chapters.title: Chapter 162: Wen Yushui Breaks Through to Demigod
paragraphs: The Divine Kingdom War was in full swing, with The Frontlines continuously advancing and Resources being poured in constantly.
Although Yang Fan was paying attention, he did not focus his main energy on the battlefield.
At this moment, he was still sitting by the window reading books.
During this period of studying at the Primordial City Library, Yang Fan clearly realized that he lacked too many things.
The Divine Kingdom War was executed by Yang San and coordinated by Yang Da; if he personally attended to every matter, it would instead be a waste of energy.
People must do meaningful things, rather than indulge in the emotional fluctuations during the process.
Staring at the advance of the battlefield and chasing that tiny “thrill of victory,” while seeming to be involved, was actually just meaningless internal friction.
True experts never indulge in instant feedback; instead, they keep their eyes on the future and invest their time where they can amplify their own value.
Calming his mind, drawing knowledge from books, improving his cognition, and accumulating greater advantages for the future.
Ten-odd days passed in a row.

The battle in the Alien Divine Kingdom remained intense, and the losses of believers on both sides continued to expand. On Yang Fan’s side alone, The Frontline casualties of Tier 5 Beings had already reached as high as 300 million.
This was still under the premise of sufficient Resources, with antidotes, healing Medicinal Pills, and Water of Life in the rear never being interrupted.
If not for this, the losses would only have been even more disastrous.
But at the same time, relying on the hundredfold time Evolution Talent, the replenishment of troops never stopped.
To help Yang San reduce pressure, Yang Da even increased the troop strength, and now the scale of the army commanded by Yang San had expanded to 1.5 billion.
Excluding high-tier believers, almost half of the mid-tier combat power of the Divine Kingdom had been drawn away.
In these dozen days, the Resources produced by the Divine Kingdom.
Excluding the necessary war consumption—strategic Materials such as Medicinal Pills, antidotes, and insecticidal potions.
The vast majority of the rest were continuously used by Yang Da to purchase f-class transformation pods, constantly strengthening the reserve forces.
This war was far from as easy as imagined; the Divine Kingdom of the Black Armored Beetle Race not only had a profound foundation, but its methods were also extremely vicious.
Toxins, traps, counterattacks, luring the enemy... methods emerged endlessly.
Even a war-type Advanced Intelligent Life like Yang San inevitably had times when he made mistakes.
Regarding this, Yang Fan’s emotions still did not fluctuate much.
He knew very well that as fellow demigods engaged in a true battle of life and death, why should he be able to easily crush the opponent?
At a time like this, who didn’t pull out all their trump cards and use all their means? The so-called “underhanded moves” were just a way to survive.
At least for now, the battle situation was still under control.
Yang San was still steadily advancing The Frontline. As for those losses, under the blessing of the Evolution Talent, they were completely within a controllable range.
One year in the opponent’s Divine Kingdom meant a hundred years had already passed in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
As long as large-scale collapse did not occur, victory would ultimately belong to him.
Through Yang San’s perspective, Yang Fan quietly observed this Divine Kingdom, a trace of burning passion faintly rising in his heart.
Marching up to now, they still hadn’t touched the Divine Kingdom Core, which meant that the opponent’s Divine Kingdom was shockingly massive in area.
Clearly, this Insectoid Demigod had devoured quite a few Divine Kingdom Cores.
As long as he devoured the opponent’s core, his Divine Kingdom’s area would surely welcome a leap.
By then, whether it was the Divine Kingdom’s investment returns or the believers’ population scale, it would rise to another level.
Just as Yang Fan was pondering, his watch suddenly vibrated gently.
The group message notification sound rang out.

Sima Bang: “Qingshan District F4 assemble, the first semester of freshman year is almost over, I’ve booked a private room at Yuexiang Pavilion in the Real World. Hurry over, we have important matters to discuss. @Everyone!”
Ye Jianfeng: “Right away.”
Wen Yushui: “Big bro, Little Sis will be right there, don’t eat all the dishes again.”
Yang Fan: “Received.”
Over this past year, the relationship among the four had grown increasingly familiar.
Because they all lived in the Qingshan District of Taichu City, Sima Bang simply gave the small circle a name—Qingshan District F4.
On normal days, they mostly gathered in the Virtual World, but this time Sima Bang chose to host a banquet in the Real World, clearly having something to discuss.
In the past, because of Yang Fan’s SSS-rank Talent, even if he was low-key on the surface, his heart still carried a bit of arrogance.
Ever since he was educated by Yang Da, his thoughts were already quite different.
Sima Bang was a direct descendant of the Five Great Giants Family, and this was an extremely important network of Resources.
Unlike investment within the Divine Kingdom, the resource circulation of the Real World was truly massive.
Which of those High-Order Gods didn’t sit atop a Family, control a company, and ally with chambers of commerce!
If all needs could be resolved solely by relying on the internal circulation of the Divine Kingdom, then systems like the Virtual World and the Divine Shop would have no meaning for existence.
Precisely because there was demand, there were transactions, resource flows, and the convergence of wealth.
Yang Fan knew clearly that he couldn’t rest on his laurels just because he had the SSS-rank Talent; otherwise, his future wouldn’t go very far!
Yuexiang Pavilion, inside the private room.
Yang Fan pushed the door and entered. At this time, Sima Bang and Ye Jianfeng had already arrived first.
The two were sitting by the table, chatting casually about something.
Sima Bang waved his hand: “Old Yang is here, sit.”
Yang Fan nodded and sat down, his gaze sweeping around: “Wen Yushui hasn’t arrived yet?”
He was somewhat surprised. In past gatherings, Wen Yushui almost never arrived late, and mostly she was even the first to arrive.
Ye Jianfeng said calmly: “Not yet.”
Yang Fan nodded and didn’t think much of it.
Perhaps when girls went out, they needed to spend a bit more time getting ready.
The three of them chatted casually, the atmosphere relaxed.
Just at this moment, the door of the private room was gently pushed open, and a figure walked in.
The three raised their heads at the same time, their gazes falling over, slightly stunned.
Wen Yushui had changed into a completely new set of clothes, her temperament brighter than before, as if her whole person had gained an indescribable change.
Confident, calm, and even faintly carrying a trace of oppression.
The three looked at each other, almost at the same time revealing a trace of realization.
So she had broken through to Demigod!

Sima Bang smiled and raised his cup: “Congratulations to Sister Wen on breaking through to Demigod. Stepping into this level in the second half of freshman year can be considered upper-middle among the Human Race Prodigy of the Primordial Academy.”
Ye Jianfeng and Yang Fan likewise stood up, raising their cups to signal: “Congratulations.”
The drinks clinked lightly, and the atmosphere instantly grew lively.
In fact, this “tardiness” was deliberately done by Wen Yushui; she needed a timing to make the three of them re-evaluate her value.
This past year, the pressure she bore was not small.
Sima Bang, Ye Jianfeng, and Yang Fan had all stepped into Demigod, only she had failed to break through for a long time.
In a circle like this, being slow by one step could mean being slow by every step.
For this reason, she even mobilized Family Resources and asked her father to lend a hand, only then catching up with the three.
Now she finally stood at the same level, even if her potential was slightly inferior. But as long as she became a Demigod, she wouldn’t be kicked out of the “Qingshan District F4” circle.
Several people sat down, and the topic quickly returned to a familiar direction.
Sima Bang mentioned casually: “Recently I heard that the coordinates of a batch of’spirit core veins’ are in circulation; the price is not high, but the Late Stage output is stable.”
Ye Jianfeng nodded: “I’ve also heard of it, but this kind of resource leans towards the mid-to-Late Stage, and the early-stage returns are too slow.”
Wen Yushui added: “Yuandan Co., Ltd. has recently been acquiring related Resources. They seem to be preparing to do a round of integration.”

Yang Fan slowly spoke: “This kind of investment cannot just look at the return cycle; the output of spirit core veins is indeed a bit slow, but the Ore they produce is an essential material for producing A-rank or even S-rank equipment.”

“What Yuandan Co., Ltd. values in its acquisition is not the veins themselves, but the supply chain stability of downstream Resources. If we can layout related basic Resources at a low price before they integrate.”
“Even if we don’t hold it long-term, exiting after the price is pumped up will still allow us to catch a wave of dividends.”
Speaking up to here, Yang Fan paused and said: “Of course, the risk is not small; once the opponent changes their plan, this kind of resource is very easily trapped.”

Although Yang Fan was paying attention, he did not focus his main energy on the battlefield.
At this moment, he was still sitting by the window reading books.
During this period of studying at the Primordial City Library, Yang Fan clearly realized that he lacked too many things.
The Divine Kingdom War was executed by Yang San and coordinated by Yang Da; if he personally attended to every matter, it would instead be a waste of energy.
People must do meaningful things, rather than indulge in the emotional fluctuations during the process.
Staring at the advance of the battlefield and chasing that tiny “thrill of victory,” while seeming to be involved, was actually just meaningless internal friction.
True experts never indulge in instant feedback; instead, they keep their eyes on the future and invest their time where they can amplify their own value.
Calming his mind, drawing knowledge from books, improving his cognition, and accumulating greater advantages for the future.
Ten-odd days passed in a row.
The battle in the Alien Divine Kingdom remained intense, and the losses of believers on both sides continued to expand.
On Yang Fan’s side alone, The Frontline casualties of Tier 5 Beings had already reached as high as 300 million.
This was still under the premise of sufficient Resources, with antidotes, healing Medicinal Pills, and Water of Life in the rear never being interrupted.
If not for this, the losses would only have been even more disastrous.
But at the same time, relying on the hundredfold time Evolution Talent, the replenishment of troops never stopped.
To help Yang San reduce pressure, Yang Da even increased the troop strength, and now the scale of the army commanded by Yang San had expanded to 1.5 billion.
Excluding high-tier believers, almost half of the mid-tier combat power of the Divine Kingdom had been drawn away.
In these dozen days, the Resources produced by the Divine Kingdom.
Excluding the necessary war consumption—strategic Materials such as Medicinal Pills, antidotes, and insecticidal potions.
The vast majority of the rest were continuously used by Yang Da to purchase f-class transformation pods, constantly strengthening the reserve forces.
This war was far from as easy as imagined; the Divine Kingdom of the Black Armored Beetle Race not only had a profound foundation, but its methods were also extremely vicious.
Toxins, traps, counterattacks, luring the enemy... methods emerged endlessly.
Even a war-type Advanced Intelligent Life like Yang San inevitably had times when he made mistakes.
Regarding this, Yang Fan’s emotions still did not fluctuate much.
He knew very well that as fellow demigods engaged in a true battle of life and death, why should he be able to easily crush the opponent?
At a time like this, who didn’t pull out all their trump cards and use all their means?
The so-called “underhanded moves” were just a way to survive.
At least for now, the battle situation was still under control.
Yang San was still steadily advancing The Frontline.
As for those losses, under the blessing of the Evolution Talent, they were completely within a controllable range.
One year in the opponent’s Divine Kingdom meant a hundred years had already passed in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
As long as large-scale collapse did not occur, victory would ultimately belong to him.
Through Yang San’s perspective, Yang Fan quietly observed this Divine Kingdom, a trace of burning passion faintly rising in his heart.
Marching up to now, they still hadn’t touched the Divine Kingdom Core, which meant that the opponent’s Divine Kingdom was shockingly massive in area.
Clearly, this Insectoid Demigod had devoured quite a few Divine Kingdom Cores.
As long as he devoured the opponent’s core, his Divine Kingdom’s area would surely welcome a leap.
By then, whether it was the Divine Kingdom’s investment returns or the believers’ population scale, it would rise to another level.
Just as Yang Fan was pondering, his watch suddenly vibrated gently.
The group message notification sound rang out.
Sima Bang: “Qingshan District F4 assemble, the first semester of freshman year is almost over, I’ve booked a private room at Yuexiang Pavilion in the Real World.
Hurry over, we have important matters to discuss. @Everyone!”
Ye Jianfeng: “Right away.”
Wen Yushui: “Big bro, Little Sis will be right there, don’t eat all the dishes again.”
Yang Fan: “Received.”
Over this past year, the relationship among the four had grown increasingly familiar.
Because they all lived in the Qingshan District of Taichu City, Sima Bang simply gave the small circle a name—Qingshan District F4.
On normal days, they mostly gathered in the Virtual World, but this time Sima Bang chose to host a banquet in the Real World, clearly having something to discuss.
In the past, because of Yang Fan’s SSS-rank Talent, even if he was low-key on the surface, his heart still carried a bit of arrogance.
Ever since he was educated by Yang Da, his thoughts were already quite different.
Sima Bang was a direct descendant of the Five Great Giants Family, and this was an extremely important network of Resources.
Unlike investment within the Divine Kingdom, the resource circulation of the Real World was truly massive.
Which of those High-Order Gods didn’t sit atop a Family, control a company, and ally with chambers of commerce!
If all needs could be resolved solely by relying on the internal circulation of the Divine Kingdom, then systems like the Virtual World and the Divine Shop would have no meaning for existence.
Precisely because there was demand, there were transactions, resource flows, and the convergence of wealth.
Yang Fan knew clearly that he couldn’t rest on his laurels just because he had the SSS-rank Talent; otherwise, his future wouldn’t go very far!
Yuexiang Pavilion, inside the private room.

Perhaps when girls went out, they needed to spend a bit more time getting ready.

Confident, calm, and even faintly carrying a trace of oppression.

So she had broken through to Demigod!

chapters.title: Chapter 163: Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle
paragraphs: As the words fell, the private room fell silent for a brief moment.
Sima Bang and the other two exchanged glances, and when they looked at Yang Fan again, their eyes noticeably changed a bit.
There was curiosity, and even surprise.
In the past, Yang Fan did not talk much during dinners. Even when he spoke, he mostly just agreed and rarely participated in such professional discussions.
But what he said now was not only clear in logic, but also very reasonable. It seemed he had done quite a bit of research usually.
Ye Jianfeng nodded, “That makes sense. If it is short-term operation, it is indeed feasible.”
He changed the subject, “By the way, Brother Yang, how is the recent production of Monkey Wine in your Divine Kingdom?”
“After my Breakthrough to demigod, the believer population has skyrocketed. The demand for Monkey Wine on my side has also increased a lot. Can you supply a bit more?”
He spoke very naturally. The transaction between the two had lasted for a long time, and both of them connected through Intelligent Life, making the operation simple and capable of evading taxes.
Hearing this, Yang Fan smiled, “Of course no problem. How much does Brother Ye want? I have whatever you need here.”

As his voice fell, he casually snapped his fingers, and the space fluctuated slightly. Three large barrels of Monkey Wine suffused with Spiritual Qi were directly materialized and landed beside the table.
“One barrel for each of you, consider it a welcome gift.”
The eyes of Sima Bang lit up, “Brother, you are generous!”
He directly picked up the wine barrel, tilted his head back to take a gulp, and then laughed as he stored it into his Divine Kingdom.
Compared to the past, Yang Fan was now noticeably much smoother and more proactive in integrating into this circle.
“Brother Sima.” Ye Jianfeng put down his wine glass, his gaze narrowing slightly, “You called us over today for the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle, right?”
As soon as these words were spoken, the expressions of the few people present did not change much.
Having lived in Taichu City for almost a year, they had long since heard of this term.
Previously, Yang Fan did not take it to heart, and during this period of time he was immersed in reading again. Although he had heard of this event, he did not care much about it.

Sima Bang wiped his mouth and nodded, saying, “That is right. This Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle does not belong to the official activities of Primordial Academy, but is jointly hosted by the Five Great Giants. As long as you are a Human Race Prodigy, you are eligible to participate.”
“If the performance is good enough, the rewards will not be few. We can coordinate when the time comes, and maybe we can rake in a few million Divinity Points.”
“A few million Divinity Points?!” The pupils of Wen Yushui shrank, and she instinctively swallowed a mouthful of saliva.
She had never seen resource rewards of this level before.

Sima Bang smiled, “After all, it is the Five Great Giants making a move. The purpose of their holding this Apotheosis Battle is essentially to screen investment targets, so their moves naturally cannot be shabby.”
Ye Jianfeng frowned slightly, “Investment from the Five Great Giants... Is it the kind that requires signing a contract?”
There was a hint of vigilance in his tone. As a Family descendant, he could not hand his future over to other families, not even the Five Great Giants were an exception.
Sima Bang waved his hand, “Rest assured, it is not the kind you think. It is more like a Guest Elder nature. It is just hanging a name, giving Resources for free, but without restricting freedom.”

“The purpose of the Five Great Giants is to forge good karma with future High-Order Gods, not a forced binding. Right now, quite a few High-Order Gods have founded their own families, but at the same time they are also Guest Elders of the Five Great Giants.”
“The relationship is more like cooperation rather than attachment.”
Saying this, he let out a laugh, “To put it bluntly, it is basically equivalent to free money. Of course, the premise is that you are qualified.”

Sima Bang glanced at the three of them, his tone slightly teasing, “This kind of opportunity is basically only possible for the top Prodigy to get. Let us not think too much for now. We are only freshmen, and we cannot compete with those junior and senior seniors.”
“Our Divine Kingdom foundation is far too lacking. If we want to eat this piece of meat, we have to wait another two years at least to have a glimmer of a chance.”

Sima Bang changed the subject, the smile on his face gradually fading, and his expression became serious, “Our goal this time is not the investment contract, but the first stage — Divinity Screening!”
Yang Fan and the other two exchanged glances, a hint of confusion emerging in their eyes.
“There are a total of over five thousand Human Race Prodigy in the entire Primordial Academy.” Sima Bang slowly spoke, “And the first stage will directly eliminate over ninety percent.”

“After the assessment begins, our Physical Body will be uniformly teleported to a special space. That place was personally forged by a high-tier Mechanical god of the Sima Family. As time goes on, the Divinity coercion within the space will continuously increase.”

“Persist for one hour, reward one hundred thousand Divinity Points; two hours, one million; three hours, ten million; four hours, one hundred million, and at the same time obtain the assessment qualifications for the last two stages.”
“One hundred million...” Wen Yushui softly murmured, her breathing even becoming a bit rapid.
Sima Bang smiled, “Do not think too much, this money is not easy to get.”
His body leaned forward slightly, lowering his voice as he said, “My brother told me that there is actually a loophole we can exploit in this stage.”
“At that time, the four of us will stand in a line and take turns at the front to bear the Divinity coercion. Whoever cannot hold on will be replaced. We will drag out time using this method.”
“Our goal is two hours.”
“Like this... is it compliant? Will it be a bit unfair?” Wen Yushui frowned slightly.
Sima Bang sneered, “Fair? What fairness is there in this world? Quite a few people know about this loophole, and the direct descendants of various families use it every year.”
“And one of the examiners this time is my brother, so no one will say much.”
“Then we will bask in the light of Brother Sima.” Ye Jianfeng raised his glass and drank it in one gulp.
One million Divinity Points was of great significance to him, enough to directly accelerate the development of his Divine Kingdom by a level.
“Is this Divinity coercion... difficult?” Yang Fan suddenly spoke, “With the four of us joining forces, can we not push ourselves a bit harder?”
Compared to that one million Divinity Points, he cared more about the investment opportunities that might be obtained later.

Sima Bang glanced at him, “Difficult. The essence of Divinity coercion is equivalent to a High-Order God directly releasing coercion against you. What it suppresses is not just the Physical Body, but also consciousness, spirit, and even your Divine Kingdom.”

“Your spiritual strength, Divine Kingdom stability, and the overall strength of your believers will all affect how long you can hold on. In short, the stronger the Divine Kingdom, the longer the pressure-resistant time.”
Saying this, his tone sank, “And after two hours, the coercion will rise to another level. At that time, it is not something that rule loopholes can make up for.”

“Do not look down on those junior and senior seniors. They have developed two or three years longer than us, and their Divine Kingdom assets, environmental stability, and overall combat power of believers are all growing exponentially. The gap is absurdly large.”
“In the freshman stage, those who can withstand three hours are as rare as phoenix feathers and unicorn horns. As for four hours, that is no longer a Prodigy, but a Prodigy.”
“However, that kind of person will not participate in this assessment. This is a Heavenly Pride Battle, not their stage.”
Yang Fan nodded, “I see.”
Then he asked again, “Then how many more stages are there behind?”
“There are two more stages.” Sima Bang picked up his wine glass and took a sip.
It seemed his interest had risen, and his tone became a bit lighter.
“The second stage depends on your own choice.”
“According to the Cultivation Route of your Divine Kingdom — the assessment methods are also different.”
“Cultivation Route — looks at attack power.”
“Martial Route — measures defense.”
“Mechanical Path — measures computing power.”
“To put it bluntly, these three directions test the overall quality of the believers in the Divine Kingdom.”
“After this stage, the number of people will be directly whittled down to ten.”

Sima Bang was seen raising a single finger, “The top ten, as long as they pass this stage, can obtain the investment of an S-Rank Building. And what is truly important is that special investment contract.”

chapters.title: Chapter 164: Please Master, punish me!
paragraphs: Speaking of this, Sima Bang let out a light sigh, a trace of burning passion emerging in his eyes, ” Ten people... I wonder if I’ll have the chance to get it when I’m a senior. “
” Big Brother Sima. ” Wen Yushui couldn’t help asking, ” You are inherently the son of the Sima Family head, do you still need these investments? “

Sima Bang gave a wry smile, ” The larger the Family, the more rules there are. Resources are never given for free; they all have to be fought for by oneself. I indeed drew a good womb, but that doesn’t mean the Sima Family will tilt resources toward me without limit. “
” In the eyes of those old fellows, they only look at value. Even if it’s a Genius of an external surname, as long as the potential is sufficient, the resource tilt can equally surpass me. “
Speaking of this, a flash of helplessness crossed Sima Bang’s eyes.

Soon, he recovered his composure, saying in a calm tone, ” The final stage is the competition among these ten people. Based on their performance, the examiners of the Five Great Giants will give the corresponding investment quotas. “
” Over the years, saying that the first place of the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle saves a thousand years of detours on the path of the Divine Kingdom is no exaggeration. “
” Then, I wish in advance that we obtain the investment contracts of the Five Great Giants before graduation. ” Ye Jianfeng raised his wine glass, his gaze firm.
” Good! ” Sima Bang laughed heartily and raised his glass along.
” Work hard together, Qingshan District F4, make our name known in Taichu City! “
” What is Taichu City? If we’re going to brag, we should blow it big and make our name known across the entire Human Race. “
” Hahaha, well said! “
” Come, let’s drink together! “
Wine glasses collided, laughter echoed, and the private room instantly became extraordinarily lively.
As the gathering neared its end, Sima Bang finally subdued his smile, his tone turning serious again, ” In another month and a half, the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle will begin. “

” During this period, try our best to raise the overall strength of believers. In addition, supplement more environmental buildings, such as Spiritual Veins, Source Qi Wells, Spirit Mist Forests, and Sky Light Towers. Although these buildings do not directly enhance combat power, they will greatly enhance the overall environment and stability of the Divine Kingdom. “
Sima Bang’s tone sank slightly: ” The Divinity pressure of the first stage is not just a test of the Physical Body and Mental Energy, the Divine Kingdom environment is equally the key. “
” If the Divine Kingdom environment is unstable, it won’t hold out for long. “

Speaking of this, Sima Bang said earnestly, ” Within a reasonable range, we can take appropriate loans. As long as the four of us can hold out for two hours, the revenue of one million Divinity Points will be enough to cover the costs. “
Hearing this, Ye Jianfeng and Wen Yushui fell into deep thought, starting to calculate the adjustment space within their Divine Kingdoms.
Obviously, both of them were tempted.
Yang Fan likewise echoed by nodding, but at this moment, a faint excitement stirred in his heart.

If it were only a competition of combat power, Yang Fan didn’t know what level he was at in the Primordial Academy, but if it came to comparing Divine Kingdom environments, he had absolute confidence.
Just the Spiritual Veins alone, his Divine Kingdom had a full fifty thousand of them.

This was an A-grade resource-type building. Placed in the outside world, if there wasn’t a powerful Family supporting it behind the scenes, being able to possess one or two lines would already be considered having a deep foundation.
Nowadays, in his Divine Kingdom, the concentration of Spiritual Qi and environmental stability had long reached a limit.

Even continuing to purchase Spiritual Veins later on, the marginal benefit to the overall environment improvement was already close to zero. The reason he continued to invest was simply because there were no better Divine Kingdom investments.
The gathering ended, and everyone dispersed.
After returning to his small courtyard, Yang Fan directly entered the Virtual World to continue studying.

There was still a month and a half until the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle. This kind of assessment had no need for special preparation; maintaining the pace to develop the Divine Kingdom would suffice.
Time passed, and in the blink of an eye, another twenty days passed.
On this day, according to his study plan, Yang Fan prepared to study the Comprehensive Guide to Cultivating Mechanical Path Believers.
The moment he just picked up the virtual helmet, his entire body suddenly stiffened, and a strong sense of palpitations appeared without warning, as if something was being lost.
” Fuck... ” Yang Fan’s expression instantly turned gloomy, ” Yang San! What are you doing?! “
Without any hesitation, his consciousness instantly entered the Divine Kingdom.
As a deity, as soon as this feeling appeared, he already understood what had happened.
Believers were dying on a large scale.

With the current environment of the Divine Kingdom, unless the Divine Kingdom was invaded, it was impossible for problems to occur. The only explanation was that something had gone wrong in the Alien Divine Kingdom Battlefield!
In the center of the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan’s figure had just condensed when he saw Yang Da and the other three neatly standing in a row.
They all lowered their heads, not daring to move a muscle, as if they had committed a grave mistake.
Yang San had already returned. At this moment, he stood in the middle, holding up high with both hands a black Divine Kingdom Core the size of a Half-man.
Yang Fan took a deep breath, forcefully suppressing the anger in his heart, and looked at Yang San with icy eyes, ” Tell me, what happened? “
” Reporting to Master. ” Yang San knelt heavily on both knees, ” This is the complete record of the final battle with the Black Armored Beetle Race. Please Master review it, and... punish me. “
Above the sky, a huge curtain of light slowly unfolded, completely presenting that final battle.
On the periphery of the Divine Kingdom Core, the flames of war had long scorched the earth pitch-black.
After decades of bitter battle with the Black Armored Beetle Race, the number of the insect swarm was forcibly reduced from the initial tens of billions to three billion.

But those remaining at this moment were all elites among elites, among which the Foundation Establishment Realm numbered a full seven thousand, and the Qi Refining Realm numbered in the millions, densely suspended in the air like a dark cloud.
The Void Realm trembled, and a massive demigod phantom slowly condensed.
That Black Armored Beetle Race demigod stood above the firmament, its aura violent, its voice carrying an extreme suppression of madness and anger: ” Human Demigod! Show yourself and meet me! “
” You have forced me to a desperate situation, this is an ultimatum! If we keep fighting, you might not necessarily come out ahead! “
The voice rolled like thunder bursting, and the entire Divine Kingdom was trembling.
However, the only response to him was a sneer.

Yang San stood in the center of the army Formation, his gaze as cold as ice: ” My army has arrived at the core area, your Divine Kingdom still has three billion troops remaining, and all your foundations have been brought out. You, worthy to see my Master? “
A single sentence, understatement, yet carrying ultimate contempt.
” You—!! ” That demigod phantom suddenly twisted, its voice completely out of control: ” Mere Intelligent Life, how dare you be so arrogant! You will regret this! “
The next moment, the flames of war completely erupted!
The Ten Halls of Yama Formation suddenly unfolded.
Between heaven and earth, Yin Qi surged, layer upon layer, enveloping the entire battlefield.
The Human Race army held nothing back.
Poisonous mist, raging fire, thunder, Sword Qi... various Cultivation Techniques and Martial Skills poured out like a torrent, attacking the insect race!
At the outermost periphery of the Formation, millions of Martial Apprentices wore B-grade defensive armor, forming the most solid flesh-and-blood defense line.
Even though their bodies had long been eroded by insect poison and their skin had turned black, they still stubbornly held their ground at the very front.
” Hold your ground! “
” Cannot retreat! “
The believers behind them continuously injected detoxification agents into their bodies, while bottles of Water of Life were crudely poured into their mouths.
Coughing up blood while roaring, they desperately blocked the first wave of the insect swarm’s impact.

I indeed drew a good womb, but that doesn’t mean the Sima Family will tilt resources toward me without limit.
