chapters.title: Chapter 165: Expert at civil war, amateur at foreign war!
paragraphs: On the other side, the Black Armored Beetle Race was equally insane.
To remove the influence of the C-rank insecticide, that demigod actually purchased an entire “Detoxification Spirit River” directly from the Divine Shop!
All bug race members going to The Frontline had to soak in it first before being thrown into battle.

Countless members of the Black Armored Beetle Race opened their mouthparts and spat out various terrifying methods: corrosive venom poured down like a torrential rain; neuroparalytic poisonous fog filled all directions; and there were dark purple spores that, once contaminated, would wildly reproduce and burst within flesh and blood!
The entire battlefield was like a purgatory.
Both sides completely entered a state of “trading lives for lives”.
Explosions, roars, angry shouts, and wails... intertwined into one piece.
Under Yang Yi’s coordination, the rear support was never cut off, and batch after batch of Tier 5 Beings poured into the battlefield to fill the gaps in the Formation.
The battle line advanced inch by inch.
Victory seemed within reach.
However, just as success was imminent, an accident occurred!
A Black Armored Beetle Race member at the Qi Refining Realm suddenly rushed into the Formation, its aura swelling frantically.
“Boom!!!”
The opponent actually self-destructed!
The terrifying energy instantly exploded!
A Qi Refining believer didn’t even have time to react before being directly torn into pieces, annihilating tens of thousands of Tier 5 Beings along with them in an instant!
Before anyone could react, the second, third, fourth...
More and more Black Armored Beetle Race members began charging frantically into the Formation!
“Boom! Boom! Boom!!!”
The explosions connected into one piece!
A full fifteen phalanxes of the Ten Halls of Yama Formation had gaps torn open at the same time!
The Formation runes cracked, the Yin Qi scattered, and the defense line collapsed instantly!
Outside the light screen, Yang Fan’s expression suddenly darkened; in this single instant, as many as four to five hundred million of his believers were killed!
Inside the light screen, Yang San’s expression changed drastically, and his voice was extremely hoarse: “Retreat!!!”
The order spread across the battlefield like thunder.
However, the retreat was even more tragic than the attack.
The Black Armored Beetle Race went completely crazy.
They no longer cared about Formations or tactics, leaving only a single thought: perish together!
The insect swarm was like a black torrent, specifically charging toward densely populated areas of the Human Race.
When a beetle race member self-destructed, it often took away dozens or even hundreds of believers of the same rank!
On the battlefield, fear began to spread.
“Marshal, save me!!!”
“Divine Being!!!”
“I don’t want to die — —!!”

Despairing shouts rose and fell one after another; some had half their bodies blown away yet were still crawling on the ground; some hugged the mutilated remains of their companions and wailed; some struggled and suffocated in the poisonous fog...
The shadow of death shrouded every believer.
In the end, the large army forcibly retreated several hundred kilometers.
Yang San made a prompt decision and decentralized into smaller units!
From “billion-level phalanxes”, they were split into “million-level combat teams”.
The Locking Heaven Array and Black Tortoise Life-Extinguishing Array were deployed layer by layer.
Defense and counterattack went hand in hand, finally stabilizing the situation and reducing losses.
This battle in the Alien Divine Kingdom lasted less than twenty days, yet it was tragic to the extreme.
In the end, the Black Armored Beetle Race was completely exterminated, but the price was equally heavy.
Five thousand Foundation Establishment died in battle, ten million Qi Refining died, and nearly eight hundred million Tier 5 Beings perished!
The light screen slowly dissipated.
Yang Fan stood in place, his knuckles slowly tightening.
Facing such huge losses, Yang Fan’s heart was bleeding at this moment.
Yang Fan didn’t feel too heartbroken over the deaths of those Tier 5 Beings.
With the Divine Kingdom’s current Cultivate environment and the assistance of the f-class transformation pod, they could always recover after developing peacefully for a period of time.
But Qi Refining and Foundation Establishment believers were truly the Foundation of the Divine Kingdom!
In a single Divine Kingdom War, nearly ten percent of high-tier combat power directly evaporated.
Yang Fan slowly walked up to Yang San.
“Bang — —!”
With a kick, Yang San was directly blasted flying, heavily crashing to the ground.
“A combat-type high-tier Intelligent Life?”
Yang Fan’s voice was low, carrying irrepressible anger, “Aren’t you full of sneaky ideas?”
“You thing who are an expert at civil wars and incompetent at foreign wars!”
“Where are my troops?”
“The losses of Qi Refining and Foundation Establishment are like this, and the resources invested in this war — — is it worth it?”
“Commanding an army of 1.5 billion, with an infinite supply of troops and resources, you must have been a very majestic marshal, right?”
“Then you tell me, why did we win so miserably?!”
As his voice fell, another kick was delivered.
One, two, three. For every sentence Yang Fan spoke, he delivered a kick.
Clearly it was just a conscious body, but the pain was incomparably real.
Yang San was kicked rolling repeatedly, his body vaguely turning a bit illusory, yet he remained silent throughout without dodging the slightest bit.
This Divine Kingdom War had unprecedented investment and equally tragic losses.
With such heavy damage, even with the current Foundation of the Divine Kingdom, it would take at least a thousand years to fully recover.
Just at this moment, Yang Da stepped forward and said, “Master, this matter cannot be entirely blamed on Yang San.”
“The opponent cultivated the insect race self-destruction secret technique. This variable was indeed unexpected.”
“Self-destruction secret technique?”
Yang Fan frowned slightly.
Yang Da nodded and slowly explained, “This method is similar to certain extreme Cultivation Techniques of the Human Race.”

“After members of the insect race Cultivate this method, they can forcibly compress all the energy in their bodies into a single point, detonating it in an instant to release a destructive might far exceeding their own Realm.”
“It belongs to a mutual destruction art.”
“However, the price is equally huge.”
“Once cultivated, the believers will completely lose their reproductive capacity, and their cultivation will not be able to advance any further.”
“Therefore, this type of secret technique is usually only used to Cultivate a very small number of’suicide squads’.”
Speaking of this, Yang Da’s tone sank slightly: “But this Black Armored Beetle Race demigod was even more ruthless.”

“Upon confirming that he could not repel our army, he directly had core believers Cultivate this technique on a large scale, trading the future of the divine kingdom in exchange for a final blow — — solely to heavily damage our army and vent his hatred.”
The scene fell silent; this method was almost equivalent to self-destroying one’s Foundation.
If it were a normal divine being, they would never make such a choice.
Yang San had truly bumped into a complete lunatic this time.
Yang Fan slowly exhaled a breath, suppressing his anger.

Seeing this, Yang Da turned to look at the three of Yang Yi, his tone regaining calmness and majesty: “In the short term, the Divine Kingdom will stop all external campaigns, focusing mainly on recovery and development.”
“Yang San.”
“This subordinate is here.”
Yang San immediately straightened his kneeling body.
“You are responsible for training the troops.”
“Although the Ten Halls of Yama Formation is strong, it leans heavily towards attack and lacks defense; this battle has exposed that very clearly.”
“Later, I will load a new C-rank Array for you. Comprehend it well and make up for your shortcomings.”
“Yes, My Lord!”
Yang San nodded heavily.
Then he turned to Yang Fan again and kowtowed heavily: “Master, the fault of this battle lies entirely with me.”
“In the future, I will definitely reorganize the military Formations and make up for the losses!”
After finishing, he lowered his head and retreated, his back clearly carrying a bit of heaviness.
“Yang Er.”
“This subordinate is here.”
“Take two billion Otherworldly Collectors and immediately return to the Black Armored Beetle Race Divine Kingdom.”
“All usable assets — — buildings, Spirit Plants, mineral veins, and remaining resources — — are to be recycled without exception.”
“Although the opponent’s divine kingdom is severely damaged, its Foundation is not small.”
“At least several hundred million Divinity Points can still be recycled.”
“This subordinate obeys the order!”
“Yang Yi.”
“Present.”
“You are responsible for the allocation of basic resources.”
“For the families of fallen believers, commend those who should be commended, and compensate those who should be compensated; do not be stingy with resources such as Medicinal Pills.”
“In addition, screen a new batch of believers to prepare to enter the f-class transformation pod, and do not allow them to remain idle.”
“Now the gap in Tier 5 combat power is huge, and it must be filled as soon as possible.”
“Yes, this subordinate understands!”

chapters.title: Chapter 166: Divine Kingdom Area Greatly Increased
paragraphs: The three accepted their orders and left, leaving only Yang Fan and Yang Da shortly after.
Yang Da bowed slightly, his tone calm: “Master, please stop making things difficult for Yang San. You might not approve of some of his methods, but his loyalty is beyond doubt.”
“Divine Kingdom Wars change in a split second. Even higher Rank Intelligent Life cannot predict all variables.”

“I know.” Yang Fan’s gaze darkened slightly, and he asked: “This war has served as a wake-up call for me. Although the overall combat power of the Divine Kingdom is not weak, our core methods are still too singular, and we almost lack the ability to cope with emergencies.”
Yang Fan looked at Yang Da: “Perhaps it is time to develop Mechanical troops.”

“You are wise, Master. I indeed have the same intention. Although we have the S-Rank Building ‘divine weapon world-forging platform’, which can continuously produce high-Rank weapons, they are ultimately just lifeless objects. However, the Mechanical Divine Kingdom system can forge ‘Smart Weapon’ in the true sense.”
Speaking of this, Yang Da raised his right hand, waved it gently, and a light screen unfolded before Yang Fan’s eyes.
In the image was a silver-white Smart Weapon.

The moment the attack arrived, the energy within its body operated instantly, and a light-blue protective shield automatically expanded, blocking all incoming impacts. The entire process had not the slightest lag, as if it were an instinct.

“As long as energy is sufficient, this type of Smart Weapon will automatically trigger a defense mechanism when attacked.” Yang Da’s voice was calm, but it faintly carried a trace of suppressed excitement: “If we can deploy this type of defensive equipment on a large scale, the losses from this war could have been reduced by at least ninety-nine percent.”

“The divine weapon world-forging platform will be responsible for producing main offensive weapons such as sabers, spears, swords, and halberds, while the defense system will be entirely handed over to the Mechanical Divine Kingdom.”

“Even if ordinary believers are not Intelligent Life and cannot unleash the full performance of Smart Weapons, relying solely on basic protection and automatic response is far superior to today’s cold weapon system.”
Speaking of this, Yang Da’s eyes were already filled with yearning.
After hearing this, Yang Fan suddenly spoke: “The reason the Mechanical Path has not been developed is because of insufficient resources, right?”

“You are wise, Master. To develop the Smart Weapon system, we first need to purchase research blueprints and supporting high-Rank research institutes from the Divine Shop. Secondly, we need to screen believers for Mechanical modification, nurture them into Intelligent Life, and participate in research, development, and debugging.”
“In addition, energy cores, computing power modules, and Materials iteration all require continuous investment, consuming a considerable amount of Divinity Points.”

Changing the subject, his tone returned to calm: “In contrast, the top priority right now remains the f-class transformation pod. According to my plan, we must first expand the quantity to one million units.”

“By then, relying solely on the transformation pods, one hundred million believers will be stably strengthened into Tier 5 Beings every month. This item has no side effects on believers, has no service life, and can directly replace the long Cultivate process. Its effect on the overall development of the Divine Kingdom is almost infinite.”
Yang Fan nodded. The f-class transformation pod was essentially “acceleration of Cultivate without side effects.”
It absorbed the Spiritual Qi of the Divine Kingdom to charge, which was equivalent to completing the Cultivate process for the believers.
One month in reality, three thousand years in the Divine Kingdom.
Each transformation pod could be recycled and used up to one hundred times.
As the population continued to expand, such facilities would only become more and more in demand, and could even be used as a “no upper limit” long-term investment.

After pondering for a moment, Yang Fan said: “Postpone the purchase of transformation pods; the Mechanical Path can no longer be delayed. From now on, begin cultivating Intelligent Life. Purchase blueprints, establish a research system, and promote the development of Smart Weapons.”
Pausing for a moment, he looked at Yang Da: “You should also take this opportunity to upgrade your computing power and evolve into Second-class Intelligent Life as soon as possible.”

The birth of just Yang Da alone had caused his Mental Energy to skyrocket dozens of times, resulting in a qualitative change in learning efficiency. If more Intelligent Life were born in the Divine Kingdom, he himself in reality might also possess computing power close to that of “Intelligent Life.”
“Yes, Master.” Yang Da bowed slightly.
After finishing the arrangements, Yang Fan’s consciousness returned to reality.
In just three days, Yang Er completed the comprehensive reclamation of the Black Armored Beetle Race Divine Kingdom.

As expected of a Dangerous-Rank Divine Kingdom, even after experiencing a devastating war leaving the entire Divine Kingdom in ruins, Yang Er still brought back buildings and resources worth three hundred million Divinity Points.
However, most of these buildings leaned towards the Insectoid system, showing extremely low compatibility with the Human Race Divine Kingdom.
Yang Da chose to list them all in the Divine Shop for sale in exchange for universal resources.
Afterwards, Yang Fan entered the Divine Kingdom and absorbed that pitch-black Divine Kingdom Core.
The Divine Kingdom trembled, its boundaries expanded, and the rules were perfected once again.
A piece of information emerged in Yang Fan’s consciousness: “Divine Kingdom Area: 19.5 million square kilometers.”
It increased by a full six million square kilometers!
Yang Fan’s gaze flickered slightly. This battle yielded far more than the total gains of all previous Divine Kingdom Wars combined.
A Dangerous-Rank Divine Kingdom came with huge risks, but the returns were equally astonishing.

If he kept attacking Alien Divine Kingdoms at this pace, perhaps in less than two years, the area of his Divine Kingdom could break through one hundred million square kilometers, becoming a First-Order God!
Subsequently, after repeated discussions with Yang Da, Yang Fan made a new decision—purchasing two more combat-type high-Rank Intelligent Life forms, respectively named Yang Four and Yang Five.
With the current foundation of the Divine Kingdom, he indeed possessed the ability to invade Dangerous-Rank Demigod Divine Kingdoms.
But what truly made him wary was not frontal combat power, but “the unknown.”
That Insectoid Demigod’s self-detonation secret technique was the best example.

If they encountered similar extreme methods again, or even ran into even more bizarre systems, once they failed to take down the enemy after a long battle and were forced to retreat, there would be the risk of exposing the Divine Kingdom’s coordinates.
After much consideration, he ultimately chose a safer route—expanding high-Rank command units, purchasing Ordinary-Rank Divine Kingdom coordinates, and fighting multi-line battles.
The advantage of his Divine Kingdom lay in the hundred-fold Time Evolution, and his troop sources far exceeded those of other demigods.

Rather than challenging evenly matched formidable enemies, it was better to proactively launch a “dimensional reduction strike” and trade quantity for quality; this could not be considered wasting believers’ combat power.
To put it bluntly, Yang Fan still felt that “bullying the weak with strength” was safer.
As the area of the Divine Kingdom expanded once again, Yang Da temporarily adjusted the development strategy.

The investment in the Mechanical Path was temporarily slowed down, and resources were instead continuously tilted toward main industries such as Dragon Fish farming, Monkey Wine brewing, and Spiritual Veins.
The reason was simple: future investments in the Divine Kingdom were a bottomless pit. Under the blessing of Evolution Talent, the earlier assets were laid out, the greater the harvest.
Ten days flashed by in an instant.
Within the Divine Kingdom, the losses from the battle with the Black Armored Beetle Race had completely recovered.
Not only that, new believers were born in the Divine Kingdom.
A full one hundred “First-class Intelligent Life” appeared. If matched with fully automatic Smart Weapons, their combat power would surpass ordinary believers in the Qi Refining Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 167: The Situation of the Divine Kingdom, Mother's Birthday
paragraphs: At this moment, the situation of the Divine Kingdom had already taken shape, divided overall into four major factions.
On Penglai Island, with the Cultivation system as its core, the “Immortal Alliance” was established here.
Countless Cultivators flew on swords, and Spells crisscrossed the air.
This was currently the strongest faction in the Divine Kingdom, possessing a profound foundation and the highest number of Foundation Establishment and Qi Refining powerhouses.
The ground was controlled by three other factions.
The “Wanxiang Martial Court”, which followed the Martial Route.
Focusing mainly on Physical Body Cultivation, they emphasized Qi and blood like a dragon, capable of shattering all Spells with a single punch.
Their military formations were strict, and their Battle Intent soared to the skies; they were the strongest shield of the Divine Kingdom.
The second was the Mechanical Civilization, personally controlled by Yang Da.
The entire city was silver-gray throughout with a cold structure, resembling a giant operating machine.
Dozens of high-level research institutes were distributed within it, operating day and night without stopping.

A large number of believers underwent body modifications according to established procedures—some replaced their arms with Mechanical structures, some connected their nerves to computers, and others implanted chips in the backs of their heads to partially upload their consciousness.
The sounds of liquid injection, gears interlocking, and metal splicing became the only “movement” here.
On the streets, squads of Mechanical soldiers patrolled back and forth.
They had no expressions and no communication. All information was transmitted through data streams.
Here, language was redundant; thoughts were compressed, uploaded, and shared, and redundant emotions were weeded out, leaving only efficiency.
The entire Mechanical Civilization was cold, quiet, and efficient, resembling a supercomputing core that never stopped running.
The third was the Elf Kingdom.
Located in the vast forest of the Divine Kingdom, ancient trees towered here, and Spiritual Qi was dense and misty.
The Elf Race coexisted with nature, excelled at ranged combat and support, and were often mobilized to help in external wars.
Right in the center of the Divine Kingdom, a magnificent giant city rose abruptly from the ground—the City of Trade.
There were no factions here; Cultivators, Martial Artists, Intelligent Life, and elves all gathered here.
Medicinal Pills, Spirit Plants, weapons, and resources were circulated and exchanged here, acting as a “blood circulation hub” spontaneously formed by believers.
Because the Divine Kingdom’s resources were abundant, the four factions performed their respective duties without conflict.
Under Yang Yi’s coordination, the entire Divine Kingdom presented a thriving scene.
Yang Fan was very satisfied with the development of the Divine Kingdom.
During this period of time, he could feel his own changes every day.
His Physical Body was stronger, his Spells were increasingly proficient, his emotions were more stable, his thinking was clearer, and his learning efficiency continued to improve.
He knew clearly in his heart that this was because the development of the Mechanical Civilization was feeding back into his spiritual level.
Although those ordinary Intelligent Life forms could not bring about a qualitative change like Yang Da, quantitative changes lead to qualitative changes.
With the development of the Mechanical Civilization, perhaps he himself in reality would also possess the ability of “creation”.
On this day, Yang Fan did not continue reading books. Instead, he put on the virtual helmet, and following the coordinates, his consciousness descended upon Yang County.
Today was the birthday of his mother, Sun Rong.
Being in Taichu City, he could not rush back in reality and could only celebrate his mother’s birthday through the Virtual World.
However, Sun Rong seemed exceptionally busy today, having not logged online all morning until she just sent a message.
The familiar Yangcheng Villa was perfectly replicated 1:1 in the Virtual World.
At this moment, the villa was brightly lit, and the living room was piled high with all kinds of gifts, leaving almost nowhere to step.
Besides his parents, Luo Bing and Luo Rou were also present.
Today, Yang Tiexin and Sun Rong looked ruddy and full of vigor.
The white hair mixed in previously had all turned black, and they both seemed to have grown over a hundred years younger.

Because of Yang Fan’s relationship, they no longer needed to squeeze believers into mining. Under the continuous resource investment, the Divine Kingdom developed steadily, believers fed back into themselves, and their bodies gradually recovered to their Peak state.

“Fan’er, Patriarch Luo Hai threw a birthday banquet for me this morning. The county magistrate and quite a few high-ranking government officials came too. There were too many people, so I really couldn’t get away, and only had time to see you just now.” Sun Rong explained with a bit of embarrassment.
“Mom, happy birthday.” Yang Fan spoke with a smile, “How have you guys been doing recently?”
“Good, very good!” Sun Rong nodded repeatedly, the smile on her face unstoppable, “Thanks to your blessing, we now have more resources than we can possibly use.”
“I recently even opened a storefront in the Yangcheng Villa district selling basic resources. With the Luo Family looking out for us, business is extremely good!”
Speaking of this, she suddenly lowered her voice with a hint of excitement:
“Your dad has really struck gold this big time! A while ago, a company called Xuanming Group came looking for him, taking a fancy to his believers’ mining abilities.”
“They directly gave him two medium-sized mineral veins and also gave him 10% of the company’s shares! Just the annual dividends alone amount to 5 billion Faith Points!”

Sun Rong became more and more excited as she spoke, and couldn’t help shaking her head, “Do you think this boss is an idiot? With your dad’s noob talent, I thought we had encountered a scammer back then!”
“I didn’t even dare let him sign the contract. We only felt relieved after sending it to Rou girl’s grandfather to confirm there were no issues.”
Yang Tiexin, who was at the side, immediately became unhappy and rolled his eyes, “What do you mean by noob talent? If we didn’t rely on my believers, what would our family eat?”
“It was clearly propped up by that miniature mineral vein in my Divine Kingdom!”
“What your believers dig in a month isn’t even as much as my daily output!”
“You—”
The two of them threw words back and forth, instantly starting to bicker again.
Watching this scene, the corners of Yang Fan’s mouth raised slightly.
No matter what, seeing that his parents were doing well now, he felt at ease.
“Dad, Mom, this is a gift I prepared for you two.”
Yang Fan spoke to interrupt their dispute, took out two cards, and handed them over.
“Develop the Divine Kingdom well and enhance the strength of your believers. Now that our family’s conditions are good, you both must work hard to break through to Demigod.”
“This is?” Sun Rong took the cards with some doubt.
“Special building—Fountain of Life.” Yang Fan said calmly, “Ten each, they can significantly improve the environment of the Divine Kingdom.”
“Fountain of Life? What is that?” Sun Rong wore a blank expression.

Luo Rou, standing nearby, stepped forward to explain, “Mom, a Fountain of Life is equivalent to a Grade B building, and its price in the Divine Shop is roughly 2 billion Faith Points, plus it’s constantly out of stock.”
“If traded in reality, the price would be at least 3 billion, or even 4 billion each.”
As her voice fell, the living room instantly grew quiet.
Sun Rong and Yang Tiexin exchanged glances, their expressions somewhat frozen.
Thirty to forty billion... each?
Twenty of them, that would be tens of billions of Faith Points?!
“No, no, this is too precious!” Sun Rong snapped back to reality and waved her hands hurriedly, “We can’t accept this!”
“You are now at Primordial Academy, and your expenses are so huge. It’s already bad enough that we can’t help you, how could we hold you back!”
Yang Tiexin also nodded repeatedly, his expression turning solemn for a rare time.
To them, this was no longer a gift. If it were truly placed into the Divine Kingdom, they would probably not even be able to sleep peacefully for fear of being targeted by others.
But Yang Fan only smiled faintly. In their eyes, these were astronomical wealth that were difficult to reach, but in his Divine Kingdom, the Fountain of Life was long no different from jelly beans.
Ever since the quantities of Moon Well and Sun Spring broke through 100 million, the appearance frequency of the Fountain of Life had greatly increased.
Today, the Fountains of Life in his Divine Kingdom had long reached several thousand in number. This bit of resources was merely a drop in the bucket to him.
To Yang Fan, the only function of the Fountain of Life was that the Water of Life it produced had a decent healing effect.
And a Fountain of Life cost only dozens of Divinity Points to make.
Resources of this level were already beneath his notice.

chapters.title: Chapter 168: Monthly Divine Kingdom Investment Revenue Exceeds 1 Billion
paragraphs: “Accept it,” Yang Fan said calmly. “Right, I remember you guys signed a Subordinate God Contract before with someone called...”
“Lin Lang,” Yang Tiexin chimed in.
“Rest assured,” Yang Tiexin quickly added. “Lin Lang is now working at Xuanming Company as a minor executive. As for the contract, he has already taken the initiative to lift it.”
“Now that our Divine Kingdom is looked after by Elder Luo, you don’t need to worry.”
At this, a trace of complexity and nostalgia inevitably flashed through his eyes.
Once upon a time, he was Lin Lang’s Subordinate God, and nearly half of his Divine Kingdom’s output had to be surrendered.
Yet today, that once aloof and lofty Lord God had become his subordinate. Every time they met, he would bow and scrape, and even returned everything he had gained in the past with interest.
This stark contrast still made Yang Tiexin feel somewhat unreal to this day.
He knew very well in his heart that all of this stemmed from his own son. He just could never figure out why Yang Fan’s influence was actually so immense.
Since his son wouldn’t say, he wouldn’t ask either.
Doing one’s own part reliably and not causing trouble for the child was the only thing parents like him, who lacked ability, could do.
After chatting about domestic matters for a while longer, the elderly couple made an excuse about having matters to attend to and exited the Virtual World.
“Husband.”
After his parents left, Luo Bing and Luo Rou visibly relaxed, each taking one of Yang Fan’s arms.
“How have you been lately?” Yang Fan asked casually.
During this period, he had devoted almost all his energy to studying and hadn’t communicated with the two of them for a long time.
“Resources are not lacking, and I’m a top student in the first year at Tianshui University now,” Luo Bing said with a hint of pride.
“After the Divine Kingdom recovered, I also returned to school, and my grades are quite good now,” Luo Rou said softly.
“That’s good,” Yang Fan nodded. “Keep up the hard work and Breakthrough to become a demigod as soon as possible. I still have matters to attend to, so I’ll be leaving first.”
As his words fell, his consciousness had already detached, leaving only the two women on the sofa looking at each other in dismay.
“What’s wrong with Husband? Didn’t he used to come find us every day?” Luo Rou asked in confusion.
“Could it be... that he found someone new in Taichu City?” Luo Bing pouted lightly. “I heard that place is full of proud daughters of heaven.”
Hearing this, Luo Rou chuckled, her tone carrying a hint of profound meaning: “Cousin, you still need to press on.”
“With Husband’s potential, he will definitely establish his own Family or company in the future, but why is there still no movement from your belly?”
“Cousin has good fortune; with Cheng Rou, you will always have a place in the future!” Luo Bing said enviously.

Luo Rou stopped joking, her expression turning a bit more serious: “I am very clear on the Family Head’s intentions. The Luo Family is too small to trap a true dragon like Husband. Sending you to his side is for the Luo Family, for you, and I will also benefit from it.”
She paused, her gaze slightly condensing:
“No matter how many proud daughters of heaven stand by Husband’s side in the future, at least, our surname is Luo.”
Luo Bing was silent for a moment and nodded gently: “I understand Father’s painstaking efforts, and I will work hard.”
In the year since leaving the Luo Family and entering Tianshui University, her sharp edges had long been worn smooth.
The B-grade talent she once took pride in was everywhere there.
Now, the reason she could rank among the top was largely due to the Luo Family’s investment in Yang Fan, half of whose Resources went to her Divine Kingdom.
On the other side.
Returning to Taichu City, Yang Fan’s Physical Body lay on the bed, while his consciousness had long sunk into the library to continue cramming basic knowledge.
Humans have seven emotions and six desires, and instinctive desires constantly stimulate the nerves, bringing short-lived and cheap pleasure.
Yet that kind of thrill comes fast and goes fast as well.
With the development of the Divine Kingdom’s Mechanical Civilization and the continuous enhancement of his Mental Energy, Yang Fan gradually stood at a higher cognitive level.

He began to clearly feel that true, lasting, and deep satisfaction never originated from carnal desires and indulgence. Rather, it came from the elevation of cognition, the growth of power, and the process of dissecting the essence of the world little by little.
The deeper the understanding and the greater the control, the less one needs to rely on low-level desires to fill the emptiness.
Just as Yang Da said, his past self was not a qualified deity.
Time flowed, and soon it was the day of the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle.
Yang Fan had already received Sima Bang’s message, and the four of them agreed to head to the examination venue together.
Before leaving, Yang Fan closed his eyes and his consciousness entered the Divine Kingdom.
The next moment, the complete information of the Divine Kingdom appeared in his mind.
“Divine Lord: Yang Fan”
“Divine Kingdom Area: 19.5 million square kilometers”
“Talent: Omitted”

“Believers: Foundation Establishment Realm (57,233), Martial Master Realm (1,289), Qi Refining Realm (130 million), Martial Disciple Realm (51.33 million), First-Class Intelligent Life (15,000), Tier 5 Being (3.5 billion)... Mortal (15.4 billion)”
“Occupations: Alchemist (1.55 million), Blacksmith (2.85 million), Rune Master (200,000), Formation Master (400,000)”
“Dependents: Adult Elf (12.44 million)”
“Dharmic Methods: Spirit Tortoise Life-Protecting Formation (C-grade, Major Achievement), Ten Kings of Hell Formation (C-grade, Major Achievement)...”
“Divinity Points: 8.11 million (Reality provides 8.86 Divinity Points daily)”

“Buildings: Moon Well x 100 million, Sun Spring x 100 million, Fountain of Life x 3,200, Spiritual Vein x 70,000 (A-grade), Monkey Wine Spring x 840,000 (B-grade), B-grade defensive building Tree Demon King x 100, C-grade City of Technology x 5...”

“Wonders: Penglai Island x 1,680 (Deployed), Spirit Peach Mountain x 8,400 (Deployed), Dragon Marsh Water Mansion x 16,800 (Deployed), Worlds Number One Martial Arts Arena x 1,000 (Deployed), myriad manifestation battle stele x 10”

“Assets: Dragon Fish fry (x 168 million), f-class transformation pod x 200,000, Smart Weapon x 110,000, Mechanical Heart x 10, Otherworldly Collector x 2 billion, cloning nutrient pod x 1 million, ordinary zombies (x 6 billion), Robot Soldiers (x 2 million), Super Alloy Robot Warrior (x 5,000), Spirit Stone (), B-grade weapon ()...”
Nowadays, the overall strength of the believers within the Divine Kingdom was no longer growing explosively, but gradually tending toward stability.
Within the Martial Arts system, a Martial Master powerhouse comparable to the Foundation Establishment Realm was finally born.
Although the number was small, it was undoubtedly a good start.

After all, his Divine Kingdom believers with Martial Arts talent were few to begin with, and coupled with insufficient investment in the path of Martial Arts, that was why it lagged so far behind the Cultivation Route.
Under Yang Da’s continuous investment and regulation, the Divine Kingdom’s revenue climbed once again.
The three main revenue streams—Spirit Stone, Dragon Fish, and Monkey Wine Spring—stabilized at approximately 700 million, 250 million, and 80 million Divinity Points per month, respectively.
Combined, the total monthly revenue of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had now broken through the 1-billion-Divinity Points mark.
Placed in the outside world, this was already jaw-dropping wealth, but to Yang Fan, it was still not enough.

Spirit Peach Mountain and Monkey Wine Spring were completely deployed on Penglai Island, the water areas were thoroughly covered by Dragon Marsh Water Mansion, and underground Spiritual Veins crisscrossed, pushing the Divine Kingdom’s Cultivate environment to its limit.
Yet in the vast surface areas, apart from the believers’ cities, there were still large tracts of open land that remained unused.
Yang Fan had been pondering recently whether to open up spiritual fields and develop a high-tier Spirit Plant industry.
It was just that after researching for a long time, he still hadn’t been able to find a suitable variety.

Although high-tier Spirit Plants had considerable yields, most of them were delicate and basically required Qi Refining Realm believers with the “Spirit Plant Farmer” occupation to Cultivate them long-term.

Currently, the primary occupations studied by his believers in the Primordial Academy were still only the four major directions of Alchemy, Blacksmithing, Rune Master, and Formation, almost all revolving around the “Warfare System”.
As for the Spirit Plant Farmer, it leaned toward the logistics faction.
Yang Fan did not wish for Qi Refining Realm believers to waste a large amount of time on this.

chapters.title: Chapter 169: Sima Tianci
paragraphs: “Go participate in the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle first, and then ask Sima Bang and the others afterwards. We might get some results.” Yang Fan muttered to himself.
With a thought, his consciousness withdrew from the Divine Kingdom, and he stood up to leave the small courtyard.
Soon, he rendezvoused with Sima Bang, Ye Jianfeng, and Wen Yushui.
“After we go in later, follow me,” Sima Bang said earnestly. “After the test begins, listen to my instructions.”
The three nodded.
Afterward, led by Sima Bang, several people arrived at a special area—the “Heaven-Pressing Realm Entrance”.
There were no buildings in the conventional sense, only a huge passage resembling a spatial rift floating mid-air.
“Let’s go.” Sima Bang didn’t say much and stepped into it first.
The next moment, space changed abruptly, as if crossing over to another world and arriving at an independent space.
As soon as they landed, a wave of noise rushed toward them.
Looking out, figures were densely packed, and a full five thousand plus Human Race Prodigy had gathered here.
This place seemed specially designed for testing, and the scale of the space could just accommodate this number, appearing compact yet not crowded.
In Taichu City, excluding a few public areas like the trading market, most people were accustomed to staying in their own rooms.
A scene where thousands of Prodigy gathered in one place like this was extremely rare.
Yang Fan stood among the crowd, his gaze slowly sweeping across, and a trace of shock inevitably arose in his heart.
In the entire Tiannan City, the number of Human Race Prodigy was probably less than can be counted on one hand.
Yet in Taichu City, the Human Race Prodigy were actually comparable to the students of the entire Yang County No. 1 Middle School!

Yang Fan’s Cultivate route ran three paths in parallel, and although it was mainly Cultivation, his Physical Body was formidable, and his Mental Energy far surpassed those of the same rank. Coupled with his deliberate concealment of his aura, he was almost inconspicuous in the crowd.
But others were not like this; quite a few Prodigy deliberately emanated a powerful aura.
One after another, tyrannical aura fluctuations loomed in the crowd. There were even a few strands that made Yang Fan faintly feel pressure.
That intensity was far above Sima Bang and Ye Jianfeng, stronger by several fold, or even more than a hundredfold!
“Are these... the seniors of junior and senior years?” Yang Fan’s heart sank slightly. “Indeed, among those who can be called Human Race Prodigy, there is not a single simple character.”
Above the high platform, five figures stood tall, and the aura of gods shrouded the entire venue.

“That is my older brother. He is two years older than me. After graduation, he went to join the army at The Frontline. He just came back a few days ago, and was arranged by the old man to host this Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle!” Sima Bang spoke in a low voice, with a hint of pride in his tone.
He raised his hand and pointed at the figure in the very center.
Yang Fan looked along his gaze. Although that person stood in the very center, he did not show any sharpness, possessing a gentle temperament as if he merged into the surrounding space.
The whole person appeared somewhat lazy, and even yawned, looking completely bored.
“Only two years older than you?” Ye Jianfeng frowned slightly.
Sima Bang explained, “My brother is named Sima Tianci, with the SS-rank Talent ‘Dao Child’. He is the strongest Genius of the Sima Family in nearly a hundred years.”

“Admitted early by Primordial Academy with a Prodigy rating. In his junior year, he achieved a Breakthrough to become a First-Order God, and directly graduated early. He just came back a few days ago, and was grabbed by the old man to be conscripted.”
Speaking of this, he smiled, “We are full brothers born of the same father and mother, and our relationship is ironclad. After the evaluation ends, I will introduce you all.”
Hearing these words, the three of Yang Fan wore expressions of shock.
They originally thought that Sima Bang, as the son of the Family head, already had a startling background.
Yet they didn’t expect that behind him there was still such a Prodigy-level older brother. He really had so many powerful thighs to hug!
For a super Family like the Sima Family, it was almost impossible for the Family head and Elder to have only one partner.
Whether it was true love or Family marriage, under a long lifespan, Bloodline and interests would eventually weave into a huge and complex network of relationships.
Just like Sima Bang, he had over a hundred older brothers above him, and blood relatives sharing the same father and mother like Sima Tianci naturally had a closer relationship.
“Then I will trouble Brother Sima,” Ye Jianfeng laughed. “With such a ‘thigh’, it would be foolish not to hug it.”
“Yeah, Big Brother Sima, help introduce me more,” Wen Yushui softly echoed.
Yet her gaze couldn’t help but fall onto the high platform once more. At that instant, her admiring gaze was almost tangibly affectionate.

Admiring the strong was a woman’s instinct, even though Wen Yushui possessed an S-rank Talent and was rated a Human Race Prodigy. Yet in front of a Prodigy like Sima Tianci, she still appeared inferior.
The so-called Dao Companion was nothing more than value complementarity. Rather than walking side by side, it was better to climb high and attach oneself to power.
This world had always been this realistic, regardless of gender.
Looking at Wen Yushui’s reaction, Sima Bang was not surprised at all, seeming long accustomed to it.
“Little sister Wen shouldn’t think about becoming my sister-in-law.” He waved his hand. “My brother is not interested in women.”
“Ah?” Ye Jianfeng was stunned, instantly taking a half-step back subconsciously and instinctively adjusting his hips.

“Old Ye, what the fuck are you thinking?” Sima Bang rolled his eyes and said irritably, “My brother is affected by his Talent. The whole person is a bit devoid of desires, and besides Cultivate, he basically has no hobbies.”
“As for a Dao Companion, he will most likely follow the Family’s arrangements and pick a proud daughter of heaven from the other four major families for a marriage alliance.”
Hearing these words, a trace of undisguisable loss flashed in Wen Yushui’s eyes.

With her identity as the legitimate daughter of the Wen Family in Tiannan City, without emotional support, solely discussing background and potential, she was simply not within Sima Tianci’s selection range.
The gap was right there; it was not something that could be crossed just by working hard.

Sima Bang said, “The other four on the stage, I have also seen a few times. Lu Chengyuan of the Lu Family, Han Wuji of the Han Family, Gu Changkong of the Gu Family, and person of the Qin Family. They are all First-Order God.”

“However, compared to my brother, their Talent is worse by more than a star or a half, and they can be considered the backbone of this generation for each Family. I have greeted them before, but that’s about it, we’re not close.”
As expected of the Sima Family young master who grew up in Taichu City since childhood, this circle of connections was obviously not on the same tier as theirs.
Just as several people were conversing, people around also successively noticed Sima Bang.
“Hello, Young Master Sima!”
“Brother Sima, long time no see!”
“Old Bang, what have you been busy with lately? Another day let’s join forces to invade an Alien Divine Kingdom!”
One voice after another came from all directions.
Some were polite, some were familiar, and some carried a hint of deliberate closeness.
Sima Bang smiled and responded to them one by one, his tone casual yet handling it with ease. Obviously, he was long accustomed to such scenes.
In contrast, the three of Yang Fan appeared much quieter, and even somewhat unable to interject.

Ye Jianfeng and Wen Yushui were already considered to have extraordinary backgrounds in the outside world, but placed on a tier like Taichu City, they could only be considered “ordinary people”. As for Yang Fan, needless to say, behind him was the Luo Family of Yang County, which placed in Taichu City, probably wouldn’t even count as an “impoverished household”.

chapters.title: Chapter 170: eye of the god
paragraphs: Half an hour passed, and people arrived one after another.
When the last batch of people stood firm, the assessment time finally arrived.
On the high platform.
Gu Changkong looked aside and smiled, ” Cousin Tianci, the time has arrived. Why don’t you announce the start of the assessment? “
” Just arrange it however you like. “
Sima Tianci lazily waved his hand, ” This morning I cast a hexagram, Snake Foot, it’s suitable to rest. As a result, the old fogey at home insisted on dragging me over. “
As his voice fell, he yawned and directly closed his eyes to enter a state of dozing. It was as if everything here had nothing to do with him.
Seeing this scene, the remaining four people all revealed wry expressions.

The name of Sima Tianci was known to almost everyone present. He was the most Prodigy existence of the Sima Family in this generation, possessing an SS-grade ” Dao Child ” talent, truly a person favored by the heavens, his believers Cultivate by leaps and bounds.
What was even more outrageous was that, as the future of the Sima Family, his daily routine was extremely regular: eating, sleeping, and meditating, never making an extra ounce of effort.
Yet even so, he still easily achieved a Breakthrough to the realm of the gods during his junior year.
Truly, comparing people to others can infuriate them to death.
” Brother Gu, then you do it. ” person spoke.
Gu Changkong nodded and did not decline.

Seeing him step forward, his gaze swept across the crowd below, and he said in a crisp voice, ” Since everyone has arrived, the annual Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle — — officially begins. Everyone, take your positions on the platform. As long as you persist for one hour, you can obtain rewards. “
As the voice fell, the entire space trembled slightly.
In the center of this independent space named the Heaven-Pressing Realm, a huge platform slowly rose.
” Follow me, snatch a position close to the middle! ” Sima Bang let out a low shout.
The next instant, his figure shot out like a cannonball, the ground beneath his feet instantly collapsing and blasting out a deep pit.
Yang Fan and the other three did not hesitate, following closely behind.
Almost at the same time, everyone moved!
Figures frantically rushed toward the center of the platform.
Someone had just occupied a position and hadn’t had time to stand firmly when they were violently flipped away and directly thrown out.
Someone roared and made a move, instantly triggering a conflict on the spot.
Although the first test had not yet begun, the fight had already broken out in advance!
Amidst the chaos, Yang Fan and the four steadily occupied a position close to the center.
Yang Fan’s gaze swept across, and his heart sank slightly.
The aura of these people around was very strong, and although not as good as himself, they were much stronger than Sima Bang and Ye Jianfeng.
Clearly, everyone here was a Senior student.
However, these people only glanced at them and did not make a move.
Yang Fan quickly understood the reason.
The Sima Family was one of the Five Great Giants, and Sima Bang had lived in Taichu City since childhood. Most of these junior and Senior students knew him.
Precisely because of this, these few freshman students could stand here peacefully.
The Heaven-Pressing Realm was not big to begin with, and at this moment, everyone was crowded onto the platform, appearing even more cramped.
The distance between people was even less than one meter. Between breaths, they could feel each other’s aura.
Right at this moment, a huge eye slowly emerged in the sky.
That gaze was cold and vast, as if a deity was looking down on all living beings.
” I walk the Martial Route, my endurance is the strongest, I will hold the front. ” Sima Bang’s voice was decisive, ” Behind is Wen Yushui, and then Yang Fan. “
” Old Ye, you take the rear. “
” You are the first among us to achieve a Breakthrough to demigod, with the strongest strength. Persist for two hours, and then we will directly withdraw. “
While speaking, he had already stepped forward, standing at the very front of the four people, facing the huge eye in the sky directly.
Wen Yushui followed closely behind, Yang Fan was in the third position, and Ye Jianfeng quietly stood at the very end, his aura restrained.
The four of them stuck closely together.
The next moment, that eye in the sky slowly opened.
Boom!!!
An indescribable terrifying coercion instantly descended!
As if heaven and earth were collapsing and the air was solidifying, an invisible force crushed over from all directions.
The Physical Body was suppressed by a myriad of jun of giant force, and every inch of muscle was trembling.
A creaking sound of bones came from the surroundings, as if they would be crushed at any moment.
And even more terrifying was the spiritual-level impact. That eye seemed to gaze directly at the Soul, making people’s minds tense.
Yang Fan’s pupils shrank slightly. He even clearly felt that the believers within his Divine Kingdom were all raising their heads at this moment, their expressions carrying doubt and unease.
That coercion actually passed through the deity’s true body, directly transmitting into the Divine Kingdom!
Solemn and majestic, oppressive to the point of suffocation.
In merely a breath of time, someone couldn’t bear it.
Someone let out a low roar and directly jumped off the platform.
More people had pale faces, cold sweat gushing wildly from their foreheads, gritting their teeth to endure bitterly.
But very soon, figures fell off the platform one after another.
The losers were standing on the periphery, panting heavily, their clothes soaked with cold sweat, the whole person as if fished out from water.
And all of this had just begun.
The loophole mentioned by Sima Bang truly existed. The four of them stood closely together, and within the perception of that eye, they were actually regarded as ” a single entity “.

At this moment, at least eighty percent of the pressure was on Sima Bang alone! Although Wen Yushui and Ye Jianfeng did not feel too much pressure, their expressions were similarly solemn at this moment.
The breathing of the two became slow and long, constantly adjusting their own state.
It was merely the beginning, yet the sense of oppression was already strong to this extent.
In their view, even if they utilized the rule loophole, wanting to persist for two hours was definitely no easy task.

On the contrary, Yang Fan’s state was extremely relaxed. Although he could feel the coercion, this bit of pressure to him was like a feather falling on his body; if he didn’t deliberately feel it, he wouldn’t notice it at all.
His expression was as usual, but his gaze quietly swept around.
Very quickly, he discovered that those Senior students standing closer to the central area similarly had calm expressions, handling everything with ease.
And around them, there were also quite a few people who adopted a similar ” huddling together ” method.
Four or five people stuck closely into a line, their auras obviously weak, at a glance they were freshmen.
Yang Fan understood in his heart. These people mostly had extraordinary backgrounds like Sima Bang, and relied on their backgrounds to stand in this area.
On the high platform.
Lu Chengyuan stood with his hands behind his back, his gaze calmly sweeping across below, ” The quality of this batch of freshmen... seems average. “
Han Wuji chuckled softly: ” Indeed, in less than a quarter of an hour, so many people have already been eliminated. “
person’s brows raised slightly, looking at the huge eye in the sky, ” Was the power of the eye of the god created by Senior Sima turned up higher? “
Gu Changkong shook his head, his tone calm.
” The eye of the god is in automatic mode and will automatically adjust the coercion based on the comprehensive strength of all participants. “
” Now it seems that among this batch of juniors and Seniors, there are some good saplings worth paying attention to. “
While a few people were speaking, their expressions were composed. Clearly, they had long been accustomed to such scenes.
Suddenly, person seemed to have seen something amusing, the corners of his mouth lifting, ” Brother Gu, that girl is from your Gu Family, right? “

chapters.title: Chapter 171: Women Are Just Troublesome
paragraphs: “Which one?” Gu Changfeng furrowed his brow.
person reached out and pointed toward the center of the platform, the smile on his face growing even thicker.

“That one right there. She’s exploited loopholes to a whole new height. Other families at most have four or five people teaming up, but look at her—she pulled in twenty people in one go. Is she planning to lead everyone to get rich together?”
As the words fell, several people looked along that gaze.
They saw that near the inner side of the platform’s center, a full twenty people were squeezed closely together, forming a very long line.
On this crowded platform, it looked exceptionally glaring.
At the very back of the crowd stood a young girl.
The young girl had exquisite features, with her black hair tied into double ponytails, and a hint of cunning in her brows and eyes.
At this moment, she was earnestly directing the team with a serious expression.
“Feng Yue, you take the front first, hold out for at least one hour!”
“Lin Que, you take over in the second round, don’t drop the ball!”
“After two hours, you guys go to the back, and the eighteen of us will take the remaining time!”
Her speaking speed was extremely fast, yet clear and orderly.
“Everyone stop looking around! Adjust your breathing, our goal is very simple: survive three hours!”
“By then, ten million Divinity Points for each person!”
As soon as these words came out, every single person in the team clenched their teeth, desperately trying to stabilize their condition.
Above the high platform.
Gu Changfeng’s expression had already grown faintly dark.

Exploiting rule loopholes was not a problem; this was the “default privilege” of the disciples from the Five Great Families. After all, this assessment venue was jointly built by their Five Great Families.
The younger generation using this to earn some resources was also considered a tacitly permitted matter.
But the problem was, you were just too eye-catching!
Others at most brought four or five, but you directly pulled in twenty? Were you afraid others wouldn’t see you?
Such a show-off!
“That stinky girl Gu Le is playing clever tricks again!” Gu Changkong couldn’t help but support his forehead.
The Gu Family controlled a large number of Spirit Plant Star and Spirit Vein Planet, possessing the most robust foundational resources among the Five Great Families.
Yet in this generation, Gu Le just had to turn out to be such a “money-grubber”.
Did the Gu Family lack Divinity Point rewards?
They didn’t lack them at all! Yet she insisted on “fleecing the wool” like this.
It was truly a bit embarrassing.
Gu Changfeng even had the impulse at this moment to directly drag her down.
Tell her: Stop competing, if you lack resources, go home and apply! Don’t embarrass yourself.

Although it was taking opportunistic cleverness too far, the several deities present just regarded it as entertainment. Even if she could really persist for three hours, it was merely a mere two hundred million Divinity Points.
For the Five Great Families, it was merely a drop in the bucket.
Time slowly passed.
One hour quickly passed.
At that very instant, the pressure above the platform suddenly surged violently! It doubled entirely!
“Damn it!” Sima Bang’s expression changed abruptly, veins bulging on his forehead.
“I can’t hold on anymore, if I keep pushing, I’m going to collapse from exhaustion!”
He clenched his teeth, forcibly stabilizing his stance, and then retreated step by step with great difficulty.
“I’m heading to the back! Sister Wen, you just completed a Breakthrough to demigod not long ago, don’t push yourself hard! The three of you joining forces to survive for one hour will be enough!”
His speech even became intermittent; every step he took felt as though he were carrying the weight of tens of thousands of jun.
Wen Yushui at this moment likewise held her breath and concentrated.
The very moment Sima Bang shifted his figure away, her complexion instantly turned pale as paper.
Until this moment, she truly understood just how terrifying the first barrier of this Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle really was!
The pressure that was originally shared now poured down entirely, crashing overwhelmingly onto her alone!
She only felt the bones throughout her body emitting an unbearable groan, as if they would shatter inch by inch at the very next moment.

Within her Divine Kingdom, countless believers sat cross-legged one after another, expressions of pain on their faces, jointly operating their Cultivation Technique in an attempt to resist the top-down oppression.
In merely a short quarter of an hour, Wen Yushui’s body began to tremble, her clothes drenched through, sweat continuously dripping down the tips of her hair, and her entire person was tottering.
“I... haven’t persisted long enough...”
She bit down hard on her teeth, continuously cheering herself on in her heart.
“I still need to hold out for a few more minutes... Otherwise, I won’t make it to two hours...”
Spirit and Physical Body seemed to reach their limits simultaneously.
Every inch of her nerves was frantically sending her a warning: ‘Give up! Give up immediately!’
Yet her pride firmly suppressed this thought.
“Persist a little longer...”
“I can still hold on...”
“I can’t be looked down upon by others...”
“I was already the last one in the Qingshan District F4 to complete a Breakthrough to demigod... I can’t hold everyone back!”
Time ticked away second by second, and her consciousness gradually grew blurry. Everything before her eyes began to sway and overlap.
“I... I seem... unable to speak anymore...” Wen Yushui’s heart sank.
Her head felt heavy and her feet light, as if in the next moment she would completely lose all strength and be directly blown flying off the platform by this pressure.
Right at this moment, a hand steadily pressed onto her shoulder.
“Don’t force yourself,” Yang Fan said softly, “Go to the back.”
As the words fell, Yang Fan stepped sideways forward, his left arm wrapping around to directly clasp Wen Yushui’s slender waist, and then single-handedly lifted her entire person up!
The movement was crisp and neat, without a trace of hesitation.
The next moment, his arm gave a forward thrust, steadily sending Wen Yushui into the hands of Ye Jianfeng behind him.
The entire process was smooth and done in one go!
Meanwhile, Yang Fan himself was already standing at the very front! Over eighty percent of the pressure poured down onto him!
“Phew—!”
Wen Yushui, whose pressure abruptly decreased, gasped heavily for air as if she had been hauled up from the deep sea.
Her chest heaved violently, as if she had “come back to life” anew.
Ye Jianfeng caught her reflexively, but his entire person was directly stunned.
He clung closely behind Yang Fan, his face filled with shock.
That scene just now—he almost thought he had seen it wrong!
You must know that over an hour had already passed! The pressure of the eye of the god was already more than double its strength.
Even just sharing a portion of the pressure, he felt as though an invisible giant hand was pressing down on his body, making even the slightest movement extremely difficult.
Yet Yang Fan not only moved just now, but also carried someone, turned around, and passed someone over in one go?!
Ye Jianfeng was in a daze inside; he had almost not dared to catch her just then! He was terrified that his breath would leak and he would be directly eliminated from the competition.
No...
‘Brother, what’s your situation?’
‘Are you really bearing the pressure?’
This thought flashed through his mind, but after all, he didn’t ask it out loud.
He took a deep breath, forcibly stabilizing his condition, supported Wen Yushui to the front of himself, and fixed her figure with both hands to prevent her from losing her balance and falling.
“Miss Wen...” Ye Jianfeng lowered his voice, a hint of helplessness in his tone.
“If you couldn’t hold on, you should have said so earlier. Isn’t this just causing chaos?”
He was already speaking with some difficulty, seeing as the pressure at this moment was very strong.
Now he still had to divide his mind and focus to steady a person who was nearly collapsed from exhaustion.
Ye Jianfeng cried out bitterly in his heart. If this went on, could the four of them really hold out until two hours?
Women were just troublesome, not even understanding how to act according to their capability...
In the end, he didn’t speak these words out loud, only complained about it in his heart.
“I’m sorry...” Wen Yushui recovered a sliver of her senses, her voice weak and bitter.
She was very well aware that she had already become a drag at this moment. Logically speaking, the most rational choice was to leave the platform directly.
Yet she was unwilling to give up—that was a full one million Divinity Points! Her Divine Kingdom desperately needed this batch of resources.

Women were just troublesome, not even understanding how to act according to their capability...
In the end, he didn’t speak these words out loud, only complained about it in his heart.
“I’m sorry...” Wen Yushui recovered a sliver of her senses, her voice weak and bitter.
She was very well aware that she had already become a drag at this moment.
Logically speaking, the most rational choice was to leave the platform directly.
Yet she was unwilling to give up—that was a full one million Divinity Points!
Her Divine Kingdom desperately needed this batch of resources.

chapters.title: Chapter 172: Would You Like Some Monkey Wine?
paragraphs: Just at this moment, Yang Fan, who was standing at the very front, suddenly spoke, “Brother Sima, can I materialize things from the divine kingdom here?”

Sima Bang was gritting his teeth to hold on at the moment, and upon hearing this, he replied with difficulty, “As long as you don’t conjure up a mountain to affect other people’s examinations, do whatever you want, as long as you can stand on it.”
Hearing these words, the corners of Yang Fan’s mouth hooked up slightly.
He was seen snapping his fingers, and the next moment, a glass of wine appeared out of thin air in his right hand.
The wine liquid swayed slightly, emitting a faint fragrance.
Yang Fan faced the pressure of the eye of the god directly, his body remaining completely motionless, yet he slightly curved his right hand and passed it backward.
“Old Ye.”
“Feed this Monkey Wine to Miss Wen, it has the effect of clearing the mind and calming the soul.”
“She is severely dehydrated now. If she doesn’t replenish her energy soon, she won’t last much longer.”
His voice remained calm, as if the person enduring tremendous pressure right now was not him at all.
Seeing Yang Fan holding the wine glass with one hand in an extremely awkward posture and passing it behind him, Ye Jianfeng’s skin couldn’t help but twitch fiercely.
“Old Ye, take it, this posture is very tiring,” Yang Fan urged.
‘I’m very tired too!’ Ye Jianfeng wailed wildly in his heart.
At this moment, even if he was only enduring a portion of the pressure, he was unwilling to raise his hand, and all his energy was spent on resisting the coercion.
Now he still had to feed someone wine?!
‘Aren’t we participating in an assessment?’
‘This is a whole one million Divinity Points!’
‘Brother Yang, aren’t you being a bit too casual?’
Ye Jianfeng went through a wave of wild complaints in his heart.
But complaints aside, he still gritted his teeth and moved.
Supporting Wen Yushui with his left hand, he raised his right hand bit by bit, as if moving a heavy object weighing thousands of catties, and difficultly took that cup of Monkey Wine.
At the very instant Yang Fan let go, Ye Jianfeng only felt a heavy sinking in his hand!
Under the terrifying pressure, that cup of wine was actually as heavy as a thousand catties!
His wrist trembled violently, and the whole cup of wine almost spilled directly onto the ground!
“Miss Wen, I will serve you your drink,” Ye Jianfeng said with a dark face and gnashing teeth, his tone full of reluctance.
As a Sword Cultivator, he didn’t know anything about cherishing jade and pitying fragrant flowers.
In his eyes, Wen Yushui at this moment was just a burden. If it weren’t for Yang Fan’s request, he wouldn’t even have bothered to glance at her more.
Women would only affect the speed of his sword-drawing, let alone a stupid woman who couldn’t even judge the limits of her own Physical Body; how could Divinity Points not be more important?
Wen Yushui’s face flushed slightly, and she was clearly also a bit embarrassed.

But her condition at this moment was simply too poor. The moment that cup of Monkey Wine entered her mouth, a warm power rapidly spread out, like sweet spring water moisturizing her withered Physical Body. Both her spirit and Physical Body visibly recovered a segment, and even that oppressive feeling was not as suffocating as before.
“Brother Sima.” At this time, Yang Fan spoke again, “You consumed quite a bit just now, would you also like some Monkey Wine to replenish your physical strength?”
Sima Bang, standing at the very back, was stunned for a moment.
Of course he wanted to drink, the problem was whether now was the time for drinking?
He couldn’t even raise his hand now, relying entirely on one breath to brace himself, and even speaking was laborious, yet he was supposed to drink?
“I’m a bit far from you,” Yang Fan said casually.
“I’ll have Old Ye pass it to you.”
As soon as his voice fell, he snapped his fingers once more.
This time what appeared in his hand was no longer a cup of wine, but a whole barrel of Monkey Wine!

The wine barrel was fully Half-man tall, heavy and thick, clearly taking into consideration Sima Bang’s S-rank Devouring Talent; drinking with a cup probably wouldn’t even be enough to fill the gaps between his teeth.
“Old Ye, pass this barrel of wine to Brother Sima.” Yang Fan raised one hand, and actually lifted the Half-man-tall wine barrel over his head understatement-style and passed it backward.
This scene made Ye Jianfeng’s lips part slightly, and his entire person froze directly.
Under this kind of pressure, let alone lifting a barrel, even moving slightly more was a torment.
Ye Jianfeng knew clearly in his heart that if he dared to reach out and take it, the next second he would definitely be directly crushed and eliminated!
“Old Ye, why are you dawdling so much?” Yang Fan in front frowned.
He also found this posture awkward.
Ye Jianfeng took a deep breath and spoke with difficulty, “Brother Yang... My strength is limited... I have no extra strength right now... This barrel of wine... I can’t catch it.”
“Ah? Is that so?” Yang Fan was stunned for a moment.
Yang Fan felt that although this pressure had strengthened quite a bit, to him, at most it had just gone from a “feather” to a “sheet of paper”, truly making no difference.
He gave a light cough, “Then... Robots should also be able to be materialized, right? I’ll let them help.”
“Brother Yang, stop messing around...” Sima Bang summoned a sliver of spirit, his tone trembling somewhat.

“The pressure here is too great, ordinary Robot Soldiers will be crushed into iron cakes as soon as they come out. Stop talking... save some strength... Together with Brother Ye, lasting until two hours shouldn’t be much of a problem.”
Just as his voice fell, Yang Fan snapped his fingers again.
The next moment, four metallic figures instantly appeared on the platform!
Super Alloy Robot Warrior!
Under this terrifying pressure, they were not affected!
One of them supported Wen Yushui, and another took the wine barrel in Yang Fan’s hand.
As for the remaining two, each holding a Moonlit Cup, they stood on the left and right sides of Ye Jianfeng and Sima Bang like accompanying attendants.
The scene went quiet for a split second; Ye Jianfeng was completely stunned, and Sima Bang’s pupils also shrank.
“No...” Sima Bang’s voice wasn’t loud, but it carried an obvious tremor, “You even bought this thing? Do you have so much money that you’re burning it?”
The Super Alloy Robot Warrior produced in the high-tier Mechanical Divine Kingdom had combat power comparable only to the Qi Refining Stage, yet the price was a full one hundred Divinity Points each.
In the eyes of the vast majority of people, this thing was purely useless chicken ribs.
With these Resources, one could casually pile up a large batch of Qi Refining Stage believers.
Who would have nothing better to do than buy this kind of thing? It’s simply a waste.
“There are only four,” Yang Fan said casually, “bought them to play with.”
“...” Ye Jianfeng’s mouth twitched slightly.
Isn’t the cost of your “playing” a bit too high?
“Quick, Brother Yang.” Sima Bang was already too lazy to think more, directly closing his eyes and opening his mouth wide, “I really can’t move anymore right now, let it feed me.”
That appearance had no trace of image to speak of.
“Um...” Ye Jianfeng hesitated for a moment, but still spoke, “Can... can I also have some?”
Wen Yushui’s cheeks flushed slightly, and she said softly, “If possible... I’d like another cup.”
“Drink as much as you like,” Yang Fan said indifferently, “Monkey Wine is plenty in my divine kingdom.”
The next moment, the aroma of wine filled the air, appearing exceptionally abrupt in this oppressive assessment space.
Several robots had clear divisions of labor.
One supported the person, one passed the wine, and the other two held Moonlit Cups, shuttling back and forth like waiters.
This scene fell into the eyes of the surrounding crowd, instantly becoming incomparably bizarre.
