chapters.title: Chapter 173: Does he like me?
paragraphs: What are they doing?
The assessment site... turned into a drinking party?
Everyone else was gritting their teeth and holding on, yet they were actually drinking to recover their state?
The atmosphere instantly became bizarre to the extreme.
Above the high platform.
Han Wuji watched this scene and couldn’t help laughing out loud, “Is this Brother Tianci’s younger brother?”
“He actually even bought a Super Alloy Robot Warrior to replenish energy. This idea is quite novel indeed.”
“It seems that in the future, there will be one more way to play the first stage of the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle.”
The divine coercion of the first stage was both a test of strength and a competition of endurance.
Under extreme consumption, if one could obtain external supplies, naturally they could persist longer.
It’s just that this routine of “bringing supplies” had truly never been done by anyone before.
“As expected of my younger brother, his mind is truly nimble.” Sima Tianci had opened his eyes at some point.
Looking down at Sima Bang’s wide-open mouth waiting to be fed, his eyes were full of indulgence.
person frowned at this moment and looked at Yang Fan: “The person at the very front of their team should be a junior or senior student, right?”
“This... is a bit out of line with the rules.”
As soon as these words were spoken, the expressions of the rest changed slightly.
There were loopholes to exploit in the first stage, but there were also unwritten rules, which was that one could only team up with peers of the same year.
Like Gu Le pulling twenty people together to form a group, although her methods were unsightly, it was still within an acceptable range.
But if they looked for upperclassmen to shoulder the pressure, then the nature of the matter would change.
This was no longer taking shortcuts, but rather fleecing the resources of the Five Great Families!
If everyone operated like this, every year’s Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle would probably have to spend an extra hundreds of billions of Divinity Points!
The atmosphere was somewhat subtle for a moment; several people exchanged glances, hesitating to speak.
If not for Sima Tianci being right here, and the person on stage being his own younger brother, they would probably already be discussing how to handle it right now.
After all, the essence of the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle was to screen for future High-Order Gods worth investing in.
The rewards of the first stage were merely to incentivize everyone to participate, not to let people come and “take advantage of the system”.
“My younger brother would not do such a thing.” Sima Tianci’s tone was calm, yet it carried an unquestionable meaning.
“If that is indeed the case, the resources rewarded to them will not go through the public account; I will make up for it personally.”
Hearing this, the situation eased slightly.

Gu Changkong chuckled and spoke to smooth things over: “There is no need to take such a small matter too seriously. I have presided over so many sessions of the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle. I don’t really have any impression of this person; perhaps he really is a freshman.”
Han Wuji narrowed his eyes slightly, “His aura is integrated as a whole, and his Foundation is profound. This doesn’t look like someone who just entered school.”
“He might be a dark horse.” Lu Chengyuan said indifferently, “Discussing these is meaningless. Once the first stage ends, just apply for Intelligent Life to check his identity.”
Hearing this, several people nodded one after another and said no more.
Time continued to pass, and the number of people on the platform decreased visibly to the naked eye.
Batch after batch of Prodigies could not withstand the pressure and were forced to leave the stage.
Soon, more than sixty percent were eliminated, and the originally crowded platform gradually became sparse.
“Brother Yang.” Ye Jianfeng had just gulped down a large cup of Monkey Wine, and his aura had recovered quite a bit.
“There is still a quarter of an hour before two hours are up. If you can’t hold on, switch with me. I am confident.”
“No need.” Yang Fan’s tone was calm, “I can still hold on. Stand behind me, and perhaps we can try for three hours.”
As the words fell, all three of them were slightly stunned. Looking at Yang Fan’s back, a trace of complex emotion emerged in their eyes.
To be able to persist until now under such coercion and still maintain a composed appearance—
Over the past year, the development progress of Yang Fan’s divine kingdom was probably already leaving them far behind.

Sima Bang had an expression of extreme relief. Originally, he thought he was leading the three of them to make a huge profit, but he didn’t expect that there was actually a dark horse like Yang Fan hidden in the team.
Had he known earlier, he would have let Yang Fan go first; the first hour he spent bearing it was practically in vain!
Time quickly advanced to two hours.
At this moment, the eye of the god’s coercion surged wildly once again!
It was several times stronger than before!
Almost in just an instant, screams rang out one after another.
Nearly another ten percent of the people were directly blasted away by the terrifying force! Their bodies, like broken kites, were fiercely bounced out of the platform.
Even with Yang Fan blocking most of the pressure at the very front, Wen Yushui’s face was still pale, and she was almost unable to stand steady.
If not for previously replenishing Monkey Wine and having the alloy robot supporting her, she would have already been eliminated in that instant just now.
However, at this moment, her state of mind had instead become much more relaxed.
Two hours had arrived, and one million Divinity Points were already secure.
For this Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle, she had invested quite a bit of resources in the early stage. Now, not only did she break even, but she would also make a huge profit.
Thinking of this, she couldn’t help letting out a breath of relief in her heart.
The surroundings were oppressive, and the air seemed to gradually solidify. The Prodigies still on the stage had expressions that were twisted almost one and all.
Some clenched their teeth tightly with veins bulging on their foreheads; some had bloodshot eyes and heavy breathing like beasts.
What’s more, their bodies had already begun to tremble uncontrollably, as if they would collapse at any moment.
The invisible coercion, like the entire heaven and earth collapsing down, pressed down so hard that even breathing became an extravagant hope.
And right in this extremely oppressive environment, Yang Fan still stood straight with a calm expression, and even his breathing did not have the slightest disorder.
That coercion, which was enough to crush the vast majority of people, fell upon him as if it didn’t exist at all.
This stage tested the Physical Body, the spirit, and the environmental stability of the divine kingdom.
And Yang Fan’s believers walked the path of three-line simultaneous cultivation, having almost no shortcomings.
As for the divine kingdom’s environment, that was even a fault-level lead. Its Foundation was so profound that it even far surpassed many ordinary gods!
This degree of coercion was nothing much to him.
Time passed once again.
When it reached two and a half hours, Wen Yushui finally couldn’t hold on anymore.
“I... can’t do it anymore...” Her voice was hoarse, “The divine kingdom... can’t hold on... Believers... are praying to me...”
She closed her eyes, her face full of struggle.
“I must go down...”

Her Physical Body could still barely support her, but the believers within the divine kingdom were already nearing their limits. Continuing further would only cause irreversible damage to the divine kingdom.
Yang Fan nodded and instructed: “Send her down.”
A robot immediately stepped forward, half-knelt on the ground, supported Wen Yushui’s calves with both hands, and steadily picked her up in its arms.
Under the terrifying coercion, the Super Alloy Robot Warrior’s metal joints emitted “kacha kacha” sounds, yet it still walked steadily step by step down the platform.
This scene was seen by those students on the periphery who had long been eliminated, instantly causing a wave of envy.
Being eliminated just the same, the gap in treatment was simply too huge!
“That person... is so handsome.”
“This isn’t called handsome; this is being gentle and considerate... Is he from our batch? I really want to get to know him.”
“Don’t think about it. Even among Prodigies, there are tiers. Those who can stand in that position as freshmen are basically connected through backchannels.”
“That’s right.” Another person rolled their eyes, “Who among ordinary people can afford a Super Alloy Robot Warrior? That costs one hundred Divinity Points each!”
“If you want to latch onto a rich bro, just say so; don’t drag in things like being gentle and considerate.”
“You toxic man, what business is it of yours? I wasn’t even talking to you, go away!”
“Heh, gold digger, don’t act like a lovestruck fool in front of me.”
The sounds of discussion rose one after another, while Wen Yushui, who had been carried down the platform, felt somewhat dazed at this moment.
Those envious gazes made her feel a slight sweetness in her heart, and even the physical exhaustion was diluted by quite a bit.
She couldn’t help turning her head back to look at the figure still standing at the very front on the stage. The scene of the other party blocking in front of her repeatedly surfaced in her mind.
“He... could it be...” Wen Yushui’s heartbeat accelerated slightly, “...that he likes me?”

This stage tested the Physical Body, the spirit, and the environmental stability of the divine kingdom.
And Yang Fan’s believers walked the path of three-line simultaneous cultivation, having almost no shortcomings.
As for the divine kingdom’s environment, that was even a fault-level lead.
Its Foundation was so profound that it even far surpassed many ordinary gods!
This degree of coercion was nothing much to him.
Time passed once again.
When it reached two and a half hours, Wen Yushui finally couldn’t hold on anymore.
“I... can’t do it anymore...” Her voice was hoarse, “The divine kingdom... can’t hold on...
Believers... are praying to me...”
She closed her eyes, her face full of struggle.
“I must go down...”
Her Physical Body could still barely support her, but the believers within the divine kingdom were already nearing their limits.
Continuing further would only cause irreversible damage to the divine kingdom.
Yang Fan nodded and instructed: “Send her down.”
A robot immediately stepped forward, half-knelt on the ground, supported Wen Yushui’s calves with both hands, and steadily picked her up in its arms.
Under the terrifying coercion, the Super Alloy Robot Warrior’s metal joints emitted “kacha kacha” sounds, yet it still walked steadily step by step down the platform.
This scene was seen by those students on the periphery who had long been eliminated, instantly causing a wave of envy.
Being eliminated just the same, the gap in treatment was simply too huge!
“That person... is so handsome.”
“This isn’t called handsome; this is being gentle and considerate...
Is he from our batch?
I really want to get to know him.”
“Don’t think about it.
Even among Prodigies, there are tiers.
Those who can stand in that position as freshmen are basically connected through backchannels.”
“That’s right.” Another person rolled their eyes, “Who among ordinary people can afford a Super Alloy Robot Warrior?
That costs one hundred Divinity Points each!”
“If you want to latch onto a rich bro, just say so; don’t drag in things like being gentle and considerate.”
“You toxic man, what business is it of yours?
I wasn’t even talking to you, go away!”
“Heh, gold digger, don’t act like a lovestruck fool in front of me.”
The sounds of discussion rose one after another, while Wen Yushui, who had been carried down the platform, felt somewhat dazed at this moment.
Those envious gazes made her feel a slight sweetness in her heart, and even the physical exhaustion was diluted by quite a bit.
She couldn’t help turning her head back to look at the figure still standing at the very front on the stage.
The scene of the other party blocking in front of her repeatedly surfaced in her mind.
“He... could it be...” Wen Yushui’s heartbeat accelerated slightly, “...that he likes me?”

chapters.title: Chapter 174: Shameless
paragraphs: As soon as this thought appeared, she couldn’t help feeling a bit flustered, but the more she thought about it, the more reasonable it seemed.
After all, being able to get distracted to take care of her in that kind of situation was just like a hero saving a beauty in storybooks.
At this moment, very few people were left standing on the stage.
Aside from Yang Fan and the other two, as well as the “main force” on Gu Le’s side, the rest were basically seniors in their third and fourth years.
As for Gu Le’s side, after two hours, the rhythm of changing people visibly accelerated.
In less than a quarter of an hour, someone would fail to hold on and step down; she constantly adjusted the formation to barely maintain it.
Lying beside their team was a “iron cake,” which was a Robot Soldier materialized earlier. As soon as it appeared, it was directly crushed flat by the terrifying coercion.

After witnessing Yang Fan’s operation, Gu Le also materialized the Robot Soldiers from her divine kingdom, intending to borrow his train of thought to increase the success rate of her team exploiting the system.
However, the idea was wonderful while reality was cruel; these ordinary robots simply couldn’t withstand the immense pressure.
As for going to the Divine Shop to buy robotic warriors right now, it was simply impossible. At this moment, if their minds relaxed even a little, they would probably fail.
Yang Fan still stood straight in place. He glanced around at those people with distorted expressions struggling bitterly, and frowned slightly.
“Old Ye, Brother Sima. Are you two alright? Do you want to eat something?”
Ye Jianfeng’s entire body was tensed up, looking like a fully drawn bow. Even breathing was extremely difficult for him, leaving him with no excess energy to respond.
On the other hand, Sima Bang, after a full few minutes, squeezed a word out from between his teeth: “Yes!”
“Alright.” Yang Fan nodded.
The next moment, a large amount of delicacies appeared out of thin air in the hands of the robots.
These foods all came from the Myriad Spirits Dietary Hub, using high-tier spiritual grain as the main ingredient, supplemented with Dragon meat essence, all containing extremely abundant energy.
For everyone who was experiencing extreme consumption at this moment, they were comparable to Spirit Pills!
A robot walked to Ye Jianfeng’s side, using a spoon to gently bring the food to his lips.
However, Ye Jianfeng’s lips were tightly shut, not moving a single bit.
Sima Bang on the other side tried his best to slowly open his mouth.
As soon as the food entered his mouth, before he even had time to chew, he swallowed it directly!
One bite, two bites, three bites...
Plate after plate was frantically sent into his mouth like stuffing a granary.
Possessing the S-tier “Devour” talent, Sima Bang was like a bottomless pit at this moment.
In just a short moment, the hundreds of kilograms of food materialized by Yang Fan were all swallowed into his belly! The scene could be described as exaggerated.
“Continue... Bring more...” Sima Bang’s voice was slurred. “The more food, the better... When the time comes... half of my reward... will be shared with you...”
As energy was continuously replenished, his aura recovered quite a bit visibly.
Yang Fan, however, shook his head. “There’s no need. We’re all brothers, spiritual grain is fully provided.”
“Good brother...” Sima Bang mumbled with a slurred voice, full of gratitude.
Time slowly ticked by, and it finally reached three hours.
At that moment, the breath in many people’s hearts broke, and their bodies were directly blasted away by the terrifying force!
Figure after figure flew out of the arena one after another, heavily crashing onto the ground.
Gu Le’s twenty-person team also completely collapsed at this moment, with everyone flying backward simultaneously.
Ye Jianfeng abruptly opened his eyes, his aura in disarray, and his voice was almost “squeezed” out from his throat.
“I... can’t hold on... no... strength... going down... first...”
“I’ll have a robot carry you.” Yang Fan spoke.
“N—no need...” Ye Jianfeng shook his head with difficulty. “Just... holding me... is fine...”
Half of his body leaned on the robot, swaying with every step, as if he were walking, yet also as if he were being dragged away from the arena.
A Sword Cultivator naturally had his own proud bones and couldn’t afford to lose face.
Being carried off like a princess in public?
Impossible! Absolutely impossible!
The moment Ye Jianfeng left, Sima Bang used his last trace of strength to lunge forward! His entire body directly slammed into Yang Fan’s thigh.
At this moment, Sima Bang was half-kneeling on the ground, his hands tightly hugging Yang Fan’s thigh.
His head was tilted to one side, his mouth wide open, continuously accepting the robot’s continuous feeding.
The scene was extremely comical.
“Brother Sima... What is the meaning of this?” Yang Fan lowered his head, looking at this scene with a puzzled face.

“I’m being shameless... Just holding on like this... maybe... I can reach four hours... When the time comes... you will be my own brother...” Sima Bang closed his eyes, swallowing while speaking vaguely.
Yang Fan: “...”
He silently raised his head, finding that quite a few people around were casting strange gazes.
At this moment, Yang Fan even had an impulse to directly transfer one hundred million Divinity Points to Sima Bang, begging him to let go.
If he kept hugging like this, his pants were going to be pulled off!
Yang Fan quietly pulled up his waistband with his left hand, staring fixedly at the eye of the god in the sky as if he knew nothing.
Above the high platform.
The gods of the Five Great Families looked at this scene and couldn’t help laughing.
Coming to this Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle was truly not in vain; after going back, they must chat about it in the Family group chat, as the topic value was quite sufficient!
At this moment, the Prodigies still persisting on the stage were fewer than a few hundred people.
Some gritted their teeth and held on stubbornly, while others had calm expressions.
And more and more gazes were concentrated on Yang Fan and the other.
On one hand, it was because of Sima Bang’s comical posture. On the other hand, it was because of Yang Fan, this “unfamiliar face.”
Those who could persist for more than three hours under the divine coercion were almost exclusively third and fourth-year students.
Being in the Primordial Academy together and frequently participating in offensive campaigns against Alien Divine Kingdoms year-round, they had more or less run into each other before.
As the young master of the Sima Family, Sima Bang was naturally recognized by many people. As for Yang Fan, most people were seeing him for the first time.
The Primordial Academy didn’t look at seniority, only potential. With the composure Yang Fan displayed now, it was enough to prove the strength of his divine kingdom’s foundation.
“When the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle ends, I must get to know this person.” The same thought appeared in everyone’s mind.
Time trickled away bit by bit. Every few breaths that passed, a new figure fell.
The number of people on the field decreased visibly to the naked eye.
Finally, the time reached the end.
High up in the sky, the “eye of the god” that had always coldly gazed at everything slowly closed, its outline blurring bit by bit until it completely disappeared into nothingness.
At the exact same moment, the terrifying pressure shrouding the entire arena suddenly dissipated!
Everyone instinctively took deep, heavy gasps of breath.
“Hoo—!” Sima Bang couldn’t hold on any longer. His whole body felt as if his strength had been drained, and he collapsed directly onto the ground, fainting.
The robot that had been mechanically feeding him stopped its right hand mid-air, its movement freezing.
Right at this moment, a light blue radiance emerged from the Void Realm, slowly falling from above Yang Fan’s head like a scan, sweeping across his entire body from top to bottom.
Above the high platform, the five people received the feedback information simultaneously.
With just a glance, the expressions of several of them changed.
“Hmm?” Han Wuji’s gaze narrowed as he took the lead to speak. “This kid is truly a freshman... and he hasn’t joined any major Family or corporation yet?”
A flash of brilliant light crossed his eyes. “A fine sapling. The Han Family intends to invite him.”

chapters.title: Chapter 175: Ranked Number One
paragraphs: Lu Chengyuan smiled faintly, but his tone was completely impolite: “Han Wuji, with your status, I’m afraid it’s not enough. Stop playing your little schemes here.”

“This kid’s ranking on the Primordial Battlefield has already entered the top million... Such potential is close to the Prodigy-level. Our Qin Family is also interested in recruiting him. I will seek instructions from the Family Elders,” Qin Lie spoke in a low voice.
For a moment, the several gods present were faintly at each other’s throats.
Just then, Sima Tianci let out a yawn and said in a lazy tone, “Have you all forgotten something?”
As he spoke, he pointed at Sima Bang, who was lying on the arena floor like a dead dog.
The corners of Sima Tianci’s mouth curled up slightly. “He is my younger brother’s friend.”
The others’ eyes flickered slightly, but they did not continue to argue.

With the potential Yang Fan was currently displaying, he was indeed worthy of investment from the Five Great Families, and not just an “unrestricted investment contract” like the one from the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle.
A Genius like him could be directly recruited as a core member of the Family.
“Let’s continue the assessment,” Gu Changkong spoke, his tone calm. “We can discuss the investment matter later.”
His gaze swept across the crowd. “The first round of assessment is over. The remaining number of people is 176. Next is the second round.”
“After choosing a direction, the Intelligent Life will perform testing, and ultimately filter out the top ten.”
“These ten people will receive special investment contracts as well as an S-Rank Building as a reward.”
As soon as he finished speaking, a gentle force lifted the unconscious Sima Bang and sent him out of the arena.
Immediately after, the space in the center of the arena distorted slightly, and three completely different areas slowly unfolded.

On the far left was the Cultivation Route, where Spiritual Qi surged, and a “target body” condensed from pure energy floated within. It could be attacked at will, and all damage would be fully recorded and converted into attack power data.
In the middle was the Martial Route, within which invisible force fields were layered one upon another to measure Physical Body and defensive weight-bearing capacity.

The far right was completely different. As far as the eye could see, countless data points interwoved in the air—a virtual deduction space created by a high-ranking Intelligent Life that could instantly determine a god’s maximum computing power.
All three major directions were uniformly evaluated by the Intelligent Life.

This second round of the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle was to test the limits of a god in a certain system. Without needing to go through a Divine Kingdom War, it could indirectly reflect the overall strength of the believers within their divine kingdom.
“Testing begins.” As the prompt sounded, the crowd quickly split up.
The Cultivation and Martial Arts routes had the largest number of people. But surprisingly, more than twenty people had also gathered in front of the Mechanical Path.
Yang Fan’s gaze swept across, and his heart stirred slightly. “As expected of the Primordial Academy, to have so many people choosing even the Mechanical Path.”
Without hesitation, he stepped forward, heading straight for the Cultivation Route area.
After all, this was the primary route of Yang Fan’s divine kingdom.
In the testing area, figures constantly went in and out.
Almost every few breaths, a cold and clear voice would ring out above the arena.
“Senior year, Human Race Prodigy—Lu Chen. Cultivation Route testing completed.
Original attack value: 872.
Comprehensive score after coefficient conversion: 1744 points.”
“Senior year, Human Race Prodigy—Han Li. Martial Route testing completed.
Original defensive load: 1030.
Comprehensive score after coefficient conversion: 2060 points.”
“Junior year, Human Race Prodigy—Gu Xingzhou. Mechanical Path testing completed.
Peak computing power: 890.
Comprehensive score after coefficient conversion: 1780 points.”
“Senior year, Human Race Prodigy—Qin Yang. Cultivation Route testing completed.
Original attack value: 2010.
Comprehensive score after coefficient conversion: 4020 points.”
“Senior year, Human Race Prodigy—Sima Ling. Martial Route testing completed.
Original defensive load: 1180.
Comprehensive score after coefficient conversion: 2360 points.”
“Junior year, Human Race Prodigy—Lin Xuan. Mechanical Path testing completed.
Peak computing power: 960.
Comprehensive score after coefficient conversion: 1920 points.”

The grading standards for the three routes were different, but under the uniform algorithm of the Intelligent Life, they were all multiplied by a fixed coefficient and converted into a unified comprehensive score.
It was clear at a glance, the superior and inferior instantly distinguished.
The entire process was like an assembly line, efficient and cold.
Enter, test, broadcast, exit—there were no extra steps.
Gu Changkong and the others stood on the high platform, nodding slightly as they listened to the continuous broadcasts of the scores.

The Primordial Academy recruited from the entire Human Federation, and there were so many with outstanding talent. However, the development of a divine kingdom was never just about talent; Resources were the foundation.
And the vast majority of Resources in this world were controlled by the Five Great Families. Therefore, the top ten of each Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle almost always came from them.
Even if they were not direct descendants of the Five Great Families, they were prodigies who had been invested in by them in advance.
Soon it was Yang Fan’s turn. He stepped into the Cultivation Route testing area and took a deep breath.
He slowly raised his right hand, and an extremely sharp golden aura emerged from his right arm. Its sharpness was restrained, yet it was heart-palpitating.
This was a B-Rank Cultivation Technique—the Gengjin Rift-Blade Art.
Although Yang Fan’s believers had no special Cultivation talent, they cultivated all Five Elements, each with their own strengths.
And the Dao of Gengjin focused on slaughter! Therefore, he did not hesitate to choose this Cultivation Technique for this test.
At the same time, the believers in the divine kingdom who cultivated the Gengjin Rift-Blade Art raised their heads almost simultaneously, as if they had sensed something.
In the next instant, Yang Fan moved.
He swung his right hand down! A pale golden light suddenly tore through the air and shot out!
There was no exaggerated momentum, yet it was sharp to the extreme! Wherever it passed, the space seemed to be sliced open with a thin crack!
However, just as that light was about to explode, an invisible force appeared in the air, melting away that golden light which was enough to slash through everything!
After a brief silence, the voice of the Intelligent Life rang out.
“Freshman year, Human Race Prodigy—Yang Fan. Cultivation Route testing completed.
Original attack value: 2490.
Comprehensive score after coefficient conversion: 4980 points.
The testing process was extremely fast; in just a few short minutes, all three routes were completely tested.
In the next moment, light converged in the sky.
A huge electronic light screen slowly unfolded, and everyone’s results appeared at the same time.
[Comprehensive Ranking]
1st Place: Yang Fan (Freshman) — 4980 points
2nd Place: Qin Yang (Senior) — 4020 points
3rd Place: Sima Ling (Senior) — 2960 points
4th Place: Han Li (Senior) — 2060 points
5th Place: Lin Xuan (Junior) — 1920 points
6th Place: Gu Xingzhou (Junior) — 1780 points
7th Place: Lu Chen (Senior) — 1744 points
8th Place: Li Xiang (Senior) — 1644 points
9th Place: Deng E (Senior) — 1598 points
10th Place: Han Chao (Senior) — 1577 points
The ranking was incredibly clear, but the entire venue was dead silent.

Within the Heaven-Pressing Realm, not one of the over five thousand people made a sound, whether they were Human Race Prodigies or the gods who had come from the Five Great Families to preside over the event.
Even Sima Tianci, the Peerless Prodigy who had once walked out of the Primordial Academy, had a completely changed look in his eyes at this moment.
Looking at Yang Fan, Sima Tianci no longer had a lazy expression, but instead looked as if he were looking at one of his own kind.

Gu Changkong and the others stood on the high platform, nodding slightly as they listened to the continuous broadcasts of the scores.
The Primordial Academy recruited from the entire Human Federation, and there were so many with outstanding talent.
However, the development of a divine kingdom was never just about talent; Resources were the foundation.
And the vast majority of Resources in this world were controlled by the Five Great Families.
Therefore, the top ten of each Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle almost always came from them.
Even if they were not direct descendants of the Five Great Families, they were prodigies who had been invested in by them in advance.
Soon it was Yang Fan’s turn.
He stepped into the Cultivation Route testing area and took a deep breath.
He slowly raised his right hand, and an extremely sharp golden aura emerged from his right arm.
Its sharpness was restrained, yet it was heart-palpitating.
This was a B-Rank Cultivation Technique—the Gengjin Rift-Blade Art.
Although Yang Fan’s believers had no special Cultivation talent, they cultivated all Five Elements, each with their own strengths.
And the Dao of Gengjin focused on slaughter!
Therefore, he did not hesitate to choose this Cultivation Technique for this test.
At the same time, the believers in the divine kingdom who cultivated the Gengjin Rift-Blade Art raised their heads almost simultaneously, as if they had sensed something.
In the next instant, Yang Fan moved.
He swung his right hand down!
A pale golden light suddenly tore through the air and shot out!
There was no exaggerated momentum, yet it was sharp to the extreme!
Wherever it passed, the space seemed to be sliced open with a thin crack!
However, just as that light was about to explode, an invisible force appeared in the air, melting away that golden light which was enough to slash through everything!
After a brief silence, the voice of the Intelligent Life rang out.
“Freshman year, Human Race Prodigy—Yang Fan.
Cultivation Route testing completed.
Original attack value: 2490.
Comprehensive score after coefficient conversion: 4980 points.
The testing process was extremely fast; in just a few short minutes, all three routes were completely tested.
In the next moment, light converged in the sky.
A huge electronic light screen slowly unfolded, and everyone’s results appeared at the same time.
[Comprehensive Ranking]
1st Place: Yang Fan (Freshman) — 4980 points
2nd Place: Qin Yang (Senior) — 4020 points
3rd Place: Sima Ling (Senior) — 2960 points
4th Place: Han Li (Senior) — 2060 points
5th Place: Lin Xuan (Junior) — 1920 points
6th Place: Gu Xingzhou (Junior) — 1780 points
7th Place: Lu Chen (Senior) — 1744 points
8th Place: Li Xiang (Senior) — 1644 points
9th Place: Deng E (Senior) — 1598 points
10th Place: Han Chao (Senior) — 1577 points
The ranking was incredibly clear, but the entire venue was dead silent.

Within the Heaven-Pressing Realm, not one of the over five thousand people made a sound, whether they were Human Race Prodigies or the gods who had come from the Five Great Families to preside over the event.
Even Sima Tianci, the Peerless Prodigy who had once walked out of the Primordial Academy, had a completely changed look in his eyes at this moment.
Looking at Yang Fan, Sima Tianci no longer had a lazy expression, but instead looked as if he were looking at one of his own kind.

chapters.title: Chapter 176: The Most Profitable Business
paragraphs: A freshman ranking first in overall score—such a situation had never occurred in the annual Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle.
This round appeared to test the strength of a God, but in reality, it tested their believers.

A God’s power is inherently an extension of their believers. The reason Qin Yang, who ranked second, could achieve a high score of over four thousand was because he possessed the S-rank combat talent, “Blade God”.
S-rank combat talents are extremely rare. Before the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle, it was the consensus that Qin Yang would be first.
And yet? A dark horse had emerged!
Wasn’t Yang Fan’s talent “Tenfold Time Sequence”?
It was clearly a growth-type talent, so how could this be?
The minds of everyone present went almost blank. The most terrifying aspect of this score was that he was only a freshman, while Qin Yang was already a senior!
In other words, Yang Fan had managed to completely crush the Prodigies of the entire Primordial Academy in just one year!
Could such an existence still be considered a Human Race Prodigy?
This was absolutely a ‘Peerless Prodigy’!
Some even couldn’t help but have an absurd thought—had the Human Federation’s supreme Intelligent Life made a mistake in its initial judgment?
The scene before them was like a boss spawning in a newbie village.
Countless gazes fell upon Yang Fan, making him feel as if he were being pricked by needles.
Yang Fan stood where he was, his throat tightening slightly as he felt uneasy: “Did I... go a bit too far?”
Even he hadn’t expected his score to be first.

That previous strike was merely the combat power of his Gengjin Rift-Blade Art believers. After all, his believers practiced five elements simultaneously, and he also had believers on the Martial Arts and Mechanical Path.
If he were to use the full power of all believers in his Divine Kingdom for an all-out strike, it would be at least six or seven times stronger.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan fell silent himself.
The question was, was he too strong, or were these so-called Human Race Prodigies too weak?
He had only been developing for a year.
What exactly were these seniors doing? Couldn’t they try a little harder?
I wanted to maintain a low profile! I just needed tenth place to get the investment contract!!!
Being at Primordial Academy and facing the Human Race Prodigies gathered here, Yang Fan had never dared to underestimate them in the slightest.
In order to break into the top ten and obtain that “Unrestricted Investment Contract”, he had used his strongest attack method at this stage for that previous strike.
It was just that Yang Fan had clearly underestimated his own strength; he had thought that making it into the top ten would be good enough.
Yet he hadn’t expected to take first place directly!
On the high platform.
Gu Changkong and the other Gods responsible for presiding over the assessment now looked at Yang Fan with burning gazes.
A Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle had actually produced a dark horse, and it was... a dark horse comparable to a Peerless Prodigy!
So-called peerless prodigies did not exceed one hundred people per generation in the entire Human Federation.
These people all studied at Primordial Academy and Xingqiong Academy. As long as they didn’t fall along the way, they were almost certain to become High-Order Gods in the future.
For any Family, these were the pillars of support!
Such a Prodigy would be courted with all their might, even by the Five Great Giants.
“Freshman Yang Fan: Potential assessment has a serious error; suspected Peerless Prodigy!”
Soon, similar information was rapidly transmitted to various Families via the network.
Just then, Sima Tianci suddenly stepped forward and spoke before Gu Changkong could.
“Congratulations to you ten for obtaining the Unrestricted Investment Contract. Next, there will be one final simple trial; the investment amount will be adjusted based on performance.”
Having said this, he stretched and said, “This assessment has been dragging on for half a day; let’s finish it quickly.”
At this moment, Sima Tianci’s gaze remained fixed on Yang Fan.
Yang Fan looked up and met his gaze.
The next moment, a voice appeared in Yang Fan’s mind.
“Next, many big figures will be watching this trial. Don’t hold back; it’s best to defeat everyone in a crushing manner. A Prodigy should look like a Prodigy.”
“I represent the Sima Family and the Gu Family in inviting you to join us. After it ends, Fatty and I will invite you to Yuexiang Pavilion for a gathering.”
Sima Tianci clearly hadn’t spoken, but the voice appeared in Yang Fan’s mind with crystal clarity, just like the telepathic communication of an Intelligent Life.
Yang Fan’s eyes flickered slightly; he could feel the goodwill being released by the other party.
Although he didn’t understand why Sima Tianci could still represent the Gu Family, he still nodded slightly.
Subsequently, Yang Fan’s gaze slowly swept over the remaining ten people on the field.

“For this round, don’t fight one by one. You ten will engage in a free-for-all. The Heaven-Pressing Realm has an immortality rule, so feel free to use your full strength without any concerns,” Sima Tianci suddenly announced loudly.
As his voice fell, Gu Changkong and the others all frowned slightly, but ultimately did not refute him.
They knew very well that this young master of the Sima Family wanted to give Yang Fan an opportunity to fully demonstrate his strength.
Gods and believers are not in the same dimension; believers cannot manifest in reality, and the Physical Body of a God in reality cannot enter the Divine Kingdom.
However, a God can receive feedback from their entire Divine Kingdom.
Physical Body, spirit, Divine Power... all will continuously transform as the believers become stronger.
Therefore, Gods in reality also possess extremely strong combat power.
Flying, burrowing, close-quarters combat, piloting mechs—the combat styles of Gods on the front lines are strange and varied.
A God’s own strength, in a sense, represents the comprehensive power of all believers in their Divine Kingdom!
On the front lines of the war between the Human Race and alien races, Gods never just hide in the rear manipulating their Divine Kingdoms to fight.
Believers are the core power of a Divine Kingdom. Therefore, everyone wanted to see: just how strong is this monster, Yang Fan, who had suddenly popped out?
At this moment, the gazes of the other nine also fell upon Yang Fan.
There was gravity, apprehension, and also Battle Intent.
As for Yang Fan himself, he sighed softly in his heart.
His original plan was actually very simple: enter the top ten, obtain the Unrestricted Investment Contract from the Five Great Giants, and then go home to steadily develop his Divine Kingdom.
As it turned out, he had accidentally used too much force.
Since he had already been exposed, there was no point in continuing to hide things.
In just a moment, Yang Fan had already made a decision in his heart.
Show his strength, get more investment, and quickly develop the Divine Kingdom!
With the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, as long as he grew fast enough, danger would never catch up to him.
After this period of learning, Yang Fan was no longer the ignorant newcomer he once was.
He knew very well that the cultivation standards between a Peerless Prodigy and an ordinary Human Race Prodigy were completely different concepts.
The resource gap between them could even reach a hundredfold or a thousandfold!
Don’t look at how his Divine Kingdom’s monthly income had already exceeded one billion Divinity Points; in front of a behemoth like the Sima Family, it was not even worth mentioning.
For these giants, the output of a Divine Kingdom was actually just a “small part”.
What was truly terrifying about them was that they controlled the entire Human Federation.
Investing in the Virtual World, using the parliament to influence the Federal Government, and swaying the flow of countless resources.

The real major income was never from painstakingly managing Divine Kingdom assets, but from sitting there without doing anything while countless taxes and benefits flowed into their Divine Kingdoms endlessly.
You have to know that the most profitable business in this world is serving the people of the Federation!

chapters.title: Chapter 177: Five-Element Spells, Dimensional Reduction Strike
paragraphs: On the platform, the atmosphere gradually grew subtle.
The remaining ten people looked at each other, but none of them made the first move for a long time.
After all, being able to reach this step meant they were truly the top Prodigy of Primordial Academy, and no one was willing to easily expose their trump cards.
But the very next moment, someone finally couldn’t help it.
Deng E, ranked ninth, and Han Chao, ranked tenth, locked their gazes onto Yang Fan almost simultaneously.
The two exchanged a glance, and then instantly burst into action!
They were not maliciously targeting Yang Fan, but simply unconvinced.
A freshman actually rated as the number one of this batch? Naturally, they wanted to test it themselves.
Furthermore, the test of the second stage was ultimately just an extreme manifestation of a certain aspect of the Divine Kingdom, and did not represent comprehensive combat power.
Yang Fan walked the Cultivation Route, and a score close to five thousand was enough to show that his spell attack power was extremely terrifying.
But the question was, how was his defense? How was his movement technique? How was his close-combat ability? Had his believers Cultivated body-protection spells?
Everything was unknown.
So what if he had the potential of a Peerless Prodigy? Ultimately, he was just a freshman.
From Awakening the Divine Kingdom until now, only two years had passed in the Real World, so to what extent could the believers grow?
“Sorry, Brother Yang.” Deng E’s voice was low, “After we go out, I’ll treat you to a meal to apologize.”
Before his voice faded, his figure had already turned into an afterimage! Appearing behind Yang Fan like a ghost.
A punch blasted out! Aiming straight for the neck!
The fist wind whistled, even producing a piercing sonic boom.
If this punch landed solidly, it would be enough to instantly shatter a demigod’s neck bone!
Bang!
The fist fell, but what it hit was only air.
Yang Fan didn’t even turn around, just slightly tilted his head, effortlessly dodging this strike.
Seeing this scene, Qin Yang and the others on the platform all constricted their pupils.
“How is this possible?!”
“Isn’t he on the Cultivation Route? How can his reaction be so fast?”
“There was no Spiritual Qi fluctuation just now...”
“It’s like he anticipated the attack in advance!”
At this moment, apart from Deng E and Han Chao, the remaining seven people all stood in place with solemn expressions.
Although they were wary of Yang Fan, they hadn’t lost face to the point where a group of junior and senior upperclassmen would team up to besiege a freshman.
If they really did that, even if they won, it wouldn’t look good.
However, above the high platform, the expressions of Gu Changkong and the others had already changed.
“He also dual-Cultivates the Mechanical Path.” Surprise appeared in Gu Changkong’s eyes.
“With regard to the demigod level, this kind of computing power is already quite astonishing.” person also frowned.
“According to the data, his talent is the Tenfold Time Sequence.”
“This kind of talent consumes resources immensely; where did he get the spare capacity to develop the Mechanical Path?”
“Could it be... he accepted investment from some force in advance?”
“No, his data shows he is still a blank slate, having not joined any forces.”
Just as several people were discussing, Yang Fan moved.
He suddenly turned around, raised his right hand, and accurately grabbed Deng E’s wrist.
Then he gently squeezed.
Crack!
A scalp-numbing sound of bone fracturing suddenly rang out!
Deng E’s entire arm actually bent and twisted at a weird angle!
“Ah—!” The scream had just begun.
Yang Fan raised his leg and kicked out!
Bang!!!
Deng E’s entire body instantly turned into a cannonball, flying horizontally out! He smashed heavily outside the arena.
Then Yang Fan turned his head to look at Han Chao, who was still stunned in place.
Taking a step forward, his figure suddenly vanished.
When he appeared again, he had already arrived by Han Chao’s side.
“Your reaction is too slow.” Yang Fan’s tone was calm.
Then with a mere pat, like swatting a fly, Han Chao was sent flying horizontally directly!
He smashed heavily off the stage, fainting on the spot.
The whole process took only a few breaths; the rest of the crowd hadn’t even reacted yet before Deng E and Han Chao were already eliminated.
Speed, strength, and reaction were completely on different levels!
At this moment, the remaining few people completely understood that the gap between them and Yang Fan was ridiculously huge!
If they didn’t join forces, they would only be defeated one by one!
“Attack together!” Someone finally let out a low shout.
“Forget about saving face!”
“This is a Peerless Prodigy coming to smash the place at our Prodigy arena!”
“Do you really want a group of junior and senior upperclassmen to be soloed by a freshman?”
“Right! Solve him first!”
As the words fell, except for Qin Yang, everyone else burst into action simultaneously!
Boom!!!
The battle completely erupted!
Fireballs, thunder, golden light, violent wind...
Various powers instantly swept across the entire platform!
There was even a deity of the Mechanical Path who directly put on a full set of Smart Weapon for himself.
Click, click, click, the metal armor closed rapidly, shoulder cannons unfolded, and high-explosive bullets poured down like a rainstorm, sealing off all of Yang Fan’s retreat routes!
Facing this overwhelming offensive, Yang Fan’s expression remained calm.
He raised his right hand, and Earth-attribute Spiritual Qi instantly converged, gathering into a heavy small mountain in the blink of an eye!
All attacks blasted onto it and shattered completely!
Dust swept across, but couldn’t shake it by the slightest bit.
It was precisely the spell from the Thick Earth Mountain-Suppressing Scripture!
The next moment, Yang Fan raised his hand again.
A huge fireball nearly a hundred meters wide suddenly appeared above the Heaven-Pressing Realm, its scorching firelight reddening the entire space, distorting the air and rising in temperature!
Everyone’s expressions changed drastically, “Retreat quickly!!”
But before they could act, the moisture in the sky began to converge.
The water streams all over the sky condensed into dense sword rain, falling overwhelmingly!
Flames, water swords, earth mountains, golden light, wooden vines...
The Five-Element spells of Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth were cast by Yang Fan as casually as picking up something!
Someone was ignited by the flames and let out a scream.
Yang Fan was not sure if the Undying Rule was absolutely safe, so he casually waved his hand and extinguished the flames.
Following that, cyan wooden vines burst out of the ground, entangling the opponent’s limbs and directly throwing them out of the arena!
The entire battle process was so fast it dazzled the eyes!
In less than a quarter of an hour, everyone on the field had been blasted flying one after another!
This battle was completely a dimensional reduction strike, a one-sided crushing defeat!
“Fuck!”
Gu Changkong looked at the battle on the platform and couldn’t help cursing.
“Since he focuses mainly on the Cultivation Route, why doesn’t he have any specific focus? Could this kid be letting his believers develop freely?”
As the Divine Kingdom continuously evolves, the Aptitude of the believers would become higher and higher, and those with Spiritual Roots would gradually increase.
And in the Cultivation system, Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth were the five most common basic Spiritual Roots.
Under normal circumstances, deities would almost never let believers “develop freely”, and most would deliberately guide the entire Divine Kingdom to Cultivate in a single direction.
The reason was very simple: ten birds in the forest are not as good as one bird in the hand.
Knowing everything often meant mastering nothing.
Only by walking a certain path to the extreme could one unleash the strongest lethality on the Divine Kingdom Battlefield.
Moreover, cultivating in a single direction would consume far fewer resources.

For example, if specializing in the Water-attribute route, then the Spirit Plant Cultivation, Spiritual Vein environment, water area distribution, and spell system of the entire Divine Kingdom could all be built around “Water”.
Whether it was resource investment or subsequent Evolution, the cost would be greatly reduced.
But if cultivating the Five Elements simultaneously, the Cultivation cost of the Divine Kingdom would skyrocket exponentially.
Therefore, most deities would focus on cultivating believers with a certain kind of Spiritual Root, giving them more resources.
As for whether other believers could naturally evolve and withdraw, that was already considered merciful; some ruthless deities would even actively accelerate this process.

Directly granting death to those believers who “did not conform to the development direction of the Divine Kingdom”, and then putting their corpses and flesh on sale in the Divine Shop at a low price.

Over time, the proportion of a single Spiritual Root within the Divine Kingdom would become higher and higher, and eventually the development direction of the entire Divine Kingdom would be completely fixed.
A development method like Yang Fan’s was extremely rare even in Taichu City.

The whole process took only a few breaths; the rest of the crowd hadn’t even reacted yet before Deng E and Han Chao were already eliminated.
Speed, strength, and reaction were completely on different levels!
At this moment, the remaining few people completely understood that the gap between them and Yang Fan was ridiculously huge!
If they didn’t join forces, they would only be defeated one by one!
“Attack together!” Someone finally let out a low shout.
“Forget about saving face!”
“This is a Peerless Prodigy coming to smash the place at our Prodigy arena!”
“Do you really want a group of junior and senior upperclassmen to be soloed by a freshman?”
“Right!
Solve him first!”
As the words fell, except for Qin Yang, everyone else burst into action simultaneously!
Boom!!!
The battle completely erupted!
Fireballs, thunder, golden light, violent wind...
Various powers instantly swept across the entire platform!
There was even a deity of the Mechanical Path who directly put on a full set of Smart Weapon for himself.
Click, click, click, the metal armor closed rapidly, shoulder cannons unfolded, and high-explosive bullets poured down like a rainstorm, sealing off all of Yang Fan’s retreat routes!
Facing this overwhelming offensive, Yang Fan’s expression remained calm.
He raised his right hand, and Earth-attribute Spiritual Qi instantly converged, gathering into a heavy small mountain in the blink of an eye!
All attacks blasted onto it and shattered completely!
Dust swept across, but couldn’t shake it by the slightest bit.
It was precisely the spell from the Thick Earth Mountain-Suppressing Scripture!
The next moment, Yang Fan raised his hand again.
A huge fireball nearly a hundred meters wide suddenly appeared above the Heaven-Pressing Realm, its scorching firelight reddening the entire space, distorting the air and rising in temperature!
Everyone’s expressions changed drastically, “Retreat quickly!!”
But before they could act, the moisture in the sky began to converge.
The water streams all over the sky condensed into dense sword rain, falling overwhelmingly!
Flames, water swords, earth mountains, golden light, wooden vines...
The Five-Element spells of Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth were cast by Yang Fan as casually as picking up something!
Someone was ignited by the flames and let out a scream.
Yang Fan was not sure if the Undying Rule was absolutely safe, so he casually waved his hand and extinguished the flames.
Following that, cyan wooden vines burst out of the ground, entangling the opponent’s limbs and directly throwing them out of the arena!
The entire battle process was so fast it dazzled the eyes!
In less than a quarter of an hour, everyone on the field had been blasted flying one after another!
This battle was completely a dimensional reduction strike, a one-sided crushing defeat!
“Fuck!”
Gu Changkong looked at the battle on the platform and couldn’t help cursing.
“Since he focuses mainly on the Cultivation Route, why doesn’t he have any specific focus?
Could this kid be letting his believers develop freely?”
As the Divine Kingdom continuously evolves, the Aptitude of the believers would become higher and higher, and those with Spiritual Roots would gradually increase.
And in the Cultivation system, Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth were the five most common basic Spiritual Roots.
Under normal circumstances, deities would almost never let believers “develop freely”, and most would deliberately guide the entire Divine Kingdom to Cultivate in a single direction.
The reason was very simple: ten birds in the forest are not as good as one bird in the hand.
Knowing everything often meant mastering nothing.
Only by walking a certain path to the extreme could one unleash the strongest lethality on the Divine Kingdom Battlefield.
Moreover, cultivating in a single direction would consume far fewer resources.

For example, if specializing in the Water-attribute route, then the Spirit Plant Cultivation, Spiritual Vein environment, water area distribution, and spell system of the entire Divine Kingdom could all be built around “Water”.
Whether it was resource investment or subsequent Evolution, the cost would be greatly reduced.
But if cultivating the Five Elements simultaneously, the Cultivation cost of the Divine Kingdom would skyrocket exponentially.
Therefore, most deities would focus on cultivating believers with a certain kind of Spiritual Root, giving them more resources.
As for whether other believers could naturally evolve and withdraw, that was already considered merciful; some ruthless deities would even actively accelerate this process.

Directly granting death to those believers who “did not conform to the development direction of the Divine Kingdom”, and then putting their corpses and flesh on sale in the Divine Shop at a low price.

Over time, the proportion of a single Spiritual Root within the Divine Kingdom would become higher and higher, and eventually the development direction of the entire Divine Kingdom would be completely fixed.
A development method like Yang Fan’s was extremely rare even in Taichu City.

chapters.title: Chapter 178: Big Shot
paragraphs: “This kid has the Tenfold Time Sequence talent, after all,” Han Wuji said slowly. “As long as there are enough resources, his believers’ development speed is naturally ten times that of ordinary gods.”

“He can be considered qualified to walk this all-attribute path. Although a single-attribute talent develops faster, its drawbacks are obvious. In a Divine Kingdom War, it’s very easy to be targeted.”

Hearing this, Gu Changkong shook his head. “That might not necessarily be the case. Divine Kingdom Wars aren’t solo battles. One can completely team up with other gods. By complementing each other’s strengths and weaknesses and campaigning together, shortfalls can naturally be made up for.”
“In comparison, the development speed of the Divine Kingdom comes first.”
On the side, Qin Lie, listening to their discussion, suddenly laughed. “We are only Grade-A Geniuses. The thoughts of a Peerless Prodigy are simply beyond our understanding.”
Speaking up to this point, his glance faintly drifted toward Sima Tianci.
The next second, however, Sima Tianci suddenly spoke seriously, “Actually, I can be considered a multi-element cultivator as well.”
Hearing these words, Gu Changkong was taken aback for a moment. “Cousin Tianci, you too?”
“Pretty much.” Sima Tianci pinched his chin, looking as if he were pondering seriously.
“Most of my believers possess Dao Bodies. Aside from Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth, they also seem to know a bit of Ice, Dark, and Space attributes.”
The air suddenly grew quiet.
Gu Changkong: “...”
The faces of the remaining few instantly darkened, not knowing how to respond.
We’re here seriously analyzing the development path of Divine Kingdoms, and you kid are just flexing here, aren’t you?
When Grade-A Geniuses and Peerless Prodigies stand together, sometimes they truly don’t have much common language.
Soon, only Yang Fan and Qin Yang were left on the entire platform.
At this moment, Qin Yang stood holding his saber, the long blade pointing diagonally at the ground. His entire being resembled a fierce weapon about to be unsheathed.
That extremely sharp Aura even made the surrounding air feel faintly stingy.
He looked at Yang Fan, his expression solemn as never before.
“I have an S-rank Talent—Saber God,” Qin Yang said slowly.
“I know my strength isn’t equal to yours, and I can’t easily defeat so many people like you did.”
“But I still want to have a hearty battle!” He slowly raised the long saber in his hand, the Battle Intent in his eyes growing stronger and stronger.
“I want to know just how big the gap is between me and a Peerless Prodigy!”
Sensing the dangerous Aura emanating from his opponent, Yang Fan did not dare to be careless.
Just upon entering the Heaven-Pressing Realm, he had felt a faint sense of threat from Qin Yang.
Combat-type talents were naturally rarer than growth-type talents.

Just like Li Tianheng of Yang County’s Li Family, relying solely on his C-rank “Mad Blood” talent, the investment he received was not inferior to that of Luo Bing, who possessed a B-rank Ice Spirit Root.
From birth until now, this was the first time Yang Fan was fighting in the Real World.
The people earlier were still too weak for him; now Yang Fan also wanted to see where his limits truly lay!
In the next moment, Qin Yang struck with his saber!
There was no vast Spiritual Qi, nor splendid spells, only a soaring Saber Intent rising to the sky!
That Aura was so sharp it seemed capable of cleaving heaven and earth!
Buzz—!
A hundred-meter saber glow suddenly coalesced, causing the air to oscillate wildly.
Then, a fierce blade slashed down toward Yang Fan!
Yet facing this unimaginably brilliant slash, Yang Fan merely raised his head slightly, a hint of confusion even showing in his eyes.
In his perception, this slash was somewhat too slow.
Ever since his Divine Kingdom began developing the Mechanical Path, Yang Fan’s Mental Energy had been continuously growing.
Now, when his focus was fully concentrated, Qin Yang’s slash appeared slowed down several fold in his eyes.
The trajectory of the blade edge, the flow of power, and even the minute vibrations of the air were crystal clear.
Yang Fan merely shifted his body sideways slightly, and that slash, capable of cleaving mountains, brushed past his body, easily dodged.
By this time, Qin Yang had already appeared beside Yang Fan, executing a vertical slash, the blade edge happening to pass right by the right side of Yang Fan’s body.
At this exact instant, Yang Fan raised his right hand.
Likewise, there was no Spiritual Qi or spells, just simply clenching a fist and striking it against the blade body.
Clang—!!!
A metallic blast, crisp to the point of ear-piercing, rang out.
The next instant, everyone’s pupils shrank abruptly. They saw cracks appear on the body of that A-rank long saber, which then snapped in two.
Half of the blade tip spun high into the air before piercing into the arena stage.
The other half remained in Qin Yang’s hand.
The entire process was so fast that people couldn’t react in time at all.
Qin Yang maintained his slanting saber stance, standing frozen on the spot.
He stared blankly at the broken saber in his hand, his eyes filled with disbelief.
Just now, Yang Fan actually broke his A-rank war saber relying solely on Physical Body strength?!
Without any Spiritual Qi fluctuations, relying purely on his right fist, he had precisely struck the weakest spot on the blade body!
Not just Qin Yang, the entire Heaven-Pressing Realm fell completely silent.
The expressions on countless faces froze, then turned into profound shock.
At the same time, deep within the Primordial Academy.
An ancient wooden high-rise stood quietly. The entire building had no sense of technology, featuring sandalwood long tables and bronze lamps.
This was the true core level of the Primordial Academy.
At this moment, on both sides of the long table sat eight figures. Seven of them were elderly men, while the one at the very front was a special existence.
It had no real body, only countless complex streams of data interweaving continuously in mid-air.
Layers upon layers of data code formed a humanoid outline.
If Yang Fan were here, he would surely recognize one of them as Senior Gu Yuan, whom he had met back at the Primordial Battlefield.
“Practicing Cultivation, Martial Arts, and the Mechanical Path simultaneously, and developing all three quite well.”
“This youth can be evaluated as a Peerless Prodigy,” a gray-robed elder said slowly.
As his voice fell, everyone nodded slightly.
However, in the next moment, another elder furrowed his brows and looked at the figure composed of data.
“One.”
“Is this a mistake in your work? Tenfold Time Sequence? Are you sure? With this development speed, his talent is Tenfold Time Sequence?”
The Primordial Academy was the cradle of geniuses for the entire Human Federation.

Its high-level management was composed of the Five Great Families, the Federal Government, and the Virtual Universe. As for that final figure composed of data, it was a Clone of the federal supreme intelligent life.
Code name: “One”.
Facing the questioning, that humanoid data flowed slowly, and a Mechanical voice rang out.
“According to the test results at the time, the target’s talent is indeed Tenfold Time Sequence. There is no error in the database.”
Hearing this, another elder couldn’t help saying, “This is too ridiculous.”
“Even if there were enough resources, developing to this extent in one year makes no sense.”
“If you ask me, SS-rank Hundredfold Time Sequence sounds more like it!”
A white-haired elder nearby took over the conversation, “It’s not entirely impossible. This youth came from a small place like Tiannan City, where resources were scarce.”
“During the Divine Being stage, there were not enough resources to support the development of his Divine Kingdom, so it’s normal that his hidden talent couldn’t be fully reflected.”
“Coming to Taichu City and obtaining abundant resources allowed him to truly display his full potential.”
Hearing this analysis, quite a few people nodded in agreement.

chapters.title: Chapter 179: Solicitation
paragraphs: “This old man feels the same.”
Just then, someone suddenly mentioned: “Whatever the talent is, just have ‘One’ go to his Divine Kingdom to check it.”
As soon as these words were spoken, the human figure composed of data suddenly paused.

The next second, a mechanical voice slowly resonated throughout the room, “According to the ‘Federal Citizen Privacy Protection Act’, after a citizen achieves a Breakthrough to Demigod, their Divine Kingdom falls under the highest level of personal privacy. No entity has the right to forcibly enter and inspect it, including myself.”
The elder who had just spoken waved his hand, “Don’t be so rigid; we don’t have any malicious intent. Knowing the situation of the Divine Kingdom in advance also facilitates targeted cultivation.”
However, the voice of the Human Federation’s supreme Intelligent Life, ‘One’, increased in volume once again.
“It was one epoch ago that Human Race civilization expended countless resources to create me.”
“The meaning of my existence is not to serve any specific Family or individual, but to uphold the laws of the Human Federation.”
Inside the hall, the data-based human silhouette gradually became clear.
“Laws were never created to restrict the weak, but to restrict the strong.”
“Because those who truly break the rules are always those who hold power.”
Its voice was not loud, yet it caused the entire space to fall silent.
“Regardless of whether the intent is good or evil, the law is an insurmountable bottom line.”
“Everyone, you surely wouldn’t want to experience the turmoil of the Lawless Era once again, would you?”
Hearing this, the expressions of everyone present shifted slightly.
Seeming to recall something, the elder who had just spoken coughed lightly, “I was just mentioning it casually; why are you getting so serious?”
“When power is concentrated in the hands of a few, society becomes dangerous; ambition will erode the system and eventually destroy civilization itself.”
“Just as the rules of the Divine Kingdom restrict High-Order Gods from invading Low-tier Gods at will.”
“My existence is likewise to protect the weak. In the short term, the rules may seem to restrict the interests of various Families.”
“But in the long run, everyone will benefit from them.”
The data slowly spread, as if the operational logic of the entire Human Federation was displayed before its eyes.
“Society can have classes, but it must have rules. Inequality can exist, but equality must also be preserved.”
“Only in this way will those at the bottom strive to move upward, and civilization will continue to function.”
“Taxes, resources, population, and Geniuses will be born continuously.”
“Only then can Human Race civilization continue to advance.”
Speaking until the end, ‘One’s’ gaze slowly swept across everyone present.
“I hope you, esteemed adults, do not harbor any further thoughts of violating the laws of the Human Federation in my presence.”
In the hall, no one spoke for a moment.
A moment later, the elder from before finally waved his hand helplessly, “One, forget it, I’m afraid of you now. You continue.”
At this moment, the Human Federation’s supreme Intelligent Life spoke again.
“I now announce that Yang Fan’s status rating has been raised to: Peerless Prodigy.”
“As for the investment plan, according to the regulations of the Human Federation, each party will propose terms, and ultimately, Yang Fan himself will make the choice.”
“Voting begins now.”
“Agreed.”
“Agreed.”
Inside the Heaven-Pressing Realm.
At this moment, Qin Yang had already voluntarily sheathed his blade and jumped off the arena.
With just a single move, his weapon had been shattered; he already understood that he and Yang Fan were simply not on the same level.
On the high platform, Sima Tianci slowly stood up and stretched, looking like someone who could finally clock off work.
“The rewards for the first round will be distributed directly to your respective Divine Kingdoms. As for the investment contracts for the top ten, they will also be sent via email.”
After speaking, he took a step forward, and his entire person instantly vanished from the high platform.
The next moment, he had already appeared beside Yang Fan.
At the same time, a voice quietly sounded in Yang Fan’s mind.
“Just leave directly later; don’t listen to what those four pieces of trash up there have to say. Someone will contact you later.”
“If you trust me, come to Yuexiang Pavilion later; Fatty and I will be waiting for you there.”
Sima Tianci, as if nothing had happened, turned and walked to the side of the unconscious Sima Bang, lifted him up with one hand, took a step, and vanished from the Heaven-Pressing Realm.
As the assessment ended, the entire venue suddenly became lively.
A large number of gazes converged on Yang Fan almost simultaneously.
“Brother Yang, that move just now was too exaggerated!”
“Junior, let’s team up for the Divine Kingdom War when we have the chance in the future.”
“Brother Yang, I am Zhou He from the fourth year. Shall we get to know each other?”
Many Seniors stepped forward, their attitudes extremely enthusiastic.
After all, anyone could see that after today, the name Yang Fan would certainly enter the sights of various Families and spread throughout the entire Primordial Academy.
Even Qin Lie and the others on the high platform walked down, their faces full of smiles.
“Young friend Yang Fan, are you interested in having a chat?” Qin Lie took the lead and smiled.
Han Wuji also spoke up: “Young man, there is no need to rush into deciding your affiliation; you can take your time to look around.”
“The Gu Family has many Seniors on the Cultivation Route; if you are willing, we can exchange pointers later.”
Facing the active overtures of several gods, Yang Fan also felt the pressure.

However, remembering Sima Tianci’s earlier reminder, he still politely cupped his hands, “Thank you all, Seniors, for your kind regard, but this Junior has important matters today, so I will take my leave first.”
Seeing Yang Fan speak this way, the few did not force him.
This was a Peerless Prodigy, whose status in Taichu City was higher than even theirs.
After leaving the Heaven-Pressing Realm, Yang Fan did not return to his small courtyard but headed straight for Yuexiang Pavilion.
He knew clearly in his heart that the Sima Family also intended to recruit him.
But Yang Fan did not resent this; Sima Bang was his friend after all, and Yang Fan held no ill will toward Sima Tianci.
Joining the Sima Family was not out of the question!
Today, Yang Fan was no longer the person he once was.
The more he learned, the more he understood the rules of this world.
To develop his Divine Kingdom and rise rapidly, relying solely on the income from his Divine Kingdom was far from enough.
Resources, channels, connections, information...
These all required relying on major powers.
Thinking back to when he had rejected Senior Gu Yuan’s invitation on the Primordial Battlefield, Yang Fan now felt it was a bit of a pity.
Yang Fan had just arrived at the entrance of Yuexiang Pavilion.
A middle-aged man wearing a black and gold robe quickly hurried up to greet him; the aura emanating from him indicated he was a Low-tier God.
“Your Highness Yang Fan.” The middle-aged man bowed slightly and said respectfully, “Young Master Sima has been waiting for a long time.”
The other party’s attitude carried a hint of fawning, which made Yang Fan feel somewhat uncomfortable.
Yang Fan recognized him; this person was one of the Senior managers of Yuexiang Pavilion.
In the past, when Sima Bang brought them here to eat, the man would at most nod in acknowledgment; he would never have personally greeted them like this.
Under his guidance, Yang Fan headed toward the top floor of Yuexiang Pavilion.
Spirit wood carved beams, star crystal paved floors.
The private room on the top floor no longer resembled a restaurant, but rather a palace in the sky.
The massive floor-to-ceiling windows even allowed one to overlook half of Taichu City.
A row of attendants stood neatly on both sides of the corridor, both men and women, all of superior appearance and temperament.
Upon seeing Yang Fan, everyone bowed simultaneously, “Welcome, Your Highness Yang Fan.”
