“Just leave directly later; don’t listen to what those four pieces of trash up there have to say.
Someone will contact you later.”
“If you trust me, come to Yuexiang Pavilion later; Fatty and I will be waiting for you there.”
Sima Tianci, as if nothing had happened, turned and walked to the side of the unconscious Sima Bang, lifted him up with one hand, took a step, and vanished from the Heaven-Pressing Realm.
As the assessment ended, the entire venue suddenly became lively.
A large number of gazes converged on Yang Fan almost simultaneously.
“Brother Yang, that move just now was too exaggerated!”
“Junior, let’s team up for the Divine Kingdom War when we have the chance in the future.”
“Brother Yang, I am Zhou He from the fourth year.
Shall we get to know each other?”
Many Seniors stepped forward, their attitudes extremely enthusiastic.
After all, anyone could see that after today, the name Yang Fan would certainly enter the sights of various Families and spread throughout the entire Primordial Academy.
Even Qin Lie and the others on the high platform walked down, their faces full of smiles.
“Young friend Yang Fan, are you interested in having a chat?” Qin Lie took the lead and smiled.
Han Wuji also spoke up: “Young man, there is no need to rush into deciding your affiliation; you can take your time to look around.”
“The Gu Family has many Seniors on the Cultivation Route; if you are willing, we can exchange pointers later.”
Facing the active overtures of several gods, Yang Fan also felt the pressure.

However, remembering Sima Tianci’s earlier reminder, he still politely cupped his hands, “Thank you all, Seniors, for your kind regard, but this Junior has important matters today, so I will take my leave first.”
Seeing Yang Fan speak this way, the few did not force him.
This was a Peerless Prodigy, whose status in Taichu City was higher than even theirs.
After leaving the Heaven-Pressing Realm, Yang Fan did not return to his small courtyard but headed straight for Yuexiang Pavilion.
He knew clearly in his heart that the Sima Family also intended to recruit him.
But Yang Fan did not resent this; Sima Bang was his friend after all, and Yang Fan held no ill will toward Sima Tianci.
Joining the Sima Family was not out of the question!
Today, Yang Fan was no longer the person he once was.
The more he learned, the more he understood the rules of this world.
To develop his Divine Kingdom and rise rapidly, relying solely on the income from his Divine Kingdom was far from enough.
Resources, channels, connections, information...
These all required relying on major powers.
Thinking back to when he had rejected Senior Gu Yuan’s invitation on the Primordial Battlefield, Yang Fan now felt it was a bit of a pity.
Yang Fan had just arrived at the entrance of Yuexiang Pavilion.
A middle-aged man wearing a black and gold robe quickly hurried up to greet him; the aura emanating from him indicated he was a Low-tier God.
“Your Highness Yang Fan.” The middle-aged man bowed slightly and said respectfully, “Young Master Sima has been waiting for a long time.”
The other party’s attitude carried a hint of fawning, which made Yang Fan feel somewhat uncomfortable.
Yang Fan recognized him; this person was one of the Senior managers of Yuexiang Pavilion.
In the past, when Sima Bang brought them here to eat, the man would at most nod in acknowledgment; he would never have personally greeted them like this.
Under his guidance, Yang Fan headed toward the top floor of Yuexiang Pavilion.
Spirit wood carved beams, star crystal paved floors.
The private room on the top floor no longer resembled a restaurant, but rather a palace in the sky.
The massive floor-to-ceiling windows even allowed one to overlook half of Taichu City.
A row of attendants stood neatly on both sides of the corridor, both men and women, all of superior appearance and temperament.
Upon seeing Yang Fan, everyone bowed simultaneously, “Welcome, Your Highness Yang Fan.”

chapters.title: Chapter 180: Advice
paragraphs: The voices were uniform and incomparably respectful.
It was not until this moment that Yang Fan truly realized Sima Tianci’s status.
In the past, when Sima Bang invited the four of them to dinner, it was at most on the second floor.
Right now, they were actually enjoying a wave of elite service.
Pushing open the door and entering, Yang Fan’s first sight was Sima Tianci sitting by the window.
On the other side, Sima Bang was lying on a soft couch, surrounded by four beautiful waitresses.
One was feeding him meat, another was feeding him wine, and the other two were massaging his shoulders and pounding his legs.
That appearance looked like he had returned victoriously and wanted to thoroughly reward himself.
The moment Sima Bang saw Yang Fan, he abruptly pushed away the surrounding attendants and sprang straight up.
“Brother Yang!!!”
That voice was so excited it was as if he were seeing a long-lost relative.
Sima Bang ran wildly all the way, rushed in front of Yang Fan, and grabbed hold of his thigh in a hug.
“Brother! Starting today, you are my own blood brother!”
“I’ve heard all about it, you are simply too fierce.”
“Later on I passed out directly and didn’t get to see Brother display such Divine Might! What a massive loss!”
“If I had known, I would have clenched my teeth and lasted a bit longer!”
Sima Bang was full of grief on his face, an expression as if he had missed some major life event.
His chubby face rubbed around unceasingly, looking just like an oversized pendant.
During the exam, Sima Bang had still embraced him from behind.
Now he pounced straight from the front, scaring Yang Fan so much that his expression changed.
His whole body abruptly retreated a few steps, but with his left leg tightly entangled, he could only hop backward on one foot while pulling up his pants.
“Calm down! Brother Sima, you being like this makes me a bit scared!” Yang Fan was speechless all over his face.
Seeing this scene, Sima Tianci by the window couldn’t help but support his forehead.
“Fatty, your own brother is still sitting right here, and you’re already prepared to switch thighs so quickly?”
“They’re both my own brothers! They’re both thighs!”
Sima Tianci waved his hand lightly. “You guys go out first.”
“Yes.”
The various attendants inside the private room immediately bowed and saluted, quietly withdrawing.
Soon, only three people were left in the room.
“Brother, come sit over here!”

Sima Bang’s movements were what one would call nimble; he hurriedly ran to the edge of the table, pulled the chair back, carefully adjusted the angle, and even reached out to wipe the armrests where no dust existed at all.
Only then did he look at Yang Fan with a flattering smile: “This spot has the best scenery, it’s comfortable to sit here!”
That appearance was just like a professional lackey.
In the past, the Qingshan District F4 had always been led by Sima Bang, but now this fatty had completely become Yang Fan’s little follower.
One had to say that the affairs of the world were unpredictable, full of twists and turns.
After Yang Fan sat down,
Sima Tianci only then picked up his wine glass and slowly spoke, “You are of a similar age to my younger brother. If you don’t mind, you can also call me brother.”
Hearing these words, Yang Fan’s heart instantly stirred.

The person before him was the younger generation most valued by the Sima Family, a Peerless Prodigy-level figure who in the future would even be qualified to take charge of the entire Sima Family. Such a level of connections was actively being handed over; Yang Fan naturally wouldn’t be foolish enough to refuse.
“Greetings, Brother Tianci.” Yang Fan immediately said.
“Mn.” Sima Tianci nodded.
“I just received news that you have been officially evaluated by the highest Intelligent Life as a Peerless Prodigy. The process can be completed today.”
“After you go back, various Families and large companies will contact you through the Virtual World.”
“I must ask Brother Tianci for guidance.” Yang Fan’s attitude was modest.
Sima Tianci casually said, “It’s very simple, choose one among the Five Great Giants. As for other companies, no matter what conditions they offer, do not agree.”
Yang Fan nodded, “I understand.”
“You haven’t joined any faction up until now, why?” Sima Tianci asked curiously.
Yang Fan was slightly embarrassed: “In the past... I didn’t want my future to be restricted.”
Hearing this, Sima Tianci immediately laughed, “Normal, geniuses coming from many small places will have this kind of thought. They feel that after joining a faction, they lose freedom.”
“But in reality, where in this world is there truly a completely free person.”
Speaking up to here, he put down his wine glass and said earnestly: “The various Families investing in you essentially value your future. Of course they do it for returns.”
“This return might be resources, it might be influence, or even taking a side in some future event.”
“However, as long as you are strong enough, when you truly walk to high places and look back, you will find that those so-called restrictions actually amount to nothing at all.”
Yang Fan silently nodded; he now understood how naive his previous thoughts had been.
Without resources and without a background, so-called freedom was nothing more than self-comfort for the weak.
True freedom is forever built upon strength. If he had accepted Senior Gu Yuan’s investment back then, the development speed of his Divine Kingdom would definitely be able to rise to another level.

Sima Tianci continued: “I’ll give you a piece of advice: as long as the contracts of the Five Great Families do not restrict you from establishing your own company, Family, or faction in the future, then choose whoever offers the highest price.”

In Sima Tianci’s view, this was the most simple common sense, but considering that Yang Fan came from a small place like Tiannan City, his vision and cognition were limited after all, which was why he patiently spoke a bit more.
“Thank you for the guidance, Brother Tianci.” Yang Fan said earnestly.

Sima Tianci suddenly gave a light cough and said apologetically: “Next is personal friendship. Although you should choose the Five Great Families based on the intensity of their investment, personally I still hope you can join the Sima Family or the Gu Family.”
“After all, by pulling a Peerless Prodigy over to the Family, both me and Fatty can get quite a lot of rewards.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan did not feel any aversion.
Everyone was a smart person; putting interests out in the open to discuss was actually much more comfortable.
However, very soon, he had some doubts again: “Why is the Gu Family included?”
Sima Bang beside him immediately rushed to answer: “Because me and Brother Tianci’s mother’s surname is Gu!”
The fatty had an expression of course: “Half of the blood flowing in our bodies is from the Gu Family. Although our surname is Sima, we actually count as Gu Family descendants.”
“We’ve always taken a double share of the Family’s resource subsidies.”
Speaking up to here, Sima Bang even looked a bit proud.
“The resources from the main Family can be taken, and the resources from grandpa’s Family can also be taken, heh heh.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but feel a bit envious.
The Five Great Families intermarried and bred offspring among themselves, long ago having you in me and me in you.

No wonder that in this Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle, the surnames of the younger generation of the Five Great Families were so numerous. Even if the talent of some of them could not be considered top-notch, with such resources supplying them, how could the development of the Divine Kingdom possibly be poor?
After pondering for a moment, Yang Fan slowly nodded, “I will carefully consider it.”
He did not immediately agree. Now that he had been evaluated as a Peerless Prodigy, the investment amounts that the various Families would give next definitely wouldn’t be low.
This was very likely the largest batch of resources he could obtain during his student days.

Yang Fan indeed wanted to build a good relationship with Sima Tianci, but if the Sima Family or the Gu Family offered a price that was too low, he couldn’t possibly damage his own interests severely just for this bit of friendship.
After all, the development of the Divine Kingdom was the foundation of everything.

chapters.title: Chapter 181: Investments of the Five Great Giants
paragraphs: After finishing discussing official business, the atmosphere in the private room became much more relaxed, and before long, a large number of dishes were served by the waiters.
Spirit Beast meat, deep-sea spirit fish, and spirit fruits thousands of years old filled the entire room with dense Spiritual Qi.

While madly devouring his food, Sima Bang could not help complaining, “Our Family’s restaurant should change its chefs. Seriously, it is not as delicious as the things in Brother Yang’s Divine Kingdom.”
Hearing this, Sima Tianci rolled his eyes directly, “That is because you were starving crazy at the time. Also, can you stop risking your life for such a tiny bit of Divinity Points in the future?”
“What do you mean by such a tiny bit of Divinity Points? That is one hundred million!” Sima Bang said anxiously.
“Brother, it is not like you do not know how much my believers can eat. Such a huge amount of Divinity Points is only enough for half a year of food expenses.”
By the end of his words, Sima Bang even felt a little aggrieved.
Sima Tianci’s mouth twitched slightly as he listened, “Your believers are just like you, complete gluttons.”

He turned his head to look at Yang Fan, “Right, I cannot make decisions regarding the formal investment contracts that the Five Great Families will give you later, but I can help arrange the investments regarding the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle.”

“Regardless of whether you finally choose the Sima Family, you can still hold the identity of a Sima Family Guest Elder. The specific funding amount has already been sent to your email. I also helped you pick an S-Rank Building suitable for your current Divine Kingdom.”
“Thank you very much for your help, Brother Tianci.” Yang Fan immediately expressed his gratitude.
“It is nothing.” Sima Tianci waved his hand, “You are Fatty’s brother, so naturally, you are my brother too.”

Speaking of this, he suddenly smiled, “I am currently serving as a battalion commander in the Fifth Legion of The Frontline. When you graduate from the Primordial Academy in the future and need to serve at The Frontline, you can come directly to find me.”
After eating and drinking to his heart’s content, Yang Fan got up to take his leave and returned all the way to his residence.
After returning to his room, Yang Fan immediately put on the virtual helmet.
His consciousness connected to the Virtual World, and the next moment, a large number of message prompts popped up frantically.
The entire virtual interface was almost completely flooded by emails.
[You have a new email reminder]
[You have a new invitation]
[You have received an SS-Rank permission contract]
[You have received exclusive invitations from the Five Great Families]
Yang Fan swept his gaze across them.
At the very top was impressively the official email of the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle.
[Primordial Academy — Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle]
[Congratulations to student Yang Fan for winning first place in this Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle]
[The Sima Family is now issuing this unlimited investment reward]
[Divinity Points: 5 billion]
[Spirit Vein Planet: One]
[S-Rank Building: Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest]

At the end of the email, there was also a private note: “Brother Yang, this is the maximum quota your elder brother can strive for you at present. The defense forces of the Spirit Vein Planet have been withdrawn, and you need to arrange for believers to receive it as soon as possible. The stable monthly income is as high as 1 billion Divinity Points, and both defensive rights and ownership belong to you. Remember to buy defensive buildings early, so it won’t be snatched away by aliens.”
Seeing this, Yang Fan could not help but sigh with emotion.

No wonder Sima Bang once said that winning first place in the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle was enough to save a thousand years of detours in the development of a Divine Kingdom. That statement was truly no brag.
The investment quota was truly exaggerated. Not to mention the 5 billion Divinity Points, the most valuable part was still the Spirit Vein Planet.

This kind of resource planet existed in the same dimension as the Divine Kingdom, but it was more like a “neutral resource area.” The entire planet was covered with Spiritual Veins, and it could not be destroyed or transferred, continuously producing a large amount of Spirit Stones every year.
Precisely because of this, Spirit Vein Planets had always been the core target contested by all races.
Under the restriction of Divine Kingdom rules, the spatial coordinates of these neutral resources were not fixed and would keep changing.
Once lost, it was almost impossible to recapture it.
Therefore, every Spirit Vein Planet was incomparably precious, and its coordinates on the market often reached up to one hundred billion Divinity Points.
Just an unlimited investment contract already exceeded all the wealth Yang Fan currently possessed.
After calming his emotions, Yang Fan continued to scroll down to read the emails.
Invitations from a large number of companies caught his eye: [Yuandan Co., Ltd.], [Star Ring Heavy Industry Group], [Wanxiang Spirit Plant Technology], [Apocalypse Mechanical Consortium]...
These companies were all prominent large enterprises in the Federation, but Yang Fan just glanced at them casually and skipped them directly.

Yang Fan knew very well in his heart that over 80% of the resources in this world were controlled by the Five Great Giants, and even those so-called large enterprises had stakes held by the Five Great Families behind them.
Now that he was rated as a Peerless Prodigy, the Five Great Families would never give up the investment opportunity. Compared to these enterprises, the real big fish were still yet to come.

[Lu Corporation: Contract Obligations: Join the Lu Family, and in the future, represent the Lu Family to participate in the Federal Commercial Council and sign a long-term resource agreement. After reaching the fourth-tier god level, any A-Rank or higher buildings obtained at The Frontline must be preferentially sold to Lu Corporation. Contract Rights: A monthly subsidy of 5 billion Divinity Points, a gift of 49% shares in a listed company, and a large amount of stable dividends obtainable every year in the future...]

[Sima Family: Contract Obligations: Join the Sima Family faction, and in the future when serving at The Frontline, enter the Sima-affiliated legions with priority. Contract Rights: A monthly subsidy of 2 billion Divinity Points, guidance from High-Order Gods, Resource Stars X5, S-Rank Buildings X10...]

[Han Family Military Government: Contract Obligations: Must enter The Frontline military department to serve for a thousand years after graduation, becoming a Core Disciple of the Han Family. Contract Rights: A monthly subsidy of 2 billion Divinity Points, Divine Kingdom S-Rank defensive buildings X10, development of Alien Divine Kingdom coordinates...]

[Gu Family Spirit Domain: Contract Obligations: Join the Gu Family faction and enter into a marriage alliance with a woman from the younger generation of the Gu Family. Contract Rights: A monthly subsidy of 2 billion Divinity Points, Spirit Vein Planets X10, Spirit Plant Stars X10, S-Rank resource-type buildings X10, open permissions to the Gu Family’s core resource channels...]

[Qin Technology Alliance: Contract Obligations: Become a member of the Qin Family, and any companies established in the future must belong to the Qin Family. Contract Rights: A monthly subsidy of 2 billion Divinity Points, provision of all development resources for the Mechanical Path, a full set of Smart Weapon systems, opening of permissions for some cutting-edge laboratories...]
Looking at the conditions given to him by the Five Great Families, even Yang Fan could not help but gasp a breath of cold air.
Is this the investment for a Peerless Prodigy? Any one of these resources could compare to a large listed company.
Compared to the other families, the Gu Family’s investment was the largest—so large that Yang Fan could not refuse it.
Yang Fan was silent for a long time, and finally decided to choose the Gu Family.
The reason was very simple; the Gu Family gave simply too much. As for the marriage alliance, Yang Fan actually did not care much about it.
In today’s era, this was already a normal thing.

He had potential, and the Gu Family had resources; essentially, it belonged to a combination of interests. With this extra layer of relationship, the Gu Family would truly cultivate him as one of their own.
Back then in Yang County when he was with Luo Rou, he was more like a matrilocal son-in-law.
But now both sides were cooperating on an equal footing; he needed the Gu Family’s resources, and the Gu Family valued his future.
Inside the Virtual World, Yang Fan raised his hand and signed his name at the end of the Gu Family’s contract.
At the same time, deep within Taichu City, inside an antique room, Senior Gu Yuan slowly opened his eyes.
In front of him, a virtual light screen was lingering on the list of geniuses newly invested by the Gu Family.
And at the very bottom were impressively written two words—Yang Fan.

Senior Gu Yuan suddenly smiled and said, “I didn’t expect this kid to have such potential. When he refused me back then, could it be that he was holding out for a better offer? He is indeed an interesting little fellow.”

No wonder Sima Bang once said that winning first place in the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle was enough to save a thousand years of detours in the development of a Divine Kingdom.
That statement was truly no brag.
The investment quota was truly exaggerated.
Not to mention the 5 billion Divinity Points, the most valuable part was still the Spirit Vein Planet.

This kind of resource planet existed in the same dimension as the Divine Kingdom, but it was more like a “neutral resource area.” The entire planet was covered with Spiritual Veins, and it could not be destroyed or transferred, continuously producing a large amount of Spirit Stones every year.
Precisely because of this, Spirit Vein Planets had always been the core target contested by all races.
Under the restriction of Divine Kingdom rules, the spatial coordinates of these neutral resources were not fixed and would keep changing.
Once lost, it was almost impossible to recapture it.
Therefore, every Spirit Vein Planet was incomparably precious, and its coordinates on the market often reached up to one hundred billion Divinity Points.
Just an unlimited investment contract already exceeded all the wealth Yang Fan currently possessed.
After calming his emotions, Yang Fan continued to scroll down to read the emails.
Invitations from a large number of companies caught his eye: [Yuandan Co., Ltd.], [Star Ring Heavy Industry Group], [Wanxiang Spirit Plant Technology], [Apocalypse Mechanical Consortium]...
These companies were all prominent large enterprises in the Federation, but Yang Fan just glanced at them casually and skipped them directly.

Yang Fan knew very well in his heart that over 80% of the resources in this world were controlled by the Five Great Giants, and even those so-called large enterprises had stakes held by the Five Great Families behind them.
Now that he was rated as a Peerless Prodigy, the Five Great Families would never give up the investment opportunity.
Compared to these enterprises, the real big fish were still yet to come.
[Lu Corporation: Contract Obligations: Join the Lu Family, and in the future, represent the Lu Family to participate in the Federal Commercial Council and sign a long-term resource agreement.
After reaching the fourth-tier god level, any A-Rank or higher buildings obtained at The Frontline must be preferentially sold to Lu Corporation.
Contract Rights: A monthly subsidy of 5 billion Divinity Points, a gift of 49% shares in a listed company, and a large amount of stable dividends obtainable every year in the future...]
[Sima Family: Contract Obligations: Join the Sima Family faction, and in the future when serving at The Frontline, enter the Sima-affiliated legions with priority.
Contract Rights: A monthly subsidy of 2 billion Divinity Points, guidance from High-Order Gods, Resource Stars X5, S-Rank Buildings X10...]
[Han Family Military Government: Contract Obligations: Must enter The Frontline military department to serve for a thousand years after graduation, becoming a Core Disciple of the Han Family.
Contract Rights: A monthly subsidy of 2 billion Divinity Points, Divine Kingdom S-Rank defensive buildings X10, development of Alien Divine Kingdom coordinates...]
[Gu Family Spirit Domain: Contract Obligations: Join the Gu Family faction and enter into a marriage alliance with a woman from the younger generation of the Gu Family.

Contract Rights: A monthly subsidy of 2 billion Divinity Points, Spirit Vein Planets X10, Spirit Plant Stars X10, S-Rank resource-type buildings X10, open permissions to the Gu Family’s core resource channels...]
[Qin Technology Alliance: Contract Obligations: Become a member of the Qin Family, and any companies established in the future must belong to the Qin Family.

Contract Rights: A monthly subsidy of 2 billion Divinity Points, provision of all development resources for the Mechanical Path, a full set of Smart Weapon systems, opening of permissions for some cutting-edge laboratories...]
Looking at the conditions given to him by the Five Great Families, even Yang Fan could not help but gasp a breath of cold air.
Is this the investment for a Peerless Prodigy?
Any one of these resources could compare to a large listed company.
Compared to the other families, the Gu Family’s investment was the largest—so large that Yang Fan could not refuse it.
Yang Fan was silent for a long time, and finally decided to choose the Gu Family.
The reason was very simple; the Gu Family gave simply too much.
As for the marriage alliance, Yang Fan actually did not care much about it.
In today’s era, this was already a normal thing.
He had potential, and the Gu Family had resources; essentially, it belonged to a combination of interests.
With this extra layer of relationship, the Gu Family would truly cultivate him as one of their own.
Back then in Yang County when he was with Luo Rou, he was more like a matrilocal son-in-law.
But now both sides were cooperating on an equal footing; he needed the Gu Family’s resources, and the Gu Family valued his future.
Inside the Virtual World, Yang Fan raised his hand and signed his name at the end of the Gu Family’s contract.
At the same time, deep within Taichu City, inside an antique room, Senior Gu Yuan slowly opened his eyes.
In front of him, a virtual light screen was lingering on the list of geniuses newly invested by the Gu Family.
And at the very bottom were impressively written two words—Yang Fan.
Senior Gu Yuan suddenly smiled and said, “I didn’t expect this kid to have such potential.
When he refused me back then, could it be that he was holding out for a better offer?
He is indeed an interesting little fellow.”

chapters.title: Chapter 182: Choice Is More Important Than Hard Work
paragraphs: Following the formal signing of the contract, the next moment, a massive amount of information flooded into Yang Fan’s mind.
[Divinity Points received: 2 billion; Resource permissions have been opened; coordinates for Spirit Vein Planet and Spirit Plant Star have been entered; S-Rank Building has been issued...]
Even though Yang Fan was mentally prepared, his breathing still couldn’t help but grow a bit hurried at this moment.
Yang Fan immediately materialized and loaded the card containing the S-Rank Building, and a familiar name came into view — Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest (S-Rank).
“It turns out to be the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest as well?” Yang Fan was slightly stunned.
The Sima Family gave this, and the Gu Family actually gave this as well.
Soon, another email popped up.
The sender was the Gu Family Spirit Domain.

[According to estimations, your divine kingdom talent is very likely to be the SS-Rank “Hundredfold Time Sequence”, so the Gu Family Resource Department specially selected a resource-type building most suitable for the current development of your divine kingdom for you. The Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest can stably produce 1 million Divinity Points worth of “Earth Heart Milk” every thirty years in the divine kingdom. This resource can greatly improve the divine kingdom’s environment and increase the overall growth rate of believers in the Cultivation system. We hope you will make good use of it.]
Seeing this, Yang Fan’s eyes flickered slightly.
If converted according to the Hundred-fold Evolution speed, the monthly income of a single Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest would be as high as 100 million Divinity Points!
“As expected of an S-rank resource building, its value truly far exceeds A-rank spirit veins.” Yang Fan couldn’t help but sigh with emotion.

Seeming to have thought of something, Yang Fan was somewhat amused and exasperated: “It seems these people have misunderstood again. Last time they thought I had the Tenfold Time Sequence, and this time it has directly become a hundredfold.”
Yang Fan was quite happy to see this happen.
After all, although an SS-rank talent was precious, it was still within the acceptable range of various major forces, belonging to future powerhouses worth devoting all Resources to nurture.
But if an SSS-rank talent were exposed, the situation might not be the same.
No one knew whether those big figures standing at the top of the Human Race would breed other thoughts.
A man is innocent, but the possession of a treasure is a crime!
Now that he had already exposed part of his potential, he must utilize these Resources to grow stronger at the fastest speed.
Only strength was something that truly belonged to himself.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan immediately searched for the detailed information of the “Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest” via his wristwatch.
[Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest (S-Rank), Price: 100 million Divinity Points (Out of stock in the Divine Shop)]

A top-tier resource building nurtured by the stellar core Origin and ley line Spiritual Qi, it can greatly improve the stability of the divine kingdom, enhance the activity of Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi, improve the environment, and continuously produce the precious resource “Earth Heart Milk”.
Earth Heart Milk possesses effects such as strengthening the Physical Body, nourishing the Divine Soul, and increasing the purity of Spiritual Roots.
For believers of the Cultivation system, Earth Heart Milk is an even more extremely precious Cultivation resource.
After Cultivators below the Nascent Soul Realm consume it, they can significantly increase their Cultivation speed and reduce the failure probability of breaking through Bottlenecks.
Evaluation: A top-tier resource building with a scarce quantity, currently rarely circulated on the market, and a strategic resource controlled by super clans!]
Yang Fan did not delay, and his consciousness instantly entered the divine kingdom.
The next moment, he directly loaded all eleven newly acquired S-Rank Building Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests into the core area of the divine kingdom.
‘Boom’
Accompanying the landing of the buildings, the entire divine kingdom violently shook.
The Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi, which was already dense to the extreme, underwent changes once again at this moment.

A massive amount of Spiritual Qi began to frantically converge towards the core area, multicolored light flowed across the sky, ley lines roared, and the entire heaven and earth seemed to be undergoing a certain transformation.
Especially on Penglai Island, which was originally the place with the densest Spiritual Qi in the entire divine kingdom, now with eleven Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests operating simultaneously,
the Spiritual Qi in the air vaguely began to liquefy, light white spiritual fog permeated the world, and even spiritual liquid slowly dripped down the rocks, resembling a celestial Holy Land.
And those who felt this the most obvious were the believers of the Foundation Establishment Realm.

They were already able to perceive Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi, and now noticing the skyrocketing Spiritual Qi in the divine kingdom, each and every one of them instantly became excited to the extreme.
“Spiritual Qi liquefaction!”
“This is a miracle!”
“The great deity has bestowed grace once again!”
A large number of Cultivators rushed out of their Immortal Caves, gazing at the miraculous phenomenon in the sky, and knelt on the ground one after another with extremely fanatical eyes.
“Praise my god!”
“May the divine kingdom prosper forever!”
The grand sound of prayer spread throughout the entire Penglai Island.
At the same time, Yang Da appeared in front of Yang Fan at the very first moment.

“Congratulations to Master for winning first place in the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle and successfully obtaining the investment of the Gu Family Spirit Domain.” Yang Da bowed in salute, his voice carrying hard-to-conceal excitement.
However, facing the suddenly skyrocketing wealth, Yang Fan did not get as excited as ordinary Intelligent Life.
He just took a deep breath and quickly regained his calmness.
Yang Fan directly opened his mouth to ask: “How are the arrangements and preparations for the Spirit Vein Planet and Spirit Plant Star?”
“Reporting to Master, the moment you signed the contract, I had already begun deployment.” Yang Da immediately replied.

“Currently, a total of twenty-one garrison teams have been established, and each team is equipped with: one thousand Foundation Establishment Realm believers, one hundred thousand Qi Refining Stage believers, one hundred thousand Martial Apprentice Realm believers, and ten million Tier 5 Beings.”

“In addition, for each resource planet, I have additionally purchased ten thousand f3500 fighter jets for airspace patrols and firepower support, and equipped them with the A-Rank Building — Eye of God.”
“Furthermore, each resource star has purchased a C-Rank City of Technology for believers to garrison and live long-term.”

“Aside from defensive forces, whether it is the Spirit Vein Planet or Spirit Plant Star, a large amount of labor will be needed for resource extraction in the future. To avoid affecting the believers’ Cultivation, I have decided to purchase Otherworldly Collectors to be responsible for all basic labor. Each resource star is expected to be invested with 100 million Otherworldly Collectors.”

As an extension of Yang Fan’s will, when he signed the contract, Yang Da began making arrangements. Although only a few minutes had passed in the outside world, the divine kingdom had developed for a long time, and he had long since arranged everything properly.
Hearing this, a trace of satisfaction flashed through Yang Fan’s eyes.

It had to be said that although Intelligent Life sometimes made quite outrageous judgments regarding the direction of the divine kingdom’s development, its efficiency in basic work was frighteningly strong.
“Are these defensive forces enough?” Yang Fan asked again.

These resource stars were extremely important. Under the influence of the divine kingdom’s rules, their spatial coordinates would constantly change. Once seized by alien races or other gods, it would be almost impossible to find them back.
And the monthly income of a single Spirit Vein Planet was as high as 1 billion Divinity Points. Even without the Hundred-fold Evolution blessing, this was an extremely terrifying fortune.
Yang Fan being able to come into contact with this level of Resources at the demigod stage was entirely because he had the Five Great Giants like the Gu Family Spirit Domain standing behind him.
If placed in a place like Yang County, let alone a demigod, even a Tier 3 God like Luo Hai probably wouldn’t have the qualification to touch such Resources.
This was the gap brought about by the platform.
Often, choice is more important than hard work. With different platforms and different starting points, the Resources and achievements one could ultimately obtain would naturally be worlds apart.

chapters.title: Chapter 183: Income Skyrockets
paragraphs: Hearing Yang Fan’s inquiry, Yang Da appeared very confident. “Master, rest assured. According to the rules of the Divine Kingdom, once you officially take over these Resource Stars, their coordinates can only be discovered by other Demigods.
“The believers can set up the Spirit Tortoise Life-Protecting Formation, combined with ten thousand f3500 fighter jets, which is enough to stall for a significant amount of time.
“Even if we encounter a full-scale attack from other Demigods, there will be plenty of time to assemble our forces for support.”

Upon hearing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but feel emotional. Weaklings truly had to thank the restrictions of the Divine Kingdom’s rules; otherwise, these Resource Stars would have long been completely monopolized by High-Order Gods.
Forget about Demigods like him, even Low-tier Gods probably wouldn’t be qualified to possess them.
Without hesitation, Yang Fan looked at Yang Da immediately. “Arrange for the believers to take over all the Resource Stars right away.”
“Yes, Master,” Yang Da respectfully accepted the command.

The Gu Family had already sent over the spatial coordinates of all the Resource Stars and completed the permission transfer in advance. Now, Yang Fan only needed to arrange for the believers to move in.
Soon, spatial teleportation formations lit up one after another within the Divine Kingdom.
A large number of believers began entering the coordinates of the Resource Stars in an orderly fashion according to their designated teams.
As the believers descended, Yang Fan also clearly saw everything on the Resource Stars through the shared vision of his believers.
First was the Spirit Vein Planet. The entire heaven and earth were almost completely covered by dense Spiritual Qi, with pale white spiritual mist floating in the air.
Just sensing it through his believers, Yang Fan could clearly perceive the astonishing concentration of Spiritual Qi, which was even more exaggerated than his current Divine Kingdom.
“Is this a Spirit Vein Planet...” Yang Fan couldn’t help but feel a bit shocked.
The believers who had just arrived here were even more utterly thrilled.
“Spiritual Qi!”
“Such dense Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi!”
“My Realm is actually starting to loosen!”

Many Qi Refining Stage believers had the Spiritual Qi inside their bodies begin to circulate automatically as soon as they arrived. Some even sat down cross-legged on the spot, attempting to achieve a Breakthrough.
For believers of the Cultivation system, this kind of environment was simply comparable to a sacred paradise.
Meanwhile, the style of the Spirit Plant Star on the other side was completely different. The entire planet was covered by boundless medicinal fields, and a extremely dense aura of life rushed over.
A vast number of Spirit Plants swayed and glowed. Looking as far as the eye could see, they were densely packed with no end in sight.
Among them, Rank-D and Rank-E Spirit Plants were the most numerous, but that terrifying scale made even Yang Fan lose focus for a moment.
“This quantity... is way too exaggerated,” Yang Fan couldn’t help but exclaim.
By comparison, the Yellow-grade Secret Realm Spirit Plant area provided to him by the Sima Family back then was like a tiny herb garden, not even on the same order of magnitude.
As for the information regarding the Spirit Plant Star, Yang Fan naturally knew about it.
Even if one simply sold the most basic herbs, the monthly income would not be lower than one hundred million Divinity Points.
However, almost no God who truly owned a Spirit Plant Star would choose to sell herbs directly, because the value was far too low.
Under normal circumstances, they would train a large number of Alchemists to refine them into Medicinal Pills before selling them.
Even for the lowest-grade Medicinal Pills, the profit could easily increase tenfold.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but feel some anticipation.

Currently, the number of Alchemists in his Divine Kingdom had already surpassed one million. Combined with the large number of Alchemy Towers purchased previously, the Alchemy system had gradually matured.
Yet even so, the current consumption rate of herbs was probably less than one percent of the total output of these ten Spirit Plant Stars.
But Yang Fan was in no hurry. He understood the development speed of his Divine Kingdom very clearly; what he lacked right now was simply time.

When the number of believers surged further in the future and the scale of Alchemists expanded, the value of these Spirit Plant Stars would likely be even more exaggerated than that of the Spirit Vein Planets.

Yang Fan said seriously, “Yang Da, double the resource investment in the Primordial Academy to train more Alchemists. The herb yield from the Spirit Plant Stars is too vast; we must utilize it as soon as possible.”

Hearing this, Yang Da immediately bowed and said, “As you command, Master. I will prioritize purchasing Alchemy courses for the academy while simultaneously raising the remuneration for Alchemists within the Divine Kingdom.”
Currently inside the Divine Kingdom, Yang San, Yang Four, and Yang Five were each leading believers in three-line battles.
The consumption of Medicinal Pills for frontline warfare required massive purchases from the Divine Shop, representing a colossal demand.
Previously, limited by herb Resources, the refining cost of many Medicinal Pills was too high, so Yang Fan didn’t want his believers wasting time.
But now, with ten Spirit Plant Stars providing a continuous output of herbs, failing to fully develop the Alchemy system under these circumstances would be a sheer waste of good Resources.
Yang Fan knew very well that as the Divine Kingdom continued to expand and the number of believers surged, the scale of future wars would only get larger and larger.
Medicinal Pills would always remain strategic Resources.
Not to mention that the value of refined Medicinal Pills was often several to dozens of times that of the raw Materials.
The truly valuable aspect of the Spirit Plant Star was never selling raw herbs, but lowering the cost of Medicinal Pills and completely integrating the upstream and downstream industry chains.
After arranging everything, Yang Fan took a deep breath, and the detailed information of the entire Divine Kingdom surfaced before his eyes.
“God Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: 19.5 million square kilometers
Talents: Omitted
Believers: Omitted
Classes: Omitted
Dependents: Omitted

Techniques: Everlasting Spring Technique (Major Achievement), Gengjin Rift-Blade Art (Major Achievement), Thick Earth Mountain-Suppressing Scripture (Major Achievement)... Spirit Tortoise Life-Protecting Formation (Rank-C, Major Achievement), Ten Kings of Hell Formation (Rank-C, Major Achievement)...
Divinity Points: 7.11 billion (Provides 9.86 Divinity Points daily in reality)

Buildings: Moon Well x100 million, Sun Spring x100 million, Fountain of Life x5,243, Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest x11 (Rank-S), divine weapon world-forging platform (Rank-S), Eye of God x22 (Rank-A), Spiritual Vein x70,000 (Rank-A), Alchemy Tower x1,000 (Rank-B), hundred herb spirit pivot academy x200 (Rank-B), prison-suppressing body-refining tower x500 (Rank-B), immortal nurturing tower x10,000 (Rank-B), Monkey Wine Spring x840,000 (Rank-B), Rank-B Defense Building City-Annihilating Cannon x4, Rank-B Defense Building f3500 fighter jet x220,000, nine profound ice tower x10,000, Rank-C City of Technology x23...

Wonders: Penglai Island x1,680 (Deployed), Spirit Peach Mountain x8,400 (Deployed), Dragon Marsh Water Mansion x16,800 (Deployed), Worlds Number One Martial Arts Arena x1,500 (Deployed), myriad manifestation battle stele x30

Assets: Spirit Vein Planet x11, Spirit Plant Star x10, Dragon Fish Fry (x168 million), f-class transformation pod x200,000, First-rate Smart Weapon x220,000, Mechanical Heart x10, Otherworldly Collector x4.1 billion, cloning nutrient pod x1 million, Large Mineral Vein x10, Ordinary Zombie (x10 billion)...”
The Sima Family’s 5 billion investment and the Gu Family’s 2 billion Divinity Points subsidy for this month had both arrived.
This was the first time that the liquid funds in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom were so abundant.

Originally, the monthly income of the Divine Kingdom had already surpassed 1 billion Divinity Points. Now, boosted by the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, eleven Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests produced Earth Heart Milk worth 1.1 billion Divinity Points for him each month.

Added to that were eleven Spirit Vein Planets, bringing a Spirit Stone income as high as 11 billion Divinity Points per month, as well as the fixed 2 billion resource subsidy from the Gu Family, plus the herb income brought by ten Spirit Plant Stars.
Currently, Yang Fan’s monthly financial influx was upwards of 15 billion Divinity Points—such a speed of wealth growth was truly horrifying.

Even if one simply sold the most basic herbs, the monthly income would not be lower than one hundred million Divinity Points.
However, almost no God who truly owned a Spirit Plant Star would choose to sell herbs directly, because the value was far too low.
Under normal circumstances, they would train a large number of Alchemists to refine them into Medicinal Pills before selling them.
Even for the lowest-grade Medicinal Pills, the profit could easily increase tenfold.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but feel some anticipation.
Currently, the number of Alchemists in his Divine Kingdom had already surpassed one million.
Combined with the large number of Alchemy Towers purchased previously, the Alchemy system had gradually matured.
Yet even so, the current consumption rate of herbs was probably less than one percent of the total output of these ten Spirit Plant Stars.
But Yang Fan was in no hurry.
He understood the development speed of his Divine Kingdom very clearly; what he lacked right now was simply time.

When the number of believers surged further in the future and the scale of Alchemists expanded, the value of these Spirit Plant Stars would likely be even more exaggerated than that of the Spirit Vein Planets.
Yang Fan said seriously, “Yang Da, double the resource investment in the Primordial Academy to train more Alchemists.
The herb yield from the Spirit Plant Stars is too vast; we must utilize it as soon as possible.”
Hearing this, Yang Da immediately bowed and said, “As you command, Master.
I will prioritize purchasing Alchemy courses for the academy while simultaneously raising the remuneration for Alchemists within the Divine Kingdom.”
Currently inside the Divine Kingdom, Yang San, Yang Four, and Yang Five were each leading believers in three-line battles.
The consumption of Medicinal Pills for frontline warfare required massive purchases from the Divine Shop, representing a colossal demand.
Previously, limited by herb Resources, the refining cost of many Medicinal Pills was too high, so Yang Fan didn’t want his believers wasting time.
But now, with ten Spirit Plant Stars providing a continuous output of herbs, failing to fully develop the Alchemy system under these circumstances would be a sheer waste of good Resources.
Yang Fan knew very well that as the Divine Kingdom continued to expand and the number of believers surged, the scale of future wars would only get larger and larger.
Medicinal Pills would always remain strategic Resources.
Not to mention that the value of refined Medicinal Pills was often several to dozens of times that of the raw Materials.
The truly valuable aspect of the Spirit Plant Star was never selling raw herbs, but lowering the cost of Medicinal Pills and completely integrating the upstream and downstream industry chains.
After arranging everything, Yang Fan took a deep breath, and the detailed information of the entire Divine Kingdom surfaced before his eyes.
“God Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: 19.5 million square kilometers
Talents: Omitted
Believers: Omitted
Classes: Omitted
Dependents: Omitted
Techniques: Everlasting Spring Technique (Major Achievement), Gengjin Rift-Blade Art (Major Achievement), Thick Earth Mountain-Suppressing Scripture (Major Achievement)...
Spirit Tortoise Life-Protecting Formation (Rank-C, Major Achievement), Ten Kings of Hell Formation (Rank-C, Major Achievement)...
Divinity Points: 7.11 billion (Provides 9.86 Divinity Points daily in reality)

Buildings: Moon Well x100 million, Sun Spring x100 million, Fountain of Life x5,243, Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest x11 (Rank-S), divine weapon world-forging platform (Rank-S), Eye of God x22 (Rank-A), Spiritual Vein x70,000 (Rank-A), Alchemy Tower x1,000 (Rank-B), hundred herb spirit pivot academy x200 (Rank-B), prison-suppressing body-refining tower x500 (Rank-B), immortal nurturing tower x10,000 (Rank-B), Monkey Wine Spring x840,000 (Rank-B), Rank-B Defense Building City-Annihilating Cannon x4, Rank-B Defense Building f3500 fighter jet x220,000, nine profound ice tower x10,000, Rank-C City of Technology x23...

Wonders: Penglai Island x1,680 (Deployed), Spirit Peach Mountain x8,400 (Deployed), Dragon Marsh Water Mansion x16,800 (Deployed), Worlds Number One Martial Arts Arena x1,500 (Deployed), myriad manifestation battle stele x30

Assets: Spirit Vein Planet x11, Spirit Plant Star x10, Dragon Fish Fry (x168 million), f-class transformation pod x200,000, First-rate Smart Weapon x220,000, Mechanical Heart x10, Otherworldly Collector x4.1 billion, cloning nutrient pod x1 million, Large Mineral Vein x10, Ordinary Zombie (x10 billion)...”
The Sima Family’s 5 billion investment and the Gu Family’s 2 billion Divinity Points subsidy for this month had both arrived.
This was the first time that the liquid funds in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom were so abundant.
Originally, the monthly income of the Divine Kingdom had already surpassed 1 billion Divinity Points.
Now, boosted by the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, eleven Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nests produced Earth Heart Milk worth 1.1 billion Divinity Points for him each month.

Added to that were eleven Spirit Vein Planets, bringing a Spirit Stone income as high as 11 billion Divinity Points per month, as well as the fixed 2 billion resource subsidy from the Gu Family, plus the herb income brought by ten Spirit Plant Stars.
Currently, Yang Fan’s monthly financial influx was upwards of 15 billion Divinity Points—such a speed of wealth growth was truly horrifying.

chapters.title: Chapter 184: federal supreme intelligent life
paragraphs: This was the benefit of having a top Family backing him. Without the Gu Family’s investment, even with the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, Yang Fan would have had to wait until after he made a Breakthrough to a true god before it would be possible to have such an income.
Most of the time, what determined a person’s growth speed was never just talent.

“Yang Da,” Yang Fan said, “for the next period of time, sixty percent of the Divine Kingdom’s income will be used to purchase f-class transformation pods. The goal is simple: the number of transformation pods must be almost equal to the total newborn population of the Divine Kingdom over thirty years.”
“In the future, the starting stage of my believers will no longer be Mortals, but Tier 5 Beings,” Yang Fan said in a calm tone.
“Yes, Master.”
“The second thing,” Yang Fan continued, “the pace of attacking Alien Divine Kingdoms must continue to accelerate. I need more Divine Kingdom Cores.”
With Yang Fan’s current Divine Kingdom foundation, every bit of area expanded would bring about a linear increase in overall strength.

With the support of the Gu Family’s Resources, combined with the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, Yang Fan even had a premonition that in at most one year, he would have the chance to step into the Rank of a First-Order God.
His consciousness returning to reality, Yang Fan took out his virtual helmet and put it on.
The moment he entered the Virtual World, a cold and Mechanical notification tone suddenly rang in his ear.
“Beep—Congratulations, Your Highness Yang Fan, your authority Rank has been upgraded. Your current identity rating is Peerless Prodigy. Reconstructing authority...”
The next moment, the virtual interface in front of Yang Fan actually began to change.
The originally familiar sections like the God Forum and Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle slowly faded away, and the entire interface became extremely simple.
Aside from the Divine Shop, only two core sections remained: ‘Taichu City’ and ‘Gu Family Spirit Domain’.
“The purchase authority for S-Rank Buildings in Taichu City has been unlocked.”
“Authority for certain federal military technologies has been unlocked.”
“Information protection Rank has been upgraded to the highest federal level.”

“Current determination: Your Highness Yang Fan is one of the highest-level cultivation targets of the Human Federation. According to the Federal Prodigy Protection Regulations, during your travels, you will be assigned two Tier 3 God guards. Guard duration: until you Break through to the god Realm. All expenses will be covered by the Federal Government.”
“Virtual World authority upgraded. Starting today, you will be served by the federal supreme intelligent life.”

“Upon detection, the security Rank of your hometown, Yang County, has been upgraded. The Federal Government has dispatched one fourth-order god and five Tier 3 Gods to hold offices in the local government. All expenses will be covered by the Gu Family Spirit Domain.”
“Upon query, your parents Yang Tiexin and Sun Rong are currently alive and are both Divine Beings. Dedicated personnel have been arranged to protect their Divine Kingdom and physical safety.”

“Your wives, Luo Rou and Luo Bing, are currently studying at Nanshan University and Tianshui University respectively. The application for transfer of academic registration has been approved. Starting today, both will enter the Star Dome Heavenly Favor Academy.
This academy is a top federal cultivation academy, open only to the children of high-ranking federal officials and Family members of Peerless Prodigies.
The two will receive higher-level educational Resources and security protection.”

“Upon query, you once signed a Subordinate God Contract with ordinary citizen Zhang Pang, which poses a risk of exposing your Divine Kingdom coordinates. Federal Government personnel have already gone to contact him, and there is no need to worry about his subsequent relocation and settlement.”
“The primary school, middle school, and high school you attended have all received federal education awards. The Luo Family of Yang County will receive government Resource subsidies.”
After hearing this series of notification tones end, Yang Fan was completely dazed.

After he became a Peerless Prodigy, the Federal Government actually made so many arrangements in an instant. It even covered his past social relationships, hometown security, and Family members’ education.
This kind of treatment was no longer as simple as being valued; it was actively clearing away any worries for him.
Just then, the data in front of Yang Fan suddenly began to gather, countless spots of light intertwining and reorganizing, until finally, a human-shaped silhouette slowly materialized.
The other party did not have a true Physical Body; its entire body was composed of high-speed flowing data streams.
“Who are you?” Yang Fan’s eyes narrowed slightly.
The figure composed of data bowed slightly. “I am a Clone of the federal supreme intelligent life. You may call me ‘One’.”
Its voice was calm and steady, without the slightest emotional fluctuation.

“Your value evaluation has been raised to the highest federal cultivation sequence. Every Peerless Prodigy has a chance to grow into a pillar of human civilization. Your existence determines the future of the Federation.”
“From today onward, in the Virtual World, I will be responsible for serving you.”
“The federal supreme intelligent life!” Yang Fan’s expression changed slightly.
Naturally, he was no stranger to this name.
Almost all networks, Virtual Worlds, legal reviews, and war data coordination of the entire Human Federation were related to it.
Even a large number of law-making, Resource regulation, and Divine Kingdom War rules among gods had to go through its review and execution.
In a sense, it was the defender of the order of the entire human civilization.
Yang Fan did not know exactly how it was born, but everyone knew that the power of the federal supreme intelligent life was incredibly immense.
It was even enough to stand on equal footing with the Five Great Giants, except that it had no emotions, no desires, and would not favor any Family.
It was like an absolutely rational civilization machine, driving the entire human civilization forward with the most rigorous rules and execution.
Yang Fan couldn’t help but swallow. He had never expected that after becoming a Peerless Prodigy, he would actually be personally served by the federal supreme intelligent life.
Yang Fan took a deep breath, forcing down the shock in his heart.
“One, why are these the only sections left in my Virtual World interface?” Yang Fan asked.
“The remaining sections no longer have any practical significance for your current stage. Do you need to unhide them?”
“No need.” Yang Fan shook his head. “Help me briefly introduce which changes after the authority upgrade will be most helpful to my current Divine Kingdom.”

One’s voice was still cold and calm. “The Divine Shop itself has not changed much; basic Resources are still purchased here. When you became a Human Race Prodigy, all authorities of the Divine Shop were already unlocked.”
“Now that your identity rating is Peerless Prodigy, the biggest change is that the purchase authority for S-Rank Buildings in Taichu City has been officially unlocked.”
As its voice fell, Yang Fan’s consciousness was instantly pulled into Taichu City.

One’s voice continued to ring in Yang Fan’s ear: “According to federal regulations, your current Primordial City Identity Key has been upgraded to permanent authority. Starting today, you will automatically become a permanent resident of Taichu City. In the future, even if you graduate from the Primordial Academy, you will still retain the qualification to freely enter and exit Taichu City.”
“And you will have an S-Rank Building purchase quota of 10 billion Divinity Points every year, which can accumulate indefinitely.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but feel shaken in his heart.

According to what One said, it meant that even if he graduated from the Primordial Academy in the future, he could still purchase strategic-level buildings from Taichu City, and the Taichu City trading area would remain open to him forever.
A look of joy couldn’t help but flash in Yang Fan’s eyes; he had long had this worry.
Even an A-rank Spiritual Vein is perpetually out of stock in the Divine Shop. Many top-tier Resources simply cannot be bought with money alone.
But now that he had become a Peerless Prodigy, this problem was actually resolved directly.

chapters.title: Chapter 185: Gu Family Resources
paragraphs: “What does a quota of 10 billion Divinity Points mean?” Yang Fan pressed.

“Buildings are generally divided into two categories. One category is mass-produced by high-tier Mechanical Divine Kingdoms; although these buildings are expensive, they are basically unlimited. For example, the S-Rank Building you once obtained on the Primordial Battlefield—the divine weapon world-forging platform—belongs to this category.”
“It contains rare Materials such as the Heaven and Earth Furnace Fire within, which is why its price is as high as 10 million Divinity Points.”

“The other category belongs to those naturally evolved by the divine kingdom or nurtured within natural Secret Realms, such as the C-Rank Buildings Moon Well and Sun Spring, the special building Fountain of Life, and the A-Rank Building Spiritual Vein; most belong to this category.”
“This includes most Wonder buildings as well. Although there are man-made Wonders, most of the truly top-tier Wonder buildings still originate from the natural Evolution of the divine kingdom.”

“The value gap between S-Rank Buildings is immense. The cheaper ones, like the divine weapon world-forging platform, only cost ten million Divinity Points. The expensive ones can reach hundreds of billions or even trillions.”

“These kinds of buildings are extremely precious and belong to the foundation of human civilization; Divinity Points are not enough to fully measure their value. If you want to obtain these buildings in large quantities, you usually can only go to The Frontline to exchange them with military merits.”
“Peerless Prodigies are the top geniuses of the federation. To better nurture them, the laws were amended to open up an additional special channel.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan understood as well.
“Help me open the S-Rank Building list,” Yang Fan said.

“The number of S-Rank Buildings is too vast. With your current brain capacity, it would be difficult to filter them efficiently. Shall I make recommendations, or synchronize the information to your Intelligent Life for auxiliary analysis?”
The corner of Yang Fan’s mouth twitched slightly. As expected of the federal supreme intelligent life, saying things like his brain capacity was insufficient was truly direct.
“Go ahead and recommend.”
The moment the words fell, three virtual projections materialized in front of Yang Fan.
[Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest]: Price: 100 million Divinity Points
[Great Void Warship]: Price: 5 billion Divinity Points
[ten thousand dao evolution sanctuary]: Price: 10 billion Divinity Points

Yi continued, “According to deductions, there is an extremely high probability that your divine kingdom talent is the SS-Rank Hundredfold Time Sequence. Therefore, the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest is highly suitable for your current stage.”
“It can enhance the stability of your divine kingdom while continuously producing Earth Heart Milk.”
“For a rapidly developing divine kingdom, this building can effectively reduce the risk of the divine kingdom collapsing and provide sufficient Spiritual Qi for support.”
Subsequently, the first projection slowly faded, replaced by a massive warship that was pitch-black all over, resembling a cosmic behemoth.

“The Great Void Warship is a Divine Kingdom War-type building. It can enter Alien Divine Kingdoms to do battle alongside your army of believers. Its interior can accommodate a massive legion of believers and possesses cross-regional warfare capabilities. At the same time, it is equipped with war modules such as space jump, defensive barriers, and Void Cannons. It is a divine kingdom weapon of war.”
Right after, the third projection lit up. It was a massive temple radiating a brilliant divine glow; just a single glance gave one a sense of resonance with the Great Dao.

“The ten thousand dao evolution sanctuary belongs to the comprehensive growth-type buildings. It can simultaneously adapt to the three major systems of Cultivation, Martial Arts, and Mechanical systems. It can significantly boost your believers’ Comprehension Ability, Cultivation efficiency, and the probability of professional Breakthroughs. For a divine kingdom, it is a core civilization building.”
After listening to the introduction, Yang Fan’s eyes flickered slightly.
As expected of the federal supreme intelligent life; even if its judgment of his divine kingdom talent was wrong, these buildings were still highly suitable for him.
Yang Fan pondered for a moment and did not immediately purchase an S-Rank Building.
An annual quota of 10 billion Divinity Points seemed massive, but when actually placed in front of S-Rank Buildings, it might not be enough.
For strategic Resources of this level, choices were very important.
“I’ll decide after discussing it with Yang Da later,” Yang Fan thought to himself.
Closing the S-Rank Building interface, his gaze fell upon the newly unlocked section—the Gu Family Spirit Domain.
As his consciousness touched it, the entire Virtual World suddenly shifted.
Yang Fan’s consciousness left Taichu City and arrived at the Gu Family Territory.

In the sky, a large number of warships shuttled past, while below lay floating continents where spiritual mountains, high-tech cities, war fortresses, Alchemy Tower clusters, and void ports intertwined.
Yi’s voice sounded at the same time, “The Gu Family Spirit Domain is a strategic permission channel directly under the Gu Family.”
“Current status: Core investment target of the Gu Family. Permission Rank: Peerless Prodigy class.”
In the next moment, a multitude of function panels floated before Yang Fan’s eyes.

[Gu Clan Resource Repository], [Frontline Legion], [War Missions], [Prodigy Protection Agreement], [High-Order God Lecture Hall], [Resource Planet Trading Zone], [Special Building Exchange], [Divine Kingdom Intelligence Network], [Gu Family Internal Shop], [Void Route]...
Just with a single glance, Yang Fan was inwardly shocked.
Is this the power of the Five Great Giants?
Unlike the Luo Family, this Gu Family Spirit Domain had practically opened up an entire world within the Virtual World, with so many categories that it was overwhelming.

“The Gu Clan Resource Repository is mainly responsible for internal resource allocation,” Yi’s voice sounded slowly. “This includes high-tier Spirit Plants, war Medicinal Pills, divine Ores, Mechanical cores, shipborne weapons, alien Materials, special Spirit Beasts, divine kingdom Wonders, and more.”
As the voice faded, a vast list of Resources appeared before Yang Fan.
“Void Dark Iron, Red Sun Thunder Wood, Boundary Sea Demon Crystals, Star Pith Liquid, war-type spirit puppet cores, shipborne psionic cannons...”
Many of these Resources were not even in stock in the Divine Shop, yet they could be supplied stably and long-term within the Gu Clan.

“The Gu Family controls many frontline channels of the Human Federation. Many Resources cannot be bought with Divinity Points, but instead require military merits, permissions, status, and contribution points. With your current permissions, you can already access some strategic-level Resources in advance,” Yi continued to explain.

Yang Fan nodded slowly. This was what a truly major power was like. Ordinary gods might not be able to buy these things even if they had money, but the Gu Family directly controlled the source of the Resources.
Subsequently, Yang Fan’s gaze fell upon the [Frontline Legion] section.

“There are seventy-two legions directly under the Gu Family. These include the Border Guard, Void Expeditionary Force, Alien Clearance Force, Resource Escort Force, Divine Kingdom Support Force, and others.”
“Upon graduating from the Primordial Academy, you must choose one to join!”
Before Yang Fan could even react, a new interface emerged.
[Prodigy Protection Agreement]

“Peerless Prodigies are strategic-level nurturing targets of the Human Race. The Gu Family will be responsible for your protection. This includes, but is not limited to, hiding your divine kingdom coordinates, shielding virtual information, emergency evacuation permissions on The Frontline, god-level guardianship, protection of your descendants after death...”
There was too much content within the Virtual World’s Gu Family Spirit Domain, so much that Yang Fan could not take it all in at once.
At this moment, Yang Fan’s breathing quickened slightly.
In the past, his horizon had always been limited to demigods, academies, and resource competition.
But now, the Gu Family Spirit Domain seemed to have directly pulled back a corner of the true world right before him.
The Five Great Families, the federation, The Frontline, alien races, High-Order Gods, and Divine Kingdom Wars.
He still had too much to learn!
