An annual quota of 10 billion Divinity Points seemed massive, but when actually placed in front of S-Rank Buildings, it might not be enough.
For strategic Resources of this level, choices were very important.
“I’ll decide after discussing it with Yang Da later,” Yang Fan thought to himself.
Closing the S-Rank Building interface, his gaze fell upon the newly unlocked section—the Gu Family Spirit Domain.
As his consciousness touched it, the entire Virtual World suddenly shifted.
Yang Fan’s consciousness left Taichu City and arrived at the Gu Family Territory.

In the sky, a large number of warships shuttled past, while below lay floating continents where spiritual mountains, high-tech cities, war fortresses, Alchemy Tower clusters, and void ports intertwined.
Yi’s voice sounded at the same time, “The Gu Family Spirit Domain is a strategic permission channel directly under the Gu Family.”
“Current status: Core investment target of the Gu Family.
Permission Rank: Peerless Prodigy class.”
In the next moment, a multitude of function panels floated before Yang Fan’s eyes.

[Gu Clan Resource Repository], [Frontline Legion], [War Missions], [Prodigy Protection Agreement], [High-Order God Lecture Hall], [Resource Planet Trading Zone], [Special Building Exchange], [Divine Kingdom Intelligence Network], [Gu Family Internal Shop], [Void Route]...
Just with a single glance, Yang Fan was inwardly shocked.
Is this the power of the Five Great Giants?
Unlike the Luo Family, this Gu Family Spirit Domain had practically opened up an entire world within the Virtual World, with so many categories that it was overwhelming.
“The Gu Clan Resource Repository is mainly responsible for internal resource allocation,” Yi’s voice sounded slowly.
“This includes high-tier Spirit Plants, war Medicinal Pills, divine Ores, Mechanical cores, shipborne weapons, alien Materials, special Spirit Beasts, divine kingdom Wonders, and more.”
As the voice faded, a vast list of Resources appeared before Yang Fan.
“Void Dark Iron, Red Sun Thunder Wood, Boundary Sea Demon Crystals, Star Pith Liquid, war-type spirit puppet cores, shipborne psionic cannons...”
Many of these Resources were not even in stock in the Divine Shop, yet they could be supplied stably and long-term within the Gu Clan.
“The Gu Family controls many frontline channels of the Human Federation.
Many Resources cannot be bought with Divinity Points, but instead require military merits, permissions, status, and contribution points.
With your current permissions, you can already access some strategic-level Resources in advance,” Yi continued to explain.
Yang Fan nodded slowly.
This was what a truly major power was like.
Ordinary gods might not be able to buy these things even if they had money, but the Gu Family directly controlled the source of the Resources.
Subsequently, Yang Fan’s gaze fell upon the [Frontline Legion] section.
“There are seventy-two legions directly under the Gu Family.
These include the Border Guard, Void Expeditionary Force, Alien Clearance Force, Resource Escort Force, Divine Kingdom Support Force, and others.”
“Upon graduating from the Primordial Academy, you must choose one to join!”
Before Yang Fan could even react, a new interface emerged.
[Prodigy Protection Agreement]
“Peerless Prodigies are strategic-level nurturing targets of the Human Race.
The Gu Family will be responsible for your protection.

This includes, but is not limited to, hiding your divine kingdom coordinates, shielding virtual information, emergency evacuation permissions on The Frontline, god-level guardianship, protection of your descendants after death...”
There was too much content within the Virtual World’s Gu Family Spirit Domain, so much that Yang Fan could not take it all in at once.
At this moment, Yang Fan’s breathing quickened slightly.
In the past, his horizon had always been limited to demigods, academies, and resource competition.
But now, the Gu Family Spirit Domain seemed to have directly pulled back a corner of the true world right before him.
The Five Great Families, the federation, The Frontline, alien races, High-Order Gods, and Divine Kingdom Wars.
He still had too much to learn!

chapters.title: Chapter 186: Young Lord
paragraphs: “The introduction to the newly added sections of the Virtual World is complete. If you have any questions or needs in the future, you can enter the Virtual World at any time to inquire.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan slightly bowed toward the federal supreme intelligent life, and then his consciousness returned to reality.
“Yang Da, what are your thoughts?” Yang Fan asked in his heart.

“Reporting to Master, I have received the detailed information of all currently purchasable S-Rank Building in Taichu City. I temporarily do not recommend purchasing them immediately; we can continue to accumulate our quota,” Yang Da responded.
“Reasons?”

“First, although the divine kingdom funds are currently abundant, most of the liquid funds have already been invested into the procurement plan of the f-class transformation pod, and it is difficult to withdraw a large amount of resources in a short time. Even if we purchase, we will need to wait at least until next month’s resource return.
Second, the current potential of the divine kingdom’s believers has not yet evolved to its limit. Whether it is Cultivation, Martial Arts, or the Mechanical Path, there is still huge room for growth.

Especially the environment of the divine kingdom. Under the blessing of eleven Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest and Spiritual Veins, the Spiritual Qi concentration far exceeds that of demigods of the same rank. S-Rank Building biased toward all-round enhancement like the ‘ten thousand dao evolution sanctuary’, if invested now, the returns will not be very high.

As for the ‘Great Void Warship’, if the Master still chooses ordinary-grade Alien Divine Kingdom coordinates to wage war, given the current strength of the enemy, this kind of strategic war structure somewhat feels like using a cannon to shoot a mosquito.”
Speaking of this, Yang Da paused for a moment.
“At the current stage, I still recommend focusing on improving the overall strength of the believers.
However, if the Master hopes to use S-Rank Building to accelerate the expansion speed of the divine kingdom, then I suggest giving priority to purchasing two Great Void Warships in the future.
This structure can directly participate in the Alien Divine Kingdom War, which can greatly improve the efficiency of obtaining the Divine Kingdom Core.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan was also thoughtful.

After a moment, he nodded slowly, “In that case, let’s develop according to the original plan first. But after next month’s resource output, reserve 5 billion Divinity Points to purchase one Great Void Warship.”
“Understood, Master.”
Nowadays, the biggest Bottleneck of Yang Fan’s divine kingdom was its area. As long as he continuously devoured the Divine Kingdom Core, his divine kingdom’s strength would continue to soar.
And for s-class war structures like the Great Void Warship, he naturally wanted to witness their power as well.
“What are your thoughts on the Gu Family Spirit Domain in the Virtual World?” Yang Fan continued to ask.
“I have screened a large number of resource prices.”
“The utilization value of resources in the Gu Clan’s resource library is extremely high, and some strategic materials are even more than half cheaper than the Federal Mall.

However, sections like resource stars and special structures are of little significance to the Master at present. With the current scale of the divine kingdom’s assets, it has not yet reached the access threshold for the relevant permissions,” Yang Da responded calmly.
Yang Fan nodded.
This was the terrifying aspect of Intelligent Life. With such a huge data stream, if he had to figure it out by himself, it might take a few months to fully understand it.
“In that case, the subsequent resource purchase and sales channels will all be managed by you,” Yang Fan directly ordered.
“Understood, Master.”
After arranging everything, Yang Fan did not rest, but opened “Overview of Divine Kingdom Wars” again and began today’s study.
A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step; knowledge needs to be accumulated bit by bit.
That night, Yang Fan never closed his eyes until early the next morning when a new email suddenly popped up.
The sender was the Gu Family Spirit Domain.

Yang Fan immediately clicked it open: “Respected Young Lord Yang Fan, the Gu Family has preliminarily screened a marriage match for you. Please head to the Gu Family Restaurant in Taichu City at 9:00 AM today. Someone will receive you then.”
The content of the email was very brief, but Yang Fan did not dare to neglect it in the slightest.
Now that he had accepted the Gu Family’s investment, and the other party was one of the Five Great Giants of the Human Race, he naturally could not be discourteous in such matters.
After a simple wash and brush-up, Yang Fan left the small courtyard.
Gu Family Restaurant was not far from Yuexiang Pavilion, but this was Yang Fan’s first time coming here.
In a place like Taichu City, almost all of the Five Great Giants owned their own industries.
The Sima Family had Yuexiang Pavilion, and the Gu Family naturally had their own restaurant.

Yang Fan looked up and saw an ancient building hundreds of zhang high standing quietly ahead. The entire building was dark golden in color, with countless runes flowing across the building body, and Spiritual Qi surrounded it like clouds and mist.
Above the flying eaves of the pavilion hung a huge plaque — Gu Family Restaurant.
Just as Yang Fan approached, at the entrance of the restaurant, a middle-aged man dressed in a black-gold robe immediately hurried up to welcome him.
The other party’s aura was unfathomable, impressively being a true god.
Although he was a god, at this moment the other party actively bent down, lowering his posture to the extreme.

“Greetings, Young Lord! I am Supervisor Gu Yuanshan, the supervisor of the Gu Family Restaurant. It is truly our honor that the Young Lord can grace the Gu Family Restaurant with your presence. In the future, whenever the Young Lord comes to the Gu Family Restaurant, everything will be at a 30% discount.” Supervisor Gu Yuanshan’s voice was full of respect, and even faintly carried a hint of flattery.
That appearance was as if he was not facing a demigod student, but rather future high-level members of the Family.
And the waiters around them lowered their heads one after another at this moment, not daring to make eye contact with Yang Fan.
Having experienced the scene at Yuexiang Pavilion yesterday, Yang Fan was much calmer about this.
In a place like Taichu City, potential was more important than current strength.
Especially him now, who had been rated as a Peerless Prodigy, belonging to the absolute top-tier existence looking across the student level of the entire Primordial Academy.
“Why did you just call me Young Lord?” Yang Fan was somewhat puzzled.
Upon hearing this, Supervisor Gu Yuanshan immediately respectfully explained: “Human Race Prodigies can be called Your Highness, while Peerless Prodigies are called Young Lords.”

“The so-called Young Lord means someone who has the qualifications to lord over a region in the future. The territory of the Human Federation is vast, and every Peerless Prodigy has the possibility of growing into a High-Order God who suppresses a region and deters all races in the future.

Internally, they can rule over hundreds of millions of believers in their divine kingdom. Externally, they can lead armies to fight and suppress alien races. Therefore, they are addressed with the character ‘Lord’.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan just smiled faintly.
The titles given to students by this Primordial Academy were one more resounding than the other.
He didn’t care too much about this. Whether it was Your Highness or Young Lord, they were just empty names.
The development of the divine kingdom and growing stronger in strength were the truly things that belonged to oneself.
Afterward, led by Supervisor Gu Yuanshan, Yang Fan came all the way to the top floor of the Gu Family Restaurant.
Compared to the luxury and bustle below, this place was excessively quiet.

The entire floor only had faint sandalwood fragrance drifting about, surrounding Spiritual Qi slowly flowed like clouds and mist, and even Formation lines could be faintly seen underfoot, making the surrounding sounds exceptionally quiet.
Obviously, this place was not just a private room of a restaurant, but also had the function of isolating prying eyes.
At the very front, a wooden door was slightly ajar.
Yang Fan looked up and saw a slender back quietly sitting by the window.
The woman was wearing a light cyan long dress, with a slender waist and black hair cascading down like a waterfall. Just a back view gave people an extremely stunning feeling.

chapters.title: Chapter 187: Pleasure Working With You
paragraphs: “Young Lord Yang Fan, this subordinate will take his leave for now so you and Young Miss can chat in peace. If you are not satisfied, our Gu Family can make other arrangements and schedule another meeting for a different day.” After bowing respectfully, Supervisor Gu Yuanshan slowly withdrew.
Hearing this, Yang Fan remained calm on the surface, but his heart couldn’t help but shudder slightly.
He could even swap? He could even pick and choose?
This was a proud daughter of heaven from the Gu Family, yet they were actually letting him pick as he pleased?
This treatment for a Peerless Prodigy was almost absurdly good.
A strange thought even popped into Yang Fan’s head: “Can I pick a few more to marry together?”
Of course, he only dared to think such thoughts in his mind.
As Supervisor Gu Yuanshan left, Yang Fan stepped into the room. Walking around the round table, he finally got a clear look at the person’s face.
The instant he saw her clearly, Yang Fan’s expression froze slightly.
It wasn’t because she was drop-dead gorgeous, but because he had seen her before.
“You are?” Yang Fan asked subconsciously.
The woman rolled her eyes at his words. “Genius Yang Da, my name is Gu Le. I thought you would remember me after my performance yesterday in the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle.”
“Sorry, I do remember,” Yang Fan said, feeling a bit embarrassed. “I just didn’t pay much attention to your name back then.”
Naturally, he had a deep impression of the scene yesterday where Gu Le stood at the back of the twenty-person squad, directing them.
Back then, Yang Fan didn’t feel much pressure from divinity pressure, spending most of his time looking around and delivering Monkey Wine to Sima Bang.
So he naturally had the spare energy to pay attention to her.
But Yang Fan never expected that the marriage partner arranged for him by the Gu Family would actually be Gu Le from the same batch.
“I don’t like beating around the bush,” Gu Le said directly, crossing her arms over her chest. “I watched your performance yesterday from start to finish.”

“I’ll be blunt: I think very highly of your future, and right now, you really are a hot commodity. After you signed the contract with the Gu Family, many eligible women in the Family were fighting for the chance to meet you first.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s expression couldn’t help but turn a bit strange.
He had only signed the contract last night, and they were already competing for blind date spots? The speed at which news circulated within these big families was truly exaggerated.
“Young Miss Gu Le, please feel free to speak your mind,” Yang Fan said slowly.
“Fine, then I’ll state my conditions first.” Gu Le didn’t waste words either.

“My father is the Third Elder of the Gu Family, in charge of Medicinal Pills and spirit material channels. You focus on the Cultivation Route, so your God Kingdom will definitely raise a large number of Alchemists in the future. At that time, whether it’s purchasing ingredients or selling Medicinal Pills, using my father’s channels can boost your profits by at least ten to twenty percent.”
“My mother comes from the Lu Corporation. She is currently a top-ten shareholder in ‘Xinghai Energy Group’ and ‘All-Spirit Bio-Pharmaceutical’.”

“As for myself, my God Kingdom talent is S-rank—Spirit Resonance. It focuses on resource cultivation and can drastically increase the growth speed of Spirit Plants, Spirit Beasts, and medicinal Resources.”
“In addition, I personally hold a 1% stake in two listed companies. Based on current market valuation, it’s worth roughly one hundred billion Divinity Points.”
“If you establish your own Family or start a company in the future, I can save you a lot of trouble.”
At this moment, Gu Le showed none of her loud, chaotic demeanor from the assessment grounds yesterday; instead, she resembled a shrewd and capable merchant.
And this so-called blind date was less about talking about feelings and more about discussing value.
The weak always like to talk about love and sacrifice because emotion is all they can offer. But those who truly stand at the top care more about Resources, benefits, the future, and compatibility.
It wasn’t that they lacked feelings, but when the value held by both sides was sufficiently massive, many relationships simply couldn’t be maintained solely by a phrase like “I like you.”
Yang Fan wasn’t surprised by this at all; he merely nodded slowly. “It seems I have no reason to refuse.”
This time, it was Gu Le’s turn to be stunned. “You’re agreeing just like that?”
“The Gu Family has already given me the investment I deserve. To me, it doesn’t matter who I marry,” Yang Fan said calmly.
To him, marrying a proud daughter of heaven from the Gu Family didn’t really make much of a difference.
Marriage contracts between big families were inherently a binding of interests and the future.

In that case, rather than continuing to waste time going on blind dates one by one, it was better to choose Gu Le directly. At least judging from her performance in yesterday’s Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle, this woman was not only capable but also smart enough.

Just as Gu Le said, when he became a deity in the future, establishing a company and developing a Family in the Real World would be inevitable. A truly capable helpmate was far more valuable than a mere trophy wife.
Hearing this, Gu Le was visibly taken aback for a moment.
Then, she suddenly burst into laughter. Her already exquisite face gained a touch of free-spirited charm at this moment.
She stood up and extended her right hand to Yang Fan. “Then I wish us a happy marriage... no, a pleasure working together.”
Yang Fan also stood up and shook her hand gently. “Before that, I must clarify in advance. Before coming to Taichu City, I already had two wives.”
Gu Le’s expression was calm, as if she wasn’t surprised by this at all. “I know. Given your talent, that’s nothing.”
The moment Yang Fan signed the contract with the Gu Family, information about him had already been placed on the desks of the Gu Family’s higher-ups.
A Peerless Prodigy suspected of possessing the SS-rank Hundredfold Time Sequence, a future pillar of the Human Race.
For such a existence, forget having two wives—even if it were a bit more extreme, it wouldn’t mean anything in the eyes of the Five Great Giants.
Besides, Yang Fan’s two wives merely came from small-town families.

Whereas she, Gu Le, far surpassed them in status, background, and future potential. There was no suspense whatsoever about who would be the main wife, or who would control the Resources and speak with authority in the future.
Gu Le waved her hand, causing a light screen to emerge, followed by a pre-prepared marriage contract slowly unfurling.
Yang Fan read through it carefully. Most of it contained official contractual content, such as being of one mind, helping each other, and developing together.
As for core interests like God Kingdom assets, resource ownership, and future profits, there was no forced binding whatsoever.
Clearly, what the Gu Family truly valued was not these superficial interests, but his personal future.
After confirming there were no issues, Yang Fan didn’t hesitate and signed his name directly on the marriage contract.
As his name was inscribed, the marriage contract glowed with a faint golden light.
The smile on Gu Le’s face deepened a bit. “Now that we’re married, my parents want to meet you. The location is in the Virtual World—Gu Family Territory. When will you have time?”
“Anytime.”
Gu Le didn’t drag her feet either, signaling directly with a raised hand.
Soon, a waiter respectfully brought over two virtual helmets.
Consciousness connecting, the world before his eyes changed abruptly.
The next moment, Yang Fan appeared at the Gu Family Territory along the coordinates.
Gu Le led Yang Fan along a familiar route, eventually arriving before an elegantly styled, ancient courtyard.

Hearing this, Gu Le was visibly taken aback for a moment.
Then, she suddenly burst into laughter.
Her already exquisite face gained a touch of free-spirited charm at this moment.
She stood up and extended her right hand to Yang Fan.
“Then I wish us a happy marriage... no, a pleasure working together.”
Yang Fan also stood up and shook her hand gently.
“Before that, I must clarify in advance.
Before coming to Taichu City, I already had two wives.”
Gu Le’s expression was calm, as if she wasn’t surprised by this at all.
“I know.
Given your talent, that’s nothing.”
The moment Yang Fan signed the contract with the Gu Family, information about him had already been placed on the desks of the Gu Family’s higher-ups.
A Peerless Prodigy suspected of possessing the SS-rank Hundredfold Time Sequence, a future pillar of the Human Race.
For such a existence, forget having two wives—even if it were a bit more extreme, it wouldn’t mean anything in the eyes of the Five Great Giants.
Besides, Yang Fan’s two wives merely came from small-town families.
Whereas she, Gu Le, far surpassed them in status, background, and future potential.
There was no suspense whatsoever about who would be the main wife, or who would control the Resources and speak with authority in the future.
Gu Le waved her hand, causing a light screen to emerge, followed by a pre-prepared marriage contract slowly unfurling.
Yang Fan read through it carefully.
Most of it contained official contractual content, such as being of one mind, helping each other, and developing together.
As for core interests like God Kingdom assets, resource ownership, and future profits, there was no forced binding whatsoever.
Clearly, what the Gu Family truly valued was not these superficial interests, but his personal future.
After confirming there were no issues, Yang Fan didn’t hesitate and signed his name directly on the marriage contract.
As his name was inscribed, the marriage contract glowed with a faint golden light.
The smile on Gu Le’s face deepened a bit.
“Now that we’re married, my parents want to meet you.
The location is in the Virtual World—Gu Family Territory.
When will you have time?”
“Anytime.”
Gu Le didn’t drag her feet either, signaling directly with a raised hand.
Soon, a waiter respectfully brought over two virtual helmets.
Consciousness connecting, the world before his eyes changed abruptly.
The next moment, Yang Fan appeared at the Gu Family Territory along the coordinates.
Gu Le led Yang Fan along a familiar route, eventually arriving before an elegantly styled, ancient courtyard.

chapters.title: Chapter 188: Good Son-in-law
paragraphs: Sitting in the courtyard were a man and a woman.
The man wore a black and gold robe, with an elegant visage and deep eyes; just sitting there, he exuded an awe-inspiring presence without anger.
The woman wore a light cyan long dress, her temperament gentle and noble, and every gesture exuded the poise of someone who had occupied a high position for a long time.
“Father, Mother.” Gu Le spoke.
The man slowly raised his head. “You’re here?”
Gu Le nodded gently and introduced, “Yang Fan, this is my father, Gu Xuanting, and my mother, Lu Qinglan.”
Yang Fan’s heart trembled slightly; even though the other party did not deliberately release divine coercion, he could still feel a terrifying pressure originating from the level of life itself.
It felt as though he was not facing ordinary gods, but rather two great suns hanging high in the sky.
Yang Fan secretly guessed in his heart that these two people were at least Mid-tier Gods above the fifth tier, if not even stronger.
Aside from Senior Gu Yuan whom he had met back in the Primordial Battlefield, this was probably the strongest person he had ever encountered.
Yang Fan did not dare to neglect them and immediately bowed respectfully, “Greetings, two Seniors.”
Hearing this, Gu Xuanting and Lu Qinglan exchanged a glance and smiled at the same time.
“Since you and Le’er are already married, there’s no need to be so formal.” Gu Xuanting’s voice was gentle.
Yang Fan reacted extremely quickly and immediately changed his address, “Greetings, Father-in-law and Mother-in-law.”
“Good.” The smile on Gu Xuanting’s face grew noticeably richer.
Meanwhile, Lu Qinglan on the side looked Yang Fan up and down, her eyes filled with satisfaction.
In the time that followed, Yang Fan and Gu Le’s parents simply chatted casually.
They did not discuss any secrets, nor did they mention resource cooperation.
More often, it felt like ordinary elders meeting a Junior, asking about Yang Fan’s past life in Yang County and whether he had adapted after coming to Taichu City.

Lu Qinglan would occasionally mention some of Gu Le’s embarrassing childhood stories, making the entire atmosphere much more relaxed than Yang Fan had imagined, allowing his originally tense mind to gradually relax.

After a moment, Lu Qinglan put down her teacup and smiled softly, “Alright, your father-in-law and I still have matters to handle. You two youngsters should go to the Real World and chat more to deepen your relationship.”
“As a family in the future, there will be plenty of time to spend together.” Gu Xuanting also nodded.

“You don’t need to be so restrained when we meet in the future. Your mother-in-law and I were already gods when we married, so we only have Le’er as our daughter. Now that you are married to Le’er, you are also our son from now on.”
When he said this, his expression was serious and not just out of politeness.
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s heart trembled slightly once again.
“Yes.” He immediately responded respectfully, feeling somewhat flattered.
As their consciousness withdrew, the two of them returned to the Real World.
Inside the virtual space, Gu Xuanting looked in the direction where the two had left, his eyes still carrying a hint of satisfaction.
“Xuanting, what do you think of this child?” Lu Qinglan asked softly.

“His Mental Energy is extremely strong, and his eyes possess divine light. His divine kingdom’s foundation is extremely solid,” Gu Xuanting slowly began. “Without the blessing of the Hundredfold Time Sequence talent, the development speed of his divine kingdom could never reach this level.”

Hearing this, Lu Qinglan likewise nodded. “During yesterday’s Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle, I watched it from beginning to end. Our son-in-law simultaneously practices Cultivation, Martial Arts, and Mechanical paths, and none of his developments are weak. The future resource investment probably won’t be a small number.”

“Hahaha!” Gu Xuanting laughed aloud. “Time-type divine kingdom talents are inherently best suited for multi-line development. As for resources? The Gu Family lacks nothing least of all resources. Coupled with your Lu family’s channel support, this child’s future achievements will definitely not be below ours.”
As he spoke, his eyes even faintly revealed a trace of anticipation.
“We’ve found a good son-in-law.” Lu Qinglan sighed softly.
“I only hope that Le’er can help each other with him in the future. That way, her future path of the divine kingdom can also go a bit smoother.”
Real World.
Gu Le stretched lazily and looked at Yang Fan with a smile. “There are still quite a few fun places in Taichu City. Do you want to look around together?”
“No need.” Yang Fan shook his head. “I have an appointment with someone else today.”
Hearing this, Gu Le did not show any disappointment.
After exchanging contact information, Yang Fan directly left the Gu Family Restaurant.
Watching Yang Fan’s receding figure, Gu Le stood in place in silence for a moment.
Then, driven by an inexplicable impulse, she walked over to a nearby mirror and carefully examined her appearance, which she had specially dressed up for today.
Slightly wavy long hair, a body-hugging red dress, and an exquisite visage.
No matter how she looked at it, she couldn’t find any flaws.

“Is this guy a monk? This Young Miss is so pretty, yet he doesn’t have any crooked thoughts at all? We are legal now, you know...” Gu Le couldn’t help muttering softly, a rare hint of self-doubt even surfacing in her eyes.
A moment later, she suddenly let out a soft hum. “Forget it, there’s still plenty of time in the future. Sooner or later I’ll win you over, my ascetic-style husband!”
In fact, Yang Fan rejecting Gu Le really wasn’t him putting on airs of reticence; he genuinely had matters to attend to.
Sima Bang had gathered people for a gathering again today. Messages had been sent over one after another since morning, afraid that Yang Fan wouldn’t go.
If it were in the past, between a beauty and bros, Yang Fan would most likely have chosen the former without hesitation.
But ever since he was “enlightened” by Yang Da, nowadays his entire mind was devoted to the development of his divine kingdom.
As for the low-level dopamine stimulation of the Physical Body, his interest was no longer as great as it used to be.
As for attending Sima Bang’s gathering, it wasn’t entirely for brotherhood either; rather, he genuinely had questions in his heart that he wanted to consult them about.
After the matters concluded, he still had to go back and continue studying.
Yuexiang Pavilion.
Yang Fan familiarly arrived at the old spot on the second floor.
This time, it was still a small gathering of the Qingshan District F4.
And Yang Fan was the last one to arrive.
As the private room door was pushed open, Sima Bang and the other two, who had been sitting, stood up simultaneously.
“Brother Yang, you’re finally here! I didn’t even dare to touch my chopsticks; I was about to starve to death!” Sima Bang wailed as he swiftly pulled open the chair for the main seat.
That appearance was practically more professional than a restaurant waiter.
“Brother Yang, thank you for the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle.” Ye Jianfeng wore a serious expression and bowed solemnly toward Yang Fan.

He was well aware that throughout the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle, he had never stood in the very front ranks. Being able to receive a sponsorship of ten million Divinity Points was entirely because Yang Fan carried him through.
That was ten million Divinity Points! For him at present, it was enough to change the recent developmental trajectory of his entire divine kingdom.
Such a kindness naturally deserved to be engraved in his heart.
“Brother Yang, congratulations.” Wen Yushui had clearly dressed up carefully today.
A light blue long dress outlined her slender figure, and her hair had also been specially tidied up.
Yet at this moment, she lowered her head, her peripheral vision constantly stealing glances at Yang Fan, as if wanting to find something on his face.
Back in the past Qingshan District F4, everyone still called Yang Fan “Brother Yang”.
However, after this Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle, the term of address had shifted from “Brother” to “Big Brother”.

This wasn’t due to a distancing of relationships; rather, as status and position changed, people would subconsciously adjust their forms of address and distance between one another—such is human nature.

chapters.title: Chapter 189: soul nourishing wood!
paragraphs: Yang Fan did not take this to heart and directly sat down.
Sima Bang stood up very bootlickingly, actively pouring wine for Yang Fan, “Brother Yang, I’ll toast you first!”
“You chose to join the Gu Family. No matter the reason, I must thank you.” Sima Bang grinned, his fat Face filled with joy.

“Because you joined the Gu Family, my mom was overjoyed and directly gave me a super large red envelope. For the next few years, I won’t have to worry about development resources for my Divine Kingdom!”
Hearing this, both Ye Jianfeng and Wen Yushui were slightly stunned.
After all, Yang Fan had only officially signed the contract with the Gu Family last night, and not many people in the entire Taichu City knew about it yet.
After a brief shock, the gazes the two of them cast toward Yang Fan grew increasingly complex.
Envy, amazement, and a trace of an indescribable sense of distance.
That was the Gu Family, one of the Five Great Giants of the Human Race.
Yang Fan’s future height was no longer something they could hope to reach.
Being able to rely on this tiny bit of friendship from Qingshan District to continue sitting at the same table to drink alcohol was already considered an Opportunity for them.
“Congratulations, Brother Yang!” The two raised their glasses simultaneously.
Yang Fan also smiled and clinked glasses with everyone.
Sima Bang downed a mouthful of wine, his gossipy soul instantly burning, “Right, Brother Yang! I heard that the Gu Family also arranged a marriage alliance? Has she been chosen yet?”
“Gu Le,” Yang Fan said calmly.

“Holy crap!” Sima Bang’s eyes instantly widened, “It’s actually Cousin Gu Le? Brother Yang, you are in for a blessing! She is a well-known little rich girl among the freshman class! I heard she even holds shares in quite a few listed companies!”
As Sima Bang spoke, he also exaggeratedly gave a thumbs up.
However, Wen Yushui, who was sitting beside them, silently put down her wine glass.
She lowered her head and did not speak, but deep within her eyes, a trace of unspeakable resentment faintly lingered.
The atmosphere at the dining table remained lively.
Sima Bang kept bragging, Ye Jianfeng occasionally chimed in with a couple of words, and Yang Fan would also join the conversation.
Only Wen Yushui sat quietly most of the time, forcing a faint smile on her Face and rarely actively cutting into the conversation.

After three rounds of drinks, Yang Fan suddenly asked, “Do you guys know of any Spirit Plant suitable for large-scale Planting in a Divine Kingdom? Preferably one that doesn’t require the Spirit Plant Farmer profession and still has high yields.”
Hearing this, all three of them revealed contemplative expressions.
Sima Bang scratched his head: “Spirit Plants of B-grade and above will have significantly increased yields. But basically, they all require careful cultivation by a Spirit Plant Farmer.”
“Things in this world are essentially about supply and demand. The rarer they are, the higher the value, and naturally the greater the profit, but matching your requirements, Brother Yang...”
As he spoke, he even furrowed his brows, obviously unable to think of an answer for the moment.

On the other hand, after pondering for a moment, Ye Jianfeng slowly spoke: “I actually do know of one. Although it is only a C-grade Spirit Plant, the long-term cultivation yields are very high, and quite a few Divine Beings plant it.”
“What is it?” Yang Fan instantly grew interested.

“soul nourishing wood,” Ye Jianfeng replied: “This item is extremely easy to survive and has low environmental requirements. It is both an Alchemy material, and the aura it emits can keep surrounding creatures clear-headed and slightly enhance Comprehension Ability. Moreover, the older the age, the higher the value.”
Hearing this name, Yang Fan’s gaze shifted slightly.
He naturally knew about soul nourishing wood, and had even specially cultivated it in the Early Stage of his Divine Kingdom.
It was just that later, as the Divine Kingdom continuously developed and there were higher-yielding investments, he phased it out and sold it.
Having experienced too many things, Yang Fan had actually forgotten about this item.

Ye Jianfeng continued to remind him: “However, Brother Yang, soul nourishing wood is actually not particularly suitable for your Divine Kingdom. Your Talent will extract the Spiritual Qi of the Divine Kingdom to accelerate believers to Cultivate. Even with the tenacious vitality of soul nourishing wood, large-scale wither and death might still occur.”

“Moreover, the longer this thing is cultivated, the more valuable it is. A seedling is only worth 500 Faith Points, but if it can be cultivated for ten thousand years, the value can even reach over 1 million Faith Points.”
“But the problem is...” Ye Jianfeng paused, “Ten thousand years in the Divine Kingdom is close to twenty-seven years in the Real World. It takes too long.”

“Besides this, there is also the biggest problem: the aura emitted by soul nourishing wood will overflow from the Divine Kingdom. The larger the Planting scale, the denser the aura, and the higher the probability of other demigods detecting the coordinates of the Divine Kingdom.”
“Many deities dare not Cultivate it on a large scale at all, and precisely because of this, clearly it is only a C-grade Spirit Plant, yet its profits are outrageously high.”
Outside Yuexiang Pavilion, the night wind was slightly cool.
Yang Fan finished the last mouthful of spirit wine in his cup and slowly stood up.
“Many thanks.” He nodded toward Ye Jianfeng.
Regarding the question of Spirit Plants, he had already obtained the answer he wanted.

soul nourishing wood—others dared not plant it on a large scale because they feared the exposure of their Divine Kingdom coordinates, and even more so could not afford that growth cycle which was so long it was almost despair-inducing.
But he was different. Under the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, ten thousand years of time were merely one hundred days in the Real World.
To other demigods, it was tasteless chicken ribs, but to him, it might not necessarily fail to become a new channel of wealth.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan did not stay any longer, turned around, and left Yuexiang Pavilion.
Inside the private room.
As the room door closed, the originally lively atmosphere gradually quieted down.
Wen Yushui lowered her head and managed to squeeze out a faint smile, “I’m not feeling very well, I’ll head home first, you guys take your time eating.”
Watching Wen Yushui’s back, Sima Bang let out a light sigh, “Little Wen’s thoughts... are a bit too much!”
Hearing this, Ye Jianfeng directly let out a cold sneer, “Her heart is higher than the heavens, yet her life is thinner than paper. What is Brother Yang’s status now?”

“A Peerless Prodigy, the son-in-law of the Gu Family, the future pillar of the Human Race. If she really had the guts to strip naked and proactively deliver herself to his door, I would instead look at her a bit higher.”
“And the result? Brother Yang hasn’t even expressed anything yet, but she herself started throwing a little tantrum first. Ridiculous.”
Ye Jianfeng’s tone was completely unsparing.
After the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle, he had long since thoroughly seen through Wen Yushui.
Sima Bang also gently shook his head; what people feared most was not being able to see themselves clearly.
“Brother Sima, in the future, call this Wen Yushui out for gatherings less often, and let the relationship fade a bit.” Ye Jianfeng’s expression was serious.

“This woman not only fails to see herself clearly, but she’s also a bit stupid. Back then in that situation on the platform, everyone was almost collapsing from being suppressed by the divine might pressure, yet she stubbornly held on without retreating. On the surface it looked like she was persisting for the team, but in reality, she was just reluctant to let go of Face and rewards.”
“If it weren’t for the fact that everyone made a huge profit in the end, I would have wanted to scold her back then.”
Ye Jianfeng had always been straightforward and direct; he wouldn’t give Face just because the other party was a beauty.

Sima Bang nodded, “Rest assured, I know what I’m doing. Calling her over this time was originally also because of Brother Yang. During the assessment, Brother Yang took such good care of her, I thought he had some feelings for her. But looking at it now, I guess I thought too much.”

Hearing this, Ye Jianfeng couldn’t help but sigh, “During the first gathering, Brother Yang probably really did have some. Back then, his gaze always drifted toward Wen Yushui’s direction. But recently... the changes are just too big.”

The larger the Planting scale, the denser the aura, and the higher the probability of other demigods detecting the coordinates of the Divine Kingdom.”
“Many deities dare not Cultivate it on a large scale at all, and precisely because of this, clearly it is only a C-grade Spirit Plant, yet its profits are outrageously high.”
Outside Yuexiang Pavilion, the night wind was slightly cool.
Yang Fan finished the last mouthful of spirit wine in his cup and slowly stood up.
“Many thanks.” He nodded toward Ye Jianfeng.
Regarding the question of Spirit Plants, he had already obtained the answer he wanted.

soul nourishing wood—others dared not plant it on a large scale because they feared the exposure of their Divine Kingdom coordinates, and even more so could not afford that growth cycle which was so long it was almost despair-inducing.
But he was different.
Under the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, ten thousand years of time were merely one hundred days in the Real World.
To other demigods, it was tasteless chicken ribs, but to him, it might not necessarily fail to become a new channel of wealth.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan did not stay any longer, turned around, and left Yuexiang Pavilion.
Inside the private room.
As the room door closed, the originally lively atmosphere gradually quieted down.
Wen Yushui lowered her head and managed to squeeze out a faint smile, “I’m not feeling very well, I’ll head home first, you guys take your time eating.”
Watching Wen Yushui’s back, Sima Bang let out a light sigh, “Little Wen’s thoughts... are a bit too much!”
Hearing this, Ye Jianfeng directly let out a cold sneer, “Her heart is higher than the heavens, yet her life is thinner than paper.
What is Brother Yang’s status now?”
“A Peerless Prodigy, the son-in-law of the Gu Family, the future pillar of the Human Race.
If she really had the guts to strip naked and proactively deliver herself to his door, I would instead look at her a bit higher.”
“And the result?
Brother Yang hasn’t even expressed anything yet, but she herself started throwing a little tantrum first.
Ridiculous.”
Ye Jianfeng’s tone was completely unsparing.
After the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle, he had long since thoroughly seen through Wen Yushui.
Sima Bang also gently shook his head; what people feared most was not being able to see themselves clearly.
“Brother Sima, in the future, call this Wen Yushui out for gatherings less often, and let the relationship fade a bit.” Ye Jianfeng’s expression was serious.
“This woman not only fails to see herself clearly, but she’s also a bit stupid.
Back then in that situation on the platform, everyone was almost collapsing from being suppressed by the divine might pressure, yet she stubbornly held on without retreating.
On the surface it looked like she was persisting for the team, but in reality, she was just reluctant to let go of Face and rewards.”
“If it weren’t for the fact that everyone made a huge profit in the end, I would have wanted to scold her back then.”
Ye Jianfeng had always been straightforward and direct; he wouldn’t give Face just because the other party was a beauty.
Sima Bang nodded, “Rest assured, I know what I’m doing.
Calling her over this time was originally also because of Brother Yang.
During the assessment, Brother Yang took such good care of her, I thought he had some feelings for her.
But looking at it now, I guess I thought too much.”
Hearing this, Ye Jianfeng couldn’t help but sigh, “During the first gathering, Brother Yang probably really did have some.
Back then, his gaze always drifted toward Wen Yushui’s direction.
But recently... the changes are just too big.”

chapters.title: Chapter 190: Mass Cultivation, Upgrading Defense
paragraphs: “As for Brother Yang now, ordinary women can no longer catch his eye.” Sima Bang leaned back in his chair and let out a long sigh, “In the future, the Qingshan District F4 will probably become F2.”
Yang Fan was already a Peerless Prodigy. The circles, Resources, and figures he would contact in the future were already on a completely different level from theirs.
Yet Wen Yushui happened to be a clueless pig teammate.
Of the four people who once had the best relationship, two were already gone in the blink of an eye.
One could only say that the distance between people sometimes widened even faster than the distance between divine kingdoms.
On the other side, Yang Fan returned to his small courtyard. As soon as he reached the entrance, he stopped in his tracks.
Two figures were standing outside the courtyard.
He recognized one of them; it was his Dao protector—Tang Yue.
As for the other person, he was a tall and slender middle-aged man.
The other party merely stood there quietly, yet his body faintly emanated a heavy wave of divinity.
That aura was not the least bit weaker than Tang Yue’s.

Seeing Yang Fan return, Tang Yue hurriedly stepped forward and respectfully saluted, “Congratulations, Young Lord, on being rated as a Peerless Prodigy. His name is Ye Wen. Like me, he is also a Tier 3 God. Starting today, the two of us will be jointly responsible for the Young Lord’s travel safety.”
Ye Wen’s expression was solemn as he also saluted, “Greetings, Young Lord Yang Fan.”
Facing such an attitude from two Tier 3 Gods, Yang Fan felt a slight emotional stirring in his heart.
Strength, status, potential—sometimes, as long as one of them reached the extreme, the entire world would take the initiative to bow its head to you.
“You two Seniors are too polite,” Yang Fan returned the salute and said.

Tang Yue continued, “The Young Lord’s status is different now, and the Primordial Academy has rearranged your accommodation. The new residence is located in the core area of Taichu City, which is where Peerless Prodigies live.”
Yang Fan nodded. He had no luggage to begin with. For gods, a so-called residence was merely a temporary resting place.
Afterwards, the three of them headed directly toward the central area of Taichu City.
Along the way, the surrounding buildings became increasingly quiet. The originally bustling trading area disappeared, replaced by large areas of Spirit Plant gardens and independent courtyards.
Every inch of land in Taichu City was worth an inch of gold; even an ordinary pigeon hole room had an absurdly high price.
Yet in this most core location, there was actually a row of villa areas.
There were no towering buildings here, nor were there overwhelming Formation Wonders; all there was was quietness.
The reason Primordial Academy made such an arrangement was not because anyone truly cared about the living environment, but to distinguish identities.
It was telling all students that only by working hard to Cultivate and raising their evaluations could they obtain better treatment.
The three of them arrived in front of a silver-white villa.
The entire villa covered an extremely large area, with the front yard planted full of Spirit Plants and even a garden in the back.

Compared to Yang Fan’s previous small courtyard, this was simply like stepping out of an ordinary residential area and into a rich district in one step, with the living area being at least four to five times larger.
“Young Lord, this is your key.” Tang Yue handed over a silver authority token. “If you have any needs, you can contact the two of us at any time.”
After speaking, without disturbing him further, the two turned and left.
After entering the villa, Yang Fan didn’t even carefully study the new environment, just casually picking a room with good lighting.
Then he took out a book, sat down quietly, and continued studying.
As the number of first-class Intelligent Life forms inside his divine kingdom increased, Yang Fan’s Mental Energy also grew increasingly powerful.
Nowadays, he was truly able to achieve multiple tasks at once.
While flipping through books in the Real World, deep within his consciousness, he was still constantly discussing the feasibility and risks of mass cultivating soul nourishing wood with Yang Da.
“Master, with the blessing of Evolution Talent, Spirit Plants like soul nourishing wood are indeed very suitable for large-scale Planting.”
“In about one hundred days in the Real World, ten-thousand-year soul nourishing wood can be harvested.”
“In addition, the aura it emits is also of no small help to the Cultivation of the divine kingdom’s believers,” Yang Da analyzed earnestly.
Yang Fan nodded slightly, “What about the risks?”
Cultivating soul nourishing wood was simple, and like ordinary trees, it could be planted at high density.
Given the current area of the divine kingdom, if it were truly cultivated on a large scale, its returns would definitely reach an extremely exaggerated degree.
Yet the higher the exorbitant profit, the greater the danger it implied.
The point of increasing the risk of exposing the divine kingdom’s coordinates always caused Yang Fan to have some misgivings in his heart.

“Reporting to Master, the aura of soul nourishing wood will indeed increase the probability of exposing the divine kingdom’s coordinates, but within the current divine kingdom, there already exist a large number of Penglai Islands.”

“Under the mixture of the two auras, the anomaly of the soul nourishing wood will not be too obvious. Moreover, according to the restrictions of the divine kingdom’s rules, those capable of detecting the Master’s divine kingdom coordinates can only be other demigods. Those true High-Order Gods cannot directly peer into the Master’s divine kingdom location because of the soul nourishing wood’s aura.”

“With the current overall strength of the divine kingdom, I believe there is completely no need for excessive worry.” Speaking up to this point, a hint of coldness even carried into Yang Da’s voice, “If there really is a blind demigod who actively invades... wouldn’t that even save the money for purchasing divine kingdom coordinates?”
Hearing this, a flash of determination also crossed Yang Fan’s eyes. “In that case, immediately help me calculate how many plants of soul nourishing wood the current divine kingdom can Cultivate.”
“Calculating is in progress...”

A moment later, Yang Da’s voice sounded again, “Calculation complete. Calculated based on the currently usable divine kingdom area, considering that the risk of the outer regions being invaded and destroyed is relatively high, it is not recommended to plant in the fringe areas.”

“Combining factors such as Spiritual Qi concentration, soil bearing capacity, and believer maintenance efficiency, it is recommended to simultaneously Cultivate five trillion soul nourishing wood seedlings.”
“Five trillion...” Yang Fan’s eyes narrowed slightly.
A ten-thousand-year soul nourishing wood was worth one million Faith Points.
One hundred trees were one Divinity Point.
Ten thousand trees were one hundred Divinity Points.
And after all five trillion of them matured... their total value would reach as high as fifty billion Divinity Points!
In a mere three-plus months, he could obtain a return of fifty billion Divinity Points.
This income was already close to the total output value of twenty Spirit Vein Planets.
Such terrifying profits—if it were an ordinary demigod, they would probably have long since lost their sanity with excitement.
Yet Yang Fan was not carried away; he always firmly believed in one principle: the greater the profit, the higher the risk.
If soul nourishing wood were truly a guaranteed-profit business with zero risk, the entire market would have long been saturated, and the price could not possibly be maintained to its current extent.
Right now inside the Divine Shop, the yield rate of soul nourishing wood was obviously abnormally high.
Behind this, there must be a reason that a large number of gods dared not touch it.

Thinking of this, Yang Fan slowly spoke, “Yang Da, let’s set the Cultivation scale of the soul nourishing wood to five trillion plants. However, before that, the divine kingdom’s overall defense power must also be upgraded by another round.”
“Please give your instructions, Master.”
Yang Fan’s eyes were calm as he slowly ordered, “Buy me the A-grade defense building—Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall.”

“I want it to surround the entire outer region of the divine kingdom. In addition, deploy City-Annihilating Cannons all over the city walls. The defense line does not need to retreat to the core region anymore. I want to deploy heavy troops starting right from the outer perimeter.”

“Issue a Divine Decree to deploy Cultivation and Martial Arts believers to the outer perimeter for long-term garrisoning. Additionally, transfer a portion of the Elf Race to cooperate with the border defense line.”
“Yes, Master.”

chapters.title: Chapter 191: Absorbing the Core, News from Parents
paragraphs: Following Yang Fan’s command, Yang Da completed the purchase immediately.
The next moment, the A-grade defensive building—the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall officially loaded into the Divine Kingdom.
Rumble!!!
Around the outer perimeter of the entire Divine Kingdom, the earth began to vibrate wildly, and a pitch-black, ink-like giant city wall slowly rose from underground.
The city wall was a thousand zhang high, covered with dense ancient runes intertwined with technological patterns, exuding a heavy and cold aura.
Looking into the distance, the city wall extended all the way into the distance, as if there was no end in sight, completely surrounding the entire Divine Kingdom.
Just standing there gave people a sense of being indestructible.

Yang Fan was also observing this A-grade defensive building. Unlike the C-grade City of Technology full of technological sense, this Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall was more like a defense fortress truly existing for war.
Its walls were extremely thick, and even just looking at it with the naked eye, one could feel a sense of solidity far surpassing that of the City of Technology.
If the City of Technology leaned more towards functional buildings, then this Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall was a war defense weapon in the true sense.

Subsequently, a large number of City-Annihilating Cannons appeared on the top of the city wall, and dense gun muzzles slowly rose, with pitch-black barrels aiming at the outer perimeter of the Divine Kingdom.
For a time, at the entire border of the Divine Kingdom, the Killing Intent soared into the sky.
As the command was issued, the entire Divine Kingdom began to operate, with a large amount of resources mobilized and population migration.
At this moment, Yang Fan’s thoughts were completely different from most gods.
Under normal circumstances, in a Divine Kingdom War, gods would choose to deploy their main force in the core area.
Because by utilizing local advantages, they could continuously consume the invaders’ living forces, and fighting the decisive battle in the core area yielded the highest win rate.
But Yang Fan was different; under the blessing of the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, every inch of land in his Divine Kingdom meant huge benefits.
The middle area could also grow precious Spirit Plants and place high-value buildings.
If they followed the traditional mindset and abandoned everything outside the core area as a buffer zone, the loss would simply be too great.
Rather than letting the enemy push all the way and fighting a protracted war of attrition within the Divine Kingdom, it was better to directly have a fierce battle on the outer perimeter.
If even the first line of defense could not be held, it would not be too late to retreat to the core area and fight a protracted war.

Yang Fan’s current train of thought was very simple: raise the overall revenue of the Divine Kingdom, and then use these revenues to crazily feedback into the Divine Kingdom and enhance the strength of believers.
As for the risk of war, as long as one’s strength was strong enough, it was not a risk, but resources delivered to the door.
After arranging everything properly, the entire Divine Kingdom completely entered a period of rapid development.
Believers growing stronger, resource procurement, combat power cultivation, weapon research... everything was running at high speed under the scheduling of Intelligent Life.
Another five days passed, and Yang San, Yang Four, and Yang Five successively brought back the Divine Kingdom Cores.
However, the Divine Kingdom War that Yang San was responsible for had not completely ended.
Because just as he was about to break through the target Divine Kingdom Core, an alien army forcefully descended onto the battlefield.
Obviously, this was the opponent’s reinforcement.

Yang Fan was not too surprised by this; whether Human Race or aliens, after developing to the demigod stage, they would gradually form cooperative relationships similar to Family, Alliance, and squads.
They shared intelligence with each other, exchanged resources, and even communicated Divine Kingdom coordinates.
After all, the risks of a Divine Kingdom War were extremely high. If they could act jointly, it could not only reduce losses but also improve hunting efficiency.
It was just that Yang Fan’s rise was too fast. From becoming a demigod until now, the number of wars he had experienced was not many, and this was the first time he truly encountered an “Alliance”.
However, even if two Divine Kingdoms joined hands, they still could not stop Yang San’s advance.
Now, the foundation of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had long far surpassed ordinary demigods.
The number of believers, resource reserves, weapon strength, technological assistance... almost completely crushed them.
Facing the two alien forces, Yang San forcefully relied on absolute strength to crush them all the way.

In just a few days, the opponent was beaten into continuous retreat. Following the breakthrough of the first Divine Kingdom Core, Yang San took the opportunity to capture the Divine Kingdom coordinates of another Alien Demigod.
Being able to deeply share coordinates indicated that the strength of both parties usually did not have too large a gap.

Since that was the case, there was no need to hesitate at all; they could just continue the expedition along the coordinates, which could not only expand the battle results but also save a large sum of money for purchasing Divine Kingdom coordinates.
At the same time, Yang Da also began to purchase new Alien Divine Kingdom coordinates.

The targets chosen this time were the Corroded-Bone Rat Clan and the Blood Lizard Spore Clan respectively. These two major alien races shared a common characteristic: their individual strength was weak, but their reproductive capability was extremely terrifying.
The reason for specifically choosing this type of alien race was because a large number of zombies had already accumulated within the Extra-dimensional Research Institute.
Using zombies to spread viruses could significantly reduce the losses of one’s own believers.
For current Divine Kingdom Wars, Yang Fan had basically completely handed them over to Intelligent Life to handle. Unless major war changes occurred, he would almost never actively interfere.
With the Hundredfold Evolution Talent existing, his troop replenishment speed far exceeded that of other demigods.

Under this circumstance, Yang Fan did not need to take risks to fight head-on with strong enemies at all; he only needed to continuously split his troops and keep attacking those demigod Divine Kingdoms far weaker than himself.
Making up for quality with quantity was Yang Fan’s current strategy for obtaining Divine Kingdom Cores.
This strategy was something only he dared to implement; not to mention the troop source issue, the purchase cost of these coordinates alone was not something ordinary demigods could afford.
A few more days passed. After Yang Er completely finished resource gathering, Yang Fan finally began to absorb these three Divine Kingdom Cores.
Boom—
Accompanied by the integration of the Divine Kingdom Cores, the entire Divine Kingdom began to vibrate violently.
The earth expanded wildly, mountain ranges extended, rivers surged, and the original boundaries constantly spread outward.
In a short time, the area of the Divine Kingdom surged by another six million square kilometers.

As the defense line of the Divine Kingdom, the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall also underwent changes. That black city wall spanning heaven and earth began to slowly translate outward.
The city wall roared, countless formation patterns lit up one after another, and one war fortress after another rose from the ground.
Looking from afar, it seemed as if the entire defense line was pushing forward outward.

This was the advantage of the A-grade defensive building, the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall. It would adjust its size by itself according to the area of the Divine Kingdom, completely resembling a movable war fortress.

At the same time, Yang Fan also felt an unspeakable sense of comfort. His life level was being constantly elevated, his Soul felt like it was soaking in a hot spring, and every inch of flesh and blood throughout his body was cheering and leaping with joy.
Yang Fan did not completely intoxicate himself in this refreshing feeling of his life level continuously rising.
After completely absorbing the three Divine Kingdom Cores, he quickly gathered his mind, and his consciousness returned to reality.
Time flew by, and another twenty days passed.
During this period, Yang Fan almost stayed at home all the time studying various Divine Kingdom theories, war systems, and alien materials.
Until this day, his parents suddenly sent a message asking him to make a trip to the Virtual World.

Since that was the case, there was no need to hesitate at all; they could just continue the expedition along the coordinates, which could not only expand the battle results but also save a large sum of money for purchasing Divine Kingdom coordinates.
At the same time, Yang Da also began to purchase new Alien Divine Kingdom coordinates.
The targets chosen this time were the Corroded-Bone Rat Clan and the Blood Lizard Spore Clan respectively.
These two major alien races shared a common characteristic: their individual strength was weak, but their reproductive capability was extremely terrifying.
The reason for specifically choosing this type of alien race was because a large number of zombies had already accumulated within the Extra-dimensional Research Institute.
Using zombies to spread viruses could significantly reduce the losses of one’s own believers.
For current Divine Kingdom Wars, Yang Fan had basically completely handed them over to Intelligent Life to handle.
Unless major war changes occurred, he would almost never actively interfere.
With the Hundredfold Evolution Talent existing, his troop replenishment speed far exceeded that of other demigods.

Under this circumstance, Yang Fan did not need to take risks to fight head-on with strong enemies at all; he only needed to continuously split his troops and keep attacking those demigod Divine Kingdoms far weaker than himself.
Making up for quality with quantity was Yang Fan’s current strategy for obtaining Divine Kingdom Cores.
This strategy was something only he dared to implement; not to mention the troop source issue, the purchase cost of these coordinates alone was not something ordinary demigods could afford.
A few more days passed.
After Yang Er completely finished resource gathering, Yang Fan finally began to absorb these three Divine Kingdom Cores.
Boom—
Accompanied by the integration of the Divine Kingdom Cores, the entire Divine Kingdom began to vibrate violently.
The earth expanded wildly, mountain ranges extended, rivers surged, and the original boundaries constantly spread outward.
In a short time, the area of the Divine Kingdom surged by another six million square kilometers.
As the defense line of the Divine Kingdom, the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall also underwent changes.
That black city wall spanning heaven and earth began to slowly translate outward.
The city wall roared, countless formation patterns lit up one after another, and one war fortress after another rose from the ground.
Looking from afar, it seemed as if the entire defense line was pushing forward outward.
This was the advantage of the A-grade defensive building, the Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall.
It would adjust its size by itself according to the area of the Divine Kingdom, completely resembling a movable war fortress.
At the same time, Yang Fan also felt an unspeakable sense of comfort.
His life level was being constantly elevated, his Soul felt like it was soaking in a hot spring, and every inch of flesh and blood throughout his body was cheering and leaping with joy.
Yang Fan did not completely intoxicate himself in this refreshing feeling of his life level continuously rising.
After completely absorbing the three Divine Kingdom Cores, he quickly gathered his mind, and his consciousness returned to reality.
Time flew by, and another twenty days passed.
During this period, Yang Fan almost stayed at home all the time studying various Divine Kingdom theories, war systems, and alien materials.
Until this day, his parents suddenly sent a message asking him to make a trip to the Virtual World.

chapters.title: Chapter 192: Changes in Hometown
paragraphs: Yang Fan did not hesitate and directly put on the virtual helmet.
His consciousness fell into a brief trance, and when he opened his eyes again, he had already returned to Yang County, where the familiar city scenery still surrounded him.
However, compared to the past, the entire Yang County was now noticeably much more prosperous.
The streets had been widened, buildings renovated, and there were even many more patrolling Mechanical units in the sky.
Arriving at the Yangcheng Villa area, as far as Yang Fan could see, the security force had greatly increased.
Every three steps there was a post, and every five steps a sentry.
One could even see personnel from special departments of the Federal Government patrolling nearby.
After entering the villa, Yang Fan swept his gaze across the room and found that quite a few people were already seated inside.
Yang Tiexin and Sun Rong sat in the main seats; although the two tried their best to remain calm, their eyes still carried a bit of undisguised excitement and pride.
Luo Rou and Luo Bing sat quietly to the side, their eyes visibly lighting up when they saw Yang Fan.
Besides them, there were also many familiar faces.
Luo Family head Luo Hai, Luo Rou’s grandfather Luo Chengfeng, high school principal Hong Bing, Yang County Magistrate Wang Yun, and Yang Fan’s former friend Zhang Pang.

Yet at this moment, the atmosphere in the hall was somewhat strange; even Hong Bing and Magistrate Wang Yun, who were Tier 3 Gods, only sat quietly in the side seats with restrained expressions and a faint sense of tension.
Seeing Yang Fan walk in, everyone who had been conversing stood up almost simultaneously.
“Fan’er is back.”
“Sit down quickly.”
“Haha, long time no see, big Genius.”
Everyone broke into smiles, but within those smiles, an extra layer of cautiousness was distinctly evident.
Even Magistrate Wang Yun and Hong Bing subconsciously softened their tone when speaking.
Today’s Yang Fan was long no longer that student from Yang County of the past.

Although no one knew exactly how far he had gone in Taichu City, based solely on the subsequent series of actions by the Federal Government, everyone could guess that Yang Fan’s current status had become unimaginably high.
“Actually, we didn’t want to disturb you originally.” Yang Tiexin took the lead in speaking, “Going to school in Taichu City must keep you very busy.”
Sun Rong also nodded hastily, “Yes, we just wanted to see how you’ve been lately.”
Yang Fan smiled, “Not bad.”

Hearing this, Magistrate Wang Yun on the side immediately took over the topic, his face filled with emotion: “Far from just not bad, the entire Yang County has benefited immensely because of you now. The Federal Government has successively allocated several batches of resources recently, all educational institutions have been completely renovated, and teachers’ salaries have doubled. Even several nearby counties have shared in the glory.”

“Now, let alone Yang County, even in the entire Tiannan City, there is no one who doesn’t know your name, Yang Fan. Our school’s recent enrollment has tripled in numbers.” Hong Bing sighed with emotion.
Speaking of this, the gaze Hong Bing cast toward Yang Fan also carried an undisguisedly complex expression.
Who would have thought that the student who originally awakened an F-rank Resource Talent would actually reach such a stage.

Luo Hai said with a full face of smiles: “The Luo Family has also received considerable support from the Federal Government recently. Not only have industrial approvals been given the green light all the way, but we can even steadily purchase a batch of strategic-level resources every year.”
This far-sighted family head’s voice was even trembling slightly at this moment.
Strategic-level resources were something the Luo Family could previously only hope to luck into by invading Alien Gods during land reclamation.
But now, the Federal Government actively opened up the quotas.
Based solely on this point, it wouldn’t be long before the Luo Family could completely shake off the Li Family.
Zhang Pang, sitting in the corner, was clearly somewhat nervous. Facing Yang Fan as he was now, he didn’t even dare to speak; after all, the gap between the two sides had grown unimaginably large.
However, Yang Fan took the initiative to smile and say: “What, don’t you recognize me anymore?”
“It’s mainly because you are now... too terrifying.” Zhang Pang scratched his head awkwardly and said.
This single sentence instantly eased the atmosphere in the hall quite a bit.
Afterwards, Yang Fan also learned from everyone’s mouths about what had happened recently.

Because he had signed a Subordinate God Contract with Zhang Pang, the Federal Government side even sent dedicated personnel to make contact, arranging all subsequent settlement and protection work properly, and even letting Zhang Pang enter government work.
As for Luo Rou and Luo Bing, the two women’s school enrollments had been transferred to the Star Dome Favored Academy, and there were even gods protecting their safety.

Besides that, the Divine Kingdom security of Yang Tiexin and Sun Rong had long been secretly taken over by the Federation, and specialized personnel were also arranged to protect them in the Real World.
It could be said that anyone related to Yang Fan had already been listed by the Federal Government on the highest priority protection list.
This meeting did not last too long; most of the time, everyone was accompanying Yang Fan in conversation, and their words always carried a bit of flattery and awe.
Yang Fan also felt some emotion regarding this; changes in strength and status could truly change everything.
After the chat ended, Yang Fan’s consciousness exited the Virtual World.
He slowly opened his eyes, and after a brief relaxation, he picked up the books again to continue studying.
Another five days passed in reality; counting from when soul nourishing wood began to be cultivated, the Divine Kingdom had developed for three thousand years.
Yang Fan’s consciousness entered the Divine Kingdom, and with a thought, he brought up the detailed information.
“Divine Master: Yang Fan”
“Divine Kingdom Area: 25.5 million square kilometers”
“Talent: Omitted”

“Believers: Foundation Establishment Realm (87,443), Martial Master Realm (14,225), Qi Refining Realm (190 million), Martial Disciple Realm (110 million), First-Class Intelligent Life (2.259 million), Tier 5 Being (11.5 billion)... Mortal (19.2 billion)”
“Occupations: Alchemist (5.85 million), Blacksmith (3.01 million), Talisman Master (300,000), Formation Master (500,000)”
“Dependents: Adult Elf (22.44 million)”

“Techniques: Everlasting Spring Technique (Major Achievement), Gengjin Rift-Blade Art (Major Achievement), Profound Water Origin-Returning Art (Major Achievement), Crimson Flame Burning Heaven Record (Major Achievement), Thick Earth Mountain-Suppressing Scripture (Major Achievement), Indestructible Golden Body Technique (Major Achievement), Spirit Tortoise Life-Protecting Formation (C-grade, Major Achievement), Ten Kings of Hell Formation (C-grade, Major Achievement)...”
“Divinity Points: 5.8 billion (Real World provides 12.6 Divinity Points daily)”

“Buildings: Moon Well x100 million, Sun Spring x100 million, Fountain of Life x6,243, Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest x11 (S-grade), divine weapon world-forging platform (S-grade), Eye of God x22 (A-grade), Spiritual Vein x91,000 (A-grade), Alchemy Tower x2,000 (B-grade), Prison Body Refining Tower x500 (B-grade), immortal nurturing tower x10,000 (B-grade), Monkey Wine Spring x1.092 million (B-grade), A-grade defense building Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall, B-grade defense building City-Annihilating Cannon x500, B-grade defense building f3500 fighter jet x220,000, C-grade City of Technology x23...”

“Wonders: Penglai Island x2,184 (Deployed), Spirit Peach Mountain x10,920 (Deployed), Dragon Marsh Water Mansion x21,840 (Deployed), Worlds Number One Martial Arts Arena x1,500 (Deployed), myriad manifestation battle stele x30”

“Assets: Spirit Vein Planet x11, Spirit Plant Star x10, soul nourishing wood (x5 trillion, millennia-old), Dragon Fish fry (x218.4 million), f-class transformation pod x1.2 million, Smart Weapon x1.45 million, Mechanical Heart x50, Otherworldly Collector x4.1 billion, ordinary zombies (x10 billion), Earth Heart Milk (), Spirit Stone (), various Medicinal Pills ()...”

As the area of the Divine Kingdom continued to expand, Yang Da also began purchasing corresponding quantities of Divine Kingdom assets to continue investing, but compared to the income from Spirit Vein Planets...
Whether it was breeding Dragon Fish or the spirit wine industry, the revenue already appeared somewhat insignificant.
Even so, the resources of the Divine Kingdom would still be utilized to the absolute limit.
For Intelligent Life, things like “waste” were virtually impossible to exist.
