chapters.title: Chapter 193: Great Void Warship
paragraphs: Currently, the entire Divine Kingdom already possessed 1.2 million f-class transformation pods. Within a month in the Real World, under the time flow rate of the Divine Kingdom, each transformation pod could be reused a hundred times.
In other words, relying solely on these f-class transformation pods, the Divine Kingdom could steadily give birth to 120 million Tier 5 Beings every month.

The value of these transformation pods naturally could not be measured purely by quantity, because the believers who grew up through the transformation pods were equivalent to significantly shortening their early-stage Cultivation time.
The Breakthroughs in life levels that originally required over a decade or even decades to complete could now be finished in a short period.
And this also meant they possessed more time to charge towards the Qi Refining Stage, with even greater potential.
Facing a huge population base, even if there were just ten percent more Qi Refining Cultivators, it would eventually form an extremely astonishing gap.
Even so, the current quantity of f-class transformation pods was still far from enough.

According to Yang Da’s population model calculations, the new population added every thirty years in the Divine Kingdom was currently around two billion, and as the Divine Kingdom continued to expand, the future newborn population would only become more and more exaggerated.

Even though Yang Fan’s monthly income currently exceeded 15 billion Divinity Points, if he truly wanted to achieve full population coverage with transformation pods, the required funds would still make one’s scalp go numb for a while.

Transformation pods were simply too money-burning. Currently, most Mortals within the Divine Kingdom wanted to Breakthrough to Tier 5 Being, mostly relying on their own Cultivate, while f-class transformation pods were mostly just the icing on the cake.

Regarding this, Yang Da had also proposed his own vision. Once he was promoted to a fifth-class Intelligent Life in the future, he would be able to purchase related Materials and produce transformation pods by himself.
By that time, the manufacturing cost could be reduced by at least several times.

However, because the Divine Kingdom possessed the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, the role played by the transformation pods within Yang Fan’s divine kingdom was far more exaggerated than that of other Demigods. If resources were sufficient, configuring them in large quantities ahead of time was still worthwhile. After all, enhancing believers’ strength had always been the core of the Divine Kingdom’s development.
Yang Fan opened his mouth and asked, “How is the utilization rate over at Spirit Plant Star?”

“Reporting to Master, the resource utilization rate of Spirit Plant Star is currently continuously increasing. In order to fully utilize the resources of Spirit Plant Star, the Divine Kingdom has focused on cultivating the Alchemist system.”
“Now basic Medicinal Pills have basically achieved self-sufficiency, and the daily needs of The Frontline legions no longer require massive procurement from the Divine Shop.”

Speaking of this, Yang Da paused slightly, then continued, “Furthermore, the production of Medicinal Pills has currently begun to show a surplus. In addition to meeting internal consumption, the excess Medicinal Pills are sold to the Gu Clan resource depository. The current stable monthly income is around 200 million Divinity Points.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded gently.

Yang Da continued to explain, “According to the deduction of the current trend, the number of Alchemists in the Divine Kingdom will continue to surge in the future. I believe it won’t be long before the resources of Spirit Plant Star can be fully utilized.”
Yang Fan’s expression was calm, “Mn, no rush.”
The development of the Divine Kingdom was inherently a long-term accumulation. Furthermore, he still had the Hundredfold Evolution Talent.

Nowadays, earth-shaking changes were happening almost every day in the entire Divine Kingdom. That feeling of growing stronger constantly to the naked eye instead prevented Yang Fan from appearing overly impatient.
After a moment, Yang Fan asked again, “Have you recently discovered any believers of other Alien Demigods approaching the Divine Kingdom?”
In order to deal with the upcoming war in advance, Yang Da had long ago purchased a large number of patrol aircraft from the Divine Shop.

These aircraft would patrol the periphery of the Divine Kingdom around the clock, continuously detecting whether there were abnormal lives around through thermal imaging, life fluctuations, laser scanning, and other methods.

“Reporting to Master, no abnormal targets have been discovered temporarily. However, patrol aircraft ultimately belong to ordinary physical-level detection, and many Alien beings have evasion methods. Therefore, whether the coordinates of the Divine Kingdom have been exposed cannot be completely determined at present.” Yang Da replied calmly.
Yang Fan said with a serious expression, “Continue to maintain high alert. Perhaps unknown gods are already observing us in secret.”
The aura emitted by the 50 trillion soul nourishing woods now was simply too astonishing.

Ever since they grew into thousand-year soul nourishing woods, the energy concentration within the entire Divine Kingdom had increased by a large margin, and the Cultivate speed of believers had skyrocketed even more.
Such a massive energy aura could not be completely covered up by Penglai Island alone.
Perhaps some Alien Demigod had already set their sights on this place, waiting only for an opportunity to take a vicious bite out of it.
“Yes, Master.” Yang Da responded respectfully.
“Use the remaining Divinity Points to purchase the Great Void Warship.” Yang Fan ordered.
Five billion Divinity Points evaporated instantly, and the next moment Yang Fan directly chose to load them into the Divine Kingdom.
The sky above the entire Divine Kingdom violently vibrated, the Void Realm cracked open, and a black crack several thousand miles long slowly emerged.
A behemoth slowly sailed out from the depths of the Void Realm.
The Great Void Warship was pitch-black all over, its surface covered with dense dark gold patterns, and countless Mechanical formation runes flowed.
Just hovering in the air gave people an oppressive feeling resembling a fortress of war.
The entire Great Void Warship was sufficient to carry a population of 10 billion, and it could also freely change its size.
To see whether these 5 billion Divinity Points were truly worth it, Yang Fan did not hesitate and immediately ordered his believers to send the Great Void Warship to The Frontline.
Yang San had now breached the core area of a Goblin divine kingdom, which was also the opponent’s last line of defense.
Rumbling—
Above the battlefield, a large number of Spells roared endlessly.
Unlike the Goblins Yang Fan initially encountered, this batch of Goblins was obviously far too powerful.
A large number of Foundation Establishment Realm Goblins wore thick black armor, held giant shields and heavy hammers, and there were even organized Goblin legions.
Relying on the mountain terrain, they tightly guarded the outer periphery of the Divine Kingdom Core.
A large amount of arrow rain poured down from high above, and war giant crossbows roared continuously.
Meanwhile, the army under Yang San’s command continuously advanced, and both sides engaged in frantic slaughter on the final line of defense.
Although the overall situation was still advantageous to Yang San, the opponent occupied the geographical advantage after all, causing the battlefield to fall into a stalemate within a short time.
Just at this moment, the Void Realm suddenly vibrated, and a huge spatial crack slowly opened.
The next second, the Great Void Warship descended upon the battlefield!
That massive black hull almost obscured the entire sky.
A large number of Goblins looked up, and expressions of panic instantly emerged in their eyes.
As for Yang San, he received the permissions at the very first moment.
As an Intelligent Life, the moment he came into contact with the Great Void Warship, he completely mastered all control methods.
The next moment, Yang San knelt on one knee with a fanatical gaze, “Thank You, My God, for Your trust. Yang San will definitely bring victory to the Divine Kingdom!”
Boom—
Following the issued command, a large number of believers began boarding the ship.
Inside the entire Great Void Warship, it resembled a mobile war fortress. Rows of Void Realm artillery batteries slowly rose, and dense war formation runes continuously lit up.
Even on both sides of the hull, a large number of Mechanical floating artillery batteries extended out, and terrifying energy fluctuations began to frantically converge.

Perhaps some Alien Demigod had already set their sights on this place, waiting only for an opportunity to take a vicious bite out of it.
“Yes, Master.” Yang Da responded respectfully.
“Use the remaining Divinity Points to purchase the Great Void Warship.” Yang Fan ordered.
Five billion Divinity Points evaporated instantly, and the next moment Yang Fan directly chose to load them into the Divine Kingdom.
The sky above the entire Divine Kingdom violently vibrated, the Void Realm cracked open, and a black crack several thousand miles long slowly emerged.
A behemoth slowly sailed out from the depths of the Void Realm.
The Great Void Warship was pitch-black all over, its surface covered with dense dark gold patterns, and countless Mechanical formation runes flowed.
Just hovering in the air gave people an oppressive feeling resembling a fortress of war.
The entire Great Void Warship was sufficient to carry a population of 10 billion, and it could also freely change its size.
To see whether these 5 billion Divinity Points were truly worth it, Yang Fan did not hesitate and immediately ordered his believers to send the Great Void Warship to The Frontline.
Yang San had now breached the core area of a Goblin divine kingdom, which was also the opponent’s last line of defense.
Rumbling—
Above the battlefield, a large number of Spells roared endlessly.
Unlike the Goblins Yang Fan initially encountered, this batch of Goblins was obviously far too powerful.
A large number of Foundation Establishment Realm Goblins wore thick black armor, held giant shields and heavy hammers, and there were even organized Goblin legions.
Relying on the mountain terrain, they tightly guarded the outer periphery of the Divine Kingdom Core.
A large amount of arrow rain poured down from high above, and war giant crossbows roared continuously.
Meanwhile, the army under Yang San’s command continuously advanced, and both sides engaged in frantic slaughter on the final line of defense.
Although the overall situation was still advantageous to Yang San, the opponent occupied the geographical advantage after all, causing the battlefield to fall into a stalemate within a short time.
Just at this moment, the Void Realm suddenly vibrated, and a huge spatial crack slowly opened.
The next second, the Great Void Warship descended upon the battlefield!
That massive black hull almost obscured the entire sky.
A large number of Goblins looked up, and expressions of panic instantly emerged in their eyes.
As for Yang San, he received the permissions at the very first moment.
As an Intelligent Life, the moment he came into contact with the Great Void Warship, he completely mastered all control methods.
The next moment, Yang San knelt on one knee with a fanatical gaze, “Thank You, My God, for Your trust.
Yang San will definitely bring victory to the Divine Kingdom!”
Boom—
Following the issued command, a large number of believers began boarding the ship.
Inside the entire Great Void Warship, it resembled a mobile war fortress.
Rows of Void Realm artillery batteries slowly rose, and dense war formation runes continuously lit up.
Even on both sides of the hull, a large number of Mechanical floating artillery batteries extended out, and terrifying energy fluctuations began to frantically converge.

chapters.title: Chapter 194: An Old Steed in the Stable Still Longs to Gallop a Thousand Li
paragraphs: Seeing this, the Goblins on the opposite side completely panicked.

A large number of archers frantically drew their bows, and a sky-filling rain of arrows shot toward the Great Void Warship, but when those arrows fell on the surface of the hull, not even a trace of sparks was splashed.
The next second, the main cannon of the Great Void Warship lit up.
Boom!!!
A pillar of psychic energy piercing through heaven and earth suddenly erupted.
The city walls painstakingly managed by the Goblins were instantly blasted out with a huge gap of hundreds of li.
A large number of Goblins didn’t even have time to scream before they directly evaporated.
The entire battlefield fell into instant silence.
Afterwards, it was a complete collapse, and a large number of Goblins had faces full of terror.
“Monster!!!”
“What is this thing!!”
“Hurry up and run!!!”
“Don’t kill me!!!”
Countless Goblins began to flee frantically, and even quite a few directly knelt on the ground to beg for mercy.
But facing a war weapon like the Great Void Warship, the so-called defense line was completely meaningless.
Stream after stream of Void Realm artillery fire continuously fell, mountains collapsed, and city walls shattered.
The entire battlefield completely turned into a one-sided massacre.
The situation that was extremely anxious just a moment ago was instantly and completely crushed.
Seeing this scene, even Yang Fan couldn’t help but swallow hard.
“As expected of a war resource worth five billion Divinity Points...”

If he could have owned this thing when fighting against the Black Armored Beetle Race back then, those self-detonation methods probably wouldn’t even be able to scratch the skin of the Great Void Warship.

“Master, the Great Void Warship is a war artwork representing the culmination of a high-tier Mechanical Divine Kingdom. Its interior is equipped with large Void Realm artillery, defense barriers, space transition, and other war modules.”
“Furthermore, the hull possesses extremely strong self-repair capabilities. As long as the core is not destroyed, the vast majority of damage can be quickly recovered.”
“Due to its extremely high forging cost, this item usually belongs to the strategic-grade war resources of the federal The Frontline.”
“With the Great Void Warship around, the legion led by Yang San is already sufficient to invade high-risk coordinates.”

Hearing this, Yang Fan shook his head without hesitation. “Unnecessary. Since you think it can fight high-risk coordinates, then lower it by one level. From now on, Yang San will be responsible for invading danger-grade Divine Kingdoms.”
In Yang Fan’s view, safety is always the number one priority at any time.
“Understood, Master.” Yang Da’s expression stiffened slightly, and his tone even carried a hint of helplessness.
Yang Da felt that under his education, his own deity had changed a lot.
No longer indulging in low-level desires like before, he had instead started actively learning and working hard to manage the Divine Kingdom, gradually possessing the traits of a deity.
The only problem was... he was too steady, to the point of being a bit outrageous.
In Yang Da’s view, given the current foundation of the Divine Kingdom, it definitely belonged to the absolute top tier among demigods.
As a result, his own master always liked to play that trick of “dimensionality reduction strike”.
If he could crush, he would never take risks; if he could gank in a group, he would never fight solo; if he could hit the weak, he would never touch the strong.
Regarding this, Yang Da could only accept it silently.
Yang Fan’s consciousness slowly returned to reality.
Just at this moment, his communicator suddenly vibrated.
Yang Fan lowered his head to look and found that it was a message sent by Sima Bang.
[Brother Fan]
[Ye Jianfeng and I have teamed up and are preparing to invade an Alien Divine Kingdom together]
[Do you want to come along? The two of us can just buy the coordinates]
[Hugging thighs.jpg]
Seeing those highly comical kaomoji, the corner of Yang Fan’s mouth twitched slightly, and then he directly replied, [No need, you guys go ahead]
In fact, from the very beginning, Yang Fan never planned to team up with others to conduct Divine Kingdom Wars.

It was not that he looked down on Sima Bang and Ye Jianfeng, but rather that the gap in strength between the two sides was already too large. For Yang Fan, ordinary cooperation no longer had any meaning.
Furthermore, Divine Kingdom Wars involved issues such as resource distribution, loot attribution, and coordinate sharing.
Once there were too many people, he would instead easily find himself restricted and constrained.
Rather than having trouble later, it was better to refuse right from the start.
At the same time, inside a private room of Yuexiang Pavilion.
Ye Jianfeng looked at the communication interface and gently sighed, “As expected, he didn’t agree.”
Sima Bang next to him was leisurely drinking wine and just smiled, “I guessed it from the very beginning.”
“With Brother Fan’s current status, even if he cooperates, he will only cooperate with those Prodigies. Right now... we are no longer able to measure up to him.”
“Furthermore, if we really act together, how would the resources be divided then? The gap in strength is too large, making it inherently very difficult to balance.”

Speaking of this, Sima Bang instead breathed a sigh of relief and said, “For people whose strength is unequal to be forcibly united, that is not cooperation, but assistance. In the end, what gets worn away will only be the remaining feelings.”
Hearing this, Ye Jianfeng also nodded in agreement.

Although his personality was straightforward, he was not stupid. The current Yang Fan was already no longer on the same level as them; if they forcibly bound themselves together, it would instead make their relationship change flavor.
After a moment, Ye Jianfeng spoke up again, “Then where are we going to buy Divine Kingdom coordinates next?”
“The Divine Shop is too expensive. The Sima Family has its own channels, the price will be much cheaper, and the safety is also higher.”
“However...” Sima Bang touched his chin, “Just the two of us is still a bit reluctant. I plan to invite two more friends.”
Ye Jianfeng nodded, “Sure, we can sign a contract in advance at that time and distribute resources according to contribution to avoid bickering afterwards.”
“No problem.”
Time slowly passed. In the blink of an eye, a full year had passed since Yang Fan came to Taichu City.
He also officially became a sophomore student of Primordial Academy now.
At the same time, on a steel planet outside a distant Star Domain, a man was sitting upright on the top floor of a skyscraper, crossing his legs and leisurely swirling a glass of red wine.
The man’s face was full of comfort, and even the corners of his mouth could not suppress his smile.
This person was none other than the boss of Elephant Loan—Ma Yu.
“Number Three, it seems it’s time for collection.” Ma Yu said lazily, “Hehe, a Human Race Prodigy is about to join my Elephant Loan. I truly am an investment Genius.”
This past month, he had been counting days almost every day.
He was just waiting for Yang Fan to enter the second semester so that he could bring the contract and officially recruit Yang Fan under his command.
Thinking about a Human Race Prodigy working for him in the future, Ma Yu couldn’t help his heart surging with emotion, and he could even wake up smiling from his dreams.
“President Ma, the time has arrived.” The Mechanical voice of the Intelligent Life sounded around.
“Mn.” Ma Yu nodded with satisfaction, then continued to ask, “Has that little Genius sent any messages recently?”
“No.”
Hearing the answer, Ma Yu slightly curled his lips.
“Forget it, in the name of Elephant Loan, submit an application to the Federal Government. I want to retrieve Yang Fan’s data for this past year.”

Speaking of this, Ma Yu felt somewhat helpless again. “The confidentiality measures for these Human Race Prodigies are truly troublesome. To take a look at their data, I still have to apply in the company’s name.”
While speaking, Ma Yu heavily gulped a mouthful of red wine, then comfortably leaned back in his chair.
He gently swirled his wine glass and, through the floor-to-ceiling windows, overlooked the entire steel planet.

Thinking of the picture of Elephant Loan continuously expanding in the future, a heroic sentiment of “An old steed in the stable still longs to gallop a thousand li” unexpectedly arose in Ma Yu’s heart.
Afterwards, he began to patiently wait for the application results.
He prepared to first look at Yang Fan’s specific performance over this past year, and then apply for a Virtual World meeting to chat by the way... about future cultivation contracts.

chapters.title: Chapter 195: Something is Definitely Wrong
paragraphs: Ma Yu waited for the application results with a face full of anticipation, but the next second, a bright red alert suddenly popped up on the virtual screen in front of him.
[Warning: Target information has been classified under Federal special confidentiality clearance.]
[Current clearance insufficient.]
[Further attempts to access relevant information are prohibited.]
[This action has been logged.]
Seeing this, Ma Yu was completely stunned.
“Wait... I have a contract with him, don’t I? Is the Federal Government now even guarding against business partners?” Ma Yu looked incredulous.

He was, after all, the CEO of a major company worth hundreds of billions of Divinity Points. Although Elephant Loan wasn’t a top-tier consortium in the Federation, it was still a legitimate, publicly listed company.
Yet now, he didn’t even have the clearance to view a trainee he had a contract with?
“Has information protection for Human Race Prodigies become this outrageous now?” Ma Yu couldn’t help but mutter.
However, just at that moment, his Intelligent Life suddenly emitted an extremely strange static noise.
Crackle, crackle, crackle—
The sound was as if the System had been hijacked.
Ma Yu’s expression changed instantly; the red wine in his hand dropped to the floor, and he sprang up from the sofa.
“Number Three? What’s going on with you?” Ma Yu’s face was solemn.

The next moment, the Intelligent Life’s voice became abnormally cold, “Ma Yu, the federal supreme intelligent life has forcibly accessed this System. It requires you to enter the Virtual World immediately.”
Hearing this, Ma Yu’s brain almost exploded. He stood there blankly, wondering if he had misheard.
The federal supreme intelligent life?
Looking for him?
He was just the CEO of a small, publicly listed company dealing in loans; how could he possibly be targeted by such an entity?
That was the ultimate intelligence that coordinated the Human Federation’s entire data network and controlled the computational cores of countless Star Domains.
Yet now, it was actually demanding to speak with him directly?
At this moment, Ma Yu even suspected that “Number Three” had caught some kind of virus.
But as soon as this thought appeared, he dismissed it himself.
Modern Intelligent Life operated on an independent System long ago.
A virus?
That was an antiquated concept from how many years ago.
Thinking of this, Ma Yu suddenly felt a chill down his spine and asked suspiciously, “Number Three, have you grown bold? You dare to prank me with something like this?”
Ma Yu’s voice was a bit shaky at the moment.

“Boss, I am not joking. The federal supreme intelligent life has taken over the current network permissions. Furthermore, your external network access has been temporarily restricted, and you are prohibited from communicating with others.”
Hearing this, Ma Yu’s expression changed instantly. He immediately tried to connect to the communication network.
He discovered that all of his social, communication, and Star Domain network permissions had indeed been frozen.
A Fifth-Order God, the CEO of a publicly listed company, was actually being forcibly disconnected at this moment.
Such a ridiculous yet terrifying scene made Ma Yu’s scalp tingle with fear.
He dared not delay any longer, rushing directly to the bedside to put on his virtual helmet.
Aside from the federal supreme intelligent life, he couldn’t think of any other possibility that could achieve all this in an instant.
But the problem was...
What kind of heinous crime had he committed to invoke such wrath?!
Hum—
With his consciousness connected, Ma Yu quickly entered the Virtual World.
But this time, he did not appear in the familiar public area; instead, he arrived in a pure white space.
The surroundings were vast and deathly silent; there was no sky, no land. There was only a human figure composed of data, standing there quietly.
The moment he saw it, Ma Yu’s heart almost skipped a beat.

“Ma Yu.” The cold, mechanical voice slowly sounded, “According to the Federal special protection regulations, you are attempting to illegally access the files of a high-confidentiality sequence member. You are hereby issued a warning.”

“A misunderstanding! It’s absolutely a misunderstanding! I have a normal contractual relationship with Yang Fan; I just wanted to see the recent situation of my trainee!” Ma Yu hurriedly waved his hands.
“The target’s current clearance Rank exceeds the scope of your company’s contact. Any unauthorized access will trigger the Federal monitoring mechanism.”
“Furthermore, your contract only possesses commercial training validity and does not represent ownership of the right to access the other party’s personal information.”

“Including but not limited to: Divine Kingdom information, war records, growth data, coordinate traces, and academy ratings. All of the above content belongs to the highest level of Federal confidentiality.”
Hearing this, Ma Yu was completely dumbfounded.
He finally realized that he had completely misunderstood; it wasn’t that he had done something wrong, the issue lay with Yang Fan.

Something must have happened in Taichu City, but with his clearance, it was impossible for him to learn anything about Taichu City’s data. If it weren’t for the fact that Yang Fan had approached him for a loan back then, the two of them likely would never have crossed paths in this lifetime.
“Then... I haven’t broken the law, have I?” Cold sweat broke out on Ma Yu’s forehead.

“Your behavior has not reached the standard of illegality; this is merely a reminder. However, if you continue to attempt unauthorized applications, you will be automatically transferred to the Federal monitoring department.”
Hearing this, Ma Yu nodded frantically, “Understood! Absolutely understood! I will never check again!”
Hum—
As his consciousness exited, Ma Yu ripped off his virtual helmet.
At this moment, his back was already soaked with cold sweat. A personal warning from the federal supreme intelligent life—this was something he wouldn’t have even dared to imagine before.
Inside the room, Ma Yu paced back and forth, his expression uncertain.
“Something is wrong... something is definitely wrong... What on earth did Yang Fan do?” The more Ma Yu thought about it, the more alarmed he became.
“Should I just treat the contract as if it doesn’t exist?”

“No, those few Divinity Points don’t matter. What’s important is Yang Fan himself. Given my status, I’m afraid I won’t be able to come into contact with any Human Race Prodigies in the future, so I must figure out what happened.”

Thinking of this, Ma Yu couldn’t sit still. Although the federal supreme intelligent life had prohibited him from querying Yang Fan’s files through network permissions, it hadn’t restricted him from asking others.
Surely asking about gossip was fine!

The next moment, Ma Yu spoke directly, “Number Three, send a message to Lin Yi. Tell him to collect recent rumors related to Yang Fan in Taichu City. As long as the information is valuable, I will double the resources provided by Elephant Loan during his university years.”
“Yes, Boss.”
As a publicly listed company, although Elephant Loan wasn’t qualified to come into contact with the “Human Race Prodigy” level, it still invested in the next tier of Geniuses.
And Lin Yi was a C-Rank Genius he had invested in. After all, he was also studying in Taichu City, so he should be able to hear some wind of it to some extent.
Several hours later, the message finally came back.
Ma Yu immediately opened the communication interface.
[Boss, I’ve managed to find out some information regarding Yang Fan, but it sounds a bit far-fetched; I can’t guarantee its authenticity.]

[I heard he took first place in the “Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle.” Additionally, there are rumors in Taichu City today saying that this person has been rated as a “Peerless Prodigy.” There is also gossip claiming that Yang Fan has seemingly already joined the Gu Family.]
[The time was too short, and the authenticity of this news is questionable. My residential area is too far from the Human Race Prodigies’ courtyard; this is all I could find out for now.]

If it weren’t for the fact that Yang Fan had approached him for a loan back then, the two of them likely would never have crossed paths in this lifetime.
“Then...
I haven’t broken the law, have I?” Cold sweat broke out on Ma Yu’s forehead.
“Your behavior has not reached the standard of illegality; this is merely a reminder.
However, if you continue to attempt unauthorized applications, you will be automatically transferred to the Federal monitoring department.”
Hearing this, Ma Yu nodded frantically, “Understood!
Absolutely understood!
I will never check again!”
Hum—
As his consciousness exited, Ma Yu ripped off his virtual helmet.
At this moment, his back was already soaked with cold sweat.
A personal warning from the federal supreme intelligent life—this was something he wouldn’t have even dared to imagine before.
Inside the room, Ma Yu paced back and forth, his expression uncertain.
“Something is wrong... something is definitely wrong...
What on earth did Yang Fan do?” The more Ma Yu thought about it, the more alarmed he became.
“Should I just treat the contract as if it doesn’t exist?”
“No, those few Divinity Points don’t matter.
What’s important is Yang Fan himself.
Given my status, I’m afraid I won’t be able to come into contact with any Human Race Prodigies in the future, so I must figure out what happened.”
Thinking of this, Ma Yu couldn’t sit still.
Although the federal supreme intelligent life had prohibited him from querying Yang Fan’s files through network permissions, it hadn’t restricted him from asking others.
Surely asking about gossip was fine!
The next moment, Ma Yu spoke directly, “Number Three, send a message to Lin Yi.
Tell him to collect recent rumors related to Yang Fan in Taichu City.
As long as the information is valuable, I will double the resources provided by Elephant Loan during his university years.”
“Yes, Boss.”
As a publicly listed company, although Elephant Loan wasn’t qualified to come into contact with the “Human Race Prodigy” level, it still invested in the next tier of Geniuses.
And Lin Yi was a C-Rank Genius he had invested in.
After all, he was also studying in Taichu City, so he should be able to hear some wind of it to some extent.
Several hours later, the message finally came back.
Ma Yu immediately opened the communication interface.
[Boss, I’ve managed to find out some information regarding Yang Fan, but it sounds a bit far-fetched; I can’t guarantee its authenticity.]

[I heard he took first place in the “Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle.” Additionally, there are rumors in Taichu City today saying that this person has been rated as a “Peerless Prodigy.” There is also gossip claiming that Yang Fan has seemingly already joined the Gu Family.]
[The time was too short, and the authenticity of this news is questionable.
My residential area is too far from the Human Race Prodigies’ courtyard; this is all I could find out for now.]

chapters.title: Chapter 196: Take Me In
paragraphs: Seeing this, Ma Yu fell into complete silence.
Inside the room, it was dead silent.
A moment later, the corners of Ma Yu’s mouth twitched slightly.
Number one in the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle? A rating of Peerless Prodigy? The Gu Family?
If he hadn’t just been warned by the federal supreme intelligent life, Ma Yu would have said this news was definitely a scam, but now...
Ma Yu took a deep breath, “No, regardless of true or false, I must meet him immediately.”
Taichu City.
Yang Fan looked at his watch and found that there was an additional Virtual World meeting application.
“Applicant: Ma Yu.” Seeing this name, Yang Fan was also slightly startled, slowly putting down the book in his hand.
He quickly recalled the loan contract from back then; he still had a debt of three million Divinity Points.
“I almost forgot about this.” Yang Fan shook his head with a chuckle, then put on the virtual helmet.
As the consciousness connection was completed, Yang Fan entered the Virtual World.
The moment Ma Yu saw Yang Fan, his gaze was noticeably dazed.
The change was simply too huge!
In just a year, that once somewhat green student now seemed to have completely changed into a different person.
His gaze was steady, showing no emotional fluctuations; just standing there, he faintly had the oppressive aura of a person in a higher position.
Thinking of the warning from the federal supreme intelligent life, Ma Yu was now much more cautious even when speaking.
“Young Master Yang.” Ma Yu smiled, “Recently, there have been quite a few rumors about you in Taichu City, and you’ve even made connections with a behemoth like the Gu Family.”
This was a probe, as well as a confirmation.
At this moment, Ma Yu’s gaze kept looking into Yang Fan’s eyes, seemingly searching for an answer.
However, Yang Fan merely nodded indifferently, “Three million Divinity Points, principal and interest included, I will transfer them to you immediately. Thank you for the funds back then.”

Although the interest Ma Yu wanted was extremely high, Yang Fan had no bad feelings toward this person. It was precisely because of this leveraged fund back then that his divine kingdom was able to develop so quickly; if not for this, he couldn’t have achieved what he has now.
Hearing this, Ma Yu hurriedly waved his hands, “No, no, no! What is such a small amount of money? I failed to recognize Mount Tai back then.”
As he spoke, Ma Yu directly took out the contract in front of him and tore it to pieces.
Yang Fan did not deny the matter concerning the Gu Family. Based on this point alone, what were three million Divinity Points? Furthermore, what was his Elephant Loan?
At this moment, Ma Yu’s heart began to beat wildly, and countless thoughts flashed through his mind.
He finally recognized reality completely; his past fantasy of a “Human Race Prodigy working for him” was simply a joke.
That loan contract was no longer important!
“This might be my own opportunity!” Ma Yu thought to himself.
He took a deep breath, then spoke: “Young Master Yang, I am ready to transfer 51% of the shares of Elephant Loan to your name. From now on, the company will be centered around you.”
As soon as these words were spoken, even Yang Fan felt a slight shock in his heart.
That was a listed company worth hundreds of billions of Divinity Points, yet the other party directly gave away 51% of the shares, which was equivalent to handing the control over to him.
Although Yang Fan was extremely shocked in his heart, his surface remained calm, “Reason.”
He knew very well that there was no free lunch in this world.

“Because of the Gu Family. As long as Young Master Yang becomes the actual controlling shareholder of Elephant Loan, the company will be equivalent to leaning against the big tree of the Gu Family. Although I lose 51% of the shares, the company’s future market value can at least multiply several times.”
Speaking of this, Ma Yu paused for a moment, then looked at Yang Fan and said earnestly: “In addition, I want to follow Young Master Yang from now on.”
“Ah???” Yang Fan was somewhat dumbfounded.
A Fifth-Order God wanted to follow him? And with an expression of paying respects to a boss.
Are you serious???

“And Young Master Yang can rest assured, you don’t need to waste energy managing anything. The company can distribute at least fifty billion Divinity Points in dividends to your divine kingdom every year.”

“In addition, I still have quite a few commercial networking resources in my hands. If Young Master Yang is interested in creating your own forces, companies, or chambers of commerce in the future, I can also help handle them.” Ma Yu hurriedly continued to add.
Ma Yu looked at Yang Fan with full hope, that expression practically saying ‘take me in’.
At this moment, he had completely figured it out. If it weren’t for a true Peerless Prodigy, the federal supreme intelligent life could not possibly have personally stepped in to warn him.
Such a figure would be at least a High-Order God in the future.
Clinging to such a thick thigh, what was a mere Elephant Loan?
Ma Yu created the company originally to obtain more resources, feed back into his divine kingdom, and strengthen himself.
Now that he saw a brighter path, he naturally had to seize it.
Investing in a Peerless Prodigy was far more valuable than running a listed company.
In fact, Yang Fan did not see through Ma Yu’s true thoughts.
But one point was very clear to him: the control of a listed company, plus a Fifth-Order God taking the initiative to submit.
For such a matter, he had no reason to refuse at all.
However, Yang Fan did not show his inner emotions. After experiencing so many things, he had long understood that a true person in a higher position never easily showed their emotions on their face.
Moreover, with the Gu Family standing behind him now, even when facing a Fifth-Order God, Yang Fan still maintained a calm and composed attitude.
It was precisely this intangible sense of distance that made Ma Yu even more respectful.

“Young Master Yang can rest assured, I will handle all matters of Elephant Loan properly in the future.” Ma Yu took the initiative to speak, his tone faintly carrying a bit of a subordinate’s posture.
Soon, both parties directly completed the contract modification in the Virtual World.
With the completion of permission authentication, Yang Fan officially became the actual controller of Elephant Loan.
“What is the current asset situation of Elephant Loan?” Yang Fan asked calmly.
Ma Yu immediately said, “Currently, the company’s circulating funds are around eighty billion Divinity Points. After all, it is a financial company, so the book cash will be relatively more.”

“In addition, the loan funds lent out are about two hundred billion Divinity Points. Most of these loans are mortgaged with divine kingdom assets, and the annual interest rate is around 35%, with extremely low risk.”
Speaking of this, Ma Yu paused for a moment.
He waved his right hand, and a virtual light screen floated in front of the two of them.

“In addition, the company also holds partial equity in seventeen small and medium-sized enterprises; owns the ownership of three asteroids; and in several major planets of the Human Federation, there are also quite a few commercial real estate and office assets, including spaceships, warehousing bases, trademarks, and other miscellaneous assets.”

“Adding them all up, Elephant Loan’s total assets are around five hundred billion Divinity Points. However, because it is a listed company, twenty percent of the shares are held by small and medium shareholders, and real estate is relatively troublesome to dispose of.”
Hearing this, even Yang Fan felt a shock in his heart.
This meant that Ma Yu had just directly given him two hundred and fifty billion Divinity Points worth of assets.
Although it couldn’t compare to the Gu Family’s investment, the problem was that Ma Yu didn’t make any requests at all.
Even if Yang Fan were to immediately sell off his shares right now and then turn hostile, Ma Yu would have no way to deal with it.

chapters.title: Chapter 197: Feedback
paragraphs: Yang Fan’s eyes flickered slightly, and he couldn’t help asking, “Can I draw on Elephant Loan’s liquid funds?”
“Of course. As long as Young Master Yang needs it, these eighty billion Divinity Points can be transferred to your Divine Kingdom at any time.”
“Later, when the loan funds are recovered, I can continue to wire them to you.”
“As for the financial statements, I will handle them cleanly!” Ma Yu said seriously, an expression of complete nonchalance on his face.
Seeing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help asking curiously, “President Ma, aren’t you afraid that I’ll completely drain Elephant Loan?”
Hearing this, Ma Yu merely smiled. “If Young Master Yang needs it, I can even buy back the shares and sell off the company.”
His tone was extremely serious, and his gaze showed no sign of flinching as he looked at Yang Fan.

Seeing Yang Fan’s confusion, Ma Yu explained, “At the end of the day, Elephant Loan is merely my industry in the Real World. I am still a Fifth-Order God after all, so my truly important assets are naturally within my own Divine Kingdom.”

“The reason I established a company was because my internal investments within the Divine Kingdom gradually hit a Bottleneck over the past millennium. That’s why I put surplus resources into the Real World to earn extra income.”

At this point, Ma Yu looked seriously at Yang Fan. “But now it’s different. Young Master Yang’s rating is that of a Peerless Prodigy, and you have the backing of the Gu Family. If I can bind our relationship in advance with a mere Elephant Loan before you fully grow up, then no matter how you look at it, it’s a guaranteed win for me.”
“Young Master Yang might not yet fully understand what the Gu Family truly signifies, nor do you grasp what kind of future lies behind the four words ‘Peerless Prodigy’.”
As he said this, Ma Yu felt a wave of emotion.
In his view, Yang Fan would inevitably become a truly prominent figure in the Federation in the future, and what he was doing now was merely an advance investment.
If not for this loan contract of one million Divinity Points, where would he have found the opportunity to get acquainted with a Peerless Prodigy?

“Transfer all of Elephant Loan’s current liquid funds to me shortly. Also, after I become a God in the future, I will create my own company. If you are willing, you can come and help me,” Yang Fan said seriously.
As soon as these words were spoken, Ma Yu’s eyes lit up instantly, and he abruptly stood up.
“Thank you, Young Master Yan—no, thank you, Boss!”
At this moment, his face was filled with excitement that was hard to suppress.
After returning to reality, Yang Fan’s consciousness immediately entered his Divine Kingdom.
“Congratulations, Master,” Yang Da appeared at the very first moment, his tone clearly excited.
Ma Yu moved fast; the full eighty billion Divinity Points had already arrived in the account.
Seeing that enormous number, even Yang Fan couldn’t help taking a deep breath.
“First, purchase a Great Void Warship. The remaining funds will be arranged by you, with priority given to raising the believers’ strength,” Yang Fan commanded directly.
“Yes, Master,” Yang Da responded immediately.

“Also, increase the investment in Mechanical Civilization. Now that funds are sufficient, foster Second-class Intelligent Life as quickly as possible. The production efficiency of Smart Weapons should also be raised. More and more believers are fighting outside now, and the current supply of Smart Weapons is too low.”

Unlike Cultivation and Martial Arts routes, the biggest limitation of Mechanical Civilization was funding. Now that he had these 80 billion Divinity Points, it was time to make up for this shortcoming.

Hearing this, Yang Da’s eyes noticeably brightened. “Rest assured, Master. With these funds, it will take at most a few hundred years for a Second-class Intelligent Life to be born in the Divine Kingdom.”
Yang Fan nodded slightly and continued, “In addition, the Great Void Warship purchased this time will not be used for Divine Kingdom War.”
“Master, this...” Yang Da was clearly stunned.

“The aura of the soul nourishing wood is growing richer, and the risk of exposing the Divine Kingdom’s coordinates is constantly rising. This Great Void Warship will be used for the Divine Kingdom’s defense.”

Hearing the explanation, the corner of Yang Da’s mouth twitched slightly. “Master, the defense force of the Divine Kingdom is already strong enough now. Adding another Great Void Warship, wouldn’t it be a bit...”
“Do as I say. With the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, the safety of the Divine Kingdom will always come first,” Yang Fan interrupted.
“Yes,” Yang Da nodded helplessly.
After arranging everything, Yang Fan’s consciousness returned to reality, and he continued with today’s study tasks.
And Yang Da’s estimation was not wrong. After only five days in the Real World, Yang Fan clearly felt the changes in the Divine Kingdom.
Inside the room, Yang Fan took a sharp breath.
The next moment, his spirit jolted as if an invisible shackle had been broken, and a massive influx of information flooded into his mind.
Inside the Divine Kingdom, the first Second-class Intelligent Life was officially born.

With the emergence of Second-class Intelligent Life, Yang Da, as the highest intelligence of the Divine Kingdom, also achieved a Breakthrough. And Yang Fan, as the God, similarly received a massive feedback.
At this moment, Yang Fan felt as though his spirit had undergone a transformation, and the entire world became exceptionally clear in his eyes.
He could vaguely sense the air flow and energy changes in his surroundings, and even his thought process speed surged by a massive margin.
This improvement was immediate; books that previously took hours to read could now be analyzed and organized by his brain after a single glance.
In less than a few quarter-hours, a thick, heavy tome was completely browsed through.
Not only that, but his comprehension, logic, and memory capabilities all underwent a qualitative shift.
Yang Fan even felt that with his current brain, he was already comparable to an ordinary computer.
Even without relying on the assistance of Intelligent Life, he could use his own spirit to quickly filter and organize vast amounts of information in the Virtual World.
“Is this the feedback brought by Mechanical Civilization...” Yang Fan slowly raised his right hand.
The next moment, the Smart Weapons materialized from inside the Divine Kingdom instantly turned into countless Mechanical modules, beginning to frantically assemble and combine.
Clack—
In just a brief moment, those Smart Weapons completely encased Yang Fan’s body. The entire Mechanical suit of armor fit seamlessly, as if connected to his flesh and nerves.
Yang Fan could clearly feel that these Smart Weapons were no longer simple external objects, but felt like an extension of his own body. With just a single thought, he could control them completely.
As the Mechanical Path caught up, Yang Fan felt his strength undergo another massive boost.
Over the next few days, Yang Fan stayed in his new home.
While keeping an eye on the development of his Divine Kingdom, he frantically absorbed all kinds of knowledge.
As Mechanical Civilization continued to develop, his learning efficiency grew increasingly terrifying.
Current Yang Fan even felt a sense of obsession with it.
That sense of fulfillment from growing stronger every single moment was more addictive than any form of entertainment.
However, on this day, a guest suddenly arrived outside the villa.
“The residence allocated to a Peerless Prodigy really is different. It’s much quieter here than at my place,” a familiar voice echoed.
Gu Le pushed open the door and stepped straight in, her movements as natural as if she were returning to her own home.

Without even bothering to greet him, after entering the courtyard, she first looked around, then sat down directly in the courtyard pavilion, crossing her long legs slightly, and even pulled out a spirit fruit from her Divine Kingdom to take a bite.
That appearance of hers was just like that of the lady of the house.
Only then did Yang Fan put down his book and look up. “Is something up?”

As Mechanical Civilization continued to develop, his learning efficiency grew increasingly terrifying.
Current Yang Fan even felt a sense of obsession with it.
That sense of fulfillment from growing stronger every single moment was more addictive than any form of entertainment.
However, on this day, a guest suddenly arrived outside the villa.
“The residence allocated to a Peerless Prodigy really is different.
It’s much quieter here than at my place,” a familiar voice echoed.
Gu Le pushed open the door and stepped straight in, her movements as natural as if she were returning to her own home.

Without even bothering to greet him, after entering the courtyard, she first looked around, then sat down directly in the courtyard pavilion, crossing her long legs slightly, and even pulled out a spirit fruit from her Divine Kingdom to take a bite.
That appearance of hers was just like that of the lady of the house.
Only then did Yang Fan put down his book and look up.
“Is something up?”

chapters.title: Chapter 198: Keeping One's Abilities Concealed
paragraphs: Hearing this, Gu Le immediately rolled her eyes, “Come on, the two of us just signed a marriage contract, and we’re husband and wife now. Do you have to be so cold?”
Speaking of this, Gu Le was obviously a bit depressed.

In the past few days, she had actually sent Yang Fan quite a few messages, but the other party stubbornly didn’t reply to a single one. In the end, she had to pull strings just to find Yang Fan’s current residence.

The reason why Yang Fan was like this was mainly because the improvements brought by the Mechanical Path were too exaggerated. As his learning efficiency skyrocketed, Yang Fan was almost completely immersed in an ocean of knowledge.

Gu Le helplessly sighed, “The development of a Divine Kingdom isn’t something that happens in a day or two. You have to give it time to slowly evolve, right? Do you want to accompany your wife out for a stroll?”
“I still have a lot of things to do.” Yang Fan politely refused.
“No way! Are you an ascetic monk? Although we are married, the Gu Family is still counting on us to take our relationship a step further. It would be best if we have a child.”

“You aren’t impotent, are you? How about artificial cultivation through genetic technology? That way it won’t delay you as you Cultivate, and the efficiency is still high.” Gu Le said in shock, with a heart-wrenching expression on her face, as if she had suffered a huge loss.
Yang Fan: “...”
The air fell silent for a few seconds, and Yang Fan finally couldn’t hold it in anymore, “I’m not very interested, but that doesn’t mean I can’t. How about trying it tonight?”
When saying this, Yang Fan’s gaze involuntarily fell on Gu Le’s graceful figure, and his state of mind, which had been calm for a long time, produced a trace of fluctuation.
Yang Fan’s state of mind had improved greatly, and he was no longer burdened by beauty, but as a dignified man of seven feet, how could he be said to be incapable?

Furthermore, his Divine Kingdom had three paths running in parallel. As a god, Yang Fan’s Physical Body and spirit far exceeded ordinary demigods. Not to mention tossing and turning for one night, even if it were for several consecutive days, he would still be full of vitality.
As for whether Gu Le could take it... that was hard to say.
“Alright.” Gu Le cupped her chin with both hands, looking at Yang Fan with a smile.
“Coincidentally, there is a gathering tonight. Do you want to accompany me? Then we’ll come back to take care of business.”
“A gathering?”
“The direct descendants and geniuses of the Five Great Giants, as well as quite a few SS-grade Peerless Prodigies will all be present.”

“The number of people isn’t large, just a few hundred. It can be considered a gathering of the top batch of Prodigies among the younger generation in Taichu City. Besides students, quite a few Senior students who have already graduated will also come.”

Speaking of this, Gu Le’s tone also became slightly more serious, “When we become gods in the future, regardless of our identity, we must go to The Frontline to serve. The essence of this gathering is also for the younger generation to make contact in advance. In the future, whichever theater of war you want to go to, whichever legion you want to join, and who you want to team up with can all be arranged in advance.”
While saying these words, Gu Le’s gaze remained fixed on Yang Fan’s eyes.
“No problem.” Yang Fan nodded.
By now, he had long since understood the rules by which the world operated.
Family, connections, interests, and cooperation—these Real World social interactions were equally important for the development of a Divine Kingdom.
Furthermore, Yang Fan truly wanted to witness what kind of abilities that top batch of Prodigies in Taichu City actually possessed.
Seeing Yang Fan agree so readily, Gu Le was instead somewhat speechless.
When she invited him out to play, he directly refused, but as soon as he heard it was a top Prodigy gathering, he immediately agreed.
“You really are realistic!” Gu Le rolled her eyes in exasperation.
“Didn’t you also want me to go?” Yang Fan asked in return.
Hearing this, Gu Le was stunned for a moment, and then chuckled, “That’s true. As my husband, he cannot be good-for-nothing. Only a person who is sufficiently realistic and calm can go further.”
After saying this, Gu Le slowly stood up, walked in front of Yang Fan with her slender legs, and gently brushed her fingers across Yang Fan’s cheek.
Those pretty eyes were filled with a faint, elusive allure.
However, the next moment, Yang Fan suddenly reached out and pulled her into his arms.
The distance between the two of them instantly closed, and even their breathing was clearly audible.
“Starting right now?” Yang Fan lowered his head and looked at her.
Gu Le originally still carried a bit of a teasing tone, but being suddenly embraced like this by Yang Fan, her face instantly turned red with a swoosh.
That bold look from just now instantly vanished, and instead, she looked like a frightened little rabbit.
“Th... There’s still a gathering tonight!”
Gu Le hurriedly broke free, then turned and ran, rushing into a room in the villa, slamming the door shut with a “bang” and locking it from the inside along the way.
Leaving only Yang Fan standing in place, the corners of his mouth curving up slightly.
“Is that it?”
Yang Fan smiled dismissively. As a battle-hardened “Great God” from Tianxiang Renjian in the past, Gu Le’s little level of skill just now was, in his eyes, simply as novice as novice could be.
“As a direct descendant of the Gu Family, her ability is strong and her brain is shrewd, but it’s quite unexpected that she’s actually quite pure.” Yang Fan chuckled inwardly.
Especially thinking of Gu Le’s panic-stricken appearance just now, compared to her previous bold teasing of him, the contrast was truly a bit strong.
Soon, time came to the evening.
Yang Fan changed into a set of clothes and then left the villa with Gu Le.

The gathering was held in the Real World. After all, having reached the current level, the Virtual World was mostly just for convenient communication; truly important gatherings and circle contact still leaned towards reality.
Center of Taichu City.

A huge restaurant stood under the night veil, neon lights flowing, suspended light screens intertwined, and the entire building was like an interstellar palace in a future metropolis, magnificent and luxurious.
Seeing this scene before him, even Yang Fan couldn’t help but be slightly surprised.
You must know that the overall style of Taichu City had always been retro and minimalist, with a large number of buildings carrying the aura of a Cultivate civilization.
But the place before his eyes was completely like a different style, even giving Yang Fan the feeling of suddenly arriving on a Vacation Planet.

“How is it, not bad right?” Gu Le put her hands behind her back and smiled slightly, “The land here was bought together by the Five Great Families, specially for the younger generation to hold gatherings.”
“Inside there is everything, racing tracks, virtual battle pavilions, private cocktail parties, entertainment areas, hot springs...”
“Anyway, as long as you can think of entertainment projects, you can basically find them here.”

Speaking of this, Gu Le gently shrugged, “The Virtual World is ultimately different from reality. Most of the time during the development of a Divine Kingdom, gods are just waiting, and Taichu City is usually too boring, so one always has to find some fun for oneself.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded slightly.
This was indeed a fact. For most people, the development of a Divine Kingdom required a lot of time to precipitate, and even with Yang Fan’s Evolution Talent, it was no exception.
Right at this moment, a familiar voice suddenly came from ahead.
“Brother Yang!” Sima Bang and Sima Tianci were just walking straight toward them.
“You’re here! I sent you a message and you didn’t reply, I thought you weren’t going to participate in this gathering.” Sima Bang said with a pleasantly surprised face.
Today he was obviously much steadier, and a tailor-made black formal suit set off his entire person as quite upright and tall.
“I’ve been quite busy recently.”
Yang Fan gave a simple explanation, then turned his head to look at Sima Tianci, “Brother Tianci, thank you very much for the matter last time.”
“Just a small matter.” Sima Tianci waved his hand.

“Speaking of which, you kid are really enviable. The investment contract given to you by the Gu Family has now completely spread within the small circle, and the specifications are much higher than those of other Prodigies.”
Speaking of this, Sima Tianci’s gaze flickered slightly, “I heard... it was even greeted personally by a veteran Senior of the Gu Family. You kid are really keeping your abilities concealed!”

chapters.title: Chapter 199: Gu Jiuheng, Cousin
paragraphs: At this moment, Sima Tianci’s gaze towards Yang Fan noticeably carried a bit more scrutiny.
To the outside world, the investment contracts of Peerless Prodigies are considered confidential.
However, within the Five Great Giants, these matters are hardly secrets at all; to a certain extent, they are even part of the comparisons made between top geniuses.

It is just like: “So what if your strength is greater? My investment specification is higher than yours, which means the Family is more optimistic about me, and I am bound to be stronger in the future.”
“Is that so?” Yang Fan narrowed his eyes slightly.
Compared to the other four major families, the investment amount given by the Gu Family was indeed much higher.
However, back then Yang Fan didn’t think too much about it.
It’s just... a veteran-level Senior?
At this moment, a figure suddenly flashed across Yang Fan’s mind—Senior Gu Yuan.
That old man who left a deep impression on him in the Primordial Battlefield.
However, very soon, Yang Fan shook his head and stopped thinking about it.
Even if it really was the other party, it wouldn’t make any difference for him to know now.
An existence of that level isn’t someone he can just meet whenever he wants right now; it’s impossible for him to make a special trip to their doorstep just to say thank you.
Soon, the group of four walked inside the restaurant.
The lobby was extremely spacious, with floating light screens, holographic projections, and Mechanical attendants shuttling back and forth.
Around them were quite a few young men and women in formal attire, most of whom exuded the aura of demigods.
As Sima Tianci entered the lobby, many people immediately took the initiative to step forward and greet him.
“Brother Tianci, after graduation, will I have a chance to hang around your side?”
“Is military merit on The Frontline really as hard to get as the rumors say?”
“I heard that The Frontline battle zone started large-scale conscription again recently. Is that true or false?”
Facing everyone’s inquiries, Sima Tianci always maintained a faint smile, his tone lazy yet not perfunctory.
“Military merit is naturally not that easy to obtain; that requires killing an Alien God.”
“As for joining the legion I’m in...” Sima Tianci swept his gaze over the crowd, “After you graduate, you will all have a chance.”
At the same time, someone also noticed Yang Fan.
“Brother Yang, congratulations!”
“That investment contract from the Gu Family has made us green with envy now. I’m afraid we won’t be able to catch up to you completely in the future.”
“When the time comes to arrive at The Frontline in the future, Brother Yang must take care of us more.”
Yang Fan turned his head to look and discovered that the person speaking was none other than Qin Yang and the others.
Standing beside him were also Sima Ling, Lu Chen, Gu Xingzhou, and a group of others.
These people were almost all geniuses at the very front of the rankings in the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle, though not all of the top ten prodigies came.
Because what was truly important in this gathering was never the identity of a “Genius”, but rather the direct-line background of the Five Great Giants.

Hearing what several people said, Yang Fan smiled and said: “You flatter me, everyone. If there is an opportunity in the future, I will naturally participate in the Divine Kingdom War together with everyone, fight side by side, and jointly guard the territory of the Federation.”
Yang Fan’s words were extremely official.

Jointly participating in the Divine Kingdom War with others was not something Yang Fan planned to do at all. After all, his divine kingdom had too many secrets, and with the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, developing independently was the way to maximize benefits.
However, Yang Fan had learned quite a few diplomatic pleasantries by now. Sometimes, interpersonal communication itself is also a science.
Just as everyone was conversing, a man walked over from not far away.

The other party wore a black military uniform, with a tall and upright figure, and steady, powerful strides. Just by walking over, he gave off an iron-blooded aura of one seasoned in battle, resembling a Vicious Beast hiding its sharpness.
Seeing the newcomer, Yang Fan subconsciously straightened his back.
“This person is even stronger than Sima Tianci; I’m afraid he has already reached a Tier 3 God!” Yang Fan was secretly startled in his heart.
As his own strength continued to increase, his perception became increasingly acute. Even when facing a true god, he could use their aura to vaguely judge the other party’s approximate level.
And the person before him gave him a feeling much more dangerous than Luo Hai, yet it seemed he hadn’t truly stepped into the Mid-tier God level.
“Cousin!” Gu Le immediately waved her hand, while very naturally locking her arm with Yang Fan’s. “I thought you weren’t coming today.”
The man smiled faintly, “I heard you got married, so I had to come and see what skills this brother-in-law of mine has.”
As he spoke, the other party’s gaze landed on Yang Fan.
In an instant, Yang Fan only felt an extremely strong mental pressure suddenly descend.

That feeling was similar to the eye of the god faced during the first stage of the Heavenly Pride Apotheosis Battle, but the difference was that all the pressure was now concentrated entirely on him alone.
Resembling a heavy hammer, it smashed down fiercely.
Even with Yang Fan’s current mental strength, he felt an extremely strong sense of oppression.
But in the next second, that aura quickly vanished, as if nothing had happened.
“Cousin, your taste is not bad.” The man nodded with satisfaction.
Gu Le immediately raised her chin, “Of course, this is the person I chose myself.”

Then she looked at Yang Fan with a smile, “Honey, let me introduce you. Gu Jiuheng, graduated from Primordial Academy 30 years ago, is already a Tier 3 God, and a brigade commander of the Ninth Legion on The Frontline. By seniority, he’s my cousin.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s heart was slightly shaken.
Reaching a Tier 3 God around the age of fifty, the other party’s divine kingdom talent was definitely not simple.
You must know that in Yang County, Luo Hai of the Luo Family was only a Tier 3 God, yet the other party didn’t know how many tens of thousands of years he had lived.
The gap between gods is sometimes even greater than that between Mortals and gods.
“Greetings, Cousin.” Yang Fan bowed slightly.

Gu Jiuheng waved his hand, his attitude quite gentle, “No need to be so polite. Since you’ve entered the Gu Family, you’re one of us. After you graduate from Primordial Academy in the future, you can come work under my command.”

Before Yang Fan could even respond, Sima Tianci on the side couldn’t help interrupting first, “Little Brother Yang, don’t listen to Cousin and go to the Ninth Legion. That place is simply a wolf’s den, with mandatory quotas for hunting Alien Gods every year. You wouldn’t even be able to rest for two days.”

Hearing this, Gu Jiuheng rolled his eyes immediately, “Just because you like to slack off yourself, don’t think others are just like you. Possessing the ‘Dao Child’ talent, yet lying flat in the Fifth Legion every day, don’t go corrupting my brother-in-law.”
“What do you mean by lying flat? I call that combining work with rest.” Sima Tianci coughed twice immediately.

Gu Jiuheng couldn’t be bothered with him and instead looked at Yang Fan, “The Ninth Legion does have mandatory missions, but they are mainly aimed at ordinary gods. Since you are a person of my Gu Family, naturally you won’t have restrictions in this regard.”
Yang Fan nodded slightly, “Thank you for your care, Cousin.”
Although he didn’t understand the rules of The Frontline legions, he could feel that Gu Jiuheng harbored no malice towards him.
Soon, as more and more people entered the restaurant, the banquet officially began.
In the center of the hall, the floating orchestra began to play, and soothing, melodious music slowly resounded.
A large number of Mechanical attendants shuttled back and forth carrying drinks and spiritual fruits, and the atmosphere at the scene gradually grew lively.
Many young men and women raised their glasses to toast each other, and some gathered together to converse in low voices.
Discussing divine kingdom development, legion prospects, The Frontline battle zones, and even the recent movements of certain alien races.

Gu Jiuheng waved his hand, his attitude quite gentle, “No need to be so polite.
Since you’ve entered the Gu Family, you’re one of us.
After you graduate from Primordial Academy in the future, you can come work under my command.”
Before Yang Fan could even respond, Sima Tianci on the side couldn’t help interrupting first, “Little Brother Yang, don’t listen to Cousin and go to the Ninth Legion.
That place is simply a wolf’s den, with mandatory quotas for hunting Alien Gods every year.
You wouldn’t even be able to rest for two days.”
Hearing this, Gu Jiuheng rolled his eyes immediately, “Just because you like to slack off yourself, don’t think others are just like you.
Possessing the ‘Dao Child’ talent, yet lying flat in the Fifth Legion every day, don’t go corrupting my brother-in-law.”
“What do you mean by lying flat?
I call that combining work with rest.” Sima Tianci coughed twice immediately.
Gu Jiuheng couldn’t be bothered with him and instead looked at Yang Fan, “The Ninth Legion does have mandatory missions, but they are mainly aimed at ordinary gods.
Since you are a person of my Gu Family, naturally you won’t have restrictions in this regard.”
Yang Fan nodded slightly, “Thank you for your care, Cousin.”
Although he didn’t understand the rules of The Frontline legions, he could feel that Gu Jiuheng harbored no malice towards him.
Soon, as more and more people entered the restaurant, the banquet officially began.
In the center of the hall, the floating orchestra began to play, and soothing, melodious music slowly resounded.
A large number of Mechanical attendants shuttled back and forth carrying drinks and spiritual fruits, and the atmosphere at the scene gradually grew lively.
Many young men and women raised their glasses to toast each other, and some gathered together to converse in low voices.
Discussing divine kingdom development, legion prospects, The Frontline battle zones, and even the recent movements of certain alien races.

chapters.title: Chapter 200: The Wager Match
paragraphs: In the grand hall, small social circles gradually began to form.
Between these circles, people constantly bustled back and forth, offering flattering smiles and pleasantries.
Exchanging greetings, making small talk, feeling each other out, or trying to climb the social ladder.
Yang Fan stood in a corner, quietly watching all of this.
Most of those who could come here were direct descendants of the Five Great Giants.
Outsiders with different surnames like him were extremely rare; only those evaluated as Peerless Prodigies and invested in by the Five Great Giants were qualified to enter.
As for true God-level powerhouses, like Gu Jiuheng and Sima Tianci, there were only five or six in the entire hall.
Most were still demigods like Yang Fan, who had not yet graduated from the Primordial Academy.
The gathering before him was actually faintly divided into five camps, each corresponding to one of the Five Great Giants’ families.
Although the Five Great Families intermarried and had long since become deeply intertwined with one another,
and would join forces to resist external enemies when facing foreign threats, competition still existed alongside cooperation.
Just like Gu Jiuheng, who primarily prioritized recruiting members of the Gu Family into his own legion.
Yang Fan slowly raised his glass and drank the red wine in one gulp.

In the hall, some of these so-called favored children of heaven conversed loudly, some toasted each other, and some lowered their postures just to be able to enter the other party’s legion in the future.
This scene unexpectedly gave rise to a trace of boredom in Yang Fan’s heart.
He suddenly understood that no matter what heights a person reached, they were merely moving from one circle into another.
Figures who once seemed completely out of reach were still shrouded by even greater rules within their own worlds.
Some looked up at the starry sky, while others bowed their heads to make a living.
And so-called growth was nothing more than transitioning from being pushed along by life to actively stepping into a larger chessboard.

People always think that climbing higher will allow them to escape the mundane world, but only after truly standing at the top do they realize they have merely stepped from one cage into an even larger world.
Everyone in the world envies those on the clouds. Little do they know, there are hardships at the foot of the mountain, and tribulations above the clouds.
“Hubby, does this feel a bit boring?” Gu Le walked over holding a wine glass and casually refilled Yang Fan’s glass with red wine.
“A bit,” Yang Fan replied, making no attempt to hide it.
In the past, Yang Fan lived in a small place like Yang County.
To survive, his parents spent every day commanding their believers to mine, sell Resources, and earn Faith Points, all just to pay rent and buy daily necessities.
Meanwhile, Yang Fan would stay in his room every day, logging into the Virtual World to attend classes and study, before returning to the Real World to eat and sleep.
After his Divine Kingdom’s Awakening, he also basically developed on his own with the help of the virtual Divine Shop, at most gathering information from group chats.
This was his first time attending a gathering of such a truly top-tier social circle.
The scene was luxurious and bustling. Although it was boring, it also allowed Yang Fan’s mind, which had been tense from long-term study, to relax slightly.

Gu Le gently swirled her wine glass. “Actually, the development of a Divine Kingdom inherently requires Time Evolution. Especially after the appearance of Intelligent Life, we, as Gods, don’t need to keep our eyes on our Divine Kingdoms at all times.”
“And this kind of gathering is actually set up by the High-Order Gods of the Five Great Families.”
“Set up by High-Order Gods?” Yang Fan was somewhat surprised.
“That’s right.” Gu Le nodded gently. “As a Divine Kingdom continues to develop, a God will possess increasingly unimaginable power.”
“The Physical Body, mind, and Soul will all continue to strengthen, and this kind of power... will make a God increasingly rational.”
“Divinity will gradually surpass Humanity.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s brow furrowed slightly, a look of doubt appearing in his eyes.
Gu Le continued, “In fact, I don’t know what’s bad about this either, but my mother once said something.”
“‘Gods also evolved from humans. Joy, anger, sorrow, happiness, greed, anger, ignorance, and hatred—if all of these are discarded... then in the end, is what remains still yourself?'”
As she finished speaking, Gu Le herself became slightly dazed, as if recalling the way her mother looked when she said those words.
Yang Fan lowered his head in deep thought, feeling that there seemed to be some truth to it, but he couldn’t put it clearly into words for the moment.
“If you can’t figure it out, then don’t think about it.” Gu Le stretched out her left hand and placed it naturally on Yang Fan’s shoulder.
Then, she asked with a smile, “After everyone has had a few drinks, there will be a wager duel. Do you want to give it a try?”
“A wager duel?” Yang Fan raised an eyebrow slightly.

“It’s just a match between geniuses. When the time comes, they’ll enter the Virtual World, and the rules of the match will be decided by both parties. They can fight in person, or have a Divine Kingdom War. The stakes can be Resources, Wonders, or buildings. It’s just for a bit of fun anyway.”
“But remember, small wagers are fun, so don’t play too big,” Gu Le specifically reminded him.
Yang Fan hearing this, shook his head gently. He didn’t have much interest in this kind of wager duel.
Compared to fighting and competing with others, he now wanted to end the gathering early and take Gu Le home.
Since he had decided to indulge himself for once, he might as well go all the way tonight.
He was a low-key person who didn’t want to show off in front of these big Family disciples; he just wanted to go home and ‘get intimate’.

As the atmosphere of the banquet grew increasingly lively, a staff member suddenly stepped onto the high platform, holding a microphone, and said, “Everyone, the virtual helmets are ready. If anyone wants to participate in a wager duel or enter the Virtual World to watch, you may put on a helmet to enter.”
“These helmets have fixed coordinates. The Martial Arena, Divine Kingdom Simulation Battlefields, and multi-player confrontation areas are all open.”
“I wish you all a wonderful time.”
As the staff member finished speaking, the entire hall instantly became even more boisterous.
“Brother Lu, you won a Wonder from me last month. Let’s compete again this time, I’ll definitely make you spit it back out!”
“Brother, we’re from the same class, why don’t we go play a bit?”
“Nothing too big, how about one Spiritual Vein?”
“A Spiritual Vein??? Are you trying to scam me, kid?”
Sounds of teasing, laughter, and exasperation rang out continuously, making the atmosphere extremely relaxed.
Even those high-and-mighty Prodigies looked no different from ordinary young people at this moment.
“Let’s go.”
Gu Le handed a virtual helmet to Yang Fan, then winked. “When the event is over, we can get a room here. Or we can go home.”
After saying that, she was the first to put on her helmet.
After a brief moment of dazed consciousness, Yang Fan slowly opened his eyes.

What met his eyes was an extremely vast, special space that seemed to exist between reality and illusion. The ground beneath his feet, the flow of air, and even his tactile perception were terrifyingly realistic, almost no different from the Real World.
All around, massive arenas towered, with quite a few Gods already clashing within them.
Close-quarters combat and mental secret techniques clashed, and the shockwaves of battle continuously rippled outward.
As for the sky above, massive battlefields floated there.
Those were the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battlefields, which could directly project the consciousness of believers into them.
Most importantly, there was no limit on the number of participants here, and even if the believers suffered a total wipeout, they would not truly die, making it a high-standard recreational venue.
